Its material choices\n"},{"number":240,"text":"account for context, attention, time, effort, computation, communication\n"},{"number":241,"text":"and the other relevant resources, together with feedback delay,\n"},{"number":242,"text":"uncertainty, integration exposure and rework; planning, checking and\n"},{"number":243,"text":"coordination consume resources too. Measures that justify a choice state\n"},{"number":244,"text":"their units, boundaries and composition rules, and keep estimates,\n"},{"number":245,"text":"assumptions and observations distinguishable. Several objectives can\n"},{"number":246,"text":"leave alternatives incomparable; the owning criteria decide the tradeoff.\n"},{"number":247,"text":"Steel thread, phased (waterfall) delivery and iterative delivery are\n"},{"number":248,"text":"possible strategies, each with its own costs, feedback delays, integration risks and rework.\n"},{"number":249,"text":"The selection belongs to the realisation and to the actor exercising the\n"},{"number":250,"text":"admitted work authority; its material rationale is stated in existing\n"},{"number":251,"text":"design or work records, and a claim that one strategy is superior states\n"},{"number":252,"text":"the objectives, comparison and assumptions it depends on. No exhaustive\n"},{"number":253,"text":"optimisation, universal numerical budget, scalar cost measure or preferred\n"},{"number":254,"text":"strategy is imposed by this relation or its consumers (P2, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":255,"text":"Context bounds what one activation can hold and attention what it can\n"},{"number":256,"text":"use; the frame selects the material and the task contract of one step,\n"},{"number":257,"text":"and the destination stays Z across the activations that reach it\n"},{"number":258,"text":"([§2](#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope)).\n"},{"number":259,"text":"\n"},{"number":260,"text":"Composition boundaries. A composition boundary is the boundary between\n"},{"number":261,"text":"successive steps, where one step's output becomes the next step's\n"},{"number":262,"text":"starting state. It is distinct from a categorical join, which is a map\n"},{"number":263,"text":"between categories ([FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra)). Steps\n"},{"number":264,"text":"compose through compatible preconditions, effects, results and authority,\n"},{"number":265,"text":"and each boundary preserves the applicable outer obligations. Refinement\n"},{"number":266,"text":"can add detail and construction can change state within the permitted\n"},{"number":267,"text":"variation (§4). Decomposition, delegation, concurrent work and recursive\n"},{"number":268,"text":"application retain the affected obligations; independent actions may\n"},{"number":269,"text":"proceed concurrently where their dependencies, effects and authority\n"},{"number":270,"text":"permit. Local success supplies end-to-end success only when the required\n"},{"number":271,"text":"coverage, composition compatibility and outcome evidence hold; the\n"},{"number":272,"text":"obligations a chain of steps must discharge are\n"},{"number":273,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Preservation through construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#preservation-through-construction).\n"},{"number":274,"text":"A categorical claim about a construction meets the demonstration of\n"},{"number":275,"text":"FOUNDATIONS §4 (P4a, P1, P6).\n"},{"number":276,"text":"\n"},{"number":277,"text":"Feedback and diagnosis. Feedback observes the current subject, compares\n"},{"number":278,"text":"it with the governing conditions, diagnoses a material discrepancy,\n"},{"number":279,"text":"selects an authorised response, acts and observes the result. Homeostasis\n"},{"number":280,"text":"means correction towards the required conditions as disturbances and new\n"},{"number":281,"text":"observations arise; it guarantees neither convergence nor the adequacy of\n"},{"number":282,"text":"those conditions. For work management a bug is a category of\n"},{"number":283,"text":"feature/change work: an observed or suspected discrepancy handled through\n"},{"number":284,"text":"the same intake and delivery mechanism\n"},{"number":285,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §4 Universal intake triage](SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage)).\n"},{"number":286,"text":"Diagnosis distinguishes four causes: a defective realisation, an\n"},{"number":287,"text":"inadequate governing requirement or design, an inaccurate predictive\n"},{"number":288,"text":"model, and insufficient observation. A prediction error alone does not\n"},{"number":289,"text":"decide whether the required outcome holds. A revised model does not erase\n"},{"number":290,"text":"the counterexample or by itself repair the realisation. Diagnosis preserves unresolved\n"},{"number":291,"text":"alternatives and routes each supported repair to the owner of its cause;\n"},{"number":292,"text":"the intake label supplies no repair class and no permission. Severity\n"},{"number":293,"text":"describes consequence; priority orders the response under the selected\n"},{"number":294,"text":"outcome, dependencies, resources and authority. A bug list projects\n"},{"number":295,"text":"existing work state and creates no separate delivery or authority\n"},{"number":296,"text":"mechanism (P1, P2, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":297,"text":"\n"},{"number":298,"text":"Preservation, progress and completion. Recursive and repeated work\n"},{"number":299,"text":"distinguish four claims: preservation, that an invariant or obligation is\n"},{"number":300,"text":"kept through the steps; progress, that the work moves towards Z on\n"},{"number":301,"text":"evidence; termination; and outcome satisfaction. A formal induction or\n"},{"number":302,"text":"termination claim supplies its premises and argument; no universal\n"},{"number":303,"text":"termination proof is required before bounded work can begin, and where\n"},{"number":304,"text":"such a proof is absent the claim stays within the available evidence.\n"},{"number":305,"text":"Continuing work has a supported purpose under the selected strategy,\n"},{"number":306,"text":"which can include reducing uncertainty or testing a bounded hypothesis.\n"},{"number":307,"text":"Discovery may enlarge the known work (Transitions above), and repeated\n"},{"number":308,"text":"activity alone establishes no progress. Control handles failure,\n"},{"number":309,"text":"unavailable information, uncertain effects and exhausted resources\n"},{"number":310,"text":"through the continuation, repair, recovery, re-entry, yield or stop that\n"},{"number":311,"text":"§3, §5 and §6 name. Resumption reacquires current reality and retains\n"},{"number":312,"text":"valid progress; unknown effects are resolved sufficiently before the next\n"},{"number":313,"text":"dependent action (§5). Ongoing maintenance can continue under its mandate; a\n"},{"number":314,"text":"delivery claim needs its completion condition. A resource limit can end\n"},{"number":315,"text":"an attempt with an unresolved outcome; it establishes neither achievement\n"},{"number":316,"text":"nor impossibility (P5, P2, P6).\n"},{"number":317,"text":"\n"},{"number":318,"text":"Evaluation and completion. Evaluation uses the core result algebra\n"},{"number":319,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results)), preserving failure,\n"},{"number":320,"text":"missing coverage and uncertainty. Formal proof, mechanical checking,\n"},{"number":321,"text":"testing and observed use establish their respective claims on their\n"},{"number":322,"text":"stated subjects, assumptions and boundaries\n"},{"number":323,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Assertions and observation](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation));\n"},{"number":324,"text":"an unavailable proof remains\n"},{"number":325,"text":"an explicit obligation where the governing conditions require that proof.\n"},{"number":326,"text":"Producing a candidate, proving a property and accepting delivery remain\n"},{"number":327,"text":"distinct acts ([EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#5-acceptance)). Completion\n"},{"number":328,"text":"requires sufficient evidence against Z, including its acceptance\n"},{"number":329,"text":"conditions; exhaustion or an unresolved attempt proves neither completion\n"},{"number":330,"text":"nor impossibility (P5, P6). A change to Z follows its owning authority and\n"},{"number":331,"text":"the re-entry rules of Transitions (Destination change); it establishes\n"},{"number":332,"text":"nothing about whether the former Z was reached, and the original\n"},{"number":333,"text":"counterexample stands.\n"},{"number":334,"text":"\n"},{"number":335,"text":"Ownership and limits. This subsection is the one owner of the\n"},{"number":336,"text":"construction relation in this corpus. Its consumers apply it where an\n"},{"number":337,"text":"actor enters construction, triage, recovery, assurance and release, and\n"},{"number":338,"text":"state no second relation. Domain strategy, actor configuration, execution\n"},{"number":339,"text":"mechanisms and additional assurance policies retain their owners:\n"},{"number":340,"text":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE for this corpus's Executive, PROFILES for the\n"},{"number":341,"text":"profiles, SPEC_METHOD §11 for the tenant's binding. The existing work and\n"},{"number":342,"text":"evidence carriers hold the necessary state ([TICKETS](TICKETS.md); the\n"},{"number":343,"text":"closed results of §7); the relation adds no independent ledger, required\n"},{"number":344,"text":"role sequence or orchestration runtime. It establishes no general solver,\n"},{"number":345,"text":"no fixed organisational structure, no guaranteed convergence and no\n"},{"number":346,"text":"theorem of categorical universality (P6, P2). Purpose and material\n"},{"number":347,"text":"relation: bounded activity can consume resources without delivering the\n"},{"number":348,"text":"intended outcome, and isolated checks can conceal a failed composition;\n"},{"number":349,"text":"the relation connects purpose, action, observation and correction so that\n"},{"number":350,"text":"features and defects alike remain governed by their end-to-end\n"},{"number":351,"text":"obligations (P2, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":352,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":390,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Intake","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FIntake","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"7f6e6e2ca37cd177cdd23d13dbf025cb6db5f411e256e9463a9a9912db809354","start_line":353,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":353,"text":"### Intake\n"},{"number":354,"text":"\n"},{"number":355,"text":"A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing\n"},{"number":356,"text":"relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory\n"},{"number":357,"text":"(P0, actor-change premise). The intake names:\n"},{"number":358,"text":"\n"},{"number":359,"text":"- the governed outcome or decision: the selected outcome, admitted\n"},{"number":360,"text":"  prerequisite or experiment it serves (P2);\n"},{"number":361,"text":"- the exact workspace subject and basis, and the inputs it may acquire,\n"},{"number":362,"text":"  each by identity and hash or by an input commit;\n"},{"number":363,"text":"- the evaluation or evaluation family the step performs and its result\n"},{"number":364,"text":"  algebra: the core of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) or\n"},{"number":365,"text":"  a refinement mapped into it (§3);\n"},{"number":366,"text":"- the bounded affected relation set and the applicable governing\n"},{"number":367,"text":"  invariants;\n"},{"number":368,"text":"- the accepted transformation-admission relations the step relies on (§4);\n"},{"number":369,"text":"- the selected computational or common-library dispositions: which\n"},{"number":370,"text":"  shared machinery serves the step and under what binding (FOUNDATIONS §4,\n"},{"number":371,"text":"  shared machinery);\n"},{"number":372,"text":"- the construction and assessment authority: the applicable frame-set,\n"},{"number":373,"text":"  semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority\n"},{"number":374,"text":"  (FOUNDATIONS §2, authority kinds), and the grant: the operations\n"},{"number":375,"text":"  permitted, the territory that may change, and the decisions reserved to\n"},{"number":376,"text":"  others (P6);\n"},{"number":377,"text":"- the available actor capability envelopes;\n"},{"number":378,"text":"- the conditions that make the result stale or out of scope, and the\n"},{"number":379,"text":"  conditions that require re-entry at an owning relation;\n"},{"number":380,"text":"- where the governed question is a cost claim, the allowance and how\n"},{"number":381,"text":"  spend will be measured (§6).\n"},{"number":382,"text":"\n"},{"number":383,"text":"Implementation folklore is not an intake source. Where a design profile\n"},{"number":384,"text":"applies, its bounded-frame conservation, transformation-admission\n"},{"number":385,"text":"completeness, invariant-reconstruction sufficiency and\n"},{"number":386,"text":"computational-realisation projection laws supply the affected set, the\n"},{"number":387,"text":"admission relations, the invariants and the computational dispositions;\n"},{"number":388,"text":"this section consumes those laws and creates no second design package\n"},{"number":389,"text":"([DESIGN_MODULE](DESIGN_MODULE.md)).\n"},{"number":390,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":401,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Execution unit","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FExecution%20unit","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"a5d9d74edbb898eda4ce8b6feef639486c96f1a7b834a1f527558dff623a568b","start_line":391,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":391,"text":"### Execution unit\n"},{"number":392,"text":"\n"},{"number":393,"text":"The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable\n"},{"number":394,"text":"of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing\n"},{"number":395,"text":"relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket\n"},{"number":396,"text":"field or design document (P0, P4b). A seam whose far side can causally affect,\n"},{"number":397,"text":"or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis\n"},{"number":398,"text":"establishes that it cannot participate. Unrelated incompleteness outside\n"},{"number":399,"text":"the cone is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded\n"},{"number":400,"text":"claim. The cone is the seed set Z of §2; the context is its projection.\n"},{"number":401,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":438,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Admission","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FAdmission","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"e85c6fdddd14033688ae2b8285bf4736c055b62ed6d8e5010d69badfec72948b","start_line":402,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":402,"text":"### Admission\n"},{"number":403,"text":"\n"},{"number":404,"text":"Drafting a step's contract and admitting it are distinct relations, even\n"},{"number":405,"text":"inside one invocation that drafts, validates, admits and executes; no\n"},{"number":406,"text":"separate turn, carrier or approval ceremony is implied by the distinction.\n"},{"number":407,"text":"A contract carries at minimum the states drafted, admitted, rejected and\n"},{"number":408,"text":"superseded ([TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#execution-contract-admission)).\n"},{"number":409,"text":"Execution begins only after deterministic admission or an\n"},{"number":410,"text":"explicit human override of the exact contract. The drafting actor never\n"},{"number":411,"text":"infers admission from its own draft, from the presence of a carrier\n"},{"number":412,"text":"(ticket, sprint entry, work contract), from lane placement or from an\n"},{"number":413,"text":"`active` label. The admitted result identifies the admission mechanism and\n"},{"number":414,"text":"its authority, the exact contract identity or digest, the decision and the\n"},{"number":415,"text":"evidence, including any human override; absent those coordinates the\n"},{"number":416,"text":"contract stays drafted or rejected, and prose asserting admission is not\n"},{"number":417,"text":"admission evidence (P6; the actor cannot self-certify its own execution\n"},{"number":418,"text":"basis). Admission validates the contract against its cited outcome,\n"},{"number":419,"text":"prerequisite or experiment basis; it does not admit that basis, and\n"},{"number":420,"text":"drafting, admitting or retaining a contract creates or renews no authority\n"},{"number":421,"text":"its owner has not admitted (P6, P2;\n"},{"number":422,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What\n"},{"number":423,"text":"creates no authority). Only an admitted contract activates a step: no\n"},{"number":424,"text":"result, child completion, tool output, model response, shared actor or\n"},{"number":425,"text":"lateral handoff activates another step or authorises continuation by\n"},{"number":426,"text":"itself, and a profile that routes results names its instances of this\n"},{"number":427,"text":"rule. Purpose and material relation: these admission conditions govern every\n"},{"number":428,"text":"configuration, and their generic owner is this section (P6).\n"},{"number":429,"text":"The admitted contract names one\n"},{"number":430,"text":"durable result and evidence surface; every result, withheld closure and\n"},{"number":431,"text":"residual obligation is recorded there before return, a conversation return\n"},{"number":432,"text":"alone is not durable evidence, and if no such surface is authorised and\n"},{"number":433,"text":"available, admission refuses (P4b). Absent or rejected admission returns\n"},{"number":434,"text":"the missing work authority without execution, as `admission_refused` with\n"},{"number":435,"text":"its cause ([§3 Admission and activation](#admission-and-activation)).\n"},{"number":436,"text":"The selection of the carrier (ticket, sprint entry, run-scoped contract)\n"},{"number":437,"text":"is owned by [TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#5-from-carrier-to-execution).\n"},{"number":438,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":488,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Applicability","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FApplicability","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"caf4dabcdb61ebf51e883db72e68472a52a88324eb4c57f4d140b8a35d272614","start_line":439,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":439,"text":"### Applicability\n"},{"number":440,"text":"\n"},{"number":441,"text":"The owning evaluation and scope declarations determine which frame\n"},{"number":442,"text":"obligations apply to the exact subject. Their declared predicates are\n"},{"number":443,"text":"evaluated from sufficient basis-bound facts: a true predicate requires the\n"},{"number":444,"text":"applicable evaluation and its result; a false predicate excludes only that\n"},{"number":445,"text":"obligation, under its cited authority; a missing or ambiguous premise\n"},{"number":446,"text":"leaves applicability unresolved, not false. A supported inapplicability\n"},{"number":447,"text":"of a conditional obligation is recorded as such, apart from any result\n"},{"number":448,"text":"value, and waives no criterion of the member's acceptance (P5, P6). A frame name, an available\n"},{"number":449,"text":"tool or a listed family triggers no activation by itself. Where\n"},{"number":450,"text":"applicability needs residual semantic judgment, that judgment and its\n"},{"number":451,"text":"evidence are retained as a judgment, never represented as a computed fact\n"},{"number":452,"text":"(P6, P1). A required result that is absent, stale, bound to another subject\n"},{"number":453,"text":"or basis, or incapable of establishing its claim cannot satisfy a dependent\n"},{"number":454,"text":"conjunction ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results));\n"},{"number":455,"text":"unresolved applicability withholds the dependent claim until\n"},{"number":456,"text":"sufficient evidence or the owning decision resolves it; other applicable\n"},{"number":457,"text":"constraints stay in force even if only one evaluation detects them (P4b,\n"},{"number":458,"text":"P5). Qualification of an applicability rule distinguishes true, false and\n"},{"number":459,"text":"unknown premises, required results that are missing or bound to the wrong\n"},{"number":460,"text":"subject, and a sufficient positive result, under a finite declared fixture;\n"},{"number":461,"text":"a rule that always skips or always activates cannot satisfy those distinct\n"},{"number":462,"text":"expected outcomes (EVALUATION §7).\n"},{"number":463,"text":"\n"},{"number":464,"text":"Exclusion and the core. Deciding applicability is an evaluation of the\n"},{"number":465,"text":"predicate \"the obligation applies to the exact subject\", and its result is\n"},{"number":466,"text":"a core value of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): a true\n"},{"number":467,"text":"predicate is `satisfied`; a false predicate is `falsified`, the\n"},{"number":468,"text":"basis-bound fact that makes it false being the counterexample; a missing\n"},{"number":469,"text":"or ambiguous premise is `indeterminate`, or `out_of_frame` where the\n"},{"number":470,"text":"premise needs a relation the frame does not declare, and never\n"},{"number":471,"text":"`falsified`. An exclusion is the state of the excluded obligation after a\n"},{"number":472,"text":"`falsified` applicability result: it is no result, the obligation's own\n"},{"number":473,"text":"evaluation is not performed and maps to no core value, and the obligation\n"},{"number":474,"text":"leaves the required coverage of a dependent conjunction under the cited\n"},{"number":475,"text":"authority of that applicability result. An obligation whose applicability is\n"},{"number":476,"text":"unresolved stays in that required coverage. A predicate that its owner\n"},{"number":477,"text":"declares as a disjunction that includes non-application, such as \"meets\n"},{"number":478,"text":"the axiom or does not apply\", may be `satisfied` because the obligation\n"},{"number":479,"text":"does not apply; that `satisfied` is for the declared disjunction only and\n"},{"number":480,"text":"never counts toward the predicate that the obligation holds\n"},{"number":481,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results),\n"},{"number":482,"text":"Predicates travel). Members, profiles and projects refer to this\n"},{"number":483,"text":"paragraph for exclusions and do not decide them again (P5, P6, P1).\n"},{"number":484,"text":"Purpose and material relation: an exclusion read as a result of the\n"},{"number":485,"text":"excluded obligation, or a \"does not apply\" counted toward that obligation,\n"},{"number":486,"text":"would report a skipped obligation as met; an unresolved premise read as an\n"},{"number":487,"text":"exclusion would drop an obligation that may apply.\n"},{"number":488,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":496,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Output","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FOutput","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"86500aae9bd210063a4f884bc042c103f65155591b4458cc679f25f7d2935313","start_line":489,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":489,"text":"### Output\n"},{"number":490,"text":"\n"},{"number":491,"text":"The step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts: judgments with\n"},{"number":492,"text":"their evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance, and\n"},{"number":493,"text":"one stop state, a value of construction availability (§3). The actor's\n"},{"number":494,"text":"internal path is not part of the output\n"},{"number":495,"text":"and is not governed (FOUNDATIONS §2, work boundary).\n"},{"number":496,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":618,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Configuration","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FConfiguration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"ec403de34eac27e779d3208d4365357c011c307d2e878ae79597c77549a13bd8","start_line":497,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":497,"text":"### Configuration\n"},{"number":498,"text":"\n"},{"number":499,"text":"A configuration allocates a task's responsibilities and information\n"},{"number":500,"text":"exchanges to frames; activation binds an actor to each frame (§2). It\n"},{"number":501,"text":"spans the task's work. The active frame configuration of\n"},{"number":502,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#frame-objects) is the part of it used for\n"},{"number":503,"text":"one evaluation or decision (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":504,"text":"\n"},{"number":505,"text":"Allocation. The allocation is derived from the task's operations, the\n"},{"number":506,"text":"dependencies among them, the capabilities of the available actors and the\n"},{"number":507,"text":"required assurance. These conditions constrain a configuration without\n"},{"number":508,"text":"determining it. One frame or several, fixed or adaptive allocation, a\n"},{"number":509,"text":"hierarchy, peer coordination, or an arrangement that changes as actors\n"},{"number":510,"text":"allocate work within their contracts may each be adequate. The method\n"},{"number":511,"text":"prescribes no role inventory, hierarchy, coordinator or actor sequence\n"},{"number":512,"text":"(P0, P2; [RF-016](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-016-implementation-neutrality)).\n"},{"number":513,"text":"\n"},{"number":514,"text":"Explanation. The design that selects a configuration explains its\n"},{"number":515,"text":"allocation, including the material resource limits it assumes, such as\n"},{"number":516,"text":"context, attention, time and spend, each declared as §6 Resource limits\n"},{"number":517,"text":"states, and its assumptions about failure. The\n"},{"number":518,"text":"explanation is recorded in the existing design, frame declarations and\n"},{"number":519,"text":"work records; no separate configuration carrier is required. It is\n"},{"number":520,"text":"proportional (§6): for a direct entry, the intake states it, its\n"},{"number":521,"text":"capability envelopes carrying the resource limits and its stale,\n"},{"number":522,"text":"out-of-scope and re-entry conditions the failure assumptions (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":523,"text":"\n"},{"number":524,"text":"Direct entry. A one-frame configuration is lawful. One directly\n"},{"number":525,"text":"authorised task that fits a sufficient frame may be entered directly, as\n"},{"number":526,"text":"Roles and delegation below states, subject to any separately required\n"},{"number":527,"text":"assessment (P0, P2).\n"},{"number":528,"text":"\n"},{"number":529,"text":"Evaluation of a configuration. A configuration is evaluated against the\n"},{"number":530,"text":"task, its dependencies, the actors' limits, the authority it applies and\n"},{"number":531,"text":"the required assurance. Its labels, its topology, and the presence or\n"},{"number":532,"text":"absence of a coordinator or of familiar roles neither accept nor reject\n"},{"number":533,"text":"it (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":534,"text":"\n"},{"number":535,"text":"Distinct relations. Within a configuration, the relation structures that\n"},{"number":536,"text":"[RF-009](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-009-no-assumed-hierarchy) lists as\n"},{"number":537,"text":"distinct stay distinct; RF-009 owns that list and the rule, and this\n"},{"number":538,"text":"section adds no structure to it and drops none. Naming or selecting a\n"},{"number":539,"text":"frame grants no authority\n"},{"number":540,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What\n"},{"number":541,"text":"creates no authority): each activation binds its subject, result algebra,\n"},{"number":542,"text":"actor capability and admitted authority through its intake (Intake above)\n"},{"number":543,"text":"and its activation (§2).\n"},{"number":544,"text":"\n"},{"number":545,"text":"Admission of a configuration. A configuration is admitted by the smallest\n"},{"number":546,"text":"existing authority that owns the material decision the configuration\n"},{"number":547,"text":"makes. One configuration may derive from several governing owners; each\n"},{"number":548,"text":"keeps its own decision, and admitting the configuration creates no new\n"},{"number":549,"text":"authority over them. An explicitly bounded proxy admits a configuration\n"},{"number":550,"text":"only inside its existing grant (FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds, Proxy\n"},{"number":551,"text":"limit). Which authority owns which decision is a binding of the method or\n"},{"number":552,"text":"profile that applies this rule; the executive configuration's binding is\n"},{"number":553,"text":"[EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §16](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#existing-authority-selects-the-configuration),\n"},{"number":554,"text":"which refers here for the rule (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":555,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a configuration allocates authority-bearing\n"},{"number":556,"text":"responsibilities, so admitting one by an authority that does not own the\n"},{"number":557,"text":"decision would move authority with position in the decomposition; the\n"},{"number":558,"text":"rule holds for every configuration, so it is stated here and not only in\n"},{"number":559,"text":"an optional profile.\n"},{"number":560,"text":"\n"},{"number":561,"text":"Reconfiguration. The allocation, and every reconfiguration, preserves the\n"},{"number":562,"text":"material dependencies, the outstanding obligations, the effects,\n"},{"number":563,"text":"including those of uncertain completion, the admitted authority and the\n"},{"number":564,"text":"required independence. A reconfiguration is any change of allocation\n"},{"number":565,"text":"during the work, including actors redistributing work among themselves\n"},{"number":566,"text":"and the changes §4 Reconfiguration selects after a result. An outstanding\n"},{"number":567,"text":"obligation and the results that depend on it move with the work. An\n"},{"number":568,"text":"effect of uncertain completion is resolved sufficiently for the next\n"},{"number":569,"text":"dependent action before that action (§3 Effects, §5). Required\n"},{"number":570,"text":"independence keeps its authorship and evidence conditions\n"},{"number":571,"text":"([EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment)), which a fresh\n"},{"number":572,"text":"context alone does not meet. An adaptive or self-organised arrangement is\n"},{"number":573,"text":"exempt from none of these conditions (P4b, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":574,"text":"\n"},{"number":575,"text":"Coordination across tasks. Where a configuration separates carrying out a\n"},{"number":576,"text":"bounded change from managing delivery across successive tasks, the frame\n"},{"number":577,"text":"that manages delivery, a coordinator, keeps the longer-term outcome. It\n"},{"number":578,"text":"decides from a sufficient bounded view of the closed results of the task\n"},{"number":579,"text":"frames (§7), not from their working context. When a decision needs\n"},{"number":580,"text":"information that view lacks, the coordinator acquires it through its\n"},{"number":581,"text":"permitted frame inputs or requests a further bounded evaluation. Missing\n"},{"number":582,"text":"information is never assumed favourable. A task result never omits a\n"},{"number":583,"text":"blocker material to delivery: a compact result keeps every residual and\n"},{"number":584,"text":"stop material to delivery, and its size is no evidence that none exists\n"},{"number":585,"text":"(P0, P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":586,"text":"\n"},{"number":587,"text":"Optimality. Adequacy and optimality are separate claims. A claim that a\n"},{"number":588,"text":"configuration is optimal is relative to stated objectives, constraints and\n"},{"number":589,"text":"comparison scope, and rests on evidence for that comparison. Familiarity,\n"},{"number":590,"text":"persistence or self-organisation is no such evidence. Different\n"},{"number":591,"text":"objectives or actor models can favour different configurations (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":592,"text":"\n"},{"number":593,"text":"Example. The executive configuration, which the\n"},{"number":594,"text":"[executive baseline profile](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md) defines, is one\n"},{"number":595,"text":"configuration, for task-based work in which a bounded change and delivery\n"},{"number":596,"text":"across tasks need separate attention. It allocates construction,\n"},{"number":597,"text":"assessment and disposition (Roles and delegation below) to three frames: a\n"},{"number":598,"text":"Worker frame, specialised as Writer for documents and records, constructs;\n"},{"number":599,"text":"a Reviewer frame assesses; an Executive frame keeps the longer-term\n"},{"number":600,"text":"outcome, selects the next work and disposes within its decision grant, and\n"},{"number":601,"text":"mutates nothing. That profile owns its frames, their grants, limits and\n"},{"number":602,"text":"prohibitions, and its explanation; they apply where it is selected. It is\n"},{"number":603,"text":"not the method's default. A configuration with other frames, names or\n"},{"number":604,"text":"topology is evaluated as Evaluation of a configuration above states.\n"},{"number":605,"text":"\n"},{"number":606,"text":"Purpose and material relation: finite context and attention bound each\n"},{"number":607,"text":"responsibility (P0); dependencies between tasks require exchanges and\n"},{"number":608,"text":"compatible results (P4a); and fallible actors with incomplete knowledge\n"},{"number":609,"text":"require checking and recovery (P5, P6). These conditions constrain a\n"},{"number":610,"text":"configuration without determining it, so the method states what every\n"},{"number":611,"text":"allocation preserves and leaves the arrangement to the design. A\n"},{"number":612,"text":"coordinator that decides from a bounded view relies on what the view\n"},{"number":613,"text":"holds, so a blocker missing from a task result would be read as absent\n"},{"number":614,"text":"(P4b). The material relation is whether an allocation or a reallocation\n"},{"number":615,"text":"can drop an obligation, an effect or a required independence, move\n"},{"number":616,"text":"authority with position in a decomposition, or hide a blocker from the\n"},{"number":617,"text":"decision that needs it. \n"},{"number":618,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":692,"heading":"ACTIVATION/1. The step/Roles and delegation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F1.%20The%20step%2FRoles%20and%20delegation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"875211dabbdc5d788db40f2e2cb5e86a3395642e460cd09fbefea4cabfd0a2ed","start_line":619,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":619,"text":"### Roles and delegation\n"},{"number":620,"text":"\n"},{"number":621,"text":"Roles are relations over steps that a configuration allocates\n"},{"number":622,"text":"(Configuration above), not kinds of actor and not a fixed inventory.\n"},{"number":623,"text":"Where a configuration's operations include construction, assessment or\n"},{"number":624,"text":"disposition, this member names the responsibility for each: a\n"},{"number":625,"text":"constructor owns the bounded implementation and its self-review; an\n"},{"number":626,"text":"assessor evaluates a frozen candidate independently; a decision owner\n"},{"number":627,"text":"disposes. A configuration may allocate other responsibilities. Where\n"},{"number":628,"text":"independent assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the\n"},{"number":629,"text":"exact live subject, its authority paths, proof and installed state, not\n"},{"number":630,"text":"the constructor's summary (EVALUATION §3). This preserves the\n"},{"number":631,"text":"independent-review relation and prescribes no actor count: one actor may\n"},{"number":632,"text":"occupy different roles across different claims when independence for the\n"},{"number":633,"text":"assessed claim is preserved; no role name confers an operation\n"},{"number":634,"text":"([RF-016](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-016-implementation-neutrality);\n"},{"number":635,"text":"P6).\n"},{"number":636,"text":"\n"},{"number":637,"text":"The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may\n"},{"number":638,"text":"accept and advance routine actions. Inside a step, a proxy so declared may\n"},{"number":639,"text":"accept preservation, require local repair, reject a violating candidate\n"},{"number":640,"text":"and advance to the next already-authorised action; what it cannot change,\n"},{"number":641,"text":"and the re-entry such a change requires, is the proxy limit of\n"},{"number":642,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), which\n"},{"number":643,"text":"this paragraph applies and does not restate. Human ceremony is not\n"},{"number":644,"text":"required at every transition when the governing basis, the affected cone,\n"},{"number":645,"text":"the decision envelope and the re-entry conditions are already accepted;\n"},{"number":646,"text":"this delegation does not weaken direct human acceptance where the\n"},{"number":647,"text":"governing product or release law requires it (P6).\n"},{"number":648,"text":"\n"},{"number":649,"text":"When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact\n"},{"number":650,"text":"intake and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor. No\n"},{"number":651,"text":"coordinating activation is required solely to appoint that constructor.\n"},{"number":652,"text":"The applicable configuration (Configuration above) selects\n"},{"number":653,"text":"coordination when material contexts, authority, capability or required\n"},{"number":654,"text":"independence need it; a role or frame name alone does not create that\n"},{"number":655,"text":"need. Direct entry preserves\n"},{"number":656,"text":"execution-contract admission (Admission above), the smallest lawful\n"},{"number":657,"text":"carrier, the required assessment and the reserved decisions; it permits\n"},{"number":658,"text":"bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance at a\n"},{"number":659,"text":"boundary owned elsewhere (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":660,"text":"\n"},{"number":661,"text":"Recording a result without review. Where the applicable law requires no\n"},{"number":662,"text":"independent assessment and reserves no acceptance, the constructor that\n"},{"number":663,"text":"holds the grant may record the satisfied bounded result, with the conditions\n"},{"number":664,"text":"it found satisfied and their evidence, in the existing durable result\n"},{"number":665,"text":"surface (Admission above), without adding a carrier, coordinating\n"},{"number":666,"text":"appointment, review or recreated design view solely to mark completion. The\n"},{"number":667,"text":"recording waives no condition that actually applies, states only\n"},{"number":668,"text":"conditions that were evaluated, as an actor cannot report an evaluation it\n"},{"number":669,"text":"did not perform\n"},{"number":670,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Not performed), and is\n"},{"number":671,"text":"no disposition at a boundary owned elsewhere\n"},{"number":672,"text":"(§3 Disposition). Where an assessment or a reserved acceptance does apply,\n"},{"number":673,"text":"it stays required, and an insufficiency found during the work withholds\n"},{"number":674,"text":"the dependent effect and returns the question to its owner. Carriers and\n"},{"number":675,"text":"profiles refer to this paragraph and add only their own carrier binding\n"},{"number":676,"text":"(P0, P2, P6). Purpose and material relation:\n"},{"number":677,"text":"requiring a review or a ceremony that no law requires adds reasoning cost\n"},{"number":678,"text":"without removing ambiguity (§6), while recording a satisfied result where\n"},{"number":679,"text":"a review or acceptance is required would read construction as acceptance.\n"},{"number":680,"text":"\n"},{"number":681,"text":"One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and\n"},{"number":682,"text":"checkpoint sequence. Actual role transitions are recorded in the existing\n"},{"number":683,"text":"work carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor\n"},{"number":684,"text":"rehashing an unchanged subject. A material change to the operation, the\n"},{"number":685,"text":"subject, the territory, the authority or the validity conditions requires\n"},{"number":686,"text":"the affected binding to be resolved before effect. Where the selected\n"},{"number":687,"text":"configuration restricts its coordinating role from mutation, as the\n"},{"number":688,"text":"executive configuration (Configuration above) restricts its Executive,\n"},{"number":689,"text":"the restriction that the coordinating role mutates nothing remains\n"},{"number":690,"text":"applicable; an operation grant covering the sequence does not lift it\n"},{"number":691,"text":"(P6, P3).\n"},{"number":692,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":901,"heading":"ACTIVATION/2. Context construction under an envelope","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F2.%20Context%20construction%20under%20an%20envelope","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"b87dd3d4f7f7213e4e11bdb2181d0c871e393bf802fcd7976d42a45fd7d4dfe4","start_line":693,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":693,"text":"## 2. Context construction under an envelope\n"},{"number":694,"text":"\n"},{"number":695,"text":"Qualified-reference guidance. Under\n"},{"number":696,"text":"[AC-003](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-003-reference-closure) and\n"},{"number":697,"text":"[AC-011](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-011-projection), a reference can supply\n"},{"number":698,"text":"sufficient context when its accessible target and qualifications preserve\n"},{"number":699,"text":"the consuming contract. Check the required subject and basis, assessment\n"},{"number":700,"text":"standing, provenance, active obligation and version, and invalidators, rather\n"},{"number":701,"text":"than candidate identity alone. A typed annotation supplies no evidence of\n"},{"number":702,"text":"sufficiency by itself. Preserve the required body or a qualified resolvable\n"},{"number":703,"text":"reference; no mandatory carrier or registry follows (P1, P3, P6).\n"},{"number":704,"text":"\n"},{"number":705,"text":"An exact local reference to a complete assessed record can preserve the\n"},{"number":706,"text":"consumer-required distinctions. A candidate-only pointer can lose them when\n"},{"number":707,"text":"unchanged candidate bytes have satisfied and indeterminate assessments that\n"},{"number":708,"text":"require different continuations. A sufficiency claim relying on hash matching\n"},{"number":709,"text":"states its collision and access assumptions. Unknown semantic relations retain their owning gap or\n"},{"number":710,"text":"result; they do not all become one error class. A declared but unperformed\n"},{"number":711,"text":"evaluation has no assessment result; an undeclared required capability is\n"},{"number":712,"text":"a different condition. The [qualified-reference example](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md#qualified-references)\n"},{"number":713,"text":"applies the sufficiency law owned by\n"},{"number":714,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation).\n"},{"number":715,"text":"\n"},{"number":716,"text":"Given a seed set Z (the subject, outcome and affected relations named in the\n"},{"number":717,"text":"intake), a relation family R (the dependency relations whose change can\n"},{"number":718,"text":"alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority), and\n"},{"number":719,"text":"the actor's envelope B:\n"},{"number":720,"text":"\n"},{"number":721,"text":"1. Compute the material closure of Z under R (AC-010,\n"},{"number":722,"text":"   [AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-010-material-closure)).\n"},{"number":723,"text":"   If Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis or the scope is not\n"},{"number":724,"text":"   exact, or the closure is not finite and unique on the exact basis,\n"},{"number":725,"text":"   activation returns `closure_unresolved` (§3, Admission and activation)\n"},{"number":726,"text":"   and no step proceeds; it does not guess.\n"},{"number":727,"text":"2. Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the\n"},{"number":728,"text":"   excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive\n"},{"number":729,"text":"   seams (AC-011,\n"},{"number":730,"text":"   [AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-011-projection)).\n"},{"number":731,"text":"   If the projection returns a gap or refusal, activation returns\n"},{"number":732,"text":"   `closure_unresolved` and no step proceeds.\n"},{"number":733,"text":"   Material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter\n"},{"number":734,"text":"   because it exists\n"},{"number":735,"text":"   ([RF-004](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-004-irrelevance-exclusion)).\n"},{"number":736,"text":"3. Test fit against B. This step owns the size measurement and the fit\n"},{"number":737,"text":"   test for the context dimension. Where B declares a context capacity,\n"},{"number":738,"text":"   the size of the selected context is measured before the actor reads it,\n"},{"number":739,"text":"   in the unit the capacity is declared in (bytes or tokens) and over the\n"},{"number":740,"text":"   boundary that the selected execution binding states for it (§6), and is\n"},{"number":741,"text":"   compared with that capacity. The measurement, the capacity and the\n"},{"number":742,"text":"   outcome of the comparison are recorded before the read. A fit holds\n"},{"number":743,"text":"   only for the measured boundary: context outside it is recorded as not\n"},{"number":744,"text":"   measured, and no fit claim covers it. The fit claim for a measured\n"},{"number":745,"text":"   boundary and the step's fit judgment are distinct: the judgment is\n"},{"number":746,"text":"   established from the recorded complete active inputs, or from a\n"},{"number":747,"text":"   supported upper bound that includes any host-supplied context; where\n"},{"number":748,"text":"   neither exists it is `indeterminate`, unless a counterexample, such as\n"},{"number":749,"text":"   a measured excess, establishes `falsified`. A correct task result keeps\n"},{"number":750,"text":"   its own bounded standing and does not satisfy a missing fit judgment\n"},{"number":751,"text":"   (P0, P5). The measurement applies wherever B declares a\n"},{"number":752,"text":"   context capacity, whatever question the step governs, because without\n"},{"number":753,"text":"   it a fit claim against that capacity is an assertion, and a context\n"},{"number":754,"text":"   that exceeds it would be cut without record\n"},{"number":755,"text":"   ([RF-014](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-014-capability-fit)). It applies only\n"},{"number":756,"text":"   there, because a resource control applies only through a selected frame\n"},{"number":757,"text":"   and its owning scope\n"},{"number":758,"text":"   ([REFERENCE_FRAME §4](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#frame-set-selection)), and a\n"},{"number":759,"text":"   declared capacity is such a control: the measurement tests that\n"},{"number":760,"text":"   capacity, is no budget, and is not a universal measurement gate (P0,\n"},{"number":761,"text":"   P2). Where B declares no context capacity, no measurement is\n"},{"number":762,"text":"   required, and the other conditions of\n"},{"number":763,"text":"   [RF-002](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-002-finite-attention) still apply. The size\n"},{"number":764,"text":"   shows fit and nothing else: whether the actor attends adequately to a\n"},{"number":765,"text":"   context that fits is decided by actual-use evidence under\n"},{"number":766,"text":"   [EVALUATION §7](EVALUATION.md#frame-qualification). The envelope's\n"},{"number":767,"text":"   other dimensions are fitted as RF-014 states; time, spend and other\n"},{"number":768,"text":"   resource limits follow [§6 Resource limits](#resource-limits), which\n"},{"number":769,"text":"   this step refines for the context dimension.\n"},{"number":770,"text":"   If the context fits, activate. If it does not, one or more of these, in\n"},{"number":771,"text":"   combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit\n"},{"number":772,"text":"   (§4); sequence activations; apply a lawful compression that preserves the material\n"},{"number":773,"text":"   distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs\n"},{"number":774,"text":"   ([RF-017](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-017-proportional-compression));\n"},{"number":775,"text":"   select another actor whose envelope fits; or return `out_of_frame`\n"},{"number":776,"text":"   ([§3 Admission and activation](#admission-and-activation)). Silent\n"},{"number":777,"text":"   omission to fit is never one of them\n"},{"number":778,"text":"   ([RF-014](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-014-capability-fit)).\n"},{"number":779,"text":"   None of these options silently reduces the required predicate: the\n"},{"number":780,"text":"   obligations the step preserves stay bound\n"},{"number":781,"text":"   ([§1 Transitions](#transitions)), a narrowing of them is a destination\n"},{"number":782,"text":"   change under its owning authority (§1, Destination change), and what\n"},{"number":783,"text":"   the selected context leaves undecided stays an explicit unknown.\n"},{"number":784,"text":"   Within its grant a step selects refinement, sequencing and compression\n"},{"number":785,"text":"   itself; selecting another actor or enlarging the envelope re-enters the\n"},{"number":786,"text":"   owner of the grant or envelope, who may delegate that choice in the grant\n"},{"number":787,"text":"   (RF-014 vests the selection in human authority; a grant is that authority\n"},{"number":788,"text":"   exercised in advance). Whether a compression preserved what the\n"},{"number":789,"text":"   evaluation needs is a claim with the standing of any other (EVALUATION\n"},{"number":790,"text":"   §1): the compressing step records the compression and its preservation\n"},{"number":791,"text":"   argument, and the claim is assessed independently only where the\n"},{"number":792,"text":"   promotion it serves needs independent assessment (EVALUATION §3).\n"},{"number":793,"text":"4. Acquire declared inputs by their exact identity. A declared input absent\n"},{"number":794,"text":"   from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere\n"},{"number":795,"text":"   nor evidence that it is absent.\n"},{"number":796,"text":"\n"},{"number":797,"text":"Acquisition. Acquisition is the read-only observation of the material a\n"},{"number":798,"text":"step needs (its frame, its subject and its declared inputs) within the\n"},{"number":799,"text":"inputs its intake permits it to acquire (§1 Intake). It is not an admission and not a further\n"},{"number":800,"text":"actor stage; effectful work still needs its admitted contract (§1\n"},{"number":801,"text":"Admission), and acquiring material grants no role, operation or decision\n"},{"number":802,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What\n"},{"number":803,"text":"creates no authority). A derived surface is material derived from owning\n"},{"number":804,"text":"sources by copying, projection or compression, such as a projected frame\n"},{"number":805,"text":"for a task; it names its sources and owns no determination. Where a\n"},{"number":806,"text":"current interpretation of the subject in `a_c` exists, the constraint\n"},{"number":807,"text":"surface it yields for the task is such a derived surface, under the\n"},{"number":808,"text":"conditions of\n"},{"number":809,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §9 Constraint surfaces](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#constraint-surfaces).\n"},{"number":810,"text":"Where a derived surface whose sources\n"},{"number":811,"text":"are current serves the task, the actor acquires it. For another task, or\n"},{"number":812,"text":"where the derived surface is stale ([Staleness of derived surfaces](#staleness-of-derived-surfaces)),\n"},{"number":813,"text":"missing or insufficient for a named unresolved question, the actor acquires the deciding owner sections\n"},{"number":814,"text":"directly: the owning sections that decide the task's questions, which are\n"},{"number":815,"text":"declared inputs of the selected basis. Only material in the exact selected\n"},{"number":816,"text":"basis is acquired: where that basis has no derived surface for the task,\n"},{"number":817,"text":"its exact owner sections are used, and a candidate source, a version-line\n"},{"number":818,"text":"selector or another basis is no substitute for it\n"},{"number":819,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §2 Product lineage objects](FOUNDATIONS.md#product-lineage-objects)).\n"},{"number":820,"text":"The actor reads the selected material and the actual subject, and follows\n"},{"number":821,"text":"the material source and coupled-obligation references the task needs\n"},{"number":822,"text":"(step 2; [RF-003](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency));\n"},{"number":823,"text":"presence of the corpus is no reason to read it (step 2;\n"},{"number":824,"text":"[RF-004](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-004-irrelevance-exclusion)). No frame,\n"},{"number":825,"text":"derived surface or acquisition carries a universal sufficiency claim:\n"},{"number":826,"text":"sufficiency is decided for the named question against the task's\n"},{"number":827,"text":"material relations, never for the corpus or the frame as a whole\n"},{"number":828,"text":"([RF-003](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency)). Before any dependent action, a missing binding is returned with\n"},{"number":829,"text":"its outcome of [§3 Admission and activation](#admission-and-activation),\n"},{"number":830,"text":"naming what is missing: where no available frame declares what the\n"},{"number":831,"text":"evaluation needs, `out_of_frame`; where the basis the step requires is\n"},{"number":832,"text":"absent, or cannot be verified as the exact basis named, the basis cannot\n"},{"number":833,"text":"support the step, and the outcome is `admission_refused(basis)` at\n"},{"number":834,"text":"admission or `activation_refusal(basis)` at activation. Coupled material that does not fit is handled under\n"},{"number":835,"text":"step 3 (P0, P6, P3).\n"},{"number":836,"text":"\n"},{"number":837,"text":"Activation. The actor or the assigning authority selects one frame or one\n"},{"number":838,"text":"declared active frame configuration capable of the evaluation. Activation\n"},{"number":839,"text":"binds each reusable frame declaration to the exact subject and basis and\n"},{"number":840,"text":"loads the declared material relations and evidence sources, never an\n"},{"number":841,"text":"undifferentiated workspace dump; what the actor receives is the packet of\n"},{"number":842,"text":"REFERENCE_FRAME §11. When no available frame and actor pairing can lawfully\n"},{"number":843,"text":"perform the evaluation, activation returns `out_of_frame` where no such\n"},{"number":844,"text":"pairing declares a material relation or capability the evaluation needs,\n"},{"number":845,"text":"and otherwise the `activation_refusal` whose cause holds\n"},{"number":846,"text":"([REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions)); both are\n"},{"number":847,"text":"outcomes of §3 Admission and activation. Work does not proceed through\n"},{"number":848,"text":"implied context (P0, P5).\n"},{"number":849,"text":"\n"},{"number":850,"text":"Evaluation. The evaluator applies the activated frame's declared\n"},{"number":851,"text":"invariants, evidence rules and result algebra. It distinguishes semantic\n"},{"number":852,"text":"law, observed evidence, inference and decision, and records every\n"},{"number":853,"text":"assumption whose failure could change the result (P6).\n"},{"number":854,"text":"\n"},{"number":855,"text":"Standalone scope. A derived surface or projected frame decides standalone\n"},{"number":856,"text":"only the questions that its own source members own. It refuses to close a\n"},{"number":857,"text":"question owned by another member, or one that joins the law of several\n"},{"number":858,"text":"owners; the evaluation of that question returns `out_of_frame`\n"},{"number":859,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results)) naming the owning\n"},{"number":860,"text":"members, and\n"},{"number":861,"text":"the question is decided from those members at their current digests or\n"},{"number":862,"text":"from a derived surface whose declared sources include every owner of it\n"},{"number":863,"text":"(P6, P1).\n"},{"number":864,"text":"\n"},{"number":865,"text":"Prompt construction. A prompt is rendered contract over typed authority;\n"},{"number":866,"text":"it is not source law. Prompt text must project the current authority\n"},{"number":867,"text":"references, obligations, contracts, boundaries, proof expectations and\n"},{"number":868,"text":"fallback conditions the step needs. A prompt body must not carry\n"},{"number":869,"text":"historical workaround prose unless the current requirement, design,\n"},{"number":870,"text":"runtime or test still needs that constraint. Construction starts from the\n"},{"number":871,"text":"highest live authority surface the question needs. If the prompt needs an\n"},{"number":872,"text":"upstream ambiguity resolved, it names the unresolved authority gap before\n"},{"number":873,"text":"fallback context is read. The prompt projects the material that\n"},{"number":874,"text":"Acquisition above selects, including the raw owning members where\n"},{"number":875,"text":"Acquisition falls back to them (P6, P0, P5). The design, ODD, UX and ticket\n"},{"number":876,"text":"specialisations are\n"},{"number":877,"text":"[DESIGN_MODULE §11](DESIGN_MODULE.md#11-review),\n"},{"number":878,"text":"[ODD §11.5D](ODD.md#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop) A5 and\n"},{"number":879,"text":"[§11.7A](ODD.md#117a-conforming-agentic-development),\n"},{"number":880,"text":"[UX §7](UX.md#7-carrier-binding) and\n"},{"number":881,"text":"[TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#5-from-carrier-to-execution) and\n"},{"number":882,"text":"[§7](TICKETS.md#7-authority-judgment-closure-and-state) (P6).\n"},{"number":883,"text":"\n"},{"number":884,"text":"The operation that joins AC-010, AC-011 and RF-002, RF-003, RF-004,\n"},{"number":885,"text":"RF-014 and RF-017 into one procedure is stated here (P0); each of\n"},{"number":886,"text":"those laws is applied here from its owning section in\n"},{"number":887,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-010-material-closure) and\n"},{"number":888,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §3](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#3-laws). The method does not require proving\n"},{"number":889,"text":"that no undiscovered material relation exists\n"},{"number":890,"text":"([RF-003](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency)).\n"},{"number":891,"text":"The size measurement of step 3 applies under its stated condition.\n"},{"number":892,"text":"Purpose and material relation of that measurement and Acquisition:\n"},{"number":893,"text":"finite context makes fit necessary (P0), so a fit against a declared\n"},{"number":894,"text":"capacity is measured rather than asserted, while fit and attention stay\n"},{"number":895,"text":"separate claims (P6); and an actor without a derived surface for its task\n"},{"number":896,"text":"still reaches the sections that decide it, from the exact basis, without\n"},{"number":897,"text":"reading the corpus or substituting a stale or mutable copy (P3, P6). The\n"},{"number":898,"text":"material relation is whether a context larger than the declared capacity\n"},{"number":899,"text":"is read as if it fit, a fit is taken as adequate attention, or a decision\n"},{"number":900,"text":"rests on material other than its deciding owners at the selected basis.\n"},{"number":901,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":937,"heading":"ACTIVATION/2. Context construction under an envelope/Staleness of derived surfaces","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F2.%20Context%20construction%20under%20an%20envelope%2FStaleness%20of%20derived%20surfaces","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"e03ba44ae809603f12c8ddfc59dc254cdd6b4cf45ac98828cea837d82cb2a705","start_line":902,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":902,"text":"### Staleness of derived surfaces\n"},{"number":903,"text":"\n"},{"number":904,"text":"This subsection owns when a derived surface (Acquisition above) is current\n"},{"number":905,"text":"and when it is stale, for any method and any carrier (P3, P5, P6):\n"},{"number":906,"text":"\n"},{"number":907,"text":"- A derived surface names the exact identity, such as the path and\n"},{"number":908,"text":"  digest, of each source it was derived from and of each source whose\n"},{"number":909,"text":"  change can change its content.\n"},{"number":910,"text":"- It is current for a selected basis only while every source identity it\n"},{"number":911,"text":"  names equals the identity of that source in the selected basis. A change\n"},{"number":912,"text":"  to any of them makes it stale.\n"},{"number":913,"text":"- A stale derived surface is not used as current for any question. It\n"},{"number":914,"text":"  becomes current again only by regeneration from the sources at the\n"},{"number":915,"text":"  selected basis, or by an explicit re-acceptance that records the new\n"},{"number":916,"text":"  source identities and the finding that its content still matches them;\n"},{"number":917,"text":"  until then the actor acquires the deciding owner sections directly\n"},{"number":918,"text":"  (Acquisition above).\n"},{"number":919,"text":"- Matching source identities establish only that the surface was derived\n"},{"number":920,"text":"  from those sources. They establish neither its fidelity to them nor its\n"},{"number":921,"text":"  sufficiency for a question; a surface found insufficient for a named\n"},{"number":922,"text":"  question is handled as Acquisition above states.\n"},{"number":923,"text":"- The owning sections at the selected basis remain the deciding source.\n"},{"number":924,"text":"  Whether a current surface is insufficient for a question, or decides\n"},{"number":925,"text":"  beyond its own sources, is judged against them (Standalone scope above);\n"},{"number":926,"text":"  a derived surface never decides that about itself.\n"},{"number":927,"text":"\n"},{"number":928,"text":"A packaging or installation carrier refines this rule with its own\n"},{"number":929,"text":"identities and re-acceptance procedure, and names this subsection as its\n"},{"number":930,"text":"owner; [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#11-one-constitutional-surface-and-version-boundary)\n"},{"number":931,"text":"does so for the method's released carriers. Purpose and material relation: an actor that relies on a\n"},{"number":932,"text":"derived surface after one of its sources has changed decides from material\n"},{"number":933,"text":"that no longer matches its owners, and a matching digest read as fidelity\n"},{"number":934,"text":"would let a faithful-looking but wrong surface decide; the material\n"},{"number":935,"text":"relation is whether a decision rests on a surface whose sources are not\n"},{"number":936,"text":"those of the selected basis. This rule applies to derived surfaces under every selected carrier.\n"},{"number":937,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":967,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"32edac7552c461d5b248d9a395a60e945bf265113beb816bd0005f6ac4adb26d","start_line":938,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":938,"text":"## 3. Step results and disposition\n"},{"number":939,"text":"\n"},{"number":940,"text":"A step returns its results in the core algebra of\n"},{"number":941,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): each evaluation it\n"},{"number":942,"text":"performed returns one core value with its predicate and domain outcome,\n"},{"number":943,"text":"and an evaluation it did not perform has no result. The outcomes of\n"},{"number":944,"text":"admitting and activating a step, and the step's own outcomes, answer other\n"},{"number":945,"text":"questions than its evaluations do. This section owns them as five\n"},{"number":946,"text":"refinements of the core. Each names the question it answers and the\n"},{"number":947,"text":"predicate its mapping is for, and maps each of its values to exactly one\n"},{"number":948,"text":"core value; the predicate travels with the value, so no refinement's\n"},{"number":949,"text":"`satisfied` counts toward another predicate\n"},{"number":950,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":951,"text":"Purpose and material relation: admission, work, decisions and effects\n"},{"number":952,"text":"stand in the one core (P5, P6), so a consumer that combines them cannot\n"},{"number":953,"text":"read a refused activation as a step's stop, availability as fitness or\n"},{"number":954,"text":"acceptance, a carried ambiguity as resolved, or an unknown effect as none.\n"},{"number":955,"text":"\n"},{"number":956,"text":"| Refinement | Question | Predicate of the mapping |\n"},{"number":957,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":958,"text":"| admission and activation | may the step begin | the step is lawfully admitted and activated on the exact subject and basis |\n"},{"number":959,"text":"| construction availability | did the step yield its output | a candidate is available |\n"},{"number":960,"text":"| disposition | what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate | the candidate is accepted at its declared boundary |\n"},{"number":961,"text":"| ambiguity outcome | what happened to a declared ambiguity | the declared ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis |\n"},{"number":962,"text":"| effects | did an intended external effect occur | the intended effect occurred |\n"},{"number":963,"text":"\n"},{"number":964,"text":"A profile that refines these values for its own units maps each of its\n"},{"number":965,"text":"values to exactly one core value under FOUNDATIONS §4 Results and adds no\n"},{"number":966,"text":"core value.\n"},{"number":967,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1001,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Admission and activation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FAdmission%20and%20activation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"6355ed6c58473d04c13251a2ea6936388f89b4f943c3a15558d995409c720263","start_line":968,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":968,"text":"### Admission and activation\n"},{"number":969,"text":"\n"},{"number":970,"text":"A step exists only after its contract is admitted (§1, Admission) and its\n"},{"number":971,"text":"frame is activated on the exact subject and basis (§2). The outcomes of\n"},{"number":972,"text":"admission and of context construction are owned here; each maps for the\n"},{"number":973,"text":"predicate \"the step is lawfully admitted and activated on the exact\n"},{"number":974,"text":"subject and basis\", and its cause selects its value (P5, P6; RF-005 for\n"},{"number":975,"text":"the basis causes). The outcomes of frame activation are the `activate`\n"},{"number":976,"text":"refinement of [REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions),\n"},{"number":977,"text":"which owns their causes, their predicate and their core values. Because\n"},{"number":978,"text":"this predicate requires activation, a refused activation decides it with\n"},{"number":979,"text":"the value REFERENCE_FRAME §5 gives; the table names those outcomes and\n"},{"number":980,"text":"maps none of them again:\n"},{"number":981,"text":"\n"},{"number":982,"text":"| Outcome | Cause | Core value |\n"},{"number":983,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":984,"text":"| `activated` | the contract is admitted with its admission evidence (§1), Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis and the scope are exact and the material closure is finite and unique (§2, step 1), its projection returns a selected context (§2, step 2), and activation returns `activated_frame` | satisfied |\n"},{"number":985,"text":"| `admission_refused(authority)` | the work authority the step needs is not admitted: no admission mechanism or explicit human override admits the exact contract, or no durable result and evidence surface is authorised and available; the outcome names the missing authority or surface and its owner | out_of_frame |\n"},{"number":986,"text":"| `admission_refused(basis)` | the contract's cited outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis, or the exact subject and basis it names, cannot support it; the outcome names that basis | invalid_basis |\n"},{"number":987,"text":"| `closure_unresolved` | the seed set Z, the relation family R, the required-edge semantics, the basis or the scope is not exact, or the material closure is not finite and unique on the exact basis (§2, step 1; AC-010), or the projection of the closure returns a gap or refusal (§2, step 2; AC-011); the outcome names the condition that fails and the basis coordinates that leave it open | invalid_basis |\n"},{"number":988,"text":"| `out_of_frame` | no available frame and actor pairing declares a material relation or capability the evaluation needs (§2, Activation), or no fit option of §2 step 3 fits the selected context to an actor's envelope | out_of_frame |\n"},{"number":989,"text":"| `activation_refusal` with its cause | a cause REFERENCE_FRAME §5 states | the core value REFERENCE_FRAME §5 maps that cause to |\n"},{"number":990,"text":"\n"},{"number":991,"text":"These outcomes are not values of construction availability and are not\n"},{"number":992,"text":"results of a step. A refused admission or activation creates no step, no\n"},{"number":993,"text":"activation of the step's frame and no work result, the closed output of a\n"},{"number":994,"text":"constructing actor to its consumer; the outcome returns to the assigning\n"},{"number":995,"text":"authority or the declared result carrier, and no consumer records it as a\n"},{"number":996,"text":"step's stop state. [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §5](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#work-result)\n"},{"number":997,"text":"applies this rule to the Worker.\n"},{"number":998,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a mismatch known before the step begins is\n"},{"number":999,"text":"reported with its cause in the one core, so it is neither mistaken for a\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"step that stopped nor for one that ran.\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1048,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Construction availability","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FConstruction%20availability","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"f1716d7080e823fa4d3b92070a88c2a2e61dfc9bc96a597b36707c3d5d759e48","start_line":1002,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1002,"text":"### Construction availability\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"A step's output is a candidate until evaluated (FOUNDATIONS §3, P0): the\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"constructed subject of a constructing step, or the closed results of an\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"assessing step. Construction availability records whether that output\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"exists (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"| Value | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"| `candidate_ready` | satisfied | an exact candidate and its transition evidence are available |\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"| `refused` | falsified | lawful activation occurred, and a governing prohibition or an owner-valid construction refusal defeats the requested construction; the prohibition or refusal is the counterexample |\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"| `incomplete` | falsified | the lawfully activated step stopped without its output, because an evaluation the output needs was not performed or could not be decided on the admissible evidence, or bounded execution ended first; the stop basis is the counterexample, and it and the residuals name which |\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"| `re_entry_requested(authority)` | out_of_frame | a material decision the step needs lies outside its grant; the value names the owner of that decision |\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"| `re_entry_requested(basis)` | invalid_basis | the activated basis can no longer support the work |\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation: the cause of\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"the stop selects the value, and payload wording, stop timing or actor\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"preference cannot select another. A mismatch known during admission or\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"activation is no value of this refinement, because no step exists; it\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"takes its outcome under Admission and activation above.\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"`satisfied` here establishes availability only and never counts toward the\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"candidate's fitness or acceptance (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results).\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"`incomplete` maps to `falsified` only for \"a candidate is available\", never\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"to `indeterminate`. The step's evaluations keep their own results: each\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"evaluation it performed returns its core value, `indeterminate` where the\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"admissible evidence could not decide; each evaluation it planned and did\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"not perform has no result, and its work state (§5) carries it as a\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"residual with the capability or the execution left unfinished\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, the third case of the boundary). An evaluation\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"not performed thus stays distinct from one whose evidence cannot decide\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"(P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"An assessing step that ends `incomplete` leaves each criterion it did not\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"evaluate not performed: no result, never `falsified`.
