The `falsified` of its\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"availability concerns its own output, never the subject under assessment\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"(P6).\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"The cause of a re-entry request is part of its value, because a re-entry\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"request without its cause would map to `out_of_frame` or to\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"`invalid_basis` according to that cause, and a refined value maps to\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"exactly one core value (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Refinements). A stop\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"with both causes records both and takes `re_entry_requested(basis)`,\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"because a decision cannot be taken on a basis that cannot support it (P5,\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"P3).\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1086,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Disposition","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FDisposition","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"a5d3394673bb27695f4d42cbae693b65edad57928cf235a2cbc6740cfe198b63","start_line":1049,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1049,"text":"### Disposition\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"The decision owner disposes an assessed candidate with one of four\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"semantic dispositions (§1, Roles and delegation; P6, P5). An assessor may recommend one; the\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"recommendation is evidence for the decision owner, never a disposition\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"([EVALUATION §4](EVALUATION.md#4-review-results)). The disposition is the\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"acceptance result: it consumes the candidate's availability and assessment\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"results and stays separate from both (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results). Each maps\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"to the core for the predicate \"the candidate is accepted at its declared\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"boundary\":\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"| Disposition | Condition | Core value |\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | satisfied |\n"},{"number":1063,"text":"| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent | falsified |\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"| `re_enter` | the governing outcome, a requirement, an identity, a lifecycle, an authority, a public contract or the accepted design must change | invalid_basis |\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | falsified |\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"\n"},{"number":1067,"text":"For `local_repair` the local defect, and for `reject` the violated relation\n"},{"number":1068,"text":"or the competing truth path, is the counterexample to accepting this\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"candidate; a repaired candidate is a new candidate with its own results.\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"For `re_enter` the governing basis the candidate was built and assessed on\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"must change, so that basis cannot support acceptance; the change re-enters\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"at its owning relation (§4). The core values place\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"acceptance in the one core, as FOUNDATIONS §4 Results requires, so that a\n"},{"number":1074,"text":"consumer combining results cannot take availability or assessment as\n"},{"number":1075,"text":"acceptance (P6).\n"},{"number":1076,"text":"\n"},{"number":1077,"text":"Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the\n"},{"number":1078,"text":"bounded action; it does not require proving the whole product inside every\n"},{"number":1079,"text":"local action (P4b). Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary\n"},{"number":1080,"text":"requires reassessment of the frame altitude, the causal cone, the common\n"},{"number":1081,"text":"components, the design-versus-code placement and the authority\n"},{"number":1082,"text":"sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold, mandatory\n"},{"number":1083,"text":"review-round count or review state machine; it prohibits repeating an\n"},{"number":1084,"text":"unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close\n"},{"number":1085,"text":"it (P2).\n"},{"number":1086,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1113,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Ambiguity outcome","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FAmbiguity%20outcome","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"c70b35a5e59dee1def59b0f50393cc0f400c36fec01c167b09b6fe88f8e0354d","start_line":1087,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1087,"text":"### Ambiguity outcome\n"},{"number":1088,"text":"\n"},{"number":1089,"text":"A declared ambiguity is resolved, carried, escalated or blocked, and the\n"},{"number":1090,"text":"outcome is recorded either way (§4, which also names the hard stops;\n"},{"number":1091,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle)\n"},{"number":1092,"text":"applies this to the method's chain of authority surfaces). Each outcome\n"},{"number":1093,"text":"maps to the core for the predicate \"the declared ambiguity is resolved on\n"},{"number":1094,"text":"the exact basis\" (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1095,"text":"\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"| Outcome | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1098,"text":"| `resolved` | satisfied | a decision was taken under the policy that permits lawful probabilistic processing, or by human adjudication, and recorded |\n"},{"number":1099,"text":"| `carried` | falsified | policy permits work to continue with the ambiguity open; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and it stays a recorded residual that names the evidence or decision that would resolve it |\n"},{"number":1100,"text":"| `escalated` | out_of_frame | policy or risk appetite reserves the decision to human adjudication, an authority the step does not hold; the value names that authority |\n"},{"number":1101,"text":"| `blocked` | falsified | the ambiguity stays unresolved, and policy or a hard stop (§4) halts work at it; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and the value names the halting condition and what would lift it |\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"An open ambiguity is a known state of the exact basis, so `carried` and\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"`blocked` decide the predicate false; neither is `indeterminate`, whose\n"},{"number":1105,"text":"evidence cannot decide the predicate. Each keeps its domain outcome with\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"the value: `carried` with what would resolve the ambiguity, `blocked` with\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"the halting condition and what would lift it (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results,\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"Recording). No outcome other than `resolved` maps to `satisfied`, so a\n"},{"number":1109,"text":"dependent claim cannot rest on a carried, escalated or blocked ambiguity\n"},{"number":1110,"text":"as if it were resolved. The mapping places ambiguity outcomes\n"},{"number":1111,"text":"in the one core, which FOUNDATIONS §4 Results requires of every outcome\n"},{"number":1112,"text":"(P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1113,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1163,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Effects","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FEffects","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"5256dd7b7399fdeb0176decb43623660821eb5ff038867b2193f8b7922e73e29","start_line":1114,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1114,"text":"### Effects\n"},{"number":1115,"text":"\n"},{"number":1116,"text":"An effectful step's intended external effect has one of three values,\n"},{"number":1117,"text":"mapped for the predicate \"the intended effect occurred\", that is, the\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"declared outcome of the effect is attained. The value turns on what the\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"admitted evidence establishes about that outcome (P5 with the open-world\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"premise, P6):\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"\n"},{"number":1122,"text":"| Value | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1123,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1124,"text":"| `completed` | satisfied | evidence about the subject establishes that the intended effect occurred in full and that the effect has ended |\n"},{"number":1125,"text":"| `not_effected` | falsified | evidence about the subject establishes that the declared outcome is not attained and that no later completion of the effect can attain it, for example where no effect began, the effect ended short, an interval that the declared outcome bounds has closed with part of it not done, or the part already done has itself made the declared outcome unattainable, as when it destroyed what the outcome needed; any part that did occur is named with the value |\n"},{"number":1126,"text":"| `completion_unknown` | indeterminate | neither of the other values is established: the evidence cannot decide whether the intended effect has occurred or will occur, as for a request whose response was lost with no counterexample observed; or the evidence shows the intended effect in full while the effect may still be acting, and the outcome stays undecided until what the effect leaves on the subject is settled; its residual names the observation that would decide |\n"},{"number":1127,"text":"\n"},{"number":1128,"text":"`not_effected` requires evidence about the subject. A lost response, an\n"},{"number":1129,"text":"absent record, or an actor's context that holds no trace of the effect is\n"},{"number":1130,"text":"not that evidence, and the value stays `completion_unknown`.\n"},{"number":1131,"text":"`completion_unknown` never maps to `completed` or to `not_effected`.\n"},{"number":1132,"text":"\n"},{"number":1133,"text":"Whether the effect has ended is a second question beside the predicate\n"},{"number":1134,"text":"above, and it enters the value only as a conjunct of `completed`. An\n"},{"number":1135,"text":"effect has ended where evidence about the subject establishes\n"},{"number":1136,"text":"that it no longer acts on the subject or that it never began. Where an\n"},{"number":1137,"text":"effect began and the evidence does not establish its end, the end is not\n"},{"number":1138,"text":"established, and that is recorded beside the value as a residual naming\n"},{"number":1139,"text":"the observation that would establish it. The end never decides a\n"},{"number":1140,"text":"`not_effected` value and is never folded into one: when an interval that\n"},{"number":1141,"text":"the declared outcome bounds has closed with part not done, the value is\n"},{"number":1142,"text":"`not_effected` while the effect may still be acting. The residual does\n"},{"number":1143,"text":"not weaken the counterexample, and the counterexample does not resolve\n"},{"number":1144,"text":"the residual. `completed` alone requires the end established, so a\n"},{"number":1145,"text":"counterexample stands without proof that the effect has ended, while\n"},{"number":1146,"text":"success is never claimed for an effect that may still be acting\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Standing).\n"},{"number":1148,"text":"\n"},{"number":1149,"text":"An effect of uncertain completion is one whose value is\n"},{"number":1150,"text":"`completion_unknown`, or whose value is `not_effected` with its end not\n"},{"number":1151,"text":"established. §5 reconciles it, sufficiently for the next dependent\n"},{"number":1152,"text":"action, before any repetition or dependent action. A `not_effected`\n"},{"number":1153,"text":"value licenses neither treating the effect as absent nor repeating it\n"},{"number":1154,"text":"while its end is not established.\n"},{"number":1155,"text":"\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"The refinement's material relation is whether an action whose\n"},{"number":1157,"text":"external effect may have occurred is repeated or relied on; §4 names a\n"},{"number":1158,"text":"lost post-effect response as a case that no added core value solves, and\n"},{"number":1159,"text":"this refinement records it in the existing core. Keeping the end of the\n"},{"number":1160,"text":"effect beside the value keeps two facts that one value would merge: a\n"},{"number":1161,"text":"counterexample already established for the declared outcome, and an\n"},{"number":1162,"text":"effect that may still be acting.\n"},{"number":1163,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1209,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"c3f19c8c4a08708eac7455c16e2d2cee6785f1ea2c689fab9aae6f6407ab87bb","start_line":1164,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1164,"text":"## 4. Totality and refinement\n"},{"number":1165,"text":"\n"},{"number":1166,"text":"Next moves after any non-satisfied result are named in advance: continue\n"},{"number":1167,"text":"within the current contract when supported; refine; recover; yield; re-enter\n"},{"number":1168,"text":"the owning relation; terminate. Each admitted condition class has a declared\n"},{"number":1169,"text":"next move, including an explicit unknown class. Total handling does not\n"},{"number":1170,"text":"claim that every external condition is recognised, that an invoked provider\n"},{"number":1171,"text":"terminates, or that every request can be completed. A hanging external call,\n"},{"number":1172,"text":"an unsatisfiable demand and a lost post-effect response are three different\n"},{"number":1173,"text":"cases and none is solved by adding a value to the algebra.\n"},{"number":1174,"text":"\n"},{"number":1175,"text":"Claiming the common deterministic kind adds the total-domain and termination\n"},{"number":1176,"text":"contract of [AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds).\n"},{"number":1177,"text":"This section's total handling does not establish that qualification. Fuel\n"},{"number":1178,"text":"exhaustion retains the evaluated predicate; candidate absence, an available\n"},{"number":1179,"text":"indeterminate assessment report and an unperformed assessment take the\n"},{"number":1180,"text":"different results of [§3](#construction-availability), as the\n"},{"number":1181,"text":"[finite cases](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md#exhaustion) demonstrate.\n"},{"number":1182,"text":"\n"},{"number":1183,"text":"Which outcome of [§3 Ambiguity outcome](#ambiguity-outcome) a declared\n"},{"number":1184,"text":"ambiguity takes is decided by the applicable ambiguity policy and its risk\n"},{"number":1185,"text":"appetite, an added choice; for this method the owner of the default\n"},{"number":1186,"text":"policy is [SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle),\n"},{"number":1187,"text":"and this section states none. The outcome is recorded either way.\n"},{"number":1188,"text":"\n"},{"number":1189,"text":"Hard stops. Some conditions are not optional ambiguity decisions and\n"},{"number":1190,"text":"remain hard stops regardless of risk appetite. Typical hard-stop classes\n"},{"number":1191,"text":"include: a violated invariant or guarantee; an absent required authority\n"},{"number":1192,"text":"surface; a missing declared capability for an executional or operational\n"},{"number":1193,"text":"stage; an undeclared irreversible side effect; and an explicit policy gate\n"},{"number":1194,"text":"requiring human approval. A hard stop halts the work at its condition whatever the policy:\n"},{"number":1195,"text":"for a declared ambiguity, with the §3 Ambiguity outcome `blocked`;\n"},{"number":1196,"text":"otherwise, as a stop of [§1 Transitions](#transitions), Stops. This\n"},{"number":1197,"text":"section owns the hard stops;\n"},{"number":1198,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle)\n"},{"number":1199,"text":"applies them to the method's chain of authority surfaces (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1200,"text":"\n"},{"number":1201,"text":"Reconfiguration. An out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or\n"},{"number":1202,"text":"incompatible result causes one of: supply the missing admissible evidence;\n"},{"number":1203,"text":"select another actor inside the frame's capability envelope; activate\n"},{"number":1204,"text":"another existing frame; refine or extend a frame declaration; revise the\n"},{"number":1205,"text":"frame set (REFERENCE_FRAME §10); change the evaluation; or re-enter the\n"},{"number":1206,"text":"governing product or method relation. The next move follows the cause; a\n"},{"number":1207,"text":"difficult evaluation alone does not prove that another frame is required\n"},{"number":1208,"text":"(P5, P2).\n"},{"number":1209,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1285,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Refinement","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FRefinement","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"5b33a40f42b5f4449224ffe67bd387dc329f62207e3bf2bea3dc5ceda0810e1d","start_line":1210,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1210,"text":"### Refinement\n"},{"number":1211,"text":"\n"},{"number":1212,"text":"An outer transformation T: A → X with success predicates P₀ … Pₙ\n"},{"number":1213,"text":"is faithfully refined by steps Tᵢ when each admitted input satisfying Pᵢ\n"},{"number":1214,"text":"yields an output satisfying Pᵢ₊₁, retains every applicable invariant, exposes\n"},{"number":1215,"text":"other outcomes without coercion, and each output satisfies the next step's\n"},{"number":1216,"text":"declared domain and preconditions, as typed composition requires (P4a;\n"},{"number":1217,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5 AC-016](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-016-typed-composition)).\n"},{"number":1218,"text":"The step and end-to-end preservation obligations this refinement discharges, and what a completion-only relation leaves unclaimed, are [FOUNDATIONS §4 Preservation through construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#preservation-through-construction); this section applies them to refinement. Then a successful composite of exact steps carries P₀ to Pₙ by induction;\n"},{"number":1219,"text":"a composite that contains an approximate step carries only what its\n"},{"number":1220,"text":"end-to-end bound states (Exact and approximate steps below). A refinement\n"},{"number":1221,"text":"carries an earlier output to a later step other than the next only through\n"},{"number":1222,"text":"a declared adapter, itself a step composed under AC-016, or a declared\n"},{"number":1223,"text":"specialised contract, in either case one whose declared domain names what\n"},{"number":1224,"text":"is carried; a specialised contract is declared under its owner's exact\n"},{"number":1225,"text":"authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and\n"},{"number":1226,"text":"invalidation law (P4a, P4b).\n"},{"number":1227,"text":"Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local\n"},{"number":1228,"text":"implications and legitimate authority are premises, not conclusions; \"each\n"},{"number":1229,"text":"step passed\" is weaker than \"the outer contract was conserved\". Required\n"},{"number":1230,"text":"coupled relations must fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay\n"},{"number":1231,"text":"outside the selected context. Every seam crossing the affected set includes\n"},{"number":1232,"text":"its far side or states why it cannot participate\n"},{"number":1233,"text":"([UP-017](DESIGN_MODULE.md#bounded-frame-conservation-up-017)).\n"},{"number":1234,"text":"Admission of a material transition is one semantic commit of the complete\n"},{"number":1235,"text":"transition within its enclosing relation, or none (the law below). The ODD [graph-function binding](ODD.md#graph-functions) refines one\n"},{"number":1236,"text":"outer vector into an inner workflow; this law also applies to other\n"},{"number":1237,"text":"realisations. [PROFILES §2](PROFILES.md#2-graph-execution) locates the ODD binding.\n"},{"number":1238,"text":"\n"},{"number":1239,"text":"Preservation and licensing. A refinement step decomposes a transformation\n"},{"number":1240,"text":"into steps, as above. A rewrite step replaces a representation, a step or\n"},{"number":1241,"text":"a composite by another that is claimed to keep its meaning, for example\n"},{"number":1242,"text":"by partitioning, regrouping, reordering, merging or substituting parts.\n"},{"number":1243,"text":"Each refinement layer, the steps that refine one transformation, states\n"},{"number":1244,"text":"what it preserves of the layer above, the transformation it refines, and\n"},{"number":1245,"text":"discharges that obligation (P4a, P6). A refinement or rewrite step is\n"},{"number":1246,"text":"admissible only under the laws declared for its subject. Its licensing law is the declared\n"},{"number":1247,"text":"law that permits it, such as an associativity, commutativity or\n"},{"number":1248,"text":"equivalence law that the subject's owner declares for the subject. Where\n"},{"number":1249,"text":"no law is declared for the subject, only universally valid steps are\n"},{"number":1250,"text":"admissible: steps that hold whatever laws the subject has. A step that\n"},{"number":1251,"text":"is neither licensed nor universally valid, such as a partition or\n"},{"number":1252,"text":"regrouping that no declared law permits, is inadmissible, and so is a\n"},{"number":1253,"text":"refinement or rewrite that relies on it (P4a, P1).\n"},{"number":1254,"text":"\n"},{"number":1255,"text":"Exact and approximate steps. An exact step preserves meaning: under the\n"},{"number":1256,"text":"subject's declared interpretation, its output means what the material it\n"},{"number":1257,"text":"replaces means, and an exact refinement step carries Pᵢ to Pᵢ₊₁ without\n"},{"number":1258,"text":"approximation (P1). Faithful refinement, defined above, requires exact\n"},{"number":1259,"text":"steps. An approximate step does not preserve meaning exactly. It\n"},{"number":1260,"text":"states its adequacy relation, which says how close its output must be to\n"},{"number":1261,"text":"the exact result to be close enough for the outer contract, and the\n"},{"number":1262,"text":"composite that contains it states an end-to-end bound, which limits how\n"},{"number":1263,"text":"far the whole composite may depart from the outer obligation and is\n"},{"number":1264,"text":"argued for that composite. Such a composite is not faithful; it is\n"},{"number":1265,"text":"adequate within its end-to-end bound and establishes nothing beyond that\n"},{"number":1266,"text":"bound. A fixed tolerance at each step does not compose into an\n"},{"number":1267,"text":"end-to-end bound, because deviations that each stay within the tolerance\n"},{"number":1268,"text":"can accumulate across steps, so the induction above applies to exact\n"},{"number":1269,"text":"steps only. A step that is neither exact nor approximate with its\n"},{"number":1270,"text":"adequacy relation and an end-to-end bound for its composite is\n"},{"number":1271,"text":"inadmissible: a composite that relies on it is neither faithful nor\n"},{"number":1272,"text":"adequate within a bound (P4a, P6).\n"},{"number":1273,"text":"\n"},{"number":1274,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a decomposition or rewrite that changes\n"},{"number":1275,"text":"meaning, or approximations whose deviations accumulate, would let a\n"},{"number":1276,"text":"composite whose every step passed violate the outer contract (P4a, P1,\n"},{"number":1277,"text":"P6). The material relation is whether the composite still meets the outer\n"},{"number":1278,"text":"obligations. Preservation per layer, licensing laws and the per-step law\n"},{"number":1279,"text":"for exact and approximate steps, including the inadmissibility of a step\n"},{"number":1280,"text":"that is neither, are stated here; the obligation to state an\n"},{"number":1281,"text":"adequacy relation and a composition bound, and the end-to-end obligations\n"},{"number":1282,"text":"of a composition, are\n"},{"number":1283,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Preservation through construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#preservation-through-construction),\n"},{"number":1284,"text":"which this section applies to refinement steps.\n"},{"number":1285,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1337,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Complete enclosing-relation admission","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FComplete%20enclosing-relation%20admission","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"b411163d4b135911d4e764396b90650184016761e885629ad47b3d9a636735e0","start_line":1286,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1286,"text":"### Complete enclosing-relation admission\n"},{"number":1287,"text":"\n"},{"number":1288,"text":"For a material transition, each admission owner is independently\n"},{"number":1289,"text":"responsible for deriving and validating the complete enclosing relation\n"},{"number":1290,"text":"from authoritative inputs (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":1291,"text":"The relation contains every participant and equality join whose identity,\n"},{"number":1292,"text":"validity, authority, currentness or transition can affect or be affected by\n"},{"number":1293,"text":"admission; each crossing seam includes its relevant far side or\n"},{"number":1294,"text":"authoritatively establishes that the far side cannot participate. Caller or\n"},{"number":1295,"text":"owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority do\n"},{"number":1296,"text":"not establish truth.\n"},{"number":1297,"text":"\n"},{"number":1298,"text":"An owner may consume established facts when their exact subject, basis,\n"},{"number":1299,"text":"scope, provenance and validity remain applicable to its relation. Their\n"},{"number":1300,"text":"production and invalidation are recoverable; an unsupported assertion of\n"},{"number":1301,"text":"prior success is not such a fact. A function, component, role,\n"},{"number":1302,"text":"conversation or status boundary alone invalidates none of those coordinates\n"},{"number":1303,"text":"and requires no repeated derivation. Material mutation, rollback, changed\n"},{"number":1304,"text":"authority or basis, expired validity and an actual trust boundary trigger\n"},{"number":1305,"text":"the applicable validation before reliance or effect. Reuse does not\n"},{"number":1306,"text":"transfer the owner's admission responsibility, omit a participant or\n"},{"number":1307,"text":"satisfy a separately required independent judgment (§7).\n"},{"number":1308,"text":"\n"},{"number":1309,"text":"Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative\n"},{"number":1310,"text":"basis identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance\n"},{"number":1311,"text":"after preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor\n"},{"number":1312,"text":"and currentness law for that basis, or re-enters derivation and validation\n"},{"number":1313,"text":"without effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a\n"},{"number":1314,"text":"design-declared coherent composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis\n"},{"number":1315,"text":"judgments cannot combine (FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis).\n"},{"number":1316,"text":"\n"},{"number":1317,"text":"Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect.\n"},{"number":1318,"text":"Internal evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned, and no\n"},{"number":1319,"text":"participant subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission\n"},{"number":1320,"text":"is one semantic commit of the complete transition, bound to its exact basis\n"},{"number":1321,"text":"identity; failure or interruption admits the complete transition or none,\n"},{"number":1322,"text":"never a subset. No realisation mechanism or participant count is\n"},{"number":1323,"text":"prescribed. Direct and every supported composite or nested boundary\n"},{"number":1324,"text":"preserve this law: a partial result cannot substitute for an owner's\n"},{"number":1325,"text":"derivation and validation, and a competing same-scope path cannot establish\n"},{"number":1326,"text":"the transition outside the governing admission relation. Fresh\n"},{"number":1327,"text":"reconstruction and replay over the same basis reproduce the enclosing\n"},{"number":1328,"text":"relation, the basis identity and the complete outcome or refusal exactly at\n"},{"number":1329,"text":"semantic altitude (P3, P5).\n"},{"number":1330,"text":"\n"},{"number":1331,"text":"The law is false if completeness is asserted rather than derived; a\n"},{"number":1332,"text":"relevant participant, join or seam is omitted; validation and admission use\n"},{"number":1333,"text":"an unidentified, stale or incoherently mixed basis; currentness can\n"},{"number":1334,"text":"advance without a commit condition or effect-free re-entry; any effect\n"},{"number":1335,"text":"precedes complete validation; failure or interruption exposes a subset;\n"},{"number":1336,"text":"fresh reconstruction differs; or competing same-scope authority remains.\n"},{"number":1337,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1369,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Standing structural qualification","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FStanding%20structural%20qualification","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"aa16059145efc645f41f62c56407a92de27ebd1a7a4c520055344bf763a1dd20","start_line":1338,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1338,"text":"### Standing structural qualification\n"},{"number":1339,"text":"\n"},{"number":1340,"text":"Qualification of the admission law is instantiated for every admission\n"},{"number":1341,"text":"owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design (P6). Case applicability\n"},{"number":1342,"text":"follows the supported input, state and operating or threat model. An\n"},{"number":1343,"text":"excluded threat alone cannot create an acceptance predicate or require\n"},{"number":1344,"text":"defensive work; a proposed scope expansion returns to its owning authority.\n"},{"number":1345,"text":"Supported malformed inputs, stale state and effect boundaries retain their\n"},{"number":1346,"text":"required checks:\n"},{"number":1347,"text":"\n"},{"number":1348,"text":"| Form | Required observation |\n"},{"number":1349,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":1350,"text":"| direct | the complete direct relation is derived, validated and admitted once |\n"},{"number":1351,"text":"| supported composite or nested | every supported constituent and owning boundary satisfies the same law; unsupported forms have a design-grounded `not_applicable` disposition and no weaker or competing path |\n"},{"number":1352,"text":"| forged | forged identity, membership, equality or authority reachable within the supported operating or threat model is refused without effect; exclusion requires its owning authority, not a helper's inability to construct the case |\n"},{"number":1353,"text":"| ambiguous enclosing relation | unresolved participant, join, seam or relation identity ambiguity is refused without effect |\n"},{"number":1354,"text":"| stale or advanced basis | stale input is refused, and basis advancement between preflight and admission causes effect-free re-entry rather than mixed-basis admission |\n"},{"number":1355,"text":"| incoherent multi-owner basis | owner judgments on bases that are neither equal nor joined by a design-declared coherent composite basis cannot combine and are refused without effect |\n"},{"number":1356,"text":"| competing same-scope admission authority | an undisposed competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition |\n"},{"number":1357,"text":"| reconstructed or fresh-process | the same basis reconstructs the same relation, basis identity and outcome or refusal |\n"},{"number":1358,"text":"| exact replay equality | replay over the same basis reproduces exactly the enclosing relation, basis identity and complete outcome or refusal |\n"},{"number":1359,"text":"| atomic publication failure | after validation succeeds, failure or interruption is observed at every materially distinct commit or publication boundary capable of exposing a subset, followed by fresh reconstruction showing the complete transition or none; named representative observations suffice only under a design-declared dominance or equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface |\n"},{"number":1360,"text":"\n"},{"number":1361,"text":"For an indivisible commit unit the atomic test establishes that boundary\n"},{"number":1362,"text":"and observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant\n"},{"number":1363,"text":"validation failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure\n"},{"number":1364,"text":"evidence. A standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is\n"},{"number":1365,"text":"omitted, a materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an\n"},{"number":1366,"text":"observation or a declared coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or a\n"},{"number":1367,"text":"manufactured refusal, or fresh reconstruction does not compare the complete\n"},{"number":1368,"text":"semantic result (EVALUATION §1).\n"},{"number":1369,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1457,"heading":"ACTIVATION/5. Work state and restart","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"e0d5cf78c76d7da93a8aeceaacb5c1621260326d216b23ed733d407533ac55a8","start_line":1370,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1370,"text":"## 5. Work state and restart\n"},{"number":1371,"text":"\n"},{"number":1372,"text":"Work state is the tuple of: the current persistent workspace; the governing\n"},{"number":1373,"text":"basis; the applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators;\n"},{"number":1374,"text":"the residuals; and the known uncertainty over external effects. It is an\n"},{"number":1375,"text":"object (P3); its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner) is\n"},{"number":1376,"text":"a profile or realisation choice. Resumption, checkpointing and the\n"},{"number":1377,"text":"progress account of this section are generic procedures\n"},{"number":1378,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding)): they require\n"},{"number":1379,"text":"no particular carrier (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":1380,"text":"\n"},{"number":1381,"text":"Resumption is re-entry of the same method over the current work state,\n"},{"number":1382,"text":"starting from the current material state, by a possibly different actor.\n"},{"number":1383,"text":"It recovers applicable progress, re-checks the invalidators of each reused\n"},{"number":1384,"text":"result (§7), reopens only affected support, and reconciles uncertain\n"},{"number":1385,"text":"external effects, sufficiently for the next dependent action, before any\n"},{"number":1386,"text":"repetition or dependent action. Resumption does not imply idempotence: an\n"},{"number":1387,"text":"action whose external effect may have occurred is not repeated blindly;\n"},{"number":1388,"text":"the lawful next moves are reconciliation, yield or stop.\n"},{"number":1389,"text":"\n"},{"number":1390,"text":"Checkpoint. Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next\n"},{"number":1391,"text":"already-authorised bounded action may begin without renewed human approval;\n"},{"number":1392,"text":"acceptance does not widen the selected outcome or the affected relation set\n"},{"number":1393,"text":"(P6, P2). A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted\n"},{"number":1394,"text":"work under an existing exact operation grant; it identifies its parent or\n"},{"number":1395,"text":"predecessor, the included territory, the concurrent-writer disposition and\n"},{"number":1396,"text":"the durable evidence location, and it is neither acceptance, promotion nor\n"},{"number":1397,"text":"publication. A proposed restart, which reconstructs from less than the\n"},{"number":1398,"text":"retained work, identifies why repair of retained work is insufficient,\n"},{"number":1399,"text":"which obligations and evidence survive, and which causal assumptions\n"},{"number":1400,"text":"change; reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction. The work state and reconciliation\n"},{"number":1401,"text":"of uncertain effects preserve the retained progress and unresolved obligations\n"},{"number":1402,"text":"(P0, P5 with the open-world premise).\n"},{"number":1403,"text":"\n"},{"number":1404,"text":"Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome;\n"},{"number":1405,"text":"prerequisite work names the obligation it enables; preservation and\n"},{"number":1406,"text":"repeated proof are evidence, not new progress; rejected or superseded\n"},{"number":1407,"text":"construction is churn; discovering previously hidden distance revises the\n"},{"number":1408,"text":"forecast and is not negative progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count,\n"},{"number":1409,"text":"commit count and review count are not progress by themselves. These are\n"},{"number":1410,"text":"semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm; a consumer may\n"},{"number":1411,"text":"derive its own progress and churn projections from them (P2). A member,\n"},{"number":1412,"text":"profile or project that distinguishes finer categories for its own\n"},{"number":1413,"text":"outcome states them as a refinement of these, naming this paragraph and\n"},{"number":1414,"text":"mapping each of its categories to one of progress, prerequisite work,\n"},{"number":1415,"text":"evidence that is not new progress, churn or forecast revision; a category\n"},{"number":1416,"text":"it cannot map is a change to this owner, not a parallel category (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1417,"text":"\n"},{"number":1418,"text":"The execution protocol of §1, §3 and this section is false if execution\n"},{"number":1419,"text":"proceeds from unreconstructable context; if a constructor's report\n"},{"number":1420,"text":"substitutes for required independent live evidence; if a bounded proxy\n"},{"number":1421,"text":"changes a governing relation outside its delegation; if unrelated\n"},{"number":1422,"text":"incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone; if a same-process test is used\n"},{"number":1423,"text":"to prove materially cross-process authority (§7); or if rejected activity\n"},{"number":1424,"text":"is reported as accepted progress.\n"},{"number":1425,"text":"\n"},{"number":1426,"text":"Foundation to law. This family, work state, resumption and reuse, covers\n"},{"number":1427,"text":"this section and §7. Its instance premises are: (a) a workspace that\n"},{"number":1428,"text":"persists across activations; (b) work that spans activations; (c) actors\n"},{"number":1429,"text":"that may change between activations; (d) external effects in an open\n"},{"number":1430,"text":"world. They are conditions of the work this family governs, not\n"},{"number":1431,"text":"commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. The standing of\n"},{"number":1432,"text":"the consequences below is stated in\n"},{"number":1433,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).\n"},{"number":1434,"text":"\n"},{"number":1435,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |\n"},{"number":1436,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1437,"text":"| P3 (independent), P0 (recovered); instance premises a, b | By P3 work state binds an exact basis, and by P0 an actor holds only part of it at a time, so work state is an object: the workspace, the governing basis, the applicable closed results and judgments, the residuals and the uncertainty over external effects | [§5](#5-work-state-and-restart), first paragraph | its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner): the profile or realisation | 2, 5 |\n"},{"number":1438,"text":"| P0 (recovered), P3 (independent), P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable), P6 (independent); instance premises a, c | By P0 an actor's context is bounded and disposable, by P3 the workspace binds the exact state, and by P4b recorded facts persist where the context does not, so the workspace is the truth surface and an actor's context a disposable account of it; current evidence corrects the account; discarding the account resets nothing | [The workspace and an actor's account](#the-workspace-and-an-actors-account) | the observations and reconciliations a resumption needs: the recovery contract, which is the resuming step's intake with the work state | 6, 9 |\n"},{"number":1439,"text":"| P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise), P6 (independent); An actor's\n"},{"number":1463,"text":"context is an account of that state. It is bounded, because it is a\n"},{"number":1464,"text":"projection of the state (§2); revisable, because an observation can\n"},{"number":1465,"text":"correct it; and disposable, because a step records its closed results and\n"},{"number":1466,"text":"step-produced facts before it returns (§1 Admission; P4b). An account is\n"},{"number":1467,"text":"never a second truth surface, and no later activation needs a prior\n"},{"number":1468,"text":"actor's context: its intake reconstructs the governing relations without\n"},{"number":1469,"text":"it (§1 Intake) (P0, P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1470,"text":"\n"},{"number":1471,"text":"Acquisition ([§2](#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope)) observes the\n"},{"number":1472,"text":"current subject and its authoritative inputs. Where they materially\n"},{"number":1473,"text":"disagree with a cached belief, a retained summary or a prior result, the\n"},{"number":1474,"text":"actor reconciles the disagreement: current evidence corrects the account,\n"},{"number":1475,"text":"and what the evidence cannot decide stays an explicit unknown. A stored\n"},{"number":1476,"text":"belief, a summary or a successful prior result never overrules contrary\n"},{"number":1477,"text":"current evidence. A prior result is relied on only after its\n"},{"number":1478,"text":"applicability and invalidators are checked against the current subject\n"},{"number":1479,"text":"and inputs (§7). The actor corrects its account within its grant; where\n"},{"number":1480,"text":"resolving the disagreement needs an operation, a territory or a decision\n"},{"number":1481,"text":"outside the grant, the step stops with `re_entry_requested(authority)`,\n"},{"number":1482,"text":"naming the owner of what it needs (§3 Construction availability) (P5,\n"},{"number":1483,"text":"P6).\n"},{"number":1484,"text":"\n"},{"number":1485,"text":"Discarding an actor's private context resets nothing: the workspace, the\n"},{"number":1486,"text":"applicable valid work and the outstanding obligations remain as the work\n"},{"number":1487,"text":"state records them. A missing trace in a context, a memory or a summary is\n"},{"number":1488,"text":"no evidence about the subject. It shows neither that work was not done\n"},{"number":1489,"text":"nor that an external effect did not occur, nor that it ended; an effect\n"},{"number":1490,"text":"of uncertain completion keeps the value `completion_unknown`, or its end\n"},{"number":1491,"text":"stays not established beside its `not_effected` value, until evidence\n"},{"number":1492,"text":"about the subject decides it (§3 Effects) (P5).\n"},{"number":1493,"text":"\n"},{"number":1494,"text":"Work that an interruption left partly written is part of the current\n"},{"number":1495,"text":"material state from which resumption (above) starts, and is assessed as\n"},{"number":1496,"text":"it stands; an assessment that was not performed has no result and is\n"},{"number":1497,"text":"never recorded as performed\n"},{"number":1498,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results); §3 Construction\n"},{"number":1499,"text":"availability). The method imposes no universal reset and no obligation to\n"},{"number":1500,"text":"replay the complete history. The recovery contract that applies, which is\n"},{"number":1501,"text":"the resuming step's intake with the work state, determines which\n"},{"number":1502,"text":"observations and which effect reconciliations the next dependent action\n"},{"number":1503,"text":"needs. Handoff between actors is by closed results, which carry no private\n"},{"number":1504,"text":"working context and keep their validity and independence conditions (§7)\n"},{"number":1505,"text":"(P0, P4b).\n"},{"number":1506,"text":"\n"},{"number":1507,"text":"Purpose and material relation: finite context (P0) means an actor's\n"},{"number":1508,"text":"context ends or is replaced while the work continues, and discarding it is\n"},{"number":1509,"text":"safe only because the step-produced facts the outer contract needs are\n"},{"number":1510,"text":"recorded (P4b). Treating the account as the truth surface would let a\n"},{"number":1511,"text":"stale account overrule the workspace; treating a discarded account as a\n"},{"number":1512,"text":"reset would erase progress or repeat an effect that occurred (P5, P6). The\n"},{"number":1513,"text":"material relation is whether a decision relies on an account that current\n"},{"number":1514,"text":"evidence contradicts, or reads a missing record as undone work or an\n"},{"number":1515,"text":"absent effect.  The workspace, the\n"},{"number":1516,"text":"work state and the closed results carry it, and no further carrier is\n"},{"number":1517,"text":"required.\n"},{"number":1518,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1626,"heading":"ACTIVATION/6. Cost and proportionality\n"},{"number":1520,"text":"\n"},{"number":1521,"text":"Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and\n"},{"number":1522,"text":"effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is\n"},{"number":1523,"text":"proportional when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space\n"},{"number":1524,"text":"justifies the additional concepts, relations, projections and evidence an\n"},{"number":1525,"text":"actor must hold together to reach a correct decision (P2, P0).\n"},{"number":1526,"text":"\n"},{"number":1527,"text":"Effective reasoning complexity includes independent concepts and authority\n"},{"number":1528,"text":"surfaces, cross-document joins, exceptions and branching, states and\n"},{"number":1529,"text":"transitions, duplicated representations requiring reconciliation, and the\n"},{"number":1530,"text":"detail required to decide the governed question. It is not raw line count,\n"},{"number":1531,"text":"artifact count or context-window size. A detailed algebra or semantic\n"},{"number":1532,"text":"design view may be highly proportional when it eliminates rival\n"},{"number":1533,"text":"interpretations; a short additional ticket, receipt or summary may be\n"},{"number":1534,"text":"disproportionate when it creates another truth surface without reducing\n"},{"number":1535,"text":"uncertainty.\n"},{"number":1536,"text":"\n"},{"number":1537,"text":"A proportional method deliberately constrains the admissible reasoning and\n"},{"number":1538,"text":"realisation space. Each constraint identifies the semantic ambiguity it\n"},{"number":1539,"text":"removes and contracts enough of the admissible interpretation space to\n"},{"number":1540,"text":"justify the reasoning complexity it introduces. Rival authority,\n"},{"number":1541,"text":"uncertainty over failure classification and evidence uncertainty count only\n"},{"number":1542,"text":"where they leave materially distinct admissible semantic, authority,\n"},{"number":1543,"text":"outcome or acceptance interpretations; they measure or evidence the same\n"},{"number":1544,"text":"interpretation space removed and are not independent proportional\n"},{"number":1545,"text":"benefits. The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,\n"},{"number":1546,"text":"collaboration, tool or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure\n"},{"number":1547,"text":"cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release\n"},{"number":1548,"text":"property. Increased actor capability may enlarge the bounded relation an\n"},{"number":1549,"text":"actor can resolve; it grants no authority, an instance of\n"},{"number":1550,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What\n"},{"number":1551,"text":"creates no authority, and it weakens no invariant and waives no\n"},{"number":1552,"text":"acceptance (P6). The owning law may justify one coherent constraint\n"},{"number":1553,"text":"family once; no rationale field, receipt or repeated audit is required for\n"},{"number":1554,"text":"every clause or consumer application.\n"},{"number":1555,"text":"\n"},{"number":1556,"text":"For symbolic design, materially divergent implementation paths, runtime\n"},{"number":1557,"text":"states, tests, reviews and reconciliation joins are counterfactual evidence\n"},{"number":1558,"text":"of the semantic alternatives the design contracts; they are not an\n"},{"number":1559,"text":"independent numerator. When one bounded symbolic model can resolve those\n"},{"number":1560,"text":"material alternatives within effective reasoning capacity, resolving it at\n"},{"number":1561,"text":"design altitude is proportional even when the model is detailed. A prior\n"},{"number":1562,"text":"design surface that removes no material semantic alternative is\n"},{"number":1563,"text":"disproportionate. A method addition is disproportionate when it duplicates\n"},{"number":1564,"text":"truth, increases reconciliation paths or expands the bounded reasoning\n"},{"number":1565,"text":"surface without materially reducing ambiguity; existing obligations should\n"},{"number":1566,"text":"absorb new detail where they can without weakening ownership or meaning.\n"},{"number":1567,"text":"\n"},{"number":1568,"text":"Apply this relation to the method's own execution: repeated source\n"},{"number":1569,"text":"acquisition, context assembly, hashing, activation preparation, status\n"},{"number":1570,"text":"recording, review and evidence generation serve an identified change,\n"},{"number":1571,"text":"decision or assurance need. Reuse stays subject to exact applicability and\n"},{"number":1572,"text":"invalidation (§7); repetition alone supplies neither validity nor\n"},{"number":1573,"text":"independence. Where this work materially affects the supported outcome, its\n"},{"number":1574,"text":"operational assumptions are qualified under UP-019 below. No universal\n"},{"number":1575,"text":"resource quota or separate accounting carrier follows. The delivery\n"},{"number":1576,"text":"priority this relation yields for a product outcome is SPEC_METHOD §8.\n"},{"number":1577,"text":"\n"},{"number":1578,"text":"Cost is selected, not universal. Where a cost claim is the governed\n"},{"number":1579,"text":"question, the activation declares its allowance and reports its spend,\n"},{"number":1580,"text":"measured under the selected execution binding or recorded as unmeasured\n"},{"number":1581,"text":"(P0; Resource limits below). The size of an activation's\n"},{"number":1582,"text":"context is measured and fitted under §2 step 3, which refines the\n"},{"number":1583,"text":"resource-limit law below for the context dimension. Separate material startup, framework\n"},{"number":1584,"text":"processing, external computation, transport and assurance costs so that\n"},{"number":1585,"text":"one cannot conceal another; declare supported input dimensions and\n"},{"number":1586,"text":"workloads before qualification\n"},{"number":1587,"text":"([UP-019](DESIGN_MODULE.md#computational-realisation-projection-up-019)).\n"},{"number":1588,"text":"Report volume is not model traffic; a cost claim over transferred context\n"},{"number":1589,"text":"counts the context transferred to every delegated actor, not only to the\n"},{"number":1590,"text":"coordinator. No universal quota, ticket count, actor count or accounting\n"},{"number":1591,"text":"carrier follows.\n"},{"number":1592,"text":"\n"},{"number":1593,"text":"Foundation to law. This family, proportionality and cost, covers this\n"},{"number":1594,"text":"section, with Resource limits below, and the delivery priority of\n"},{"number":1595,"text":"SPEC_METHOD §8. Its instance premises\n"},{"number":1596,"text":"are: (a) a selected outcome; (b) method obligations that each add\n"},{"number":1597,"text":"reasoning complexity; (c) where one is the governed question, a cost\n"},{"number":1598,"text":"claim; (d) an activation that consumes bounded resources, such as\n"},{"number":1599,"text":"context, attention, time or spend. They are conditions of the work this family governs, not\n"},{"number":1600,"text":"commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. probability waives no hard stop | [SPEC_METHOD §8](SPEC_METHOD.md#8-bounded-execution-in-this-method), outside this member | the default priority, the smallest supported product path first: SPEC_METHOD §8 | 1, 5 |\n"},{"number":1612,"text":"\n"},{"number":1613,"text":"Consumers of these rows, where an actor enters them (FOUNDATIONS §3\n"},{"number":1614,"text":"Foundation to law, Consumers), one list per row, each consumer linked to\n"},{"number":1615,"text":"its own locus:\n"},{"number":1616,"text":"\n"},{"number":1617,"text":"- Row 1, the proportionality relation: [§1 Configuration](#configuration), whose explanation of an allocation is proportional, and [Roles and delegation](#roles-and-delegation), where a review or ceremony that no law requires adds reasoning cost without removing ambiguity; Cost and proportionality/Resource limits","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F6.%20Cost%20and%20proportionality%2FResource%20limits","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"92ab379aae0fb61566894e2278729d41919f8363f6e4cf174388865fe6165bfe","start_line":1627,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1627,"text":"### Resource limits\n"},{"number":1628,"text":"\n"},{"number":1629,"text":"A resource limit bounds a resource that an activation consumes: context,\n"},{"number":1630,"text":"attention, wall time, spend, human effort, communication or a machine\n"},{"number":1631,"text":"resource (P0). This subsection owns the law for every such limit. It sets\n"},{"number":1632,"text":"no value (P0, P2, P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1633,"text":"\n"},{"number":1634,"text":"- Declaration. A limit applies to an activation only where its intake,\n"},{"number":1635,"text":"  its actor's capability envelope or the selected execution binding\n"},{"number":1636,"text":"  declares it, because a resource control applies only through a selected\n"},{"number":1637,"text":"  frame and its owning scope\n"},{"number":1638,"text":"  ([REFERENCE_FRAME §4 Frame-set selection](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#frame-set-selection)).\n"},{"number":1639,"text":"  A declared limit states its unit and the boundary over which it is\n"},{"number":1640,"text":"  measured: which inputs, actors, processes and repeated reads it counts.\n"},{"number":1641,"text":"  No universal quota, budget or measurement gate follows.\n"},{"number":1642,"text":"- Measurement. A declared limit is measured in its unit over its boundary\n"},{"number":1643,"text":"  where the obligation it serves needs the measurement; consumption\n"},{"number":1644,"text":"  outside the boundary is recorded as not measured, and no claim against\n"},{"number":1645,"text":"  the limit covers it. A context limit bounds the material held in active\n"},{"number":1646,"text":"  context at once, including material acquired during the activation, so\n"},{"number":1647,"text":"  the bytes supplied at its start, the cumulative bytes it acquires,\n"},{"number":1648,"text":"  counting repeated reads, and the bound on what it holds at once are\n"},{"number":1649,"text":"  reported separately; §2 step 3 refines this for the measurement of the\n"},{"number":1650,"text":"  selected context before it is read. Measures that answer different\n"},{"number":1651,"text":"  questions, such as the cost components of Cost is selected above, are\n"},{"number":1652,"text":"  reported separately.\n"},{"number":1653,"text":"- Exhaustion. Pressure on a declared limit never licenses omitting or\n"},{"number":1654,"text":"  truncating a material obligation or input. Before a limit would be\n"},{"number":1655,"text":"  exceeded, the activation refines the task, sequences activations,\n"},{"number":1656,"text":"  reassigns the work to an actor whose limits fit, or stops with the\n"},{"number":1657,"text":"  applicable value of §3, naming the limit, such as `incomplete` where\n"},{"number":1658,"text":"  bounded execution ends first; a stop keeps the unresolved outcome\n"},{"number":1659,"text":"  ([§1 Transitions](#transitions), Stops). Enlarging a limit re-enters the\n"},{"number":1660,"text":"  owner of the grant or binding that set it.\n"},{"number":1661,"text":"- Values. The value of each limit, and the units and boundaries the\n"},{"number":1662,"text":"  selected environment can measure, are set by the selected execution\n"},{"number":1663,"text":"  binding, which binds this law; for a build tenant that binding is the\n"},{"number":1664,"text":"  one [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding) defines.\n"},{"number":1665,"text":"  A value is stated before the activation it limits.\n"},{"number":1666,"text":"- Standing. An activation that stays within its limits is not thereby\n"},{"number":1667,"text":"  adequate, and an actor's larger limits grant no authority and waive no\n"},{"number":1668,"text":"  invariant (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1669,"text":"\n"},{"number":1670,"text":"Purpose and material relation: the configuration (§1), context\n"},{"number":1671,"text":"construction (§2) and frame qualification\n"},{"number":1672,"text":"([EVALUATION §7](EVALUATION.md#frame-qualification)) rely on resource\n"},{"number":1673,"text":"limits, so the law for declaring, measuring and honouring them is stated\n"},{"number":1674,"text":"once in tier 1, and only their values are left to the execution binding.\n"},{"number":1675,"text":"The material relation is whether an undeclared, unmeasured or exceeded\n"},{"number":1676,"text":"limit is read as fitting, or forces a silent omission. The rule applies\n"},{"number":1677,"text":"RF-014's prohibition of silent omission, REFERENCE_FRAME §4's rule that a\n"},{"number":1678,"text":"resource control applies only through a selected frame, and UP-014's\n"},{"number":1679,"text":"selection rule.\n"},{"number":1680,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1749,"heading":"ACTIVATION/7. Closed result and reuse\n"},{"number":1682,"text":"\n"},{"number":1683,"text":"A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the\n"},{"number":1684,"text":"basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual\n"},{"number":1685,"text":"uncertainty and the invalidation conditions (the minimal shape is\n"},{"number":1686,"text":"REFERENCE_FRAME §13). The frame's internal working context need not be\n"},{"number":1687,"text":"transferred when the closed result and its provenance are sufficient for\n"},{"number":1688,"text":"the consuming decision; it may still be attached, for audit or otherwise,\n"},{"number":1689,"text":"without changing the result. Independent evaluations may share valid\n"},{"number":1690,"text":"mechanical evidence under the declared independence conditions of\n"},{"number":1691,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment), which owns that\n"},{"number":1692,"text":"permission (P4b, P0).\n"},{"number":1693,"text":"\n"},{"number":1694,"text":"The sufficiency of a handed-off result or reference for subsequent decisions\n"},{"number":1695,"text":"is [FOUNDATIONS §4 Observation sufficiency](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation)'s\n"},{"number":1696,"text":"consumer-relative claim. Reuse preserves the material standing and\n"},{"number":1697,"text":"continuation distinctions, including unassessed versus indeterminate; a\n"},{"number":1698,"text":"role change alone requires no full-history scan or new representation.\n"},{"number":1699,"text":"\n"},{"number":1700,"text":"The selection of affected results after a change and the conditions for\n"},{"number":1701,"text":"retaining evidence on a new subject are\n"},{"number":1702,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse);\n"},{"number":1703,"text":"this section applies them to closed results and handoffs, and the three\n"},{"number":1704,"text":"invalidators below are kinds of change Δ, and a closed result is affected\n"},{"number":1705,"text":"when its dependencies `D*(t)` meet the impact cover `I(Δ)` (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1706,"text":"\n"},{"number":1707,"text":"A closed result is reused by an unchanged consumer that checks exact\n"},{"number":1708,"text":"applicability; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates\n"},{"number":1709,"text":"nothing. An invalidator invalidates the affected result before reliance,\n"},{"number":1710,"text":"even where the subject's own bytes are unchanged, preserving its\n"},{"number":1711,"text":"predecessor/successor relation and any demonstrably independent surviving\n"},{"number":1712,"text":"results. Invalidation withdraws the result from direct reliance; whether\n"},{"number":1713,"text":"its evidence is retained on the new basis is decided by `retain_applicable`\n"},{"number":1714,"text":"of FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse, and the changed\n"},{"number":1715,"text":"coordinate alone establishes neither that the claim fails nor that it\n"},{"number":1716,"text":"holds. The invalidators are three:\n"},{"number":1717,"text":"\n"},{"number":1718,"text":"- a material input change: a change to the result's subject or to an\n"},{"number":1719,"text":"  input it rests on, including the admissible evidence that bears on its\n"},{"number":1720,"text":"  predicate; newly acquired or changed admissible evidence is such a\n"},{"number":1721,"text":"  change when it is material to the result as\n"},{"number":1722,"text":"  [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology) defines material, that is,\n"},{"number":1723,"text":"  when it could change the result's value;\n"},{"number":1724,"text":"- a changed basis: a change to any coordinate of the basis the result\n"},{"number":1725,"text":"  binds (FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis);\n"},{"number":1726,"text":"- a declared revising observation: an observation that the result or\n"},{"number":1727,"text":"  judgment itself names as one that would revise it, once it occurs.\n"},{"number":1728,"text":"\n"},{"number":1729,"text":"A changed source, task or actor condition is a changed basis where the\n"},{"number":1730,"text":"basis binds it, and otherwise a material input change; a role change that\n"},{"number":1731,"text":"alters a required actor condition is such a change, while a role,\n"},{"number":1732,"text":"conversation or resumption change that alters none of these invalidates\n"},{"number":1733,"text":"nothing (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1734,"text":"\n"},{"number":1735,"text":"Judgment continuity names the basis and the evidence; Return A Closed\n"},{"number":1736,"text":"Result names inputs and the observation. A member, profile or project\n"},{"number":1737,"text":"that names a trigger for its own domain, such as a changed projection,\n"},{"number":1738,"text":"rule or configuration, names it as an instance of one of these three and\n"},{"number":1739,"text":"states no parallel list (P3, P4b, P6). A reused judgment does not\n"},{"number":1740,"text":"satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor\n"},{"number":1741,"text":"acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment. [TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity)\n"},{"number":1742,"text":"uses the same evidence invalidator. Naming these kinds once gives every\n"},{"number":1743,"text":"consumer the same triggers. The\n"},{"number":1744,"text":"material relation is whether a result is relied on after a change that\n"},{"number":1745,"text":"could alter it (P3, P6). Whether a revision of a frame needs a new\n"},{"number":1746,"text":"revision coordinate is\n"},{"number":1747,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §10](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#revision-actions)'s question;\n"},{"number":1748,"text":"whether a result it touches stays valid is this section's.\n"},{"number":1749,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1769,"heading":"ACTIVATION/7. Consumers\n"},{"number":1758,"text":"choose the representation. Transition evidence is a read\n"},{"number":1759,"text":"model; it does not become specification, design or admission authority\n"},{"number":1760,"text":"(P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":1761,"text":"\n"},{"number":1762,"text":"Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the\n"},{"number":1763,"text":"active relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a\n"},{"number":1764,"text":"declared candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the\n"},{"number":1765,"text":"affected risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary (§6). A durable or\n"},{"number":1766,"text":"reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a same-process\n"},{"number":1767,"text":"proof when loss of incidental process state is a material counterexample:\n"},{"number":1768,"text":"the proof destroys or excludes the incidental authority and compares the\n"},{"number":1769,"text":"reconstructed semantic outcomes (P5, P6).\n"}]},{"end_line":30,"heading":"ASSURANCE","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ASSURANCE.md#ASSURANCE","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ASSURANCE.md","sha256":"c080a8ab6616ee2cbfa1cc9a4b82006e1708b1676bc99c6d7cbd4eeefe927862","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ASSURANCE.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# ASSURANCE\n"},{"number":2,"text":"\n"},{"number":3,"text":"Tier 2. Owns the assurance and testing law of the method: the verification\n"},{"number":4,"text":"layers of the chain, the testing strategy taxonomy with its two proof\n"},{"number":5,"text":"authorities and its fixture and proof portability rule, test authority,\n"},{"number":6,"text":"scenario bundles, installed dev proof, significant path coverage, the\n"},{"number":7,"text":"product testing frame set, combinatorial coverage and testing value,\n"},{"number":8,"text":"legitimate-path and technical-debt erasure, testing evidence composition,\n"},{"number":9,"text":"assurance subject acquisition, counterexample localisation and the\n"},{"number":10,"text":"end-to-end interface integration frame. Its family table (F14) is §1\n"},{"number":11,"text":"Foundation to law.\n"},{"number":12,"text":"Consumes [FOUNDATIONS](FOUNDATIONS.md) (§2 claim, evidence, judgment,\n"},{"number":13,"text":"authority; §4 [Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), the core result algebra,\n"},{"number":14,"text":"and [Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)),\n"},{"number":15,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md) (the frame, its declaration shape,\n"},{"number":16,"text":"frames in conjunction, translation and coverage),\n"},{"number":17,"text":"[EVALUATION](EVALUATION.md) (claims, separation, independent\n"},{"number":18,"text":"assessment, acceptance, conformance) and [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md)\n"},{"number":19,"text":"(§1 applicability and the execution relation, §6 proportionality, §7\n"},{"number":20,"text":"reuse); adds no definition to tier 1. The particular\n"},{"number":21,"text":"method's chain and change classes are [SPEC_METHOD](SPEC_METHOD.md); the\n"},{"number":22,"text":"project's bindings are [PRODUCT_DEFINITION](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md). The\n"},{"number":23,"text":"design profile's module-derived unit-proof law (its 6A to 6C) is §14 to\n"},{"number":24,"text":"§16, and the ticket law's test-case authority is\n"},{"number":25,"text":"[TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#test-case-authority); this text pre-empts neither. Verification layers\n"},{"number":32,"text":"\n"},{"number":33,"text":"Each layer of the chain ([SPEC_METHOD §2 Constitutional chain](SPEC_METHOD.md#constitutional-chain)) preserves a distinct kind of truth\n"},{"number":34,"text":"(P2, P6):\n"},{"number":35,"text":"\n"},{"number":36,"text":"| Layer | What it preserves | Primary question answered |\n"},{"number":37,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":38,"text":"| Requirements | invariant truth | what must be true? |\n"},{"number":39,"text":"| Design | structural choice | how is that truth realised? |\n"},{"number":40,"text":"| Scenarios | operational meaning | can the realised system actually do the claimed thing? |\n"},{"number":41,"text":"\n"},{"number":42,"text":"Without scenarios a capability can appear covered because the words exist\n"},{"number":43,"text":"in requirements and design. Scenarios force the sharper question: can the\n"},{"number":44,"text":"product really do the thing? A requirement can name a reusable composable\n"},{"number":45,"text":"unit and a design record can describe the types that realise it, but only\n"},{"number":46,"text":"a scenario asks whether a user can build such a unit and apply it twice\n"},{"number":47,"text":"(P6).\n"},{"number":48,"text":"\n"},{"number":49,"text":"Scenarios are the product-owner layer: concrete, end-to-end use cases that\n"},{"number":50,"text":"validate the chain from intent to realised behaviour. While no scenario\n"},{"number":51,"text":"for a capability can be written, its operational meaning is unverified;\n"},{"number":52,"text":"that alone does not show whether its governing claim is inadequate or the\n"},{"number":53,"text":"means to state or observe its expected outcome is missing, and diagnosis\n"},{"number":54,"text":"under [ACTIVATION §1 Feedback and diagnosis](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation)\n"},{"number":55,"text":"locates the cause. When a scenario fails, its observed outcome disagrees\n"},{"number":56,"text":"with the scenario's expected outcome, which no comparison of the\n"},{"number":57,"text":"specification's words with its other words could show. That report is an\n"},{"number":58,"text":"observation, so it shows that actual behaviour disagrees only where its\n"},{"number":59,"text":"observation binding is supported\n"},{"number":60,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Assertions and observation](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation)).\n"},{"number":61,"text":"The failure alone does not show whether the realisation, the governing\n"},{"number":62,"text":"claim, the scenario's expected outcome or its observation is wrong;\n"},{"number":63,"text":"[§12 Counterexample localisation](#12-counterexample-localisation) locates\n"},{"number":64,"text":"the cause as far as the evidence supports (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":65,"text":"\n"},{"number":66,"text":"Scenarios do not replace requirement categories. They primarily validate\n"},{"number":67,"text":"capability claims and other behaviour with concrete operational meaning.\n"},{"number":68,"text":"Constraints, governance rules and verification-infrastructure requirements\n"},{"number":69,"text":"may require different evidence in addition to, or instead of, end-to-end\n"},{"number":70,"text":"scenarios (P2).\n"},{"number":71,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":132,"heading":"ASSURANCE/1.
