What\n"},{"number":521,"text":"creates no authority is listed there; in `a_c` its instances are copying,\n"},{"number":522,"text":"interpreting, encoding, evaluating and transporting a record, none of\n"},{"number":523,"text":"which transfers authority (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":524,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":535,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-006 Basis coherence","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-006%20Basis%20coherence","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"5db54d8c401e8835c39ef52af6a722c64f3f735454624110c7e63decf728d6a5","start_line":525,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":525,"text":"### AC-006 Basis coherence\n"},{"number":526,"text":"\n"},{"number":527,"text":"Every result binds its exact basis under\n"},{"number":528,"text":"[RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates), which\n"},{"number":529,"text":"owns the exact-basis rule for results; what a basis is, including that\n"},{"number":530,"text":"mixed bases need an explicit composite relation, is FOUNDATIONS §2,\n"},{"number":531,"text":"Basis. This law binds the same rule to every fundamental record and model\n"},{"number":532,"text":"of `a_c`: each binds an exact basis, the composite-basis relation of a\n"},{"number":533,"text":"mixed basis is an explicitly owned record, and individually valid\n"},{"number":534,"text":"coordinates do not create a coherent composite basis by proximity (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":535,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":635,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-007 Constraint and refusal","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-007%20Constraint%20and%20refusal","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"e476536499c81ef3294db1007956c7d3eb83314cee81a3f22bf1090798d13267","start_line":536,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":536,"text":"### AC-007 Constraint and refusal\n"},{"number":537,"text":"\n"},{"number":538,"text":"Each constraint names its governed subject, predicate, judgment kind,\n"},{"number":539,"text":"latitude and refusal (§3, Constraint). The judgment of a constraint\n"},{"number":540,"text":"returns one value of the core result algebra of\n"},{"number":541,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), directly or through a\n"},{"number":542,"text":"refinement that the owning signature declares and that maps each of its\n"},{"number":543,"text":"values to exactly one core value. Under the no-coercion rule of\n"},{"number":544,"text":"FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, a failed, missing, indeterminate, out-of-scope or\n"},{"number":545,"text":"invalid-basis result of a constraint follows that algebra and is never\n"},{"number":546,"text":"coerced to satisfied (P5, P6). The\n"},{"number":547,"text":"core values, the rule that no mapping raises a result's standing and the\n"},{"number":548,"text":"boundary among out_of_frame, indeterminate and an evaluation that was not\n"},{"number":549,"text":"performed are FOUNDATIONS §4 Results'. This law applies them to the\n"},{"number":550,"text":"judgment of a constraint and to the outcomes of the operations of this\n"},{"number":551,"text":"member, and adds no core value.\n"},{"number":552,"text":"\n"},{"number":553,"text":"Constraint results. The outcomes of a constraint's judgment map for the\n"},{"number":554,"text":"predicate \"the constraint's predicate holds for its governed subject on\n"},{"number":555,"text":"the exact basis\" (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":556,"text":"\n"},{"number":557,"text":"| Outcome | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":558,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":559,"text":"| holds | satisfied | the judgment establishes the predicate on the exact basis |\n"},{"number":560,"text":"| failed | falsified | a counterexample defeats the predicate; the judgment names it |\n"},{"number":561,"text":"| indeterminate | indeterminate | the admissible evidence cannot decide the predicate; the judgment names the evidence that would decide |\n"},{"number":562,"text":"| out of scope | out_of_frame | the predicate is asked of a subject or relation outside the constraint's declared `applies_to`, context or scope, so deciding it needs a relation the constraint does not declare; the judgment names that relation, with its owner where the subject gives one |\n"},{"number":563,"text":"| invalid basis | invalid_basis | the subject or basis cannot support the judgment; the judgment names the basis repair |\n"},{"number":564,"text":"\n"},{"number":565,"text":"A missing result is no value of this refinement: a judgment that was not\n"},{"number":566,"text":"performed has no closed result, is never `indeterminate`, and enters every\n"},{"number":567,"text":"conjunction over it as a planned assessment without a closed result\n"},{"number":568,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Not performed).\n"},{"number":569,"text":"\n"},{"number":570,"text":"Operation outcomes. A closure (AC-010), a projection (AC-011), the\n"},{"number":571,"text":"structural admission of a record, model or carrier, the application of a\n"},{"number":572,"text":"transformation (AC-013) and an interpretation (§6) each end in their\n"},{"number":573,"text":"declared result or in one of the stops `hold`, `gap` and `refusal` that\n"},{"number":574,"text":"this member writes. Where this member says that a condition refuses, the\n"},{"number":575,"text":"operation returns `refusal` naming the condition; the record, model or\n"},{"number":576,"text":"carrier is not admitted, and nothing is dropped silently. Each outcome\n"},{"number":577,"text":"maps for the predicate \"the operation yields its declared result on the\n"},{"number":578,"text":"exact basis\" (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":579,"text":"\n"},{"number":580,"text":"| Outcome | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":581,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":582,"text":"| declared result | satisfied | the closure, the projection with its boundary, the admission, the proposed successor `M_b_prime*` or the proposed model `M_subject*` is returned on the exact basis; a proposed successor or model establishes that it is available, never its acceptance or admission (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) |\n"},{"number":583,"text":"| `hold` | indeterminate | the operation was applied and stops because evidence, an observation or a disposition it needs is not yet admitted, so the admissible evidence cannot decide whether it yields its result; its residual names what would decide |\n"},{"number":584,"text":"| `gap` | invalid_basis | the result needs a member, reference, resolution or declaration whose resolution on the basis is still open: the declared relation that resolves it has not yet decided it, as for an external resolution not yet evaluated; the result is undefined on this basis until it is supplied. A reference evaluated to no target is dangling and refuses (AC-003): a local reference with no record in the model's closed population, and an external reference whose declared resolution has been evaluated and yields no target |\n"},{"number":585,"text":"| `refusal(constraint)` | falsified | every refusal that is not `refusal(basis)`: the refusal names a demonstrated violation of a declared law of this member or a constraint of its signature by the record, model, carrier, transformation or application under judgment, including a missing record family (AC-001), a dangling reference (AC-003) and an application without its traversal (AC-015), or it names no condition of the basis; the violation or other defect it names is the counterexample |\n"},{"number":586,"text":"| `refusal(basis)` | invalid_basis | the refusal names one or more conditions of the basis the operation acts on and no demonstrated violation of a declared law or constraint by the record, model, carrier, transformation or application under judgment: a seed set, relation family, required-edge semantics, basis or scope that is not exact; a fixed point that is not finite and unique; an input model, subject or carrier whose exact identity, basis or admission is not established; or mixed bases with no composite-basis relation (AC-006) |\n"},{"number":587,"text":"\n"},{"number":588,"text":"The cause is part of a refusal's value, because a refusal would otherwise\n"},{"number":589,"text":"map to falsified or to invalid_basis according to its cause, and a refined\n"},{"number":590,"text":"value maps to exactly one core value (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results,\n"},{"number":591,"text":"Refinements). A refusal that names a demonstrated violation of a declared\n"},{"number":592,"text":"law or constraint by the record, model, carrier, transformation or\n"},{"number":593,"text":"application under judgment is `refusal(constraint)`, whatever condition of\n"},{"number":594,"text":"the basis it also names. The basis condition is recorded with the refusal\n"},{"number":595,"text":"and reported beside it as its own `invalid_basis` result, which names the\n"},{"number":596,"text":"basis repair and answers the predicate of the evaluation that the\n"},{"number":597,"text":"condition leaves without a supporting basis, never the operation-outcome\n"},{"number":598,"text":"predicate that the refusal answers\n"},{"number":599,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results),\n"},{"number":600,"text":"Predicates travel). A refusal that names only conditions of the basis is\n"},{"number":601,"text":"`refusal(basis)`. A violation inside an input that the operation acts on\n"},{"number":602,"text":"as its basis is a condition of the basis for that operation, not a\n"},{"number":603,"text":"violation by what it judges, as the projection below shows. Purpose and\n"},{"number":604,"text":"material relation: a demonstrated violation is a known failure, which\n"},{"number":605,"text":"survives every join only as a `falsified` result, so a basis condition\n"},{"number":606,"text":"named beside it neither hides the failure nor discards its counterexample,\n"},{"number":607,"text":"and the basis repair stays named (FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results,\n"},{"number":608,"text":"Survival; P5, P6). A basis mismatch inside a model or a record, a\n"},{"number":609,"text":"relation's qualifier record included, is mixed bases with no\n"},{"number":610,"text":"composite-basis relation (AC-006): a coordinate of the model or record\n"},{"number":611,"text":"binds, or a reference in it resolves on, a basis that the governing basis\n"},{"number":612,"text":"relation does not admit, as a wrong-basis reference of AC-003 does. It is\n"},{"number":613,"text":"a condition of the basis, in the structural admission that judges that\n"},{"number":614,"text":"model or record as in every other operation, and never a violated\n"},{"number":615,"text":"constraint of a signature, even where the signature declares the basis\n"},{"number":616,"text":"relation; a refusal that names only such a mismatch is `refusal(basis)`.\n"},{"number":617,"text":"One defect can bear on two predicates: a model that violates AC-001 is\n"},{"number":618,"text":"`refusal(constraint)` in the structural admission that judges it and\n"},{"number":619,"text":"`refusal(basis)` in a projection over it, and each outcome answers its own\n"},{"number":620,"text":"predicate. An operation that was not applied has no outcome. A stop `gap`\n"},{"number":621,"text":"is a closed result with the value invalid_basis; it is not the absence of\n"},{"number":622,"text":"a result that\n"},{"number":623,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)\n"},{"number":624,"text":"records as a gap. A signature's stop contract and a traversal record map\n"},{"number":625,"text":"stops of their own under §5.\n"},{"number":626,"text":"\n"},{"number":627,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a\n"},{"number":628,"text":"constraint result or an operation's stop combines with results of other\n"},{"number":629,"text":"members only through the one core, so a refusal, a hold or a gap is\n"},{"number":630,"text":"neither read as success nor mistaken for another case; and a closure or\n"},{"number":631,"text":"projection that is not established has the value invalid_basis here, as\n"},{"number":632,"text":"the activation outcome `closure_unresolved` of\n"},{"number":633,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation) has for its own\n"},{"number":634,"text":"predicate (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":635,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":643,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-008 Explicit latitude","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-008%20Explicit%20latitude","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"23f3ee970e3c8dc8ca04973641344de931646d8587c3466c5676f891318ba147","start_line":636,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":636,"text":"### AC-008 Explicit latitude\n"},{"number":637,"text":"\n"},{"number":638,"text":"Two values may differ lawfully only through an applicable latitude record\n"},{"number":639,"text":"or transformation relation. An implementation preference, a probabilistic\n"},{"number":640,"text":"choice or a human presence is not implicit latitude. FOUNDATIONS §4 states\n"},{"number":641,"text":"the same rule for any two values; this law is its form over `L` and `T`\n"},{"number":642,"text":"(P6, P1).\n"},{"number":643,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":650,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-009 Residual conservation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-009%20Residual%20conservation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"684d8db7b7dc3f7cb295bac7e9ce1a7bf2fbbf7e3666df28d5abdcad0c4a3a75","start_line":644,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":644,"text":"### AC-009 Residual conservation\n"},{"number":645,"text":"\n"},{"number":646,"text":"Every material uncertainty, omission, translation loss, unresolved\n"},{"number":647,"text":"boundary or unproven relation remains in `X` until an authorised\n"},{"number":648,"text":"disposition creates an exact successor model. Absence from a projection is\n"},{"number":649,"text":"not resolution (P4b).\n"},{"number":650,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":669,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-010 Material closure","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-010%20Material%20closure","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"393cbd3c2d95679717248af7bd689894b7bb50515a886712fb92f65a598c0b55","start_line":651,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":651,"text":"### AC-010 Material closure\n"},{"number":652,"text":"\n"},{"number":653,"text":"For model `M`, seed set `Z` and exact dependency relation family `R`,\n"},{"number":654,"text":"material closure is the least fixed point (P0, P2):\n"},{"number":655,"text":"\n"},{"number":656,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":657,"text":"closure_R(M, Z) = lfp(lambda Q: Z union required_R(M, Q))\n"},{"number":658,"text":"```\n"},{"number":659,"text":"\n"},{"number":660,"text":"The result is defined only when `Z`, `R`, required-edge semantics, basis\n"},{"number":661,"text":"and scope are exact and the fixed point is finite and unique. Failure to\n"},{"number":662,"text":"establish those conditions returns a gap or refusal: `gap` where a\n"},{"number":663,"text":"condition is unresolved on the basis, otherwise `refusal(basis)`, because\n"},{"number":664,"text":"each condition bears on the basis the closure acts on (AC-007). Least\n"},{"number":665,"text":"closure means least lawful record closure under `R`; it does not claim\n"},{"number":666,"text":"globally minimal prose, bytes, tokens, cost or cognitive effort.\n"},{"number":667,"text":"ACTIVATION §2 applies this closure to the construction of a step's context\n"},{"number":668,"text":"under an envelope.\n"},{"number":669,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":696,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-011 Projection","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-011%20Projection","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"7a63dd69149e90e6c4a3434855654370d0f9bc9036585c5021dbe108315931e6","start_line":670,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":670,"text":"### AC-011 Projection\n"},{"number":671,"text":"\n"},{"number":672,"text":"A projection selects a view of a model without changing selected meaning\n"},{"number":673,"text":"(P4b, P2):\n"},{"number":674,"text":"\n"},{"number":675,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":676,"text":"project(M, Z, R) -> (M_Z, Boundary_Z) | gap | refusal\n"},{"number":677,"text":"```\n"},{"number":678,"text":"\n"},{"number":679,"text":"`M_Z` contains the material closure of `Z`, so a projection's `gap` or\n"},{"number":680,"text":"`refusal` is that of the closure it contains or of the model it acts on:\n"},{"number":681,"text":"`gap` or `refusal(basis)` (AC-007). `Boundary_Z` records excluded,\n"},{"number":682,"text":"external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams. A\n"},{"number":683,"text":"projection is not a new semantic owner. It is a reference, so the rule\n"},{"number":684,"text":"that no reference trims a required member to fit a carrier or budget,\n"},{"number":685,"text":"stated at [FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra), Reference versus\n"},{"number":686,"text":"body, applies to it: here the required members are those of the material\n"},{"number":687,"text":"closure of `Z`, and a capability budget is one such budget. ACTIVATION §2\n"},{"number":688,"text":"applies the projection to a step's context, and every projected frame of\n"},{"number":689,"text":"this corpus is one.\n"},{"number":690,"text":"\n"},{"number":691,"text":"Sufficiency for later decisions consumes\n"},{"number":692,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Observation sufficiency](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation),\n"},{"number":693,"text":"including the distinctions required by the bound consumer and continuation.\n"},{"number":694,"text":"A projection by itself establishes neither a Markov property nor a\n"},{"number":695,"text":"categorical-functor claim (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":696,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":704,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-012 Overlay","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-012%20Overlay","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"b99c800207806048c3a567710c52241ef64e476763112fc5b399da0a0a1ee795","start_line":697,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":697,"text":"### AC-012 Overlay\n"},{"number":698,"text":"\n"},{"number":699,"text":"An overlay adds explicit records to one or more declared `Population_M`\n"},{"number":700,"text":"families of a basis model. It does not mutate the basis. Override,\n"},{"number":701,"text":"disambiguation, equivalence, specialisation or translation exists only as\n"},{"number":702,"text":"a typed relation with exact authority, direction, scope, basis,\n"},{"number":703,"text":"preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation semantics (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":704,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":890,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-013 Transformation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-013%20Transformation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"9433ceb327c80b4b4ea933fd922bba987767adbc4245367ce47a3aac6538b0eb","start_line":705,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":705,"text":"### AC-013 Transformation\n"},{"number":706,"text":"\n"},{"number":707,"text":"A transformation is an operation-bearing specialisation of one exact\n"},{"number":708,"text":"traversal record `v` (§5). Its record is (P4b, P3):\n"},{"number":709,"text":"\n"},{"number":710,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":711,"text":"t = {\n"},{"number":712,"text":"  id,\n"},{"number":713,"text":"  traversal,\n"},{"number":714,"text":"  domain_model,\n"},{"number":715,"text":"  codomain_model,\n"},{"number":716,"text":"  context,\n"},{"number":717,"text":"  owner,\n"},{"number":718,"text":"  scope,\n"},{"number":719,"text":"  basis,\n"},{"number":720,"text":"  operation_authority,\n"},{"number":721,"text":"  preconditions,\n"},{"number":722,"text":"  preservation_relation,\n"},{"number":723,"text":"  preserved,\n"},{"number":724,"text":"  introduced,\n"},{"number":725,"text":"  removed,\n"},{"number":726,"text":"  external_preserved,\n"},{"number":727,"text":"  external_introduced,\n"},{"number":728,"text":"  external_removed,\n"},{"number":729,"text":"  external_resolution_witnesses,\n"},{"number":730,"text":"  residuals,\n"},{"number":731,"text":"  evidence,\n"},{"number":732,"text":"  provenance,\n"},{"number":733,"text":"  stop_states,\n"},{"number":734,"text":"  invalidation,\n"},{"number":735,"text":"  re_entry\n"},{"number":736,"text":"}\n"},{"number":737,"text":"```\n"},{"number":738,"text":"\n"},{"number":739,"text":"`t.traversal` resolves one `v`; its context, owner, scope, basis,\n"},{"number":740,"text":"operation authority, evidence, provenance and stop contract equal or\n"},{"number":741,"text":"lawfully restrict the corresponding traversal coordinates. A broader or\n"},{"number":742,"text":"mismatched coordinate refuses (P6).\n"},{"number":743,"text":"\n"},{"number":744,"text":"`domain_model` and `codomain_model` resolve exact content identities of\n"},{"number":745,"text":"the complete input and proposed successor models. Each model identity\n"},{"number":746,"text":"commits to its exact calculus basis, signature identity, complete finite\n"},{"number":747,"text":"`Population_M`, complete `External_M`, exact external-resolution map and\n"},{"number":748,"text":"selected model-content identity under the owning identity law. A mutable\n"},{"number":749,"text":"locator, a model-family name, a partial projection or a population digest\n"},{"number":750,"text":"without the exact model identity refuses (P3).\n"},{"number":751,"text":"\n"},{"number":752,"text":"For each `x in External_M`, the model's exact resolution relation\n"},{"number":753,"text":"determines:\n"},{"number":754,"text":"\n"},{"number":755,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":756,"text":"Resolution_M(x) = {\n"},{"number":757,"text":"  external_identity,\n"},{"number":758,"text":"  reference_domain,\n"},{"number":759,"text":"  external_target_kind,\n"},{"number":760,"text":"  resolved_target_identity,\n"},{"number":761,"text":"  basis_relation,\n"},{"number":762,"text":"  resolution_basis,\n"},{"number":763,"text":"  evidence_identity\n"},{"number":764,"text":"}\n"},{"number":765,"text":"\n"},{"number":766,"text":"ResolutionSet_M = { Resolution_M(x) | x in External_M }\n"},{"number":767,"text":"```\n"},{"number":768,"text":"\n"},{"number":769,"text":"`Resolution_M` is a model coordinate supplied by the signature-declared\n"},{"number":770,"text":"external reference relation, not a ninth fundamental record family. Every\n"},{"number":771,"text":"field is identity-bearing and exact. One external identity has exactly one\n"},{"number":772,"text":"resolution tuple in one model; a missing, ambiguous or extra tuple refuses\n"},{"number":773,"text":"(P3).\n"},{"number":774,"text":"\n"},{"number":775,"text":"For an ordinary same-basis transformation:\n"},{"number":776,"text":"\n"},{"number":777,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":778,"text":"basis(domain_model) = basis(codomain_model) = t.basis = basis(t.traversal)\n"},{"number":779,"text":"signature(domain_model) = signature(codomain_model)\n"},{"number":780,"text":"```\n"},{"number":781,"text":"\n"},{"number":782,"text":"A cross-basis or cross-signature migration requires a separately\n"},{"number":783,"text":"identified transformation specialisation whose exact composite-basis and\n"},{"number":784,"text":"compatible signature-extension relations name both sides. No identity\n"},{"number":785,"text":"whose basis or record kind changes belongs to `preserved`; the source\n"},{"number":786,"text":"identity is removed and the successor identity is introduced, with their\n"},{"number":787,"text":"continuity represented only by the exact migration relation (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":788,"text":"\n"},{"number":789,"text":"`preservation_relation` resolves one exact typed equality relation\n"},{"number":790,"text":"applicable to the declared domain and codomain model identities and record\n"},{"number":791,"text":"kinds. It binds both model identities, both exact bases, comparison\n"},{"number":792,"text":"domain, direction, authority, scope, evidence and equality law.\n"},{"number":793,"text":"Equivalence or meaning-preservation may relate a removed identity to an\n"},{"number":794,"text":"introduced identity; it cannot retain one identity in `preserved` (P1,\n"},{"number":795,"text":"P3).\n"},{"number":796,"text":"\n"},{"number":797,"text":"Let `Local_b` be the complete input-model local-record identity set, `P_t`\n"},{"number":798,"text":"the identities named by `preserved`, `R_t` those named by `removed`, and\n"},{"number":799,"text":"`N_t` the identities of the complete records named by `introduced`. A\n"},{"number":800,"text":"lawful transformation proves the closed local-record delta (P4b):\n"},{"number":801,"text":"\n"},{"number":802,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":803,"text":"Local_b       = P_t disjoint_union R_t\n"},{"number":804,"text":"Local_b_prime = P_t disjoint_union N_t\n"},{"number":805,"text":"N_t intersect Local_b = empty\n"},{"number":806,"text":"R_t intersect Local_b_prime = empty\n"},{"number":807,"text":"```\n"},{"number":808,"text":"\n"},{"number":809,"text":"For every identity in `P_t`, the input and successor records have the\n"},{"number":810,"text":"same record kind, identity, context, owner, scope and basis. They are\n"},{"number":811,"text":"either:\n"},{"number":812,"text":"\n"},{"number":813,"text":"1. byte-identical under one exact canonical record grammar selected for\n"},{"number":814,"text":"   both models; or\n"},{"number":815,"text":"2. equal under the exact `preservation_relation` when the abstract\n"},{"number":816,"text":"   records do not share such a byte grammar.\n"},{"number":817,"text":"\n"},{"number":818,"text":"Canonical-byte equality and typed record equality are alternative proofs\n"},{"number":819,"text":"of identity preservation, not carrier selection by the calculus. A changed\n"},{"number":820,"text":"field, changed basis, changed record kind, nominally equal identifier,\n"},{"number":821,"text":"equivalence or unbound assertion of preserved meaning refuses membership\n"},{"number":822,"text":"in `P_t` (P3, P1).\n"},{"number":823,"text":"\n"},{"number":824,"text":"Every removed identity is absent from the successor. Every introduced\n"},{"number":825,"text":"identity is absent from the input and carries a complete lawful record in\n"},{"number":826,"text":"exactly one successor population. Every input local-record identity is\n"},{"number":827,"text":"classified exactly once as preserved or removed; no local record may be\n"},{"number":828,"text":"silently dropped, retained or duplicated (P4b).\n"},{"number":829,"text":"\n"},{"number":830,"text":"The external-resolution coordinates form a distinct closed delta. Let\n"},{"number":831,"text":"`E_b` and `E_b_prime` be `ResolutionSet_M` for the domain and codomain\n"},{"number":832,"text":"models; `EP_t`, `ER_t` and `EN_t` are exactly the resolution coordinates\n"},{"number":833,"text":"named by `external_preserved`, `external_removed` and\n"},{"number":834,"text":"`external_introduced`:\n"},{"number":835,"text":"\n"},{"number":836,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":837,"text":"E_b       = EP_t disjoint_union ER_t\n"},{"number":838,"text":"E_b_prime = EP_t disjoint_union EN_t\n"},{"number":839,"text":"EN_t intersect E_b = empty\n"},{"number":840,"text":"ER_t intersect E_b_prime = empty\n"},{"number":841,"text":"```\n"},{"number":842,"text":"\n"},{"number":843,"text":"For every `x in EP_t`, `external_resolution_witnesses` contains exactly\n"},{"number":844,"text":"one:\n"},{"number":845,"text":"\n"},{"number":846,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":847,"text":"ExternalResolutionPreservationWitness = {\n"},{"number":848,"text":"  external_resolution: x,\n"},{"number":849,"text":"  domain_model,\n"},{"number":850,"text":"  codomain_model,\n"},{"number":851,"text":"  domain_resolution: Resolution_domain_model(x),\n"},{"number":852,"text":"  codomain_resolution: Resolution_codomain_model(x),\n"},{"number":853,"text":"  decision: equal,\n"},{"number":854,"text":"  evidence\n"},{"number":855,"text":"}\n"},{"number":856,"text":"```\n"},{"number":857,"text":"\n"},{"number":858,"text":"The two resolution tuples are exactly field-equal. A nominally equal\n"},{"number":859,"text":"external identifier, an equivalent target, a changed target kind, a\n"},{"number":860,"text":"changed resolved target, a changed reference domain, a changed basis\n"},{"number":861,"text":"relation, a changed resolution basis or a missing witness cannot enter\n"},{"number":862,"text":"`EP_t`. Every member of `ER_t` has its complete resolution only in the\n"},{"number":863,"text":"domain model; every member of `EN_t` has its complete resolution only in\n"},{"number":864,"text":"the codomain model. A changed external resolution is a removal followed by\n"},{"number":865,"text":"introduction of the new resolution coordinate and any separately declared\n"},{"number":866,"text":"continuity relation; the referenced external identity may remain\n"},{"number":867,"text":"unchanged, but the resolution is not preserved. Witnesses are total and\n"},{"number":868,"text":"unique over `EP_t` and name no other resolution coordinate (P4b, P3).\n"},{"number":869,"text":"\n"},{"number":870,"text":"Material residuals remain in the successor residual set unless an exact\n"},{"number":871,"text":"authorised disposition is included in the transformation evidence.\n"},{"number":872,"text":"Failure to establish any model identity, basis, population, local or\n"},{"number":873,"text":"external partition, equality, external-resolution witness, residual or\n"},{"number":874,"text":"codomain equation refuses (P4b, P5).\n"},{"number":875,"text":"\n"},{"number":876,"text":"Application is:\n"},{"number":877,"text":"\n"},{"number":878,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":879,"text":"T[t](M_b, inputs) -> M_b_prime* | hold | gap | refusal\n"},{"number":880,"text":"```\n"},{"number":881,"text":"\n"},{"number":882,"text":"The exact transformation identity `t` declares every mutation it may\n"},{"number":883,"text":"perform. The input model remains unchanged; `M_b_prime*` is a proposed\n"},{"number":884,"text":"successor. A proposed successor does not accept or admit itself (P6). The\n"},{"number":885,"text":"stops `hold`, `gap` and `refusal` take their core values under AC-007 by\n"},{"number":886,"text":"their causes.\n"},{"number":887,"text":"FOUNDATIONS §4 consumes this law as the conservation accounting of every\n"},{"number":888,"text":"step: what was preserved, introduced and removed, the external resolution\n"},{"number":889,"text":"witnesses and the residuals.\n"},{"number":890,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":918,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-014 Judgment separation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F4.%20Fundamental%20laws%2FAC-014%20Judgment%20separation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"b7f575510fce6c0e9a827aa6bfb26f7f50e1a13c5983294e4969c44c6a490386","start_line":891,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":891,"text":"### AC-014 Judgment separation\n"},{"number":892,"text":"\n"},{"number":893,"text":"A judgment points to an unchanged subject; it is the Judgment of\n"},{"number":894,"text":"FOUNDATIONS §2 carried as a model record (P6):\n"},{"number":895,"text":"\n"},{"number":896,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":897,"text":"Judgment = {\n"},{"number":898,"text":"  id,\n"},{"number":899,"text":"  kind,\n"},{"number":900,"text":"  subject,\n"},{"number":901,"text":"  subject_digest,\n"},{"number":902,"text":"  context,\n"},{"number":903,"text":"  owner,\n"},{"number":904,"text":"  scope,\n"},{"number":905,"text":"  basis,\n"},{"number":906,"text":"  evaluator,\n"},{"number":907,"text":"  authority,\n"},{"number":908,"text":"  decision,\n"},{"number":909,"text":"  evidence,\n"},{"number":910,"text":"  provenance,\n"},{"number":911,"text":"  decided_at\n"},{"number":912,"text":"}\n"},{"number":913,"text":"```\n"},{"number":914,"text":"\n"},{"number":915,"text":"Issuing a judgment does not transform, rewrite, reissue or rename its\n"},{"number":916,"text":"subject. Promotion is an explicit relation between the unchanged subject\n"},{"number":917,"text":"and its admission or acceptance judgment (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":918,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1062,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"25b0cece8f1fd058d6645b94a9305c3c926b7c56a6d5315c290674750dbbbf48","start_line":919,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":919,"text":"## 5. Traversals and functor kinds\n"},{"number":920,"text":"\n"},{"number":921,"text":"A traversal is a typed contract (P4a, P6):\n"},{"number":922,"text":"\n"},{"number":923,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":924,"text":"v = {\n"},{"number":925,"text":"  id,\n"},{"number":926,"text":"  domain,\n"},{"number":927,"text":"  codomain,\n"},{"number":928,"text":"  context,\n"},{"number":929,"text":"  owner,\n"},{"number":930,"text":"  scope,\n"},{"number":931,"text":"  basis,\n"},{"number":932,"text":"  preconditions,\n"},{"number":933,"text":"  postconditions,\n"},{"number":934,"text":"  authority,\n"},{"number":935,"text":"  evidence,\n"},{"number":936,"text":"  provenance,\n"},{"number":937,"text":"  stop_states\n"},{"number":938,"text":"}\n"},{"number":939,"text":"```\n"},{"number":940,"text":"\n"},{"number":941,"text":"The traversal record is this member's own concept. A same-spelled term\n"},{"number":942,"text":"owned by a profile, a realisation or a runtime is not imported by nominal\n"},{"number":943,"text":"equality and does not specialise this record except through a declared\n"},{"number":944,"text":"binding under that owner's authority (§9; P3, P1).\n"},{"number":945,"text":"\n"},{"number":946,"text":"`a_c` defines three fundamental functor-kind identities (P3):\n"},{"number":947,"text":"\n"},{"number":948,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":949,"text":"F_D = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-d\n"},{"number":950,"text":"F_P = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-p\n"},{"number":951,"text":"F_H = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-h\n"},{"number":952,"text":"```\n"},{"number":953,"text":"\n"},{"number":954,"text":"Application notation is:\n"},{"number":955,"text":"\n"},{"number":956,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":957,"text":"F_K[v](X_v) -> Y_v | Omega_v\n"},{"number":958,"text":"```\n"},{"number":959,"text":"\n"},{"number":960,"text":"where `F_K` is one functor kind, `v` is one exact traversal identity,\n"},{"number":961,"text":"`X_v` and `Y_v` are its typed input and result domains, and `Omega_v` is\n"},{"number":962,"text":"its closed stop algebra. `Omega_v` is a refinement of the core result\n"},{"number":963,"text":"algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): it adds no\n"},{"number":964,"text":"core value, and each of its stop values maps to exactly one core value,\n"},{"number":965,"text":"never to `satisfied`. A stop this member writes, `hold`, `gap`,\n"},{"number":966,"text":"`refusal(constraint)` or `refusal(basis)`, has the meaning and the core\n"},{"number":967,"text":"value that AC-007 gives it. The signature's stop contract declares any\n"},{"number":968,"text":"further stop value with the one core value it maps to, and may refine a\n"},{"number":969,"text":"stop value by cause. A traversal record's `stop_states` binds the stop\n"},{"number":970,"text":"mapping of that traversal, exactly one core value for each stop value; it\n"},{"number":971,"text":"may refine a value of the signature's stop contract further by cause for\n"},{"number":972,"text":"that traversal. Each refined value, whether the stop contract or a\n"},{"number":973,"text":"`stop_states` declares it, names its parent value and its cause and maps\n"},{"number":974,"text":"to its parent's core value: a value refined from `hold` to indeterminate,\n"},{"number":975,"text":"from `gap` or `refusal(basis)` to invalid_basis, and from\n"},{"number":976,"text":"`refusal(constraint)` to falsified. No refined value takes `satisfied`. A\n"},{"number":977,"text":"different core value needs a different parent value, which only the member\n"},{"number":978,"text":"that owns the parent declares; for these four stops that member is this\n"},{"number":979,"text":"one. Neither the stop contract nor a traversal's `stop_states` raises a\n"},{"number":980,"text":"result's standing (P5, P6). Purpose and material relation: one stop of one\n"},{"number":981,"text":"traversal has one core value, so its consumers cannot read it two ways,\n"},{"number":982,"text":"and no refinement gives a stop another core value, so a violated\n"},{"number":983,"text":"constraint never becomes a case that the evidence merely cannot decide.\n"},{"number":984,"text":"\n"},{"number":985,"text":"- `F_D` classifies total deterministic processing under an exact traversal\n"},{"number":986,"text":"  contract. An application declares `f_B:D_B->Outcome_B`, its closed logical\n"},{"number":987,"text":"  domain, exact basis, all material computational state and dependencies,\n"},{"number":988,"text":"  and its termination argument. For every domain input it terminates with\n"},{"number":989,"text":"  exactly one declared outcome. Closed domains may be infinite when\n"},{"number":990,"text":"  termination and outcome determination are established. Open-world\n"},{"number":991,"text":"  semantic choice and undeclared clock, filesystem or global dependencies\n"},{"number":992,"text":"  are outside this contract (P3, P4a, P6).\n"},{"number":993,"text":"\n"},{"number":994,"text":"  Here B is the exact basis of v, D_B is its declared logical input domain\n"},{"number":995,"text":"  X_v (including material state and resource inputs), and Outcome_B is the\n"},{"number":996,"text":"  declared result-or-stop domain Y_v | Omega_v. The function f_B determines\n"},{"number":997,"text":"  one such outcome, including a stop with its closed report where declared;\n"},{"number":998,"text":"  that report and its stop are not two outcomes. An enclosing step's output\n"},{"number":999,"text":"  availability remains a separate predicate.\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"  State-dependent processing declares input state and the meaning of its\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"  returned next state and value. Refusal and exhaustion retain their cause\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"  and evaluated predicate. The signature and traversal bind each stop to\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"  exactly one core value, never satisfied; an exhausted tag alone supplies\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"  no mapping. Construction availability and assessment retain their\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"  separate predicates and results, and an unperformed assessment has no\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"  result. A fuel-bounded operation is distinct from the potentially\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"  divergent operation it bounds. A deterministic decision or effect proposal\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"  establishes no physical completion, runtime admission, permission or\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"  quality (P5, P6; [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition)).\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"- `F_P` classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation, construction or\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"  proposal under an exact traversal contract. Its result has no semantic,\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"  admission, acceptance or closure authority merely because it is useful\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"  or repeatable (P6, P0; instance premise (iii) of §1 Foundation to law).\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"- `F_H` classifies explicit human adjudication under an exact identity,\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"  authority grant, subject, basis and decision contract. Human presence\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"  grants no ambient authority (P6).\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"The actor, the executor, the domain operation and the functor kind are\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"different coordinates. `Encode`, `Interpret`, `Serialize`, `Measure` and\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"other named domain operations are not aliases for `F_D`, `F_P` or `F_H`.\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"Different traversals may share one functor kind without sharing identity,\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"semantics, inputs, outputs, authority or evidence (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"Classifying an operation as F_D grants no semantic, evaluation, operation\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"or decision authority. This is the kind-specific application of\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"[AC-005](#ac-005-authority-conservation) and\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds): the exact\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"operation contract and admitted grant determine its permissions and\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"consequences. Consumers apply this boundary to their own operations.\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"Evaluation-operation profile. An operation declared to evaluate an unchanged\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"subject identifies that subject, admissible reads, witness or log outputs,\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"permitted writes, stops and results, authority and invalidation conditions.\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"It preserves the judged subject and does not perform the domain construction\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"it judges. Separately authorized persistence of a witness does not perform\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"the judged domain construction. A construction or mutation needs its own\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"operation contract and grant; reporting a changed subject's property as the\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"original subject's property violates this evaluation contract (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"Closedness concerns dependencies material to the computation, not complete\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"world knowledge. This kind's totality is stronger than total handling of\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"conditions in [ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement).\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"Unbounded work is not automatically `F_P` when a totality argument is missing.\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"The calculus does not classify every executable process as one of its kinds.\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"A new non-total deterministic process is outside qualifying F_D. A route to\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"an F_D claim is a separately identified bounded successor with its own\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"domain, outcomes, dependency closure and termination argument; a fuel bound\n"},{"number":1049,"text":"is one possible construction. This proves nothing about the unbounded\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"original. Other work remains governed by its selected operation and execution\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"basis without being asserted to be a qualifying a_c application.\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"Existing operations enter this edition only through the evidence-sensitive\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"[migration relation](RELEASE.md#deterministic-kind-migration). The\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"[finite examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish construction,\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"assessment, proposed effects and three predicate-specific exhaustion cases.\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"\"Functor kind\" is an `a_c` term for this traversal classification. It does\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"not by itself assert a category-theoretic functor. A model that claims\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"categorical functor laws carries the demonstration that\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra), Formal fragment, requires of\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"every categorical claim (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1094,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds/AC-015 Functor classification","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds%2FAC-015%20Functor%20classification","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"faaa16bf6d619619d30440b412ed5369cea8d2238256cdbe1f63eed7856517e2","start_line":1063,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1063,"text":"### AC-015 Functor classification\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"Every functor application binds exactly one functor kind and one traversal\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"identity. Applying any `F_*` kind without the bracketed traversal identity\n"},{"number":1067,"text":"`[v]` is incomplete (P3). Such an\n"},{"number":1068,"text":"application violates this law, and its outcome is `refusal(constraint)`\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"under AC-007; this sense of incomplete is not the construction-availability\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"value `incomplete` of a step\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"([ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability)). Purpose and\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"material relation: an application without its traversal has one core\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"value, and the shared word does not let it be read as a step's stop (P5).\n"},{"number":1074,"text":"\n"},{"number":1075,"text":"A claimed application also meets its bound kind's contract in §5. A missing\n"},{"number":1076,"text":"required declaration (for example the F_D termination argument), a demonstrated\n"},{"number":1077,"text":"undeclared material dependency, a disallowed kind or a demonstrated\n"},{"number":1078,"text":"non-totality is a contract violation. A judgment of that violation is\n"},{"number":1079,"text":"`falsified` under AC-007; structural admission of the unlawful application\n"},{"number":1080,"text":"returns `refusal(constraint)`. This is not a judgment that every unproved\n"},{"number":1081,"text":"operation diverges. If a performed assessment on a valid basis cannot decide\n"},{"number":1082,"text":"the declared operation's totality, its totality judgment is `indeterminate`\n"},{"number":1083,"text":"under AC-007 and the F_D eligibility claim remains unestablished. An\n"},{"number":1084,"text":"unperformed assessment has no result.\n"},{"number":1085,"text":"\n"},{"number":1086,"text":"No invocation is admitted as qualifying F_D by an unestablished claim.\n"},{"number":1087,"text":"Before a step exists, missing authority, unsupported basis or unresolved\n"},{"number":1088,"text":"closure follows the distinct admission/activation outcomes of\n"},{"number":1089,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation). If a lawful a_c\n"},{"number":1090,"text":"operation has been applied and awaits admissible evidence, its declared\n"},{"number":1091,"text":"`hold`/`gap`/`refusal` follows AC-007 by cause. These predicates and boundaries\n"},{"number":1092,"text":"are not interchangeable, and this clause creates no universal stop for all\n"},{"number":1093,"text":"unproved processes, no new kind and no automatic F_P classification.\n"},{"number":1094,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1116,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds/AC-016 Typed composition","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds%2FAC-016%20Typed%20composition","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"4aae96336685169b0f858124f3cfad431e601c15c4cacaf8b168dac0788c287d","start_line":1095,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1095,"text":"### AC-016 Typed composition\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"Two traversals compose only when the first result type and judgment\n"},{"number":1098,"text":"satisfy the second traversal's exact domain and preconditions (P4a):\n"},{"number":1099,"text":"\n"},{"number":1100,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1101,"text":"F_K2[w] compose F_K1[v]\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"Composition retains both traversal identities, intermediate results,\n"},{"number":1105,"text":"judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states. It cannot\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"flatten probabilistic proposal, deterministic construction or evaluation and human\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"decision into one undifferentiated operation. `a_c` prescribes no\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"universal `F_P -> F_D -> F_H` sequence; each application owns its lawful\n"},{"number":1109,"text":"topology (P4a, P4b, P6). FOUNDATIONS §3 P4a consumes this law.\n"},{"number":1110,"text":"\n"},{"number":1111,"text":"A deterministic constructor feeding a deterministic evaluator still has\n"},{"number":1112,"text":"two exact traversal identities and retains both results and stops. A claimed\n"},{"number":1113,"text":"projection of their continuation follows the consumer-relative sufficiency\n"},{"number":1114,"text":"law in [FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation); composition\n"},{"number":1115,"text":"alone establishes neither adequate observations nor a Markov property.\n"},{"number":1116,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1150,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F6.%20Interpretation%20and%20models","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"ebcc519e031c4c37a840af06575c23e707f5ab5a3f056414b1915cb624cb88e0","start_line":1117,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1117,"text":"## 6. Interpretation and models\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"An interpretation applies `a_c` to an exact subject (P1):\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1122,"text":"Interpret_a_c(subject_basis, signature, interpretation_contract)\n"},{"number":1123,"text":"  -> M_subject* | hold | gap | refusal\n"},{"number":1124,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1125,"text":"\n"},{"number":1126,"text":"The stops `hold`, `gap` and `refusal` take their core values under AC-007\n"},{"number":1127,"text":"by their causes. The trailing `*` marks a proposed model that has not\n"},{"number":1128,"text":"received the\n"},{"number":1129,"text":"applicable semantic acceptance judgment. The interpretation contract is\n"},{"number":1130,"text":"the Interpretation of FOUNDATIONS §2 made exact for one subject and one\n"},{"number":1131,"text":"signature. It declares:\n"},{"number":1132,"text":"\n"},{"number":1133,"text":"- the exact `a_c` basis;\n"},{"number":1134,"text":"- the exact subject identity, inventory, and bytes or semantic addresses;\n"},{"number":1135,"text":"- the selected signature and any compatible extension relation;\n"},{"number":1136,"text":"- the mapping from subject declarations to every applicable model record\n"},{"number":1137,"text":"  population, including objects, relations, constraints, latitude,\n"},{"number":1138,"text":"  residuals, traversals, transformations and judgments;\n"},{"number":1139,"text":"- the interpreter identity, capability, provenance and stop states;\n"},{"number":1140,"text":"- the structural evaluation contract;\n"},{"number":1141,"text":"- the semantic selection and acceptance authority; and\n"},{"number":1142,"text":"- the source re-entry and invalidation rules.\n"},{"number":1143,"text":"\n"},{"number":1144,"text":"The proposed model `M_subject*` does not become accepted through\n"},{"number":1145,"text":"construction. Structural evaluation can prove closed shape, reference\n"},{"number":1146,"text":"typing, identity derivation and basis coherence. It cannot prove that\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"probabilistic semantic selection retained every material subject meaning.\n"},{"number":1148,"text":"Semantic acceptance remains a separately recorded authority judgment (P6,\n"},{"number":1149,"text":"P1).\n"},{"number":1150,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1158,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-017 Interpretation fidelity","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F6.%20Interpretation%20and%20models%2FAC-017%20Interpretation%20fidelity","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"f056f649e46a003956223a6d2a907b192a7cbb26a0f5bc7de93ca58603e4d457","start_line":1151,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1151,"text":"### AC-017 Interpretation fidelity\n"},{"number":1152,"text":"\n"},{"number":1153,"text":"Every admitted model record maps to exact subject provenance or is\n"},{"number":1154,"text":"explicitly identified as model-local content under competent authority.\n"},{"number":1155,"text":"Every evaluated subject declaration has a retained, omitted, residual,\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"inapplicable or refused disposition. Interpretation cannot treat absence\n"},{"number":1157,"text":"as immateriality without a recorded basis and authority (P1, P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":1158,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1169,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-018 Structural and semantic separation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F6.%20Interpretation%20and%20models%2FAC-018%20Structural%20and%20semantic%20separation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"a6797eac85489c7f6037a19a74651040ae9e2145b56e664b0d075d5502230adf","start_line":1159,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1159,"text":"### AC-018 Structural and semantic separation\n"},{"number":1160,"text":"\n"},{"number":1161,"text":"The separation of structural conformance from semantic fidelity, and the\n"},{"number":1162,"text":"rule that structural success is evidence for semantic review and no\n"},{"number":1163,"text":"substitute for it, are [EVALUATION §2](EVALUATION.md#2-separation)'s,\n"},{"number":1164,"text":"which owns them for every review. This law binds them to `a_c`: the\n"},{"number":1165,"text":"structural conformance of a model covers its closed syntax, types,\n"},{"number":1166,"text":"identities, references, bases and mechanically decidable predicates, and\n"},{"number":1167,"text":"the semantic fidelity of an interpretation covers its meaning and\n"},{"number":1168,"text":"materiality (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":1169,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1190,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-019 Valid model","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F6.%20Interpretation%20and%20models%2FAC-019%20Valid%20model","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"5d90fe60d4024a589836ddaf5798a9070208cf96d73ca6e3b010f2fd4146cd43","start_line":1170,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1170,"text":"### AC-019 Valid model\n"},{"number":1171,"text":"\n"},{"number":1172,"text":"A model `M_b` is a valid model of `a_c` under signature `Sigma`, written\n"},{"number":1173,"text":"`M_b satisfies a_c[Sigma]`, only when (P6, P1):\n"},{"number":1174,"text":"\n"},{"number":1175,"text":"1. `Sigma` and the exact `a_c` basis resolve;\n"},{"number":1176,"text":"2. every record satisfies AC-001 through AC-009;\n"},{"number":1177,"text":"3. every claimed closure, projection, overlay, transformation, judgment\n"},{"number":1178,"text":"   and composition satisfies its applicable law, and every claimed functor\n"},{"number":1179,"text":"   application satisfies AC-015 and its bound kind's §5 contract;\n"},{"number":1180,"text":"4. interpretation fidelity and residual dispositions bind the exact\n"},{"number":1181,"text":"   subject;\n"},{"number":1182,"text":"5. structural evaluation and semantic acceptance remain distinct and both\n"},{"number":1183,"text":"   required where claimed; and\n"},{"number":1184,"text":"6. all evidence, provenance, invalidation and re-entry coordinates\n"},{"number":1185,"text":"   resolve.\n"},{"number":1186,"text":"\n"},{"number":1187,"text":"A checker may decide the structural subset. No generic checker may claim\n"},{"number":1188,"text":"the semantic or authority subset unless the model supplies an exact lawful\n"},{"number":1189,"text":"decision contract for it (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1190,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1229,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/7. Layers","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F7.%20Layers","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"9802e73732c16c4762d67102b1527b5844517c8dbbe1023a023b4b0b1215ee7a","start_line":1191,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1191,"text":"## 7. Layers\n"},{"number":1192,"text":"\n"},{"number":1193,"text":"The three governed layers are (P3):\n"},{"number":1194,"text":"\n"},{"number":1195,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1196,"text":"a_c       = the pure calculus\n"},{"number":1197,"text":"a_c.X     = subject X interpreted as a model of a_c\n"},{"number":1198,"text":"a_c.X.C   = that accepted model encoded in carrier C\n"},{"number":1199,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1200,"text":"\n"},{"number":1201,"text":"Their relations are:\n"},{"number":1202,"text":"\n"},{"number":1203,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1204,"text":"M_X = Interpret_a_c(X)\n"},{"number":1205,"text":"J_X = Accept_X(M_X) -> accepted | refuse\n"},{"number":1206,"text":"G_C = Encode_C(M_X, J_X) where J_X = accepted\n"},{"number":1207,"text":"D_C = F_D[v_carrier_admission](G_C, Profile_C, CarrierBasis_C)\n"},{"number":1208,"text":"      -> admitted | refuse\n"},{"number":1209,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1210,"text":"\n"},{"number":1211,"text":"`J_X` is an external semantic-acceptance judgment over unchanged `M_X`.\n"},{"number":1212,"text":"The `F_D[v_carrier_admission]` notation requires §5's total-domain evidence\n"},{"number":1213,"text":"for the actual admission traversal and its unchanged-subject evaluation\n"},{"number":1214,"text":"profile. The diagram supplies neither that evidence nor admission authority;\n"},{"number":1215,"text":"an unresolved implementation retains its migration obligation under\n"},{"number":1216,"text":"[RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#deterministic-kind-migration).\n"},{"number":1217,"text":"Encoding requires `J_X.decision = accepted` and exact equality between the\n"},{"number":1218,"text":"judgment subject identity and digest and `M_X`; hold or refusal cannot be\n"},{"number":1219,"text":"encoded. `D_C` is a judgment over unchanged carrier bytes; it is not a\n"},{"number":1220,"text":"transformed carrier. The admitted encoding evidence relation is the exact\n"},{"number":1221,"text":"triple `(G_C, J_X, D_C)`; neither judgment enters the identity of its\n"},{"number":1222,"text":"subject (P6, P3). Each judgment answers its own predicate, that `M_X` is\n"},{"number":1223,"text":"accepted and that the carrier bytes are admitted: `accepted` and\n"},{"number":1224,"text":"`admitted` map to satisfied, a hold maps as AC-007's `hold`, and `refuse`\n"},{"number":1225,"text":"is a `refusal` that takes its core value under AC-007 by its cause (P5,\n"},{"number":1226,"text":"P6). The mapping ensures that an acceptance or admission\n"},{"number":1227,"text":"judgment combines with other results only through the one core, so a\n"},{"number":1228,"text":"withheld or refused judgment is never read as accepted.\n"},{"number":1229,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1247,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/7. Layers/AC-020 Layer and release separation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F7.%20Layers%2FAC-020%20Layer%20and%20release%20separation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"d057e9d30b8162e4e202577a3a23f392d4cb5571cb0a4b5e27643875c3563ae3","start_line":1230,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1230,"text":"### AC-020 Layer and release separation\n"},{"number":1231,"text":"\n"},{"number":1232,"text":"`a_c`, `a_c.X` and `a_c.X.C` have independent content identities,\n"},{"number":1233,"text":"judgments, supersession relations and proof obligations (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":1234,"text":"\n"},{"number":1235,"text":"- `a_c` qualification evaluates internal coherence against its complete\n"},{"number":1236,"text":"  declared calculus-law set;\n"},{"number":1237,"text":"- `a_c.X` proves faithful interpretation of exact subject `X`; and\n"},{"number":1238,"text":"- `a_c.X.C` proves faithful, canonical encoding of the accepted model in\n"},{"number":1239,"text":"  carrier `C`.\n"},{"number":1240,"text":"\n"},{"number":1241,"text":"An encoding failure does not change `a_c.X`. An interpretation failure\n"},{"number":1242,"text":"does not change `a_c`. A downstream success cannot ratify an upstream\n"},{"number":1243,"text":"layer or basis. None of these layers is automatically an independently\n"},{"number":1244,"text":"released Product. The external authority that selects and releases one\n"},{"number":1245,"text":"owns that Product status. SPEC_METHOD §6 applies this law to release\n"},{"number":1246,"text":"lineage.\n"},{"number":1247,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1359,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/8. Calculus identity","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F8.%20Calculus%20identity","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","sha256":"81816a9ffd5aa28a5fd05b9620c5ad74a2c31f24e69ef8350849140138abc47e","start_line":1248,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","lines":[{"number":1248,"text":"## 8. Calculus identity\n"},{"number":1249,"text":"\n"},{"number":1250,"text":"The stable concept identity does not identify one immutable calculus\n"},{"number":1251,"text":"edition. An exact released calculus basis is an external record created\n"},{"number":1252,"text":"after the publication bytes exist. It binds the governing premise clauses\n"},{"number":1253,"text":"and the published calculus member as distinct roles inside one exact\n"},{"number":1254,"text":"immutable package (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":1255,"text":"\n"},{"number":1256,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1257,"text":"AxiomaticCalculusBasis = {\n"},{"number":1258,"text":"  kind: \"stdo.axiomatic-calculus-basis\",\n"},{"number":1259,"text":"  schema_version: 1,\n"},{"number":1260,"text":"  concept_identity: \"urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:a-c\",\n"},{"number":1261,"text":"  derivation_basis: {\n"},{"number":1262,"text":"    release_uri: absolute immutable package release URI,\n"},{"number":1263,"text":"    manifest_sha256: \"sha256:\" + 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters,\n"},{"number":1264,"text":"    principle_refs: non-empty absolute semantic-address URI[]\n"},{"number":1265,"text":"  },\n"},{"number":1266,"text":"  publication_basis: {\n"},{"number":1267,"text":"    release_uri: the same absolute immutable package release URI,\n"},{"number":1268,"text":"    manifest_sha256: \"sha256:\" + 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters,\n"},{"number":1269,"text":"    member_uri: absolute URI for this member in that release,\n"},{"number":1270,"text":"    member_sha256: \"sha256:\" + 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters\n"},{"number":1271,"text":"  }\n"},{"number":1272,"text":"}\n"},{"number":1273,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1274,"text":"\n"},{"number":1275,"text":"The record uses RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme bytes. Duplicate\n"},{"number":1276,"text":"object names are rejected before canonicalisation.\n"},{"number":1277,"text":"`derivation_basis.principle_refs` is duplicate-free and sorted by\n"},{"number":1278,"text":"ascending unsigned UTF-16 code units. The record's identity is:\n"},{"number":1279,"text":"\n"},{"number":1280,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1281,"text":"urn:stdo:axiomatic-calculus-basis:sha256:\n"},{"number":1282,"text":"  + sha256(JCS(AxiomaticCalculusBasis))\n"},{"number":1283,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1284,"text":"\n"},{"number":1285,"text":"`derivation_basis` binds the complete finite set of governing clauses\n"},{"number":1286,"text":"identified under §1 Derivation provenance. Every principle reference resolves\n"},{"number":1287,"text":"inside the same exact immutable package named by `publication_basis`, and\n"},{"number":1288,"text":"the two `release_uri` and `manifest_sha256` values are equal. The set is\n"},{"number":1289,"text":"recomputed when those governing clauses change and is not inferred from a\n"},{"number":1290,"text":"hard-coded member count. Local premise ownership does not move to the\n"},{"number":1291,"text":"calculus member merely because both are published together (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1292,"text":"\n"},{"number":1293,"text":"`publication_basis` binds this member's exact bytes. Its member URI resolves\n"},{"number":1294,"text":"inside its release URI. Every release URI in this record has the immutable\n"},{"number":1295,"text":"`stdo://releases/v<version>-rc.<positive-ordinal>/` form defined by\n"},{"number":1296,"text":"[RELEASE §2](RELEASE.md#2-release-identities). Acceptance is a verdict over\n"},{"number":1297,"text":"that exact cut under [RELEASE §8](RELEASE.md#acceptance-criteria), not a\n"},{"number":1298,"text":"second release identity. The record grants no acceptance or release status\n"},{"number":1299,"text":"by its presence. A principle reference outside the bound package, a\n"},{"number":1300,"text":"missing or ambiguous clause, an extra undeclared premise reference, or a\n"},{"number":1301,"text":"manifest or member digest mismatch invalidates the record (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1302,"text":"\n"},{"number":1303,"text":"The identity record is external to the member bytes and to the manifest\n"},{"number":1304,"text":"member set whose digest it names. It is issued only after that set and its\n"},{"number":1305,"text":"manifest are frozen, and may accompany them as release metadata outside\n"},{"number":1306,"text":"that hashed member set. Neither the member nor that manifest embeds the\n"},{"number":1307,"text":"record's identity or final bytes. The dependency is one-way: the record\n"},{"number":1308,"text":"hashes already-fixed basis coordinates; those coordinates do not depend on\n"},{"number":1309,"text":"the record being created. This prevents a member or manifest from requiring\n"},{"number":1310,"text":"its own final digest through the identity record (P3).\n"},{"number":1311,"text":"\n"},{"number":1312,"text":"An interpreted-subject identity binds at least:\n"},{"number":1313,"text":"\n"},{"number":1314,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1315,"text":"id(a_c.X) binds\n"},{"number":1316,"text":"  exact id(a_c)\n"},{"number":1317,"text":"  + exact subject basis id(X)\n"},{"number":1318,"text":"  + exact interpretation contract\n"},{"number":1319,"text":"  + selected model content identity\n"},{"number":1320,"text":"  + semantic-selection ledger identity and digest\n"},{"number":1321,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1322,"text":"\n"},{"number":1323,"text":"An external semantic-acceptance judgment points to that unchanged identity\n"},{"number":1324,"text":"and content digest. It is not embedded in `id(a_c.X)`. The accepted\n"},{"number":1325,"text":"interpretation is the pair `(a_c.X, J_X)` where `J_X` is the applicable\n"},{"number":1326,"text":"accepted judgment. This one-way relation prevents the acceptance record\n"},{"number":1327,"text":"and its subject from requiring each other's final identity (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1328,"text":"\n"},{"number":1329,"text":"An encoded-carrier identity binds at least:\n"},{"number":1330,"text":"\n"},{"number":1331,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1332,"text":"id(a_c.X.C) binds\n"},{"number":1333,"text":"  exact id(a_c.X)\n"},{"number":1334,"text":"  + exact carrier Product or cut\n"},{"number":1335,"text":"  + exact encoding profile\n"},{"number":1336,"text":"  + canonical carrier content identity\n"},{"number":1337,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1338,"text":"\n"},{"number":1339,"text":"The accepted semantic judgment remains external to both content\n"},{"number":1340,"text":"identities. Encoding mechanically verifies its subject identity and digest\n"},{"number":1341,"text":"against the unchanged interpreted model and retains it in the evidence\n"},{"number":1342,"text":"relation. The carrier-admission judgment points to the unchanged carrier\n"},{"number":1343,"text":"identity and digest and is not embedded in `id(a_c.X.C)`. The admitted\n"},{"number":1344,"text":"encoding relation is the triple `(a_c.X.C, J_X, D_C)`. Any Product\n"},{"number":1345,"text":"acceptance and release likewise point to the unchanged content-first layer\n"},{"number":1346,"text":"identity rather than entering it (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1347,"text":"\n"},{"number":1348,"text":"The owning Product defines the canonical record grammar and issuance\n"},{"number":1349,"text":"authority for those downstream identities. It cannot omit the upstream\n"},{"number":1350,"text":"identities or replace them with mutable locators (P3).\n"},{"number":1351,"text":"\n"},{"number":1352,"text":"Publication binding. The `AxiomaticCalculusBasis` for this member is issued\n"},{"number":1353,"text":"under [RELEASE](RELEASE.md) and AC-020 after the exact package bytes exist.\n"},{"number":1354,"text":"Its `publication_basis` binds this member and its `derivation_basis` binds\n"},{"number":1355,"text":"the local governing clauses listed in §1, all under that same package\n"},{"number":1356,"text":"identity. A dependency on a released calculus binds that record's identity,\n"},{"number":1357,"text":"release, manifest digest and member digest. A mutable authoring copy or an\n"},{"number":1358,"text":"unissued record is never substituted for that exact basis (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1359,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1361,"heading":"AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9.
