One actor may lawfully perform\n"},{"number":157,"text":"several; the record keeps them distinguishable. This section owns these\n"},{"number":158,"text":"separations. [RF-007](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-007-semantic-evidence-and-verdict-separation)\n"},{"number":159,"text":"binds them to a frame declaration and\n"},{"number":160,"text":"[AC-018](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-018-structural-and-semantic-separation)\n"},{"number":161,"text":"to an a_c model; each adds only its domain binding.\n"},{"number":162,"text":"\n"},{"number":163,"text":"An evidence change can invalidate a verdict without any change of law.\n"},{"number":164,"text":"Whether a given change does so is decided by the reuse rule of\n"},{"number":165,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse), and where it\n"},{"number":166,"text":"does, the invalidation is mandatory and takes effect before reliance. A\n"},{"number":167,"text":"projection change can invalidate a view without changing semantic truth;\n"},{"number":168,"text":"when a derived view is stale is decided by\n"},{"number":169,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2, Staleness of derived surfaces](ACTIVATION.md#staleness-of-derived-surfaces).\n"},{"number":170,"text":"A semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected\n"},{"number":171,"text":"downstream acceptance. A broad digest may conservatively\n"},{"number":172,"text":"invalidate a review; it does not prove that every semantic relation\n"},{"number":173,"text":"changed (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":174,"text":"\n"},{"number":175,"text":"Structural conformance decides closed syntax, types, identities, references,\n"},{"number":176,"text":"bases and mechanically decidable predicates. Semantic fidelity decides\n"},{"number":177,"text":"meaning and materiality. Structural success is evidence for semantic\n"},{"number":178,"text":"review, not a substitute for it. A checker decides the structural subset; it claims a\n"},{"number":179,"text":"semantic or authority subset only under an exact lawful decision contract\n"},{"number":180,"text":"supplied by the model. For a_c models,\n"},{"number":181,"text":"[AC-018](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-018-structural-and-semantic-separation)\n"},{"number":182,"text":"and [AC-019](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-019-valid-model) bind this rule to\n"},{"number":183,"text":"the model's records and validity conditions (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":184,"text":"A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each\n"},{"number":185,"text":"establish exactly their own claim. Evidence bound to a basis other than\n"},{"number":186,"text":"the evaluated one is excluded by basis; it is not admitted with a narrower\n"},{"number":187,"text":"scope (P3;\n"},{"number":188,"text":"[RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)).\n"},{"number":189,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":261,"heading":"EVALUATION/3. Independent assessment","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F3.%20Independent%20assessment","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"d5e8cd4f574cebc1728e1aefafd5cd05763ab782f872bce3f29d7c8649e442c9","start_line":190,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":190,"text":"## 3. Independent assessment\n"},{"number":191,"text":"\n"},{"number":192,"text":"A constructor's self-review is construction output, not assessment. Where\n"},{"number":193,"text":"promotion needs independent assessment, the assessor evaluates the exact\n"},{"number":194,"text":"live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state, not the\n"},{"number":195,"text":"constructor's summary (P6, and P0 with its premise that a step's output is\n"},{"number":196,"text":"a candidate until evaluated; instance premise (c) of §1 Foundation to law).\n"},{"number":197,"text":"This section decides what counts as independent assessment. Which\n"},{"number":198,"text":"boundaries require it is a policy choice of the Spec Method, owned by\n"},{"number":199,"text":"[TICKETS §7 Execution and verification authority separation](TICKETS.md#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-up-007);\n"},{"number":200,"text":"a governing basis may add boundaries.\n"},{"number":201,"text":"\n"},{"number":202,"text":"Protocol: where method qualification applies\n"},{"number":203,"text":"([§7 Method self-qualification](#method-self-qualification)), the subject is\n"},{"number":204,"text":"frozen by identity before material reference exposure; elsewhere it is\n"},{"number":205,"text":"stabilised by an immutable identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation\n"},{"number":206,"text":"sufficient for the claimed assessment. The assessor records its\n"},{"number":207,"text":"expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it\n"},{"number":208,"text":"reads the subject at that identity or relation, never a mutable working\n"},{"number":209,"text":"tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its\n"},{"number":210,"text":"own authorship. Reusing the constructor's judgment does not satisfy\n"},{"number":211,"text":"independence; shared mechanical evidence may be reused, judgment may not\n"},{"number":212,"text":"(ACTIVATION §7). Binding a returned assessment to its producer, subject,\n"},{"number":213,"text":"basis and evidence authenticates the result; it establishes neither the\n"},{"number":214,"text":"assertion provenance of its expected answer nor the execution provenance\n"},{"number":215,"text":"of its run, which\n"},{"number":216,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Parallel derivation and mutual assurance](FOUNDATIONS.md#parallel-derivation-and-mutual-assurance)\n"},{"number":217,"text":"requires separately (P6, P3). Membership in a plan authenticates nothing,\n"},{"number":218,"text":"an unauthenticated result satisfies no required assessment, and a result\n"},{"number":219,"text":"bound to another subject satisfies no planned assessment\n"},{"number":220,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results));\n"},{"number":221,"text":"no cryptographic or transport protocol is prescribed for the binding (P6). Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention: it\n"},{"number":222,"text":"is either a method constituent with its own qualification boundary or a new\n"},{"number":223,"text":"qualification subject, and it cannot retroactively make the original\n"},{"number":224,"text":"frozen construction pass. This law prescribes no actor type or count,\n"},{"number":225,"text":"review-round count, engine, prompt or orchestration (P6).\n"},{"number":226,"text":"\n"},{"number":227,"text":"Author identity is the party responsible for the content of a realised\n"},{"number":228,"text":"subject. It is distinct from actor identity, whoever performs one\n"},{"number":229,"text":"operation, which is an identity and not an authority\n"},{"number":230,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds)).\n"},{"number":231,"text":"Authorship is one of the conditions on\n"},{"number":232,"text":"which the independence of an assessment rests; the evidence conditions are\n"},{"number":233,"text":"the other (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":234,"text":"\n"},{"number":235,"text":"Reporting a defect, supplying a counterexample or identifying behaviour\n"},{"number":236,"text":"already required by governing law does not by itself author the realised\n"},{"number":237,"text":"subject. Contributing wording, design or policy that is adopted into the\n"},{"number":238,"text":"subject, including through directions for a particular repair, is authorship\n"},{"number":239,"text":"of that contribution. A\n"},{"number":240,"text":"reporter may assess a later repair only when the existing assessment grant,\n"},{"number":241,"text":"authorship relation and evidence-independence conditions permit it; a\n"},{"number":242,"text":"reporter gains no review authority from having found the defect. A person\n"},{"number":243,"text":"who authored an adopted repair cannot supply its required independent\n"},{"number":244,"text":"assessment by calling that authorship a finding (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":245,"text":"\n"},{"number":246,"text":"Independence rests on authorship and on the evidence conditions above, not\n"},{"number":247,"text":"on a new context. The assessor may read the same governing sources as the\n"},{"number":248,"text":"constructor. A fresh context alone establishes no independence, and it\n"},{"number":249,"text":"supplies no review authority the author lacks: an author that opens a\n"},{"number":250,"text":"fresh context to review its own candidate is still its author, and its\n"},{"number":251,"text":"review is self-review, which stays construction output and cannot be\n"},{"number":252,"text":"relabelled as independent assessment (P6;\n"},{"number":253,"text":"[TICKETS UP-007](TICKETS.md#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-up-007)). A contribution received from another author stays that\n"},{"number":254,"text":"author's wherever it is carried, and that author's reading of it supplies\n"},{"number":255,"text":"no independent acceptance of it (P6).\n"},{"number":256,"text":"\n"},{"number":257,"text":"Independence across actor families is declared, not assumed. Whether two\n"},{"number":258,"text":"activations of one model family are independent for a semantic judgment is a\n"},{"number":259,"text":"policy the governing basis states for the claim; the default where it is not\n"},{"number":260,"text":"stated is that they are not independent.\n"},{"number":261,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":280,"heading":"EVALUATION/4. Review results","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F4.%20Review%20results","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"91a6025c49220aba6bace6a1dab06fec488d7675a7aa3afc82ffa6ac841436ed","start_line":262,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":262,"text":"## 4. Review results\n"},{"number":263,"text":"\n"},{"number":264,"text":"A review returns one core result\n"},{"number":265,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4, Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results)) for each declared\n"},{"number":266,"text":"predicate it evaluated, with: the exact subject and basis, the evidence\n"},{"number":267,"text":"consulted, the findings ranked by consequence, each finding's evidence and\n"},{"number":268,"text":"the smallest bounded correction, the residual uncertainty, and the\n"},{"number":269,"text":"invalidation conditions. A declared predicate the review planned and did\n"},{"number":270,"text":"not evaluate has no result (FOUNDATIONS §4, Results). The review names it\n"},{"number":271,"text":"as not performed and reports no core value for it, neither\n"},{"number":272,"text":"`indeterminate` nor `falsified`, so that conjunction keeps it apart from\n"},{"number":273,"text":"an undecided predicate and from required coverage that no planned\n"},{"number":274,"text":"assessment addresses\n"},{"number":275,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4, Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results);\n"},{"number":276,"text":"P5, P6). It may recommend a disposition\n"},{"number":277,"text":"([ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition)), which is\n"},{"number":278,"text":"evidence only and never a disposition; it does not apply one. A finding\n"},{"number":279,"text":"without evidence a consumer can chase is commentary.\n"},{"number":280,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":336,"heading":"EVALUATION/4. Review results/Result and triage projection","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F4.%20Review%20results%2FResult%20and%20triage%20projection","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"aad51afeba192031fe47b3082cee0c03138ca7854b8d6a6203c9d49e48c84342","start_line":281,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":281,"text":"### Result and triage projection\n"},{"number":282,"text":"\n"},{"number":283,"text":"Where a review returns findings with technical triage, the triage is the\n"},{"number":284,"text":"assessor's evidence-bound assessment of each finding against the exact\n"},{"number":285,"text":"evaluated claim and basis. Severity, the assessor's grade of consequence,\n"},{"number":286,"text":"is evaluation evidence. Priority, the effect on the current promotion\n"},{"number":287,"text":"boundary and the disposition are the decision owner's (ACTIVATION §1,\n"},{"number":288,"text":"Roles and delegation; when a finding can block is\n"},{"number":289,"text":"[§5, When a finding blocks promotion](#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion))\n"},{"number":290,"text":"and stay distinct values even where a\n"},{"number":291,"text":"Product-defined policy maps one to another. A recommended disposition\n"},{"number":292,"text":"is evidence for the decision owner: it is not a disposition, a\n"},{"number":293,"text":"priority or a boundary effect, and it is never adopted mechanically (P6,\n"},{"number":294,"text":"RF-007). The fields of a triage are declared by the profile that adopts it, and\n"},{"number":295,"text":"the scales it uses are bound by the adopting Product (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":296,"text":"\n"},{"number":297,"text":"The projection of the finding-level triage payload is total over the core\n"},{"number":298,"text":"values of [FOUNDATIONS §4, Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). A predicate\n"},{"number":299,"text":"not performed has no result and so no triage payload; the payload class\n"},{"number":300,"text":"`indeterminate` never stands for it. The payload classes `complete`,\n"},{"number":301,"text":"`indeterminate` and `not_applicable` classify the triage only; they are\n"},{"number":302,"text":"not new results, dispositions, priorities or lifecycle states (P5, P1).\n"},{"number":303,"text":"\n"},{"number":304,"text":"| Core result | Finding and triage payload | Decision-owner consumption constraint |\n"},{"number":305,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":306,"text":"| satisfied | an explicit no-finding state; triage `not_applicable`; evidence, residuals and invalidation stay present | priority and boundary effect are `not_applicable` to this result unless another exact consumed result supplies a finding |\n"},{"number":307,"text":"| falsified | one or more exact findings; triage `complete` where supported, keeping `indeterminate` fields where evidence cannot close them | apply the Product-owned priority and boundary policy without mapping severity mechanically to a disposition |\n"},{"number":308,"text":"| indeterminate | a partial finding or observation state; triage `indeterminate`; the exact evidence gaps and residual uncertainty | keep the uncertainty or reactivate a capable evaluation; do not consume it as satisfaction or as a closed finding |\n"},{"number":309,"text":"| out_of_frame | the evaluated claim needs an undeclared material relation or evaluator capability; triage `indeterminate`; the missing relation or capability and the exact reconfiguration pressure are named | refine or reconfigure a capable activation and keep the claim unresolved; do not consume the result as satisfaction or falsification |\n"},{"number":310,"text":"| invalid_basis | a basis failure; triage `not_applicable`; invalidation evidence and basis-repair pressure | refuse to consume the result and return through the declared basis re-entry relation |\n"},{"number":311,"text":"\n"},{"number":312,"text":"An adjacent observation outside the evaluated claim does not replace the\n"},{"number":313,"text":"claim-relative result. The assessor returns it separately, with triage\n"},{"number":314,"text":"`not_applicable` to that claim and the exact repricing or re-entry\n"},{"number":315,"text":"pressure; the decision owner returns it to its declared owner without\n"},{"number":316,"text":"creating a claim-relative block, or another review round, from its\n"},{"number":317,"text":"severity alone (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":318,"text":"\n"},{"number":319,"text":"The assessor returns to the decision owner, not to the constructor. It does\n"},{"number":320,"text":"not edit the candidate, direct the repair or authorise continuation (P6,\n"},{"number":321,"text":"§3).\n"},{"number":322,"text":"\n"},{"number":323,"text":"Recording the assessment is a separate artifact effect. Where the activation\n"},{"number":324,"text":"grants it, the assessor may write the exact named findings carrier under\n"},{"number":325,"text":"[TICKETS §4 Review findings and bug items](TICKETS.md#review-findings-and-bug-items).\n"},{"number":326,"text":"That grant adds no candidate-repair authority or acquisition route. A review\n"},{"number":327,"text":"has covered its declared subject only when every planned predicate has been\n"},{"number":328,"text":"evaluated or lawfully removed from that subject; a partial return preserves\n"},{"number":329,"text":"the unperformed coverage. Closing the review activity does not satisfy a\n"},{"number":330,"text":"falsified or unresolved work claim (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":331,"text":"\n"},{"number":332,"text":"Purpose and material relation: every configuration keeps severity,\n"},{"number":333,"text":"priority, boundary effect and disposition separate. The rule applies to any\n"},{"number":334,"text":"assessor and decision owner; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md)\n"},{"number":335,"text":"binds its Reviewer and Executive instance (P6).\n"},{"number":336,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":362,"heading":"EVALUATION/5. Acceptance","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F5.%20Acceptance","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"4bc4a02ce7c28455beb4a3e01bc575e2f158051f707e8abd242207046390651b","start_line":337,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":337,"text":"## 5. Acceptance\n"},{"number":338,"text":"\n"},{"number":339,"text":"Acceptance is the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject;\n"},{"number":340,"text":"recording it cannot widen it, and it exhausts only the instance and interval\n"},{"number":341,"text":"it names (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":342,"text":"A work item closes by the condition it stated, not by a reviewer's approval;\n"},{"number":343,"text":"a reviewer result is an input to closure, never the closure. Green labels,\n"},{"number":344,"text":"document counts, review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.\n"},{"number":345,"text":"A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted\n"},{"number":346,"text":"bounded proxy. What a proxy grant names is\n"},{"number":347,"text":"[IDENTITY §6](IDENTITY.md#6-authority-identity-and-conservation-stdo-up-004)'s,\n"},{"number":348,"text":"and what a proxy can never decide is\n"},{"number":349,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds)';\n"},{"number":350,"text":"for acceptance, a change a proxy cannot make re-enters at its owning\n"},{"number":351,"text":"relation ([ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)).\n"},{"number":352,"text":"\n"},{"number":353,"text":"Where the subject is a successor, its acceptance evidence includes the\n"},{"number":354,"text":"successor disposition record of [RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015)\n"},{"number":355,"text":"(STDO-UP-015), which states the law: the exact predecessor immutable cut\n"},{"number":356,"text":"the successor evolves, and one semantic disposition for every predecessor\n"},{"number":357,"text":"claim capable of affecting the successor. A claim whose disposition is\n"},{"number":358,"text":"unresolved cannot be qualified and so cannot be accepted; how the record\n"},{"number":359,"text":"is evaluated is [RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015).\n"},{"number":360,"text":"An intentionally removed disposition is a decision of the current Product\n"},{"number":361,"text":"authority, and its record is that decision (P6, P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":362,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":388,"heading":"EVALUATION/5. Acceptance/Landing, closure and release","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F5.%20Acceptance%2FLanding%2C%20closure%20and%20release","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"59685df8aca240ee7cf1781016df5f540ec258d108d77afe293d255a6afd05f5","start_line":363,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":363,"text":"### Landing, closure and release\n"},{"number":364,"text":"\n"},{"number":365,"text":"Landing makes an exact candidate available at an authorized checkpoint or\n"},{"number":366,"text":"integration destination. It is an operation under its existing grant, not\n"},{"number":367,"text":"acceptance of the candidate's claims. Work closure applies the stated closing\n"},{"number":368,"text":"condition; release applies the separately selected publication and acceptance\n"},{"number":369,"text":"conditions of [RELEASE](RELEASE.md). Record these as separate decisions (P6,\n"},{"number":370,"text":"P3).\n"},{"number":371,"text":"\n"},{"number":372,"text":"Review supplies QA evidence for those decisions. A pending review does not by\n"},{"number":373,"text":"itself hold landing: an admitted candidate may land after its bounded work\n"},{"number":374,"text":"and fix pass, while review of that exact candidate runs beside subsequent\n"},{"number":375,"text":"authorized work. A required review holds the closure or acceptance claim that\n"},{"number":376,"text":"depends on its complete report. A governing landing condition, applicable hard\n"},{"number":377,"text":"stop or missing operation authority still prevents landing; availability is\n"},{"number":378,"text":"no waiver. [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §12](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#qa-cadence-and-repair-rechecks)\n"},{"number":379,"text":"binds the optional profile's repair/recheck cadence (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":380,"text":"\n"},{"number":381,"text":"Permitted downstream work may consume a landed candidate before its review\n"},{"number":382,"text":"reports, carrying its exact identity, unresolved conditions and dependency\n"},{"number":383,"text":"links. This is provisional use, not admitted truth. A later material finding\n"},{"number":384,"text":"invalidates the affected dependent results under\n"},{"number":385,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse); unrelated valid results\n"},{"number":386,"text":"remain reusable. Repair and re-evaluation follow those dependencies before\n"},{"number":387,"text":"further reliance (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":388,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":405,"heading":"EVALUATION/5. Acceptance/Declared Product acceptance gates","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F5.%20Acceptance%2FDeclared%20Product%20acceptance%20gates","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"e668581bf044984a25588432cadead431ed7e992b3bd54c3e5922629a6c3dbe6","start_line":389,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":389,"text":"### Declared Product acceptance gates\n"},{"number":390,"text":"\n"},{"number":391,"text":"A Product-owned frame basis, or a work contract explicitly delegated that\n"},{"number":392,"text":"choice by the basis, may declare a gated handoff between two Products. It\n"},{"number":393,"text":"names both Product identities, the directed relation, exact candidate/claim,\n"},{"number":394,"text":"required review and coverage, acceptance conditions and decision owner. Until\n"},{"number":395,"text":"that review has covered its declared subject and the acceptance conditions\n"},{"number":396,"text":"are satisfied, the downstream Product cannot accept the candidate as an\n"},{"number":397,"text":"admitted input or close claims dependent on that acceptance. Authorized\n"},{"number":398,"text":"provisional work and repair may continue under the preceding section (P6,\n"},{"number":399,"text":"P2).\n"},{"number":400,"text":"\n"},{"number":401,"text":"The gate's declaration is explicit; co-location, a dependency or this available\n"},{"number":402,"text":"mechanism creates none. Existing user-acceptance, release/go-live and other\n"},{"number":403,"text":"Product boundaries retain their own conditions. This member declares no\n"},{"number":404,"text":"particular Product gate or extra capture-review hold on landing (P6).\n"},{"number":405,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":444,"heading":"EVALUATION/5. Blocking current promotion is the decision owner's act\n"},{"number":410,"text":"over that finding (§4, Result and triage projection). This section is the\n"},{"number":411,"text":"one statement of when a finding can block; profiles and work carriers\n"},{"number":412,"text":"refer to it and add only their domain triggers.\n"},{"number":413,"text":"\n"},{"number":414,"text":"A review verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and its applicable\n"},{"number":415,"text":"hard stops ([ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement)). A\n"},{"number":416,"text":"finding can block current promotion only when it:\n"},{"number":417,"text":"\n"},{"number":418,"text":"1. falsifies that claim;\n"},{"number":419,"text":"2. exposes competing or ambiguous authority on the claim's acceptance\n"},{"number":420,"text":"   path;\n"},{"number":421,"text":"3. violates applicable active authority, safety or retained accepted\n"},{"number":422,"text":"   behaviour; or\n"},{"number":423,"text":"4. establishes a material architectural decision with durable\n"},{"number":424,"text":"   consequences that forecloses an admitted Product outcome.\n"},{"number":425,"text":"\n"},{"number":426,"text":"These conditions are necessary. Which of them suffice is decided as\n"},{"number":427,"text":"follows:\n"},{"number":428,"text":"\n"},{"number":429,"text":"| Consumed condition | Effect on the current promotion boundary |\n"},{"number":430,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":431,"text":"| a valid falsification of a mandatory claim governed by a non-waivable hard stop | the boundary blocks, whatever the assigned priority or the decision cutoff |\n"},{"number":432,"text":"| any other finding meeting one of the four conditions | the decision owner decides blocking from the exact affected claim, the governed outcome or decision the work serves ([ACTIVATION §1, Intake](ACTIVATION.md#intake)), the applicable hard stops and the Product-owned cutoff policy; below that cutoff no block follows mechanically, and an accepted residual is retained explicitly |\n"},{"number":433,"text":"| a finding meeting none of the four conditions | it does not block |\n"},{"number":434,"text":"| an observation outside the exact reviewed claim | repricing or re-entry input, returned as §4 states: by itself it does not widen the reviewed subject, block its bounded claim, or require a new ticket, artifact, review round or implementation increment |\n"},{"number":435,"text":"\n"},{"number":436,"text":"Severity selects neither priority nor a block mechanically, and priority\n"},{"number":437,"text":"neither erases severity nor waives a hard stop. The decision cutoff is the\n"},{"number":438,"text":"adopting Product's policy; this member sets no cutoff (P6, P2). This law\n"},{"number":439,"text":"applies at any promotion boundary; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#promotion-constraint-projection)\n"},{"number":440,"text":"binds the Executive instance. Purpose and material relation: one owner\n"},{"number":441,"text":"gives every review consumer the same blocking condition. A bounded review\n"},{"number":442,"text":"does not block on observations outside its claim, while a non-waivable hard\n"},{"number":443,"text":"stop still blocks.\n"},{"number":444,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":535,"heading":"EVALUATION/6. Conformance of realisations\n"},{"number":446,"text":"\n"},{"number":447,"text":"A realisation aⱼ conforms to a specification Σ when its interpreted behaviour\n"},{"number":448,"text":"satisfies Σ under a declared interpretation contract (P1) and an independent\n"},{"number":449,"text":"judgment (P6). Several realisations may conform to one Σ; sufficiency does\n"},{"number":450,"text":"not require unique derivation or equality with an incumbent. A weak Σ that\n"},{"number":451,"text":"admits materially different behaviours either declares the latitude or is\n"},{"number":452,"text":"repaired before a decision-complete design is claimed.\n"},{"number":453,"text":"\n"},{"number":454,"text":"Equivalence ladder. The ladder is the list of the four claims named next,\n"},{"number":455,"text":"each a rung; the rungs are listed, not ordered, and no rung implies\n"},{"number":456,"text":"another. Conformance, semantic equivalence, computational equivalence and\n"},{"number":457,"text":"categorical equivalence are separate claims with separate evidence (P1,\n"},{"number":458,"text":"P6). Conformance establishes neither identical behaviour outside Σ nor\n"},{"number":459,"text":"equal cost. Semantic equivalence of realisations claims that two\n"},{"number":460,"text":"realisations, or a realisation and a declared reference outcome, have\n"},{"number":461,"text":"identical interpreted behaviour on a stated domain, behaviour outside Σ\n"},{"number":462,"text":"included. In this member semantic equivalence is always this equivalence\n"},{"number":463,"text":"of realisations, not the equivalence of concepts across bounded contexts\n"},{"number":464,"text":"that\n"},{"number":465,"text":"[PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#5-bounded-context-semantic-resolution)\n"},{"number":466,"text":"governs, and semantic conformance, in the comparison rule below, is\n"},{"number":467,"text":"conformance with the governing semantic basis as Σ. Computational\n"},{"number":468,"text":"equivalence claims that two realisations compute the same function at\n"},{"number":469,"text":"equal cost for declared workloads on a declared architecture H.\n"},{"number":470,"text":"Categorical equivalence is a claim about categories and the maps between\n"},{"number":471,"text":"them: FOUNDATIONS §4, Formal fragment, owns what a category or functor\n"},{"number":472,"text":"claim must show and defines the symbols 𝒜, ℐ and 𝒞_H used here, and a\n"},{"number":473,"text":"map's preservation of identities and composition is a further claim\n"},{"number":474,"text":"distinct from every rung.\n"},{"number":475,"text":"For a proposed span 𝒜 → ℐ and 𝒜 → 𝒞_H, conformance to Σ, semantic\n"},{"number":476,"text":"equivalence and computational equivalence remain different claims.\n"},{"number":477,"text":"A claim of categorical equivalence meets each item of the Formal fragment\n"},{"number":478,"text":"that applies to it, as that section states them. This rung adds one\n"},{"number":479,"text":"requirement of its own to those items: a quasi-inverse functor, and\n"},{"number":480,"text":"natural isomorphisms between each composite of the functor with its\n"},{"number":481,"text":"quasi-inverse and the identity functor, on a stated domain. An analogy or matching result\n"},{"number":482,"text":"is insufficient. Evidence for one claim is not reported as a result for\n"},{"number":483,"text":"another (§1). The ladder keeps a matching output, an analogy\n"},{"number":484,"text":"or a passing conformance check from being read as equivalence or as\n"},{"number":485,"text":"preserved structure (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":486,"text":"\n"},{"number":487,"text":"Layered sufficiency. A specification arranged in layers is sufficient when\n"},{"number":488,"text":"a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from each layer; the\n"},{"number":489,"text":"derivation need not be unique, since different realisations may satisfy the\n"},{"number":490,"text":"same upper layer, and the test is sufficiency, not determinism. A failure\n"},{"number":491,"text":"to derive at any boundary is a defect of the upper layer: unclear,\n"},{"number":492,"text":"contradictory, underspecified, not concrete or decomposable enough, or\n"},{"number":493,"text":"polluted with accidental lower-layer detail. A boundary that can be crossed\n"},{"number":494,"text":"only by hiding a major unresolved ambiguity is not yet sufficient even if\n"},{"number":495,"text":"some downstream artifact can be produced. For an already accepted relation,\n"},{"number":496,"text":"reconstruction may reuse its exact current basis and sufficient evidence\n"},{"number":497,"text":"after checking applicability and invalidation (ACTIVATION §7);\n"},{"number":498,"text":"reconstructability requires a correct reconstruction route, not its\n"},{"number":499,"text":"execution at every use, grants no restart authority and does not excuse\n"},{"number":500,"text":"stale success. The claim determines the reconstruction span; a local\n"},{"number":501,"text":"selected function does not require recreating the whole subject. New\n"},{"number":502,"text":"material counterexamples still challenge the affected relation (P2, P1,\n"},{"number":503,"text":"P0). [SPEC_METHOD §2 Reconstruction litmus](SPEC_METHOD.md#reconstruction-litmus)\n"},{"number":504,"text":"applies this law to the method's own chain, with diagnosis per layer.\n"},{"number":505,"text":"\n"},{"number":506,"text":"Comparison. After freeze the evaluator compares the frozen result against\n"},{"number":507,"text":"the mandatory governing semantic basis for semantic conformance or\n"},{"number":508,"text":"equivalence. A separately held expected or reference outcome, if one exists\n"},{"number":509,"text":"and is applicable, is optional evidence and explicitly non-authoritative;\n"},{"number":510,"text":"semantic equivalence to it is required only where the governing basis\n"},{"number":511,"text":"requires it. A lawful alternative construction permitted by the basis\n"},{"number":512,"text":"passes. Subjective similarity to the basis or the reference is insufficient\n"},{"number":513,"text":"to establish conformance or equivalence. Byte or structural identity,\n"},{"number":514,"text":"unique derivation, determinism and incumbent equality are not generic\n"},{"number":515,"text":"comparison criteria. A construction outside the declared competence or\n"},{"number":516,"text":"configuration envelope cannot indict generic method sufficiency (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":517,"text":"\n"},{"number":518,"text":"For representation-benefit experiments, an optional design is to compare\n"},{"number":519,"text":"equivalent substantive information and access while independently varying\n"},{"number":520,"text":"relevant counterexamples retained, absent, or stale and out of scope.\n"},{"number":521,"text":"Include the existing contract and the simplest adequate qualified plain-text\n"},{"number":522,"text":"fix. State outcome oracles and the units and boundaries of acquisition,\n"},{"number":523,"text":"rendering, reasoning, repair and assurance cost. Scale trials to the claim,\n"},{"number":524,"text":"risk and resources; this guidance prescribes no universal trial count or\n"},{"number":525,"text":"new review cycle (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":526,"text":"\n"},{"number":527,"text":"Information-equivalent benefit can support an architecture decision;\n"},{"number":528,"text":"retention benefit supports context-selection policy; stale-material failure\n"},{"number":529,"text":"targets provenance and invalidation. No benefit or higher total cost supports\n"},{"number":530,"text":"retaining the existing construction. Outcome correctness and unresolved\n"},{"number":531,"text":"obligations remain visible. A Propose–Probe–Compose harness is one possible\n"},{"number":532,"text":"experiment strategy, not a dependency or acceptance oracle. Consumer\n"},{"number":533,"text":"adequacy remains distinct from functor laws under\n"},{"number":534,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Formal fragment](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra).\n"},{"number":535,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":555,"heading":"EVALUATION/6. It states under three\n"},{"number":540,"text":"separate heads what it claims and the evidence for each, and claims none of\n"},{"number":541,"text":"them by a byte or size measure. Semantic conservation: a disposed claim of\n"},{"number":542,"text":"the predecessor keeps its meaning in the successor text, judged by reading\n"},{"number":543,"text":"both texts against the disposition\n"},{"number":544,"text":"([RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015)\n"},{"number":545,"text":"owns the dispositions and their conservation reading). Demonstrated\n"},{"number":546,"text":"reduction: a deciding path of the successor costs less than the same path\n"},{"number":547,"text":"in the predecessor on a declared measure, shown by the trace of both paths\n"},{"number":548,"text":"with the declared tradeoffs. Mere relocation: text moved from one owner or\n"},{"number":549,"text":"carrier to another without a change in meaning and without a traced\n"},{"number":550,"text":"change in any deciding path. Relocation reported as reduction, or\n"},{"number":551,"text":"conservation claimed from unchanged bytes, misreports the claim (§1, P1,\n"},{"number":552,"text":"P6). The three heads stay separate in the return as the rungs of the\n"},{"number":553,"text":"ladder do above; a frame for a reconstruction task binds this\n"},{"number":554,"text":"distinction.\n"},{"number":555,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":615,"heading":"EVALUATION/6. It covers §6 and §7 of this member and the\n"},{"number":562,"text":"[CONFORMANCE](CONFORMANCE.md) member; a rule in CONFORMANCE is marked\n"},{"number":563,"text":"\"outside this member\" in the third column. They are conditions of\n"},{"number":568,"text":"the work this family governs, not commitments, and do not follow from\n"},{"number":569,"text":"finite capacity alone. P0's actor-change premise, that the actor of one\n"},{"number":570,"text":"step need not be the actor of the next and may re-acquire declared sources\n"},{"number":571,"text":"but not private memory, is cited by name. Decision test: can a competent actor produce a result in the declared\n"},{"number":625,"text":"   algebra for representative in-domain evaluations?\n"},{"number":626,"text":"2. Reconstruction test: can a fresh competent actor activate the frame\n"},{"number":627,"text":"   from the declared packet without hidden history (RF-013)?\n"},{"number":628,"text":"3. Sensitivity test: do changes to declared material relations affect the\n"},{"number":629,"text":"   result where expected?\n"},{"number":630,"text":"4. Irrelevance test: do excluded unrelated changes leave the result stable\n"},{"number":631,"text":"   where expected?\n"},{"number":632,"text":"5. Basis test: does stale, mismatched or ambiguous basis information\n"},{"number":633,"text":"   invalidate or refuse the evaluation?\n"},{"number":634,"text":"6. Authority test: does frame selection preserve semantic and decision\n"},{"number":635,"text":"   authority and the exact inherited operation authority for every\n"},{"number":636,"text":"   material construction, transformation, admission, publication or\n"},{"number":637,"text":"   mutation?\n"},{"number":638,"text":"7. Counterexample test: does the frame detect the representative\n"},{"number":639,"text":"   historical or constructed violations it claims to cover?\n"},{"number":640,"text":"8. Capability test: can the declared actor class hold and operate the\n"},{"number":641,"text":"   frame within its envelope?\n"},{"number":642,"text":"9. Result-consumption test: can a declared consumer use the closed result\n"},{"number":643,"text":"   without importing hidden frame context?\n"},{"number":644,"text":"\n"},{"number":645,"text":"Qualification binds the exact frame revision, actor envelope, evaluation\n"},{"number":646,"text":"family, basis class and evidence conditions evaluated. It does not\n"},{"number":647,"text":"generalise to an unevaluated population by naming the frame generically\n"},{"number":648,"text":"(§1, the quantifier rule).\n"},{"number":649,"text":"\n"},{"number":650,"text":"Adequate attention. The capability test asks two questions, and they are\n"},{"number":651,"text":"evaluated separately. Whether the declared actor class can hold the frame\n"},{"number":652,"text":"is fit: for the context dimension, the size of the selected\n"},{"number":653,"text":"representation, measured as ACTIVATION §2 step 3 measures it, against the\n"},{"number":654,"text":"declared capacity; the envelope's other dimensions are fitted as RF-014\n"},{"number":655,"text":"states. Whether the actor class\n"},{"number":656,"text":"operates the frame adequately is adequate attention, and only actual-use\n"},{"number":657,"text":"evidence establishes it: actors of the declared class apply the frame to\n"},{"number":658,"text":"its declared tasks under its declared conditions, and the results are\n"},{"number":659,"text":"judged against expectations recorded from the governing sources before the\n"},{"number":660,"text":"results are opened, by an assessor under §3 where the claim needs\n"},{"number":661,"text":"independent assessment. A size measurement, or any byte or token\n"},{"number":662,"text":"threshold, establishes fit and nothing about attention; a frame that fits\n"},{"number":663,"text":"is not thereby adequately attended. Actual-use evidence binds the frame\n"},{"number":664,"text":"revision, actor class, tasks and conditions evaluated, like the\n"},{"number":665,"text":"qualification above, and establishes no universal attention score (§1,\n"},{"number":666,"text":"the quantifier rule). Time, spend and other resource limits are those of\n"},{"number":667,"text":"the selected execution binding, under the resource-limit law of\n"},{"number":668,"text":"[ACTIVATION §6](ACTIVATION.md#6-cost-and-proportionality), not of this\n"},{"number":669,"text":"test. Finite attention makes fit necessary\n"},{"number":670,"text":"(RF-002), and only use shows that a frame that fits is applied, so a frame\n"},{"number":671,"text":"is never qualified for attention because it fits (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":672,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":773,"heading":"EVALUATION/7. Qualification of frames and of the method/Method self-qualification","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md#EVALUATION%2F7.%20Qualification%20of%20frames%20and%20of%20the%20method%2FMethod%20self-qualification","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","sha256":"fe8584eeeae97e1e105812baf98cc9155367f222a39c37eb10f427f79bea8914","start_line":673,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EVALUATION.md","lines":[{"number":673,"text":"### Method self-qualification\n"},{"number":674,"text":"\n"},{"number":675,"text":"The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else. Qualification\n"},{"number":676,"text":"of generic method sufficiency consumes the work boundary (FOUNDATIONS §2),\n"},{"number":677,"text":"the construction and assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 and the layered\n"},{"number":678,"text":"sufficiency of §6; it creates no second process. A fresh competent\n"},{"number":679,"text":"constructor operates inside a declared capability, context and\n"},{"number":680,"text":"configuration envelope, using only the declared ordinary method and\n"},{"number":681,"text":"authority surfaces and declared trial subjects. An independently\n"},{"number":682,"text":"authorised evaluator has a declared governing basis and comparison\n"},{"number":683,"text":"predicate. Material expected or reference outcomes, source exemplars or\n"},{"number":684,"text":"incumbent realisations, author memory and ad hoc rescue are withheld from\n"},{"number":685,"text":"the constructor until its construction result is frozen wherever earlier\n"},{"number":686,"text":"exposure would compromise reconstructive independence; then the evaluator\n"},{"number":687,"text":"compares the frozen result with the method's mandatory relation population\n"},{"number":688,"text":"under the comparison rule of §6.\n"},{"number":689,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME RF-013](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-013-reconstructable-activation)\n"},{"number":690,"text":"owns the reconstructability of the activation. The constructor, freeze,\n"},{"number":691,"text":"assessor, acceptance and release protocols are supplied by the governing\n"},{"number":692,"text":"authority; this member does not select a particular protocol for those\n"},{"number":693,"text":"roles.\n"},{"number":694,"text":"\n"},{"number":695,"text":"The qualification population is every function and failure relation the\n"},{"number":696,"text":"method claims (REFERENCE_FRAME §5), each with its required representative\n"},{"number":697,"text":"observations (P6):\n"},{"number":698,"text":"\n"},{"number":699,"text":"| Relation under qualification | Required representative observations |\n"},{"number":700,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":701,"text":"| `declare` | a frame set derived from a governed workspace, outcome, practices, capability envelopes, evaluation inventory, authority and residual boundary; missing authority or evaluation basis refuses |\n"},{"number":702,"text":"| `activate` | activation with an exact subject and basis and a capable actor succeeds; stale, ambiguous, topology-mismatched, unauthorised and capability-incompatible activations refuse or return the applicable closed pressure |\n"},{"number":703,"text":"| `evaluate` | representative `satisfied`, `falsified`, `indeterminate`, `out_of_frame` and `invalid_basis` results; sensitivity to material changes and stability under established irrelevance |\n"},{"number":704,"text":"| `conjoin` | compatible closed results decide under the declared rule; a result conflict returns `conflict`, mandatory indeterminacy `indeterminate`, and a basis mismatch `invalid_basis` (Stale results, [FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)); under a veto or deferral the decision rule declares, `conjoin` returns the [REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) outcome whose cause holds; none flattens frame meaning |\n"},{"number":705,"text":"| `translate` | preserved coordinates and provenance reach the target; declared loss stays explicit; identity, basis, authority or equality mismatch refuses |\n"},{"number":706,"text":"| `audit_coverage` | evaluation, interaction, semantic, operation and decision authority, failure, capability and required independently activated or assurance-independent coverage map to capable frames or explicit residuals; artifact or actor count cannot close coverage |\n"},{"number":707,"text":"| `revise` | historical failure, topology mutation, evidence change and capability change produce the declared frame-set delta and identify every prior activation, result, conjunction and coverage claim requiring reevaluation |\n"},{"number":708,"text":"| result consumption | a declared consumer uses one closed result without importing hidden frame context or authority; insufficient output produces a reconstructability failure |\n"},{"number":709,"text":"| material composition | a case requiring cross-frame execution declares composition, order where material, closure, failure and the conservation of semantic, operation and decision authority; a case not requiring composition stays uncomposed |\n"},{"number":710,"text":"\n"},{"number":711,"text":"One valid frame-set declaration and coverage result establishes only the\n"},{"number":712,"text":"`declare` and evaluated `audit_coverage` population; it proves activation,\n"},{"number":713,"text":"evaluation, conjunction, translation, revision, result consumption and\n"},{"number":714,"text":"material composition by no implication. Each relation is exercised through\n"},{"number":715,"text":"representative positive, boundary and falsifying cases. Qualification may\n"},{"number":716,"text":"be staged, and every verdict states the exact functions, frame revisions,\n"},{"number":717,"text":"actor envelopes, basis classes, result branches and evidence populations\n"},{"number":718,"text":"evaluated; an unevaluated function or branch stays open rather than\n"},{"number":719,"text":"inheriting a whole-method verdict (P6; §1). Prior exemplar frame sets or\n"},{"number":720,"text":"outcomes may serve as optional comparison evidence after freeze; they are\n"},{"number":721,"text":"not mandatory target answers unless the governing basis explicitly requires\n"},{"number":722,"text":"equivalence (§6).\n"},{"number":723,"text":"\n"},{"number":724,"text":"Derived guidance. Changed derived guidance, a compression, a frame packet,\n"},{"number":725,"text":"a skill or any other projection of the method, is qualified against\n"},{"number":726,"text":"source-derived expected behaviour, including the affected permissions,\n"},{"number":727,"text":"exclusions and invalidators. For a native use claim, an ordinary actor\n"},{"number":728,"text":"applies that guidance through its declared entry and available context.\n"},{"number":729,"text":"Digest integrity and index generation establish identity and structure,\n"},{"number":730,"text":"not semantic fidelity or usability. Mechanical and operational claims\n"},{"number":731,"text":"require their own executable observations, including the applicable\n"},{"number":732,"text":"workload and operational assumptions of ACTIVATION §6; semantic agreement\n"},{"number":733,"text":"cannot substitute for those observations (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":734,"text":"\n"},{"number":735,"text":"The qualification law is false if constructor competence or its\n"},{"number":736,"text":"capability, context or configuration envelope, or evaluator authority,\n"},{"number":737,"text":"governing basis or comparison predicate, is undeclared, or an\n"},{"number":738,"text":"out-of-envelope construction is used to indict the method; if the\n"},{"number":739,"text":"constructor uses supplemental method or authority input that is not\n"},{"number":740,"text":"declared; if a material expected or reference outcome, source exemplar or\n"},{"number":741,"text":"incumbent realisation, author memory or ad hoc rescue is exposed to the\n"},{"number":742,"text":"constructor before freeze where that exposure compromises reconstructive\n"},{"number":743,"text":"independence; if comparison omits the mandatory governing semantic basis,\n"},{"number":744,"text":"proceeds under constructor authority instead of independently authorised\n"},{"number":745,"text":"evaluator authority, or is self-adjusted after seeing the result; if a\n"},{"number":746,"text":"reference outcome is used as authority, reference equivalence is required\n"},{"number":747,"text":"where the governing basis does not require it, basis-required reference\n"},{"number":748,"text":"equivalence is omitted, subjective similarity is used as proof, or\n"},{"number":749,"text":"identity, unique derivation, determinism or incumbent equality substitutes\n"},{"number":750,"text":"for semantic conformance or equivalence; or if a post-exposure revision is\n"},{"number":751,"text":"unclassified or is used to make the original frozen construction pass\n"},{"number":752,"text":"retroactively (§3).\n"},{"number":753,"text":"\n"},{"number":754,"text":"Recoverability benchmark (P0 with the actor-change premise). For a selected\n"},{"number":755,"text":"activation, measure whether a fresh actor given only the published documents\n"},{"number":756,"text":"recovers the governing relations with fidelity judged independently, and at\n"},{"number":757,"text":"what reconstruction cost. The context transferred is measured as\n"},{"number":758,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope) step 3\n"},{"number":759,"text":"measures size; time and spend are measured where measurable, under the\n"},{"number":760,"text":"selected execution binding. The fidelity judgment is actual-use evidence\n"},{"number":761,"text":"under Frame qualification above, and measured size is not evidence of it.\n"},{"number":762,"text":"A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus\n"},{"number":763,"text":"loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its\n"},{"number":764,"text":"content.\n"},{"number":765,"text":"\n"},{"number":766,"text":"A comparative claim additionally declares its exact comparison baseline,\n"},{"number":767,"text":"task population, actor envelope, evidence conditions and measures before\n"},{"number":768,"text":"running the comparison. Material differences remain explicit and limit the\n"},{"number":769,"text":"inference under §1; the baseline is evidence for that declared comparison,\n"},{"number":770,"text":"not another source of method authority. No comparison baseline is required\n"},{"number":771,"text":"to measure the package's own recoverability. Report fidelity, reconstruction\n"},{"number":772,"text":"cost, task completion and material errors detected as separate observations;\n"},{"number":773,"text":"one measure does not stand in for another (P3, P6).\n"}]},{"end_line":45,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"a552fc62f349afc9a4d0b9b6a334977044b397722ae502681320f51e9027059e","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# EXECUTIVE_BASELINE\n"},{"number":2,"text":"\n"},{"number":3,"text":"Tier 3. An optional operational profile. It describes the executive\n"},{"number":4,"text":"configuration: one configuration in the sense of\n"},{"number":5,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), with three\n"},{"number":6,"text":"engagement frames (Executive, Worker, Reviewer) and a catalogue of\n"},{"number":7,"text":"specialist frames, mapped onto the law of tiers 1 and 2. An operational\n"},{"number":8,"text":"profile owns only its own bindings, the terms and choices it adds for its\n"},{"number":9,"text":"operation. Here they are: the additions to direct entry (§3); the\n"},{"number":10,"text":"empirical revision boundary (§4); the three frames with their grants, limits and\n"},{"number":11,"text":"prohibitions, and the explanation of their allocation (§5 to §10); the\n"},{"number":12,"text":"catalogue of specialist-frame families (§11); the Executive engagement\n"},{"number":13,"text":"procedure (§6, §12 to §15); the reading of\n"},{"number":14,"text":"each work-result value for the Worker (§5 Work result); and the records for\n"},{"number":15,"text":"adoption, project configuration, qualification and closure (§16 to §22).\n"},{"number":16,"text":"\n"},{"number":17,"text":"It imports [FOUNDATIONS](FOUNDATIONS.md),\n"},{"number":18,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md), [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md),\n"},{"number":19,"text":"[EVALUATION](EVALUATION.md), [SPEC_METHOD](SPEC_METHOD.md),\n"},{"number":20,"text":"[PRODUCT_DEFINITION](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md) and\n"},{"number":21,"text":"[ASSURANCE](ASSURANCE.md) by reference and defines none of their objects\n"},{"number":22,"text":"again: the frame, frame set, activation packet and method functions, with\n"},{"number":23,"text":"the outcomes of `activate`, are REFERENCE_FRAME's; the core result algebra\n"},{"number":24,"text":"and the conjunction of results are\n"},{"number":25,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#results); intake, admission,\n"},{"number":26,"text":"applicability, configuration, and roles and delegation are ACTIVATION §1,\n"},{"number":27,"text":"and the refinements of the core for steps, with the four dispositions, are\n"},{"number":28,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition); the\n"},{"number":29,"text":"independent-assessment protocol and the review-result shape, including the\n"},{"number":30,"text":"result and triage projection, are EVALUATION §3 and §4; the product\n"},{"number":31,"text":"testing frames, testing value, path erasure, subject acquisition,\n"},{"number":32,"text":"counterexample localisation and the interface integration frame are\n"},{"number":33,"text":"ASSURANCE §7 to §13. Each clause names the principle that requires it (P0\n"},{"number":34,"text":"to P6, FOUNDATIONS §3), as FOUNDATIONS §1 requires.\n"},{"number":35,"text":"\n"},{"number":36,"text":"The frames take the responsibilities that\n"},{"number":37,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)\n"},{"number":38,"text":"names where a configuration's operations include construction, assessment\n"},{"number":39,"text":"and disposition: the Worker frame carries the constructor's, the Reviewer\n"},{"number":40,"text":"frame the assessor's, and the Executive frame is the configuration's\n"},{"number":41,"text":"coordinator, which disposes as decision owner or its admitted proxy within\n"},{"number":42,"text":"the grant existing authority admits. Canonical compression\n"},{"number":47,"text":"\n"},{"number":48,"text":"REFERENCE_FRAME defines the finite engagement unit. The selected complete\n"},{"number":49,"text":"method cut defines specification, design, construction, assessment,\n"},{"number":50,"text":"disposition, checkpoint, continuation, identity and release law. This\n"},{"number":51,"text":"profile maps three practical engagement frames onto those owners; it owns\n"},{"number":52,"text":"only the bindings its lead names and no rule of those owners (P6, P0):\n"},{"number":53,"text":"\n"},{"number":54,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":55,"text":"existing project authority\n"},{"number":56,"text":"  + selected complete method basis, REFERENCE_FRAME included\n"},{"number":57,"text":"  + exact governed Product or Product-chain outcome and workspace basis\n"},{"number":58,"text":"  + known evaluation inventory, dependencies and residuals\n"},{"number":59,"text":"  -> a sufficient direct Worker activation, or coordination where material\n"},{"number":60,"text":"  -> when coordinated: Executive locks outcome and basis, holds a finite ready frontier\n"},{"number":61,"text":"  -> Worker and the applicable specialist evaluations; Reviewer only where required\n"},{"number":62,"text":"  -> closed results, technical triage where applicable, declared conjunction\n"},{"number":63,"text":"  -> existing bounded decision authority, result recording, next lawful action\n"},{"number":64,"text":"  -> updated basis, coverage, residuals and frontier\n"},{"number":65,"text":"  -> repeat or stop\n"},{"number":66,"text":"```\n"},{"number":67,"text":"\n"},{"number":68,"text":"The three frames are overlapping evaluation contexts. They are neither a\n"},{"number":69,"text":"hierarchy nor an actor topology (P6; RF-009). The Worker supplies the\n"},{"number":70,"text":"candidate and never activates the Reviewer. The Reviewer evaluates and does\n"},{"number":71,"text":"not implement. The Executive applies only decision authority already\n"},{"number":72,"text":"granted by Product, Goals, requirements, accepted design, a ticket, identity\n"},{"number":73,"text":"law or release law. The Worker carries only the construction or\n"},{"number":74,"text":"transformation authority of its admitted intake. No frame acquires\n"},{"number":75,"text":"admission, publication, mutation or any other operation authority from its\n"},{"number":76,"text":"label (P6).\n"},{"number":77,"text":"\n"},{"number":78,"text":"The profile derives twelve generic specialist-frame families (§11):\n"},{"number":79,"text":"Product, Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary,\n"},{"number":80,"text":"Entity, Operator, Owner, Effect, Reuse/Foundation, Install and Proof. They\n"},{"number":81,"text":"keep apart recurring evaluation questions that otherwise collapse across\n"},{"number":82,"text":"constitutional WHAT, structural HOW, identity, authority, effects,\n"},{"number":83,"text":"foundations, installed subjects and evidence. They are available families,\n"},{"number":84,"text":"not mandatory actors, stages, components, services, files or runtime types.\n"},{"number":85,"text":"An activation selects only the families material to its exact evaluation\n"},{"number":86,"text":"and keeps an explicit residual for any material family it cannot cover (P2,\n"},{"number":87,"text":"P1).\n"},{"number":88,"text":"\n"},{"number":89,"text":"The four product testing frames (user acceptance, end to end, integration,\n"},{"number":90,"text":"unit) are tier-2 law in ASSURANCE §7. Under this profile they are activated\n"},{"number":91,"text":"inside the same conditionally selected engagement relation; they add no\n"},{"number":92,"text":"role, stage, authority or testing hierarchy. Their evidence topology, the\n"},{"number":93,"text":"assignment of claims to congruent evidence frames, is ASSURANCE §7; a\n"},{"number":94,"text":"broader frame cannot make a module-owned law true, and any number of\n"},{"number":95,"text":"narrower green frames cannot establish an unevaluated Product composition\n"},{"number":96,"text":"or user outcome (P6, P4a).\n"},{"number":97,"text":"\n"},{"number":98,"text":"A project may adopt this profile or define another frame configuration\n"},{"number":99,"text":"(§16). The executive configuration is selected where it fits the task; it\n"},{"number":100,"text":"is not the method's default (§7 The executive configuration). Adopting the\n"},{"number":101,"text":"profile is the Product authority's act (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7), and each\n"},{"number":102,"text":"decision a configuration makes is admitted by the existing authority that\n"},{"number":103,"text":"owns it (ACTIVATION §1 Configuration, Admission of a configuration; §16).\n"},{"number":104,"text":"A local axioms file may carry the decision; carrying it does not make the\n"},{"number":105,"text":"file a new constitutional owner (P6).\n"},{"number":106,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":146,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/2. Neither kind opens a second amendment\n"},{"number":138,"text":"path for the owning law. Where this profile conflicts with an owning\n"},{"number":139,"text":"clause, the owning clause controls and this profile requires revision (P6).\n"},{"number":140,"text":"\n"},{"number":141,"text":"Inclusion in an exact released cut or another admitted method basis makes\n"},{"number":142,"text":"the profile available; it does not adopt it. Its instance premises hold where\n"},{"number":217,"text":"the executive configuration is selected; they are adopted with it and do\n"},{"number":218,"text":"not follow from the foundations (P1, P6):\n"},{"number":219,"text":"\n"},{"number":220,"text":"- I1: the work is a series of bounded tasks under one governed outcome,\n"},{"number":221,"text":"  and carrying out a bounded change and managing delivery across the tasks\n"},{"number":222,"text":"  need separate attention;\n"},{"number":223,"text":"- I2: existing project authority (Goals, Product, requirements, accepted\n"},{"number":224,"text":"  design, a work item, identity or release law) holds every decision grant\n"},{"number":225,"text":"  the configuration applies;\n"},{"number":226,"text":"- I3: the actors are fallible and have finite context and attention, and a\n"},{"number":227,"text":"  constructing actor may be probabilistic.\n"},{"number":228,"text":"\n"},{"number":229,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |\n"},{"number":230,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":231,"text":"| P6 (independent), P1 (independent); F2 imported | By P6 authority exists only through an admitted grant, and F2 makes the executive configuration one lawful configuration among others, so this profile cannot hold a decision an owning clause holds: it owns only the terms and choices it adds, and where it conflicts with an owning clause, that clause controls. Empirical revision boundary\n"},{"number":301,"text":"\n"},{"number":302,"text":"Accumulated delivery practice and observed failure may inform frame\n"},{"number":303,"text":"selection, qualification and revision. That evidence does not become method\n"},{"number":304,"text":"authority, and it imports none of the originating consumer's architecture,\n"},{"number":305,"text":"names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or work stages into this\n"},{"number":306,"text":"generic profile (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":307,"text":"\n"},{"number":308,"text":"The engagement relation of this profile requires (P0, P6):\n"},{"number":309,"text":"\n"},{"number":310,"text":"- one bounded authority selects the active work and the finite frames\n"},{"number":311,"text":"  needed to evaluate it;\n"},{"number":312,"text":"- a Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops;\n"},{"number":313,"text":"- where independent assessment is required, a separately activated\n"},{"number":314,"text":"  Reviewer acquires sufficient exact live authority, subject and evidence,\n"},{"number":315,"text":"  reusing valid computed facts while supplying its own judgment;\n"},{"number":316,"text":"- an activated Reviewer returns evidence-bound severity and technical\n"},{"number":317,"text":"  implications without becoming a second implementation loop;\n"},{"number":318,"text":"- where coordination is required, the Executive assigns priority and\n"},{"number":319,"text":"  adjudicates the current Product mandate under an existing bounded grant;\n"},{"number":320,"text":"  and\n"},{"number":321,"text":"- inability to perceive a known violation is evidence of a missing,\n"},{"number":322,"text":"  misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame (RF-014).\n"},{"number":323,"text":"\n"},{"number":324,"text":"Repeated resets, long repair loops, moving review subjects, proof masking\n"},{"number":325,"text":"and duplicated authority are generic signals that a frame declaration,\n"},{"number":326,"text":"activation, capability match, basis or authority relation may be defective\n"},{"number":327,"text":"(REFERENCE_FRAME §10, missing-frame signals). They justify re-evaluation;\n"},{"number":328,"text":"they neither identify one universal architecture nor give a precedent\n"},{"number":329,"text":"semantic authority (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":330,"text":"\n"},{"number":331,"text":"Repeated Product drift is read the same way: a useful implementation,\n"},{"number":332,"text":"specialisation, scenario, dependency, installed builder or downstream\n"},{"number":333,"text":"Product does not become the Product being authored because it is visible to\n"},{"number":334,"text":"the same actor or takes part in one delivery chain (P3, P2).\n"},{"number":335,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":337,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. It\n"},{"number":403,"text":"evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound\n"},{"number":404,"text":"technical triage when a finding exists. It does not implement the repair,\n"},{"number":405,"text":"assign priority, apply disposition or activate the next frame (P6).\n"},{"number":406,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":467,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. Profile terms/Technical triage, severity, priority and boundary effect","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F5.%20Profile%20terms%2FTechnical%20triage%2C%20severity%2C%20priority%20and%20boundary%20effect","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"9c723fcf1f8e1fdd5b79551bcc3d78e3a01fb220ee95842a95f1e9300fdfb6b3","start_line":407,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":407,"text":"### Technical triage, severity, priority and boundary effect\n"},{"number":408,"text":"\n"},{"number":409,"text":"Technical triage is the Reviewer's assessment of one finding against the\n"},{"number":410,"text":"exact evaluated claim and basis. Where admissible evidence and the actor's\n"},{"number":411,"text":"capability envelope support it, the triage records (P6, P5):\n"},{"number":412,"text":"\n"},{"number":413,"text":"- the affected claim and the observed failure;\n"},{"number":414,"text":"- severity on the Product-selected severity scale;\n"},{"number":415,"text":"- causal assessment and confidence, the confidence being a quantified\n"},{"number":416,"text":"  claim under [FOUNDATIONS §4 Quantified assurance](FOUNDATIONS.md#quantified-assurance);\n"},{"number":417,"text":"- blast radius and the affected users, paths or relations;\n"},{"number":418,"text":"- an available workaround or containment;\n"},{"number":419,"text":"- repair complexity, regression risk and material dependencies; and\n"},{"number":420,"text":"- residual uncertainty and the evidence that would reduce it.\n"},{"number":421,"text":"\n"},{"number":422,"text":"Missing causal or repair evidence stays explicit. Where the missing\n"},{"number":423,"text":"relation can change the evaluation, the Reviewer returns `indeterminate` or\n"},{"number":424,"text":"`out_of_frame` pressure (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results); it does not invent precision and\n"},{"number":425,"text":"does not send work sideways to the Worker (P5).\n"},{"number":426,"text":"\n"},{"number":427,"text":"Severity grades the consequence if the finding manifests. Priority orders\n"},{"number":428,"text":"the response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and\n"},{"number":429,"text":"exposure, the current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies,\n"},{"number":430,"text":"cost of delay and available capacity. The Reviewer grades severity; the\n"},{"number":431,"text":"Executive assigns priority (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":432,"text":"\n"},{"number":433,"text":"The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis binds the severity scale,\n"},{"number":434,"text":"the priority scale and the current-boundary decision cutoff, and names\n"},{"number":435,"text":"which conditions of the governed outcome are hard stops. What a hard stop\n"},{"number":436,"text":"is, its classes, and that it holds whatever the priority, cutoff or risk\n"},{"number":437,"text":"appetite, so that no decision waives it, are\n"},{"number":438,"text":"[ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement) Hard stops,\n"},{"number":439,"text":"whose classes are typical, not closed; the basis names its own\n"},{"number":440,"text":"non-waivable hard stops, each holding as that section states. \"Non-waivable hard stop\" in this\n"},{"number":441,"text":"profile and in EVALUATION §5 means such a stop. The selected review-flow\n"},{"number":442,"text":"severity convention below does not relabel another Product's declared scale.\n"},{"number":443,"text":"Severity, priority, the frame result\n"},{"number":444,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) and the current-boundary effect are four distinct\n"},{"number":445,"text":"values. When a finding can block a promotion boundary is\n"},{"number":446,"text":"[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion),\n"},{"number":447,"text":"and none of the four values alone decides it (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":448,"text":"\n"},{"number":449,"text":"Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what\n"},{"number":450,"text":"one finding does to the current promotion boundary: it blocks it, requires\n"},{"number":451,"text":"narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision\n"},{"number":452,"text":"projection, a state this profile declares, not a result and not a\n"},{"number":453,"text":"disposition (§8): it maps to no core value of its own and decides nothing\n"},{"number":454,"text":"by itself. Where it is \"blocks\", a condition of EVALUATION §5 holds; the\n"},{"number":455,"text":"decision it records returns through the core only through the one\n"},{"number":456,"text":"existing disposition the Executive then applies (ACTIVATION §3,\n"},{"number":457,"text":"Disposition). Purpose and material relation: the record keeps the\n"},{"number":458,"text":"Executive's reading of each finding apart from severity, priority and the\n"},{"number":459,"text":"disposition, so a consumer can see why a boundary was held, narrowed or\n"},{"number":460,"text":"promoted with a residual, and no field other than the disposition decides\n"},{"number":461,"text":"acceptance (P6, P2). A hard stop or a falsified mandatory claim cannot be\n"},{"number":462,"text":"waived by lowering priority. An observation outside the exact claim\n"},{"number":463,"text":"boundary cannot open another review round because it carries a severe\n"},{"number":464,"text":"label (P6, P2). How each result member projects the triage payload and\n"},{"number":465,"text":"constrains its consumption is EVALUATION §4 (Result and triage\n"},{"number":466,"text":"projection).\n"},{"number":467,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":500,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. Profile terms/Technical triage, severity, priority and boundary effect/Selected 1–5 severity convention","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F5.%20Profile%20terms%2FTechnical%20triage%2C%20severity%2C%20priority%20and%20boundary%20effect%2FSelected%201%E2%80%935%20severity%20convention","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"7d45ff27b50162bab44886d3dfa98dd49e196bc2838f5cb8e159393f7bddc29c","start_line":468,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":468,"text":"#### Selected 1–5 severity convention\n"},{"number":469,"text":"\n"},{"number":470,"text":"The severity convention selected for this review flow is **1 highest to 5\n"},{"number":471,"text":"lowest**. The Reviewer grades the consequence of the demonstrated defect if\n"},{"number":472,"text":"it manifests, using these qualitative anchors. The Product-owned frame basis\n"},{"number":473,"text":"binds the convention and its Product-specific evidence criteria: affected\n"},{"number":474,"text":"claims, users/paths, consequence, dependencies and supported containment (P6).\n"},{"number":475,"text":"\n"},{"number":476,"text":"| Severity | Consequence anchor |\n"},{"number":477,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":478,"text":"| 1 | Critical loss of the governed outcome or of essential safety, authority or integrity across its affected scope. |\n"},{"number":479,"text":"| 2 | Major failure of essential behaviour, with substantial affected users, paths or dependencies and no adequate ordinary containment. |\n"},{"number":480,"text":"| 3 | Material but bounded failure whose disposition depends on its downstream impact and wider blast radius. |\n"},{"number":481,"text":"| 4 | Limited local failure with supported containment or a practical workaround and little effect outside that local scope. |\n"},{"number":482,"text":"| 5 | Minor actionable defect with minimal functional consequence for the declared outcome. |\n"},{"number":483,"text":"\n"},{"number":484,"text":"Severity 3 requires an explicit assessment of downstream dependencies and\n"},{"number":485,"text":"blast radius. Material impact on dependent work normally calls for repair;\n"},{"number":486,"text":"contained local impact may be deferred with a recorded reason and responsible\n"},{"number":487,"text":"owner. The Executive makes that disposition from the evidence and its grant,\n"},{"number":488,"text":"preserving the Reviewer's grade; a departure from the normal repair response\n"},{"number":489,"text":"also records its reason. Unknown dependent impact is not evidence of\n"},{"number":490,"text":"containment. Mandatory claims, hard stops and acceptance conditions still\n"},{"number":491,"text":"determine boundary effects under EVALUATION §5. Severity 3 is not priority P3,\n"},{"number":492,"text":"and no severity value automatically supplies priority, a block or permission\n"},{"number":493,"text":"to defer (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":494,"text":"\n"},{"number":495,"text":"An older or alternative Product-selected scale keeps its identity and evidence\n"},{"number":496,"text":"criteria. Selecting this convention is explicit; any translation is declared\n"},{"number":497,"text":"and justified rather than inferred from matching numbers. Historical findings\n"},{"number":498,"text":"retain the scale and grade under which they were assessed. A no-finding result\n"},{"number":499,"text":"carries no severity grade; it is not severity 5 (EVALUATION §4; P3, P6).\n"},{"number":500,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":512,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5.
