Where finding volume would overwhelm its\n"},{"number":505,"text":"bounded attention, it may activate a triage Worker to group causes, identify\n"},{"number":506,"text":"duplicates and propose priorities and responsible owners from the admitted\n"},{"number":507,"text":"findings. The assistant neither grades nor changes Reviewer severity and\n"},{"number":508,"text":"decides no priority or disposition. The Executive consumes its evidence and\n"},{"number":509,"text":"records its own decision; unsupported cause relations stay uncertain. The\n"},{"number":510,"text":"assistant adds no read authority, and this profile requires no extra actor\n"},{"number":511,"text":"for a small or clear result (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":512,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":533,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. The labels have no numeric meaning outside that adoption; the\n"},{"number":517,"text":"Product supplies its ordering/assignment criteria and any finer distinctions.\n"},{"number":518,"text":"This is priority policy, not a Reviewer severity scale (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":519,"text":"\n"},{"number":520,"text":"| Selected priority | Response and boundary effect |\n"},{"number":521,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":522,"text":"| P0–P2 | Include in the next bounded fix pass; hold the affected outcome's closure and release, not candidate landing merely because of this priority. |\n"},{"number":523,"text":"| P3–P5 | Repair before release/go-live; hold that release, while bounded work may close with the item durably retained or transferred with its disposition. |\n"},{"number":524,"text":"\n"},{"number":525,"text":"This policy never waives applicable hard stops, mandatory claims, acceptance\n"},{"number":526,"text":"conditions, access restrictions or operation grants. Those owners may require\n"},{"number":527,"text":"an earlier hold at any priority. A P3–P5 item may outlive a local work claim's\n"},{"number":528,"text":"closure only when that claim does not require the unfixed behaviour; assigning\n"},{"number":529,"text":"that priority cannot satisfy a false mandatory claim. No review-to-work ratio or additional\n"},{"number":530,"text":"capture-review landing hold is selected by adopting this example. Durable\n"},{"number":531,"text":"items and their actual verification state are owned by\n"},{"number":532,"text":"[TICKETS §4](TICKETS.md#review-findings-and-bug-items).\n"},{"number":533,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":590,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. Profile terms/Work result","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F5.%20Profile%20terms%2FWork%20result","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"f03b15a7929df30c83f1d8db5db69dbbef9f6ab678e5de4f2365fa5a39d321b5","start_line":534,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":534,"text":"### Work result\n"},{"number":535,"text":"\n"},{"number":536,"text":"A work result is the Worker's closed output to its declared consumer; in\n"},{"number":537,"text":"the coordinated branch that consumer is the Executive. It exists only after\n"},{"number":538,"text":"a successful Worker activation. An `activation_refusal`, with the cause and\n"},{"number":539,"text":"core value that\n"},{"number":540,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) gives it,\n"},{"number":541,"text":"returns to the assigning authority or declared result carrier and creates\n"},{"number":542,"text":"neither a Worker activation nor a Worker result. This applies to the\n"},{"number":543,"text":"Worker the rule that\n"},{"number":544,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3 Admission and activation](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation)\n"},{"number":545,"text":"states for every step (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":546,"text":"\n"},{"number":547,"text":"The work-result values are the five values of construction availability,\n"},{"number":548,"text":"the refinement that\n"},{"number":549,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability) defines for the\n"},{"number":550,"text":"predicate \"a candidate is available\". ACTIVATION §3 owns their grounds,\n"},{"number":551,"text":"maps each to exactly one core value, and states that the mapping is total\n"},{"number":552,"text":"and exclusive after lawful activation. In this profile they are carriers,\n"},{"number":553,"text":"not new semantic dispositions, and none of them is an assessment or an\n"},{"number":554,"text":"acceptance of the candidate (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results). The cause that\n"},{"number":555,"text":"selects each value is the ground ACTIVATION §3 states; this profile states\n"},{"number":556,"text":"no ground of its own. It binds only what the Worker reports and what its\n"},{"number":557,"text":"consumer does with each value; the core value shown with each is\n"},{"number":558,"text":"ACTIVATION §3's (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":559,"text":"\n"},{"number":560,"text":"- `candidate_ready` (`satisfied`): the consumer receives the exact\n"},{"number":561,"text":"  candidate and its transition evidence and decides whether independent\n"},{"number":562,"text":"  review is required (§12 step 4); the value is not `accept`;\n"},{"number":563,"text":"- `refused` (`falsified`): the work result names the prohibition or\n"},{"number":564,"text":"  refusal that is the value's counterexample; the Executive verifies the\n"},{"number":565,"text":"  basis and applies the existing authority relation (§12 step 4);\n"},{"number":566,"text":"- `incomplete` (`falsified`): the Worker's residuals and stop basis name\n"},{"number":567,"text":"  each evaluation it did not perform, which has no result, each it\n"},{"number":568,"text":"  performed that its evidence could not decide, which keeps its own\n"},{"number":569,"text":"  `indeterminate`, and whether bounded execution ended first. The work\n"},{"number":570,"text":"  result is never read as `indeterminate`, as ACTIVATION §3 states, and\n"},{"number":571,"text":"  the Executive reactivates work only where current authority already\n"},{"number":572,"text":"  permits it (§12 step 4);\n"},{"number":573,"text":"- `re_entry_requested(authority)` (`out_of_frame`): the Executive returns\n"},{"number":574,"text":"  the question to the decision owner the value names; and\n"},{"number":575,"text":"- `re_entry_requested(basis)` (`invalid_basis`): the Executive revalidates\n"},{"number":576,"text":"  the basis lock (§6 Drift locks) before any further activation.\n"},{"number":577,"text":"\n"},{"number":578,"text":"A capability, authority, stale-basis, ambiguous-basis or topology mismatch\n"},{"number":579,"text":"known during activation is an `activation_refusal` with its cause, never a\n"},{"number":580,"text":"synthetic Worker result (P5, P6). Consumers choose the representation;\n"},{"number":581,"text":"ACTIVATION §1 and §3 stay the owners of the execution relation, its\n"},{"number":582,"text":"results and its dispositions.\n"},{"number":583,"text":"\n"},{"number":584,"text":"The result references the current computed classification, supporting\n"},{"number":585,"text":"evidence, residual judgments and original rulings through their existing\n"},{"number":586,"text":"carriers. It does not reconstruct unchanged C/J/O at each handoff. The\n"},{"number":587,"text":"consumer checks applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence\n"},{"number":588,"text":"revises only the affected results, preserving originals and supported\n"},{"number":589,"text":"surviving claims (ACTIVATION §7; P4b).\n"},{"number":590,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":601,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/5. Where generic\n"},{"number":595,"text":"method qualification applies (EVALUATION §7), its construction result is\n"},{"number":596,"text":"frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires.\n"},{"number":597,"text":"Elsewhere this profile stabilises the review subject through an immutable\n"},{"number":598,"text":"identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed\n"},{"number":599,"text":"assessment. and\n"},{"number":627,"text":"3. authorised action selection: it assigns priority, determines the effect\n"},{"number":628,"text":"   on the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and\n"},{"number":629,"text":"   issues only the next already-authorised activation or action.\n"},{"number":630,"text":"\n"},{"number":631,"text":"The Executive does not contain the complete workspace and does not perform\n"},{"number":632,"text":"every evaluation. It acquires no Product meaning, implementation, mutation,\n"},{"number":633,"text":"acceptance, publication or other operation authority from the role. A\n"},{"number":634,"text":"material effect stays owned by the actor that carries its exact operation\n"},{"number":635,"text":"grant (P6, RF-002).\n"},{"number":636,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":653,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/6. Executive attention, evaluation and action/No mutation while Executive","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F6.%20Executive%20attention%2C%20evaluation%20and%20action%2FNo%20mutation%20while%20Executive","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"47ba49a7974c86cccad928c328b5e9d80d3c81da3e3cdc63accb183416f7404c","start_line":637,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":637,"text":"### No mutation while Executive\n"},{"number":638,"text":"\n"},{"number":639,"text":"An actor occupying the Executive frame modifies no candidate, Product or\n"},{"number":640,"text":"worktree bytes and performs no implementation effect. Filesystem or tool\n"},{"number":641,"text":"access is no exception, and neither is an edit that is small, test-only,\n"},{"number":642,"text":"reversible or apparently obvious. Mutation requires a separately activated\n"},{"number":643,"text":"Worker or Writer relation carrying the exact operation grant, subject and\n"},{"number":644,"text":"write territory. A same-actor role transition is explicit and is recorded in\n"},{"number":645,"text":"the existing work carrier before the effect; for that effect the actor is no\n"},{"number":646,"text":"longer acting as Executive. Recording or delegating after an Executive edit\n"},{"number":647,"text":"cannot authorise the edit retroactively (P6, P3). This prohibition is this\n"},{"number":648,"text":"profile's, and it applies wherever the executive configuration is selected\n"},{"number":649,"text":"([ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Example; §7);\n"},{"number":650,"text":"an operation grant covering a construction, status and checkpoint sequence\n"},{"number":651,"text":"does not lift it\n"},{"number":652,"text":"([ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)).\n"},{"number":653,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":719,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/6. Executive attention, evaluation and action/Attention cycle","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F6.%20Executive%20attention%2C%20evaluation%20and%20action%2FAttention%20cycle","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"d4dfc0d4ab3f87ad8c2d1eda77a6342a2a7674bb194bc59ec1019b7e033479c2","start_line":654,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":654,"text":"### Attention cycle\n"},{"number":655,"text":"\n"},{"number":656,"text":"`U` is the durable inventory of known material evaluations that do not have\n"},{"number":657,"text":"a closed result applicable to the current basis. `M` is the finite,\n"},{"number":658,"text":"dependency-ready part selected for the next activation. The frontier is the\n"},{"number":659,"text":"inventory's readiness relation; the closed-result ledger records the\n"},{"number":660,"text":"returned results, their predicates, subject, basis, evidence and residuals.\n"},{"number":661,"text":"An applicable stop is a stop condition admitted for this work, including an\n"},{"number":662,"text":"authority, capability or resource limit under\n"},{"number":663,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#1-the-step), Stops. A stop condition is not permission\n"},{"number":664,"text":"to discard the obligations that remain open (P0, P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":665,"text":"\n"},{"number":666,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":667,"text":"U = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis\n"},{"number":668,"text":"\n"},{"number":669,"text":"while U is non-empty:\n"},{"number":670,"text":"  if an applicable stop condition holds:\n"},{"number":671,"text":"    preserve all open obligations, results and required re-entry in the durable work carrier\n"},{"number":672,"text":"    end this attention cycle with the stop cause and its bounded result\n"},{"number":673,"text":"  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors\n"},{"number":674,"text":"  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis\n"},{"number":675,"text":"  keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results\n"},{"number":676,"text":"  when no other authorised decision is ready:\n"},{"number":677,"text":"    await decision-relevant input (event-driven attention, below)\n"},{"number":678,"text":"  record every closed result, technical triage, residual and invalidation condition\n"},{"number":679,"text":"  apply only declared conjunctions or translations\n"},{"number":680,"text":"  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate\n"},{"number":681,"text":"  withdraw affected reliance after a subject or basis change until applicability is established\n"},{"number":682,"text":"  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality\n"},{"number":683,"text":"\n"},{"number":684,"text":"end this cycle when every mandatory evaluation is closed, governing authority\n"},{"number":685,"text":"has retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim, or an\n"},{"number":686,"text":"applicable stop condition holds; retain every unresolved obligation\n"},{"number":687,"text":"```\n"},{"number":688,"text":"\n"},{"number":689,"text":"The cycle needs no scheduler and no frame engine (RF-016). `M` may hold\n"},{"number":690,"text":"parallel activations. Recursion follows declared evaluation dependencies and\n"},{"number":691,"text":"bounded refinements; it does not nest or join undifferentiated copies of\n"},{"number":692,"text":"every frame. The frontier and closed-result ledger are durable and\n"},{"number":693,"text":"reconstructable. The Executive acquires the portion material to the next\n"},{"number":694,"text":"selection or decision, with the exact owner routes and dependencies needed\n"},{"number":695,"text":"to establish its sufficiency; it need not hold the whole ledger or every\n"},{"number":696,"text":"evaluator's working context in active attention (P0, P4b, P2).\n"},{"number":697,"text":"\n"},{"number":698,"text":"Ending the cycle establishes neither Product success nor acceptance. A\n"},{"number":699,"text":"closed evaluation may be `falsified`; an applicable stop may leave required\n"},{"number":700,"text":"evaluations without results. The return distinguishes closed results,\n"},{"number":701,"text":"unperformed evaluations, retained residuals and the stop cause. Outcome\n"},{"number":702,"text":"satisfaction still requires its own evidence and the applicable closure and\n"},{"number":703,"text":"acceptance conditions. Changed subjects or bases preserve the historical\n"},{"number":704,"text":"result while current reliance follows\n"},{"number":705,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse)\n"},{"number":706,"text":"and [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse) (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":707,"text":"\n"},{"number":708,"text":"Severity supplied by the Reviewer is evaluation evidence. Priority,\n"},{"number":709,"text":"current-boundary effect, disposition and the next action are Executive\n"},{"number":710,"text":"decisions. They stay distinct ledger entries even where a Product-defined\n"},{"number":711,"text":"policy maps one to another (P6, RF-007).\n"},{"number":712,"text":"\n"},{"number":713,"text":"Every result returns to the Executive, to a declared conjunction or to\n"},{"number":714,"text":"another frame through an explicit declared relation. That none of them\n"},{"number":715,"text":"activates another frame or authorises continuation by itself is\n"},{"number":716,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Admission](ACTIVATION.md#admission), applied here. A consumer receives the\n"},{"number":717,"text":"closed result and its source routes, not the child's hidden reasoning\n"},{"number":718,"text":"context (P6, P4a; ACTIVATION §7).\n"},{"number":719,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":752,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/6. Executive attention, evaluation and action/Event-driven attention","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F6.%20Executive%20attention%2C%20evaluation%20and%20action%2FEvent-driven%20attention","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"3ba197cfea3fa836639937902de8cffcf8df01b120a87eaa723c196c0c716470","start_line":720,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":720,"text":"### Event-driven attention\n"},{"number":721,"text":"\n"},{"number":722,"text":"Executive attention is event-driven by default. The Executive re-enters the\n"},{"number":723,"text":"attention cycle for a decision-relevant closed result, a material exception\n"},{"number":724,"text":"or changed basis, an owner request, or a declared deadline or checkpoint.\n"},{"number":725,"text":"While Workers carry out their bounded grants and no other authorised\n"},{"number":726,"text":"decision is ready, it waits. It does not repeatedly inspect unfinished work,\n"},{"number":727,"text":"replay unchanged judgments or request status without a decision need (P0,\n"},{"number":728,"text":"P2).\n"},{"number":729,"text":"\n"},{"number":730,"text":"It keeps the frontier, the return conditions and the valid evidence and\n"},{"number":731,"text":"judgments. It refreshes affected support when a material observation\n"},{"number":732,"text":"changes its basis, and revalidates the drift locks (below) before activation\n"},{"number":733,"text":"and before disposition. Waiting waives no current-workspace verification,\n"},{"number":734,"text":"evidence validity, required independent assessment, closed-result\n"},{"number":735,"text":"consumption, or authority or closure duty (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":736,"text":"\n"},{"number":737,"text":"Where notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision\n"},{"number":738,"text":"obligation requires observation, the Executive uses bounded fallback\n"},{"number":739,"text":"observation with a declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target,\n"},{"number":740,"text":"and stop or escalation condition. Silence proves neither progress nor\n"},{"number":741,"text":"failure. A genuine blocker or material risk is investigated, with\n"},{"number":742,"text":"intervention where required, within existing grants; unknown status alone\n"},{"number":743,"text":"does not establish a stalled Worker (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":744,"text":"\n"},{"number":745,"text":"Repeated no-progress observations, or returns with no new decision-relevant\n"},{"number":746,"text":"evidence, require a bounded reassessment of the frame, grant, dependency or\n"},{"number":747,"text":"evidence gap and a decision under existing authority. The Executive does not\n"},{"number":748,"text":"keep polling or repeat the same repair on an unchanged basis (ACTIVATION §3,\n"},{"number":749,"text":"Disposition). Reduced reasoning churn is not a lower-assurance path and is\n"},{"number":750,"text":"no permission to reduce required actor capability; it introduces no\n"},{"number":751,"text":"universal cost, budget or accounting gate (P2, P0; ACTIVATION §6).\n"},{"number":752,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":781,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/6. Drift locks\n"},{"number":754,"text":"\n"},{"number":755,"text":"Before activation and before disposition, the Executive revalidates five\n"},{"number":756,"text":"locks (P3, P6, P2):\n"},{"number":757,"text":"\n"},{"number":758,"text":"| Lock | Holds when |\n"},{"number":759,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":760,"text":"| outcome lock | the selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary and lawful re-entry class, the current MVP or release mandate, and the triage policy are unchanged |\n"},{"number":761,"text":"| basis lock | the subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates are exact and current |\n"},{"number":762,"text":"| Product-role lock | the mutable Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product identities stay distinct, and every Development Product role stays bound to its exact underlying Install |\n"},{"number":763,"text":"| authority lock | the semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication owners and grants are unchanged |\n"},{"number":764,"text":"| coverage-and-return lock | every material evaluation and interaction is closed or an explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared return relation |\n"},{"number":765,"text":"\n"},{"number":766,"text":"A failed lock takes the value or move its owner gives the case; this\n"},{"number":767,"text":"profile adds none (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":768,"text":"\n"},{"number":769,"text":"| Failed lock | Value or move, and its owner |\n"},{"number":770,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":771,"text":"| changed Product meaning (outcome lock) | `re_enter` to the owning relation ([ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition)) |\n"},{"number":772,"text":"| stale or substituted basis, before activation (basis lock) | the activation refuses: `activation_refusal(basis)`, `invalid_basis` ([REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions)) |\n"},{"number":773,"text":"| stale or substituted basis of an evaluation performed on it | that evaluation's own result is `invalid_basis`, or it is reactivated on the current basis ([RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)) |\n"},{"number":774,"text":"| stale basis of a held result, before disposition | for the disposition's conjunction the component has no applicable closed result: a gap, never relabelled `invalid_basis` and never counted as returned ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results), Stale results) |\n"},{"number":775,"text":"| missing material scope | `out_of_frame`: at activation, as [ACTIVATION §3 Admission and activation](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation) states; for an evaluation, on the ground [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) gives, an undeclared material relation or capability |\n"},{"number":776,"text":"| missing operation authority (authority lock) | the activation refuses, `activation_refusal(authority)` (REFERENCE_FRAME §5), or the effect is refused |\n"},{"number":777,"text":"| an unresolved mandatory conflict (coverage-and-return lock) | the conjunction is not `satisfied`; the conflict survives every join (FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results, Survival) |\n"},{"number":778,"text":"\n"},{"number":779,"text":"The Executive repairs none of these by making its own frame larger (P5,\n"},{"number":780,"text":"P6).\n"},{"number":781,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":817,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/6. A cycle in Product\n"},{"number":788,"text":"relations is not itself a work deadlock, and naming a lead supplies no missing\n"},{"number":789,"text":"current prerequisite. An enclosing Product is not required for a constituent's\n"},{"number":790,"text":"scoped standalone entry when its declared dependencies suffice (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":791,"text":"\n"},{"number":792,"text":"A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of\n"},{"number":793,"text":"Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source\n"},{"number":794,"text":"Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release\n"},{"number":795,"text":"Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and\n"},{"number":796,"text":"composition edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying\n"},{"number":797,"text":"Install identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, its governing\n"},{"number":798,"text":"authority and contracts, its lifecycle, its evidence boundary, its refusal\n"},{"number":799,"text":"and its invalidation (P3, P6; the Product-role\n"},{"number":800,"text":"map in the basis is PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7, the lineage objects FOUNDATIONS\n"},{"number":801,"text":"§2).\n"},{"number":802,"text":"\n"},{"number":803,"text":"An installed Product may lawfully build its own successor or another\n"},{"number":804,"text":"Product. That Development Product stays distinct from the mutable Source\n"},{"number":805,"text":"Project and from the Product being authored. Directory nesting, shared code,\n"},{"number":806,"text":"shared actors, source imports, tool reachability, matching labels or equal\n"},{"number":807,"text":"outputs create no Product identity, composition edge or authority transfer\n"},{"number":808,"text":"(P3, P1).\n"},{"number":809,"text":"\n"},{"number":810,"text":"Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may\n"},{"number":811,"text":"cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by\n"},{"number":812,"text":"its operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint\n"},{"number":813,"text":"produced from that workspace. A repair advances the workspace, creates a new\n"},{"number":814,"text":"candidate and invalidates the affected results. A released Product, Release\n"},{"number":815,"text":"Cut or exact Install stays immutable under its own lifecycle law and imposes\n"},{"number":816,"text":"no immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor (P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":817,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":858,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/7. Non-hierarchical frame configuration\n"},{"number":819,"text":"\n"},{"number":820,"text":"[RF-009](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-009-no-assumed-hierarchy) owns the list of\n"},{"number":821,"text":"distinct relation structures and the rule that they may be aligned where\n"},{"number":822,"text":"the subject warrants it but are never one hierarchy. This configuration\n"},{"number":823,"text":"uses three of them, under its own names (P6, RF-009):\n"},{"number":824,"text":"\n"},{"number":825,"text":"1. authority precedence, RF-009's structure of that name, decides which\n"},{"number":826,"text":"   existing surface may select work, admit a frame configuration, dispose\n"},{"number":827,"text":"   a result or require re-entry;\n"},{"number":828,"text":"2. temporal and evidence flow, RF-009's communication, carries activation\n"},{"number":829,"text":"   packets and closed results; and\n"},{"number":830,"text":"3. frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation\n"},{"number":831,"text":"   or composition among the evaluations actually used (REFERENCE_FRAME §7),\n"},{"number":832,"text":"   while evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence stay\n"},{"number":833,"text":"   separate activation relations.\n"},{"number":834,"text":"\n"},{"number":835,"text":"The other structures RF-009 lists stay distinct as it states; this\n"},{"number":836,"text":"section adds none and merges none.\n"},{"number":837,"text":"\n"},{"number":838,"text":"Executive, Worker and Reviewer commonly overlap on the selected method\n"},{"number":839,"text":"basis, the governed outcome, the workspace checkpoint, the affected relation\n"},{"number":840,"text":"set, the candidate, the evidence and the residuals. The overlap collapses\n"},{"number":841,"text":"neither evaluation nor authority (P1, P6, RF-008): the Executive evaluates\n"},{"number":842,"text":"activation, priority, boundary effect and disposition; the Worker evaluates\n"},{"number":843,"text":"and performs bounded construction; the Reviewer evaluates the exact\n"},{"number":844,"text":"candidate claim and supplies technical triage where assessment is activated.\n"},{"number":845,"text":"\n"},{"number":846,"text":"The active evaluation may be represented as (P0, P4a):\n"},{"number":847,"text":"\n"},{"number":848,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":849,"text":"engagement frame\n"},{"number":850,"text":"  + material specialist frame set\n"},{"number":851,"text":"  + exact subject and basis\n"},{"number":852,"text":"  + capable actor\n"},{"number":853,"text":"  -> one activated evaluation\n"},{"number":854,"text":"```\n"},{"number":855,"text":"\n"},{"number":856,"text":"The notation needs no Cartesian-product schema and no universal frame\n"},{"number":857,"text":"runtime (P2, RF-016).\n"},{"number":858,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":938,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/7. Non-hierarchical frame configuration/The executive configuration","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F7.%20Non-hierarchical%20frame%20configuration%2FThe%20executive%20configuration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"752f60a04f11b6f44e0095fe0835af3a1c32577b174cd98a39d475b2abe6f59d","start_line":859,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":859,"text":"### The executive configuration\n"},{"number":860,"text":"\n"},{"number":861,"text":"The executive configuration is the configuration this profile describes,\n"},{"number":862,"text":"in the sense of [ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration).\n"},{"number":863,"text":"It allocates construction to the Worker frame, specialised as Writer for\n"},{"number":864,"text":"documents and records; assessment, where it is required, to the Reviewer\n"},{"number":865,"text":"frame; and coordination across tasks to the Executive frame, which disposes\n"},{"number":866,"text":"within the decision grant existing authority admits (§5, §8 to §10). It is\n"},{"number":867,"text":"one configuration, selected where it fits the task, not an inventory of\n"},{"number":868,"text":"roles that all work needs. Existing authority selects it or another\n"},{"number":869,"text":"configuration under §16, and a configuration with other frames, names or\n"},{"number":870,"text":"topology is evaluated against its own task as ACTIVATION §1 Configuration\n"},{"number":871,"text":"states, not by its distance from this one (P0, P2, P6).\n"},{"number":872,"text":"\n"},{"number":873,"text":"Where it is selected, every grant, duty, limit and prohibition this\n"},{"number":874,"text":"profile places on its frames is in force without exception: the\n"},{"number":875,"text":"Executive's prohibition on mutation (§6 No mutation while Executive), its\n"},{"number":876,"text":"duties under §6 The three duties, Attention cycle, Event-driven attention\n"},{"number":877,"text":"and Drift locks, and the exclusions of the Worker and Reviewer frames (§9,\n"},{"number":878,"text":"§10) among them.\n"},{"number":879,"text":"Selecting the configuration makes none of them optional, and no operation\n"},{"number":880,"text":"grant lifts them (P6).\n"},{"number":881,"text":"\n"},{"number":882,"text":"Explanation of the allocation. ACTIVATION §1 Configuration requires the\n"},{"number":883,"text":"design that selects a configuration to explain its allocation; for this\n"},{"number":884,"text":"configuration the explanation is (P0, P5, P6):\n"},{"number":885,"text":"\n"},{"number":886,"text":"- fit: task-based work in which carrying out a bounded change and managing\n"},{"number":887,"text":"  delivery across successive tasks need separate attention; where one\n"},{"number":888,"text":"  sufficient frame covers the task, direct entry applies instead (§3);\n"},{"number":889,"text":"- resource limits assumed: every actor has a finite context and attention\n"},{"number":890,"text":"  envelope, so no frame holds the whole workspace. The Worker's context\n"},{"number":891,"text":"  holds one causal cone (§9), the Reviewer's one exact claim with its\n"},{"number":892,"text":"  evidence (§10), and the Executive's the outcome, the frontier and the\n"},{"number":893,"text":"  closed-result ledger (§6), never the working context of an evaluator.\n"},{"number":894,"text":"  The adopting Product's basis records the concrete capability envelopes\n"},{"number":895,"text":"  (§16 Adopt this baseline); time, spend and other resource limits are\n"},{"number":896,"text":"  declared, measured and honoured as\n"},{"number":897,"text":"  [ACTIVATION §6 Resource limits](ACTIVATION.md#resource-limits) states,\n"},{"number":898,"text":"  with the values the selected execution binding sets;\n"},{"number":899,"text":"- failure assumptions: a constructor can be wrong about its own candidate,\n"},{"number":900,"text":"  so its self-review is construction output and required assessment is\n"},{"number":901,"text":"  independent (EVALUATION §3); a coordinator that also changed the subject\n"},{"number":902,"text":"  would decide on its own effects, so the Executive makes none (§6); a\n"},{"number":903,"text":"  result can become stale or bound to another subject, so the Executive\n"},{"number":904,"text":"  revalidates the drift locks before activation and disposition (§6); an\n"},{"number":905,"text":"  activation can fail, so a refused activation returns with its cause and\n"},{"number":906,"text":"  no Worker result (§5 Work result); an effectful activation can stop\n"},{"number":907,"text":"  with an effect whose completion is unknown, as where a response was\n"},{"number":908,"text":"  lost, so the work result names each intended effect with its\n"},{"number":909,"text":"  [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects) value, and an effect of\n"},{"number":910,"text":"  uncertain completion is reconciled under\n"},{"number":911,"text":"  [ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart), sufficiently\n"},{"number":912,"text":"  for the next dependent action, before work is reactivated or that\n"},{"number":913,"text":"  action is taken (§12 step 4, §13); and a\n"},{"number":914,"text":"  bounded view can lack what a task frame knows, so results carry every\n"},{"number":915,"text":"  blocker material to delivery (next paragraph).\n"},{"number":916,"text":"\n"},{"number":917,"text":"Coordination. The Executive is this configuration's coordinator, and\n"},{"number":918,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Coordination\n"},{"number":919,"text":"across tasks, owns the rule for a coordinator's bounded view. Here that\n"},{"number":920,"text":"view is the closed-result ledger (§6 Attention cycle) with the\n"},{"number":921,"text":"work-result, review-result and specialist-result projections of §13. The\n"},{"number":922,"text":"Executive acquires what a decision needs beyond that view through its\n"},{"number":923,"text":"frame inputs (§8) or by activating a further bounded evaluation (§6). A\n"},{"number":924,"text":"compact result carries every blocker material to delivery, as that rule\n"},{"number":925,"text":"requires, in the residuals, stop basis and effect values of a work\n"},{"number":926,"text":"result, the findings, counterexamples and residuals of a review result,\n"},{"number":927,"text":"and the residuals of a specialist result (P0, P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":928,"text":"\n"},{"number":929,"text":"Purpose and material relation:\n"},{"number":930,"text":"ACTIVATION §1 makes the executive configuration one example among lawful\n"},{"number":931,"text":"configurations and leaves its frames, prohibitions and explanation to this\n"},{"number":932,"text":"profile. Without the explanation the allocation could be applied where it\n"},{"number":933,"text":"does not fit or read as the method's default; without the statement that\n"},{"number":934,"text":"its prohibitions hold wherever it is selected, selection could be read as\n"},{"number":935,"text":"relaxing them. The material relation is whether a task receives this\n"},{"number":936,"text":"allocation only where it fits, and whether its prohibitions and its\n"},{"number":937,"text":"reporting of blockers hold wherever it is used.\n"},{"number":938,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":966,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/8. Derived Executive frame","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#EXECUTIVE_BASELINE%2F8.%20Derived%20Executive%20frame","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","sha256":"1c7d012a0f2233494bd471f975905c2e5ebcf978550ae8a013adbe36b308aedc","start_line":939,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md","lines":[{"number":939,"text":"## 8. Derived Executive frame\n"},{"number":940,"text":"\n"},{"number":941,"text":"The Executive frame, in the shape of a frame declaration (REFERENCE_FRAME\n"},{"number":942,"text":"§13; P6, P0):\n"},{"number":943,"text":"\n"},{"number":944,"text":"| Frame element | Executive |\n"},{"number":945,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":946,"text":"| evaluation family | Is the bounded outcome and execution basis authorised? Which frames and actors are capable? Is a returned result exact and current? Which priority, current-boundary effect, disposition and next action follow from the current Product mandate? |\n"},{"number":947,"text":"| subject and basis | the complete selected method cut; the exact Goals, Product, requirements, design and work authority; the current MVP or release mandate; the current workspace and checkpoint; open findings and their technical triage; the Product-selected triage policy; the proxy grant where one is used |\n"},{"number":948,"text":"| material manifold | outcome, mandate, affected causal cone, evaluation inventory, frame configuration, actor envelopes, evidence obligations, returned results and technical triage, priority, boundary effect, re-entry owners and the boundary of already-authorised continuation |\n"},{"number":949,"text":"| coordinates | exact method, project, outcome, mandate, authority, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, triage-policy and actor identities |\n"},{"number":950,"text":"| governing invariants | RF-001 to RF-017 (REFERENCE_FRAME §3); the execution relation and intake of ACTIVATION §1 with the design profile's bounded-frame conservation laws; applicable identity, carrier, assurance and release law |\n"},{"number":951,"text":"| authority | the existing Product or work frame-set and decision authority, or its admitted bounded proxy; no operation or other authority arises from the label |\n"},{"number":952,"text":"| evidence | live authority surfaces, frame results, Reviewer technical triage, exact candidate identity, transition evidence, coverage residuals and specialist results |\n"},{"number":953,"text":"| capability envelope | enough method, Product, release or MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor-selection competence to configure, prioritise and dispose the bounded evaluation; implementation expertise may be delegated to specialist frames |\n"},{"number":954,"text":"| exclusions | candidate, Product or worktree byte mutation and implementation effects while occupying the frame; implementation ownership; silently rewriting Reviewer evidence or severity; claiming independent review without a qualifying activation; semantic reconstruction owned elsewhere; disposition outside the admitted grant |\n"},{"number":955,"text":"| result | one core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results), the assigned priority and current-boundary effect, and one existing disposition (ACTIVATION §3 Disposition) where the basis is decidable |\n"},{"number":956,"text":"| invalidation | a material change of method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology |\n"},{"number":957,"text":"\n"},{"number":958,"text":"The frame adds no `authorize` or `no_action` disposition. Activation is the\n"},{"number":959,"text":"`activate` function of REFERENCE_FRAME §5; candidate disposition stays\n"},{"number":960,"text":"exactly `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter` or `reject` (ACTIVATION §3,\n"},{"number":961,"text":"Disposition). Priority and current-boundary effect are decision\n"},{"number":962,"text":"projections, neither core results nor dispositions. If the Executive cannot\n"},{"number":963,"text":"rely on a supplied severity or technical assessment, it reactivates a\n"},{"number":964,"text":"capable evaluation or keeps the uncertainty; it never silently rewrites the\n"},{"number":965,"text":"Reviewer result (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":966,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1005,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/8. The path is established early and widened in\n"},{"number":972,"text":"bounded increments; where it already exists, the affected thread is extended\n"},{"number":973,"text":"or revalidated. Increments are chosen for consequential uncertainty,\n"},{"number":974,"text":"dependency and interface reach, and failure impact (P2; the generic sequencing heuristic is SPEC_METHOD §8).\n"},{"number":975,"text":"The steel thread is this profile's selected strategy under the\n"},{"number":976,"text":"construction relation ([ACTIVATION §1 Strategy](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation)):\n"},{"number":977,"text":"its rationale is early feedback on the end-to-end composition at the cost\n"},{"number":978,"text":"of later widening; other strategies remain lawful for other\n"},{"number":979,"text":"configurations; no superiority over them is claimed, and the rationale\n"},{"number":980,"text":"states the objective the selection serves and its cost (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":981,"text":"\n"},{"number":982,"text":"Early end-to-end and integration evidence prunes incompatible construction\n"},{"number":983,"text":"choices before they spread; it settles the exercised interfaces, keeps\n"},{"number":984,"text":"working composition, and concentrates construction on unresolved\n"},{"number":985,"text":"obligations. Each passing thread establishes only the relations and\n"},{"number":986,"text":"conditions actually exercised; untested branches, interaction combinations,\n"},{"number":987,"text":"and refusal and recovery paths keep their material proof obligations.\n"},{"number":988,"text":"Settled construction decisions are revisited when material counterevidence\n"},{"number":989,"text":"invalidates their basis (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":990,"text":"\n"},{"number":991,"text":"During construction, focused deterministic regression and targeted\n"},{"number":992,"text":"judgment probes resolve material uncertainty, and unit evidence covers\n"},{"number":993,"text":"module-owned laws under the testing frames (ASSURANCE §7). Substantial,\n"},{"number":994,"text":"resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles are scheduled near release or\n"},{"number":995,"text":"when a bounded capability is complete enough to qualify; an early focused\n"},{"number":996,"text":"user probe stays appropriate where it decides a material outcome\n"},{"number":997,"text":"uncertainty (P2, ACTIVATION §7 proof cadence).\n"},{"number":998,"text":"\n"},{"number":999,"text":"The product testing frames keep their distinct claims and govern the\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"necessary scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Qualified\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"results are reused while their exact subject and basis stay valid; affected\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"assurance is rerun when a material change invalidates it. The Executive\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"selects this sequence under the existing mandate and activates construction\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"only through the existing operation grants (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1040,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/9. Derived Worker frame\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"(P6, P0)\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"| Frame element | Worker |\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"| evaluation family | Can the exact authorised outcome be constructed through the smallest coherent causal cone while preserving every affected governing relation and disposing of competing paths? |\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"| subject and basis | the sufficient execution intake of ACTIVATION §1, with the accepted design-to-execution basis of the design profile where it applies |\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"| material manifold | affected entities, lifecycles, transformations, authorities, capabilities, algorithms, inputs, outputs, dependencies, interaction seams, failure boundaries and proof obligations |\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"| coordinates | exact activation, source checkpoint, workspace, inputs, dependencies, configuration, actor envelope, outputs, candidate and evidence identities |\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"| governing invariants | the complete selected method and project relations material to the affected cone; ACTIVATION §1 owns construction and self-review |\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"| authority | inherited bounded construction or transformation authority and self-review only; mutation only where the exact inherited owner grant names the subject and write territory; no admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision or inferred next action |\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"| evidence | live implementation, tests and test source, analysis, generated artifacts, installed or operational behaviour where claimed, reconstruction, mutations and exact transition evidence |\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"| capability envelope | the declared method, domain, implementation, tool, access and finite-context competence the causal cone requires |\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"| exclusions | upstream semantic change, unauthorised cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing paths, and advancing after returning the work result |\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"| result | exactly one work-result value, which carries the one core value ACTIVATION §3 maps it to for \"a candidate is available\" (§5 Work result); It is not `accept`. Green tests are evidence only for the\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"relations their production and test semantics actually exercise (P6;\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"EVALUATION §1).\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"The Worker label grants no mutation authority. An effectful Worker may\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"mutate only the exact subject and write territory named by its inherited\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"construction or transformation grant; missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"mutation authority refuses the effect (P6).\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"Read scope follows the complete causal cone and may exceed write territory\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"within the declared access grant. A narrow mutation grant does not justify\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"omitting a material producer, consumer or governing owner from inspection.\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"A repair needed outside the territory is returned to its owner;\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"understanding a relation grants no cross-boundary effect (P0, P6;\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"ACTIVATION §1, Execution unit).\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1093,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/10. Derived Reviewer frame\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"(P6, P5)\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"| Frame element | Reviewer |\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"| evaluation family | Is this the exact claimed subject and basis? Does it satisfy the applicable method and project relations without competing authority, proof masking or an unevaluated composition boundary? For each finding, which evidence-bound severity and technical implications follow? |\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"| subject and basis | exact candidate, claim, governing method and project authority, scope, exclusions, evidence population, Product-selected severity scale, review carrier and declared independence conditions |\n"},{"number":1049,"text":"| material manifold | claimed relations; causal producers and consumers; authority seams; competing paths; failure, recovery, installed and reconstruction surfaces where claimed; test and fixture semantics; historical counterexamples; a finding's cause, blast radius, workaround, repair complexity, regression risk and uncertainty where supportable |\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"| coordinates | exact candidate, source basis, authority revision, configuration, dependency, evidence population, severity scale, installed subject, review time and Reviewer identity |\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"| governing invariants | RF-001 to RF-017; the execution relation (ACTIVATION §1 and §3); independence and traceability (EVALUATION §3); assurance boundary and qualification freeze (EVALUATION §1, §3 and §7); applicable Product, design, identity and release law |\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"| authority | bounded evaluation only; review access yields no construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next-activation authority |\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"| evidence | independently acquired live authority, candidate implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operational evidence, mutations, replay or reconstruction, and reproduced observations material to the claim and the technical triage |\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"| capability envelope | declared method, domain, implementation, assurance, technical-triage, tool, access, context, counterexample-search and independence competence |\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"| exclusions | editing the candidate, implementing a repair, assigning priority, disposing the release or MVP boundary, selecting the next action, substituting the Worker's summary, assurance-owned semantic reconstruction, flattening unbound evidence, silent scope expansion |\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"| result | one core result with findings, counterexamples, evidence-bound technical triage and residuals sufficient for the Executive to assign priority and apply the existing disposition where the basis is decidable |\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"| invalidation | a material change of candidate, authority, basis, evidence population, severity scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence |\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"When independent review is required, and what makes a claimed review\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"traceable, are\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"[TICKETS UP-007](TICKETS.md#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-up-007),\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"with the further boundaries a governing basis adds; what counts as\n"},{"number":1063,"text":"independent is [EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment);\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"EVALUATION §1, §3 and §7 decide the exact assurance boundary and the\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"qualification freeze. This profile adds no universal review round and no\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"new independence test (P6).\n"},{"number":1067,"text":"\n"},{"number":1068,"text":"ACTIVATION §1 and §3 stay the owners of assessment and disposition. This\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"profile uses an activated Reviewer result as independent live-surface\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"evaluation input and, in the coordinated branch, the Executive as the\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"authorised assessor or proxy that applies the one existing disposition. It\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"creates no second verdict or disposition family (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"\n"},{"number":1074,"text":"The Reviewer may assess likely repair complexity and regression risk\n"},{"number":1075,"text":"without becoming the repair owner. Where cause, blast radius, workaround or\n"},{"number":1076,"text":"repair risk cannot be supported inside the activation, the result records\n"},{"number":1077,"text":"that uncertainty instead of manufacturing a complete triage (P5).\n"},{"number":1078,"text":"\n"},{"number":1079,"text":"Tests are inside the Reviewer's manifold when their code, fixtures,\n"},{"number":1080,"text":"mutations, environment or interpretation can change the proof claim; a\n"},{"number":1081,"text":"passing result is not relied on in place of reviewing those semantics (P6,\n"},{"number":1082,"text":"EVALUATION §1).\n"},{"number":1083,"text":"\n"},{"number":1084,"text":"Each finding binds a violated property, a supported entry or state, the\n"},{"number":1085,"text":"governing operating or threat model and a credible causal path. The same\n"},{"number":1086,"text":"conditions apply to retained guards and acceptance predicates as to new\n"},{"number":1087,"text":"findings. An excluded threat alone gives no retention claim; a proposed\n"},{"number":1088,"text":"wider threat model re-enters its owner. Internal location alone does not\n"},{"number":1089,"text":"establish trust, and hypothetical hostility alone does not establish\n"},{"number":1090,"text":"applicability. The actual untrusted-input, mutable-state, authority and\n"},{"number":1091,"text":"effect checks the supported model requires are retained. A suggested repair\n"},{"number":1092,"text":"becomes an obligation only through its proper owner (P6, P2, P5).\n"},{"number":1093,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1132,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/11. Derived generic specialist frame set\n"},{"number":1095,"text":"\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"The profile declares the following generic families for Product work. Each\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration\n"},{"number":1098,"text":"(REFERENCE_FRAME §13). An adopting project binds, for every activated\n"},{"number":1099,"text":"instance, the exact subject, basis, material manifold, coordinates,\n"},{"number":1100,"text":"invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability\n"},{"number":1101,"text":"envelope, dependencies and invalidation conditions (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"The family labels resolve inside\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"`urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation`, owned by\n"},{"number":1105,"text":"REFERENCE_FRAME, under the selected basis. Under bounded-context semantic\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"resolution (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5), `Product`, `Owner`, `Entity`,\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"`Operator`, `Install` and the other labels do not become equal to\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"same-spelled Product, authority, domain or runtime concepts; every material\n"},{"number":1109,"text":"cross-context seam needs an explicit relation (P1, P3).\n"},{"number":1110,"text":"\n"},{"number":1111,"text":"| Family | Evaluation family and exact subject | Governing authority and permitted output | Immediate falsifier |\n"},{"number":1112,"text":"|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1113,"text":"| Product | Does one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle govern the claimed Product subject without downstream reinterpretation? The basis is the current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and exact Product coordinates. | Product and requirement authority keep meaning and acceptance. The frame returns only a bounded evaluation result and evidence. | Design, code, tests, a predecessor's behaviour or a local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another Product subject. |\n"},{"number":1114,"text":"| Product Composition | Does one exact directed relation between Products preserve the source and target roles, the Product Definition, Release Cut, Product and Install identities, each Development Product role binding, the governing contracts, authority, lifecycle, evidence boundary and invalidation law? A chain is evaluated through bounded edge activations and a declared conjunction. | Each Product keeps its own meaning. The authority and contracts the composition relation cites own the edge. The frame returns evaluation evidence only. | Directory nesting, shared implementation, a common actor, a source import, tool reachability, matching output or builder convenience creates or changes a composition relation; a Development Product is confused with the Product being authored; or one node silently redefines another. |\n"},{"number":1115,"text":"| Design | Does the accepted structural HOW satisfy the material constitutional WHAT, close the required design relations and keep their owners across the affected topology? | Accepted design under its governing Product and requirements owns structural decisions. The frame may identify satisfaction, contradiction or a design re-entry gap; it cannot invent Product truth. | Implementation precedent resolves an open material design decision, design creates Product meaning, or a material relation or competing structure stays undeclared. |\n"},{"number":1116,"text":"| Design Component | Does one bounded design component, with its direct causal dependency cone, preserve its parent contract, internal relations, sibling seams and required outputs? | The accepted design boundary owns only its bounded composition decision. Parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners keep their relations. | The component omits a material far-side seam, absorbs a sibling or parent decision, or reports local closure while its direct composition is unresolved. |\n"},{"number":1117,"text":"| Public Boundary | Does one supported public entry or exit perform exactly its assigned validation, selection, transport, refusal and projection relations while preserving the selected interior owners? | Product, interface, identity, security and accepted-design authority define the boundary. The frame evaluates the boundary result or refusal and returns only its closed evaluation; it does not recreate interior semantics. | The public surface interprets owner meaning, sequences hidden domain decisions, exposes an interior carrier as Product truth, or admits an unsupported path. |\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"| Entity | Is one semantic, artifact or runtime entity bound to its exact identity, kind, lifecycle, owner, representation and applicable effect regime? | Product, domain, identity, requirement and accepted-design authority define the entity. The frame returns an identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation. | A filename, wrapper, ticket, object shape, cache or process instance stands in for stable entity identity, or distinct lifecycle coordinates are collapsed. |\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"| Operator | Is one material operation an irreducible declared relation over its admitted domain, inputs, outputs, refusals, algebra, effects and lawful compositions? | Product, requirements, the accepted ontology and design, and the named operation owner define the relation. The frame evaluates it without creating another executable plan. | An endpoint, function, class, command or file label is asserted to be the semantic atom; orchestration hides the real operator; or generic mechanics are rebuilt as domain law. |\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"| Owner | Does one semantic or authority-bearing relation preserve its owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle, refusal invariants and permitted delegation? | The existing Product, requirement, identity, accepted-design, release or other named authority owns the relation. The frame may evaluate authority congruence only. | Another surface recreates the judgment, source authorship is treated as authority transfer, or a proxy, foundation, frame or actor widens the grant. |\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"| Effect | Does one action obey its declared pure, observational, artifact or runtime effect regime, including commit, failure, retry, recovery, compensation, admission and projection law where material? | The applicable Product, requirement, design, artifact, runtime and admission owners keep their decisions. The frame returns an effect-bound result and evidence. | Distinct effect regimes are collapsed, a mutation bypasses its admitted owner, compensation is treated as semantic rollback, or a read becomes rival writable truth. |\n"},{"number":1122,"text":"| Reuse/Foundation | Has one material generic capability or dependency been normalised and compared against credible lawful foundations, with any irreducible local remainder and authority-bearing role preserved? | The design profile's capability-and-foundation selection law and the existing trade-off owner govern selection. The frame cannot move semantic authority to a foundation. | Incumbent or local code wins without a bounded comparison, a richer lawful foundation is reproduced, unknowns are scored favourably, or reuse acquires owner authority. |\n"},{"number":1123,"text":"| Install | Is the exact selected Product, release, artifact, dependency set, configuration and callable entry resolved and exercised through its admitted installed coordinate, independently of mutable source convenience? | Product, identity, release, dependency, packaging and accepted-design authority define the installed subject. The frame returns installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence. | Source-tree imports, ambient resolution, process registries, fixture bindings, rebuilt artifacts or a moving workspace stand in for the claimed installed subject. |\n"},{"number":1124,"text":"| Proof | Does one exact claim have a congruent subject, basis, path, population, oracle, evidence, falsifier, residual boundary and invalidation law? | The claim owner defines meaning; the applicable testing, assurance, review, Product and release owners define evaluation and acceptance. The frame returns evidence and a closed evaluation result, not Product meaning or disposition. | A harness recreates owner meaning, evidence targets another subject or path, a count or aggregate green stands in for the claim, or proof tooling mutates the subject undetectably. |\n"},{"number":1125,"text":"\n"},{"number":1126,"text":"The families are non-hierarchical and may overlap (RF-008, RF-009).\n"},{"number":1127,"text":"Product does not outrank Design by frame topology; Product authority\n"},{"number":1128,"text":"already governs constitutional meaning. Owner gains no authority over\n"},{"number":1129,"text":"Entity or Operator by being a broader frame. Proof does not become Reviewer,\n"},{"number":1130,"text":"acceptance or disposition authority. The existing authority graph stays in\n"},{"number":1131,"text":"control (P6).\n"},{"number":1132,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1149,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/11. Conversely, adopting this profile\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"does not require a project to create twelve components or to activate\n"},{"number":1148,"text":"twelve frames for every task (P2, P1).\n"},{"number":1149,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1192,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/11. Refinement opens only for a material\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. Executive disposes and checkpoints\n"},{"number":1356,"text":"\n"},{"number":1357,"text":"The Executive verifies that every consumed result is still bound to the\n"},{"number":1358,"text":"current subject and basis, revalidates the complete Product view and the\n"},{"number":1359,"text":"current MVP or release mandate, applies any declared result conjunction\n"},{"number":1360,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results), assigns priority, records the\n"},{"number":1361,"text":"effect on the current promotion boundary, and acts on exactly one\n"},{"number":1362,"text":"disposition within its grant: `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter` or\n"},{"number":1363,"text":"`reject` (ACTIVATION §3; P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1364,"text":"\n"},{"number":1365,"text":"ACTIVATION §3 and §5 stay the owners of each disposition, the exact accepted\n"},{"number":1366,"text":"checkpoint and the next already-authorised bounded action. The disposition\n"},{"number":1367,"text":"is the acceptance result; neither `candidate_ready` nor a satisfied review\n"},{"number":1368,"text":"result is acceptance (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results). A repair creates\n"},{"number":1369,"text":"a new candidate; the Executive invalidates affected results and selects\n"},{"number":1370,"text":"verification or independent recheck under the cadence below, rather than\n"},{"number":1371,"text":"automatically reactivating every affected review.\n"},{"number":1372,"text":"Acceptance does not widen the Product outcome or authorise an unselected\n"},{"number":1373,"text":"successor (P4b, EVALUATION §5).\n"},{"number":1374,"text":"\n"},{"number":1375,"text":"When a finding blocks the current promotion boundary, and that severity\n"},{"number":1376,"text":"selects neither priority nor a block and priority waives no hard stop, is\n"},{"number":1377,"text":"[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion),\n"},{"number":1378,"text":"read with the Executive as the decision owner; this profile restates none\n"},{"number":1379,"text":"of it. The Executive records its determination as the current-boundary\n"},{"number":1380,"text":"effect (§5 Technical triage, severity, priority and boundary effect). An\n"},{"number":1381,"text":"unsupported technical assessment returns through a new or refined\n"},{"number":1382,"text":"activation rather than being silently rewritten (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1383,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1432,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/12. For this profile,\n"},{"number":1388,"text":"an admitted step lands its candidate after its selected work and fix pass.\n"},{"number":1389,"text":"Where review is required or selected, one bounded QA review covers that exact\n"},{"number":1390,"text":"declared subject and may run beside the next authorized step. It is not a\n"},{"number":1391,"text":"standing permission for another review of every local change. The Executive\n"},{"number":1392,"text":"records review size and its reason in the existing work carrier; any ratio is\n"},{"number":1393,"text":"Product-selected, and none is imposed here (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1394,"text":"\n"},{"number":1395,"text":"Sizing does not shrink a declared claim. Preserve the exact evaluated\n"},{"number":1396,"text":"population and conjunction; a sample supports its stated scope and leaves\n"},{"number":1397,"text":"uncovered required coverage explicit. A budget or ratio cannot turn that\n"},{"number":1398,"text":"residual into a completed whole-subject review (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1399,"text":"\n"},{"number":1400,"text":"Each test-reproducible repair binds a reproduction that fails on the faulty\n"},{"number":1401,"text":"subject and passes on the repaired subject, with the full suite declared for\n"},{"number":1402,"text":"that repair scope passing. A repair without a reproduction states that gap and\n"},{"number":1403,"text":"requires the independent recheck below; a green total does not fill the gap.\n"},{"number":1404,"text":"Tests may verify a repair without becoming independent assessment. A fix pass\n"},{"number":1405,"text":"closes on that evidence and its other applicable conditions unless independent\n"},{"number":1406,"text":"recheck is required by one of these conditions (P6, P5):\n"},{"number":1407,"text":"\n"},{"number":1408,"text":"1. the candidate reaches a boundary whose governing basis requires or claims\n"},{"number":1409,"text":"   independent review, including any Product, release, qualification, risk or\n"},{"number":1410,"text":"   admitted-work addition;\n"},{"number":1411,"text":"2. the pass repairs a hard stop or a capture whose source-fidelity claim is\n"},{"number":1412,"text":"   material to the outcome;\n"},{"number":1413,"text":"3. a repair has no reproducing test; or\n"},{"number":1414,"text":"4. a selected review left part of its declared subject uncovered.\n"},{"number":1415,"text":"\n"},{"number":1416,"text":"For a required recheck, activate one fresh Reviewer for the bounded fix pass,\n"},{"number":1417,"text":"with its affected claims, prior findings, reproductions and remaining coverage.\n"},{"number":1418,"text":"Fresh means a new bounded assessment activation with the independence of\n"},{"number":1419,"text":"EVALUATION §3, not independence inferred from a new context or actor name.\n"},{"number":1420,"text":"Partitioning follows the declared conjunction, not extra serial rounds. The\n"},{"number":1421,"text":"covered fixes remain unresolved for the dependent closure claim until that\n"},{"number":1422,"text":"report arrives and the required predicates are satisfied; tests alone cannot\n"},{"number":1423,"text":"substitute for this required review. A later material finding is a new input\n"},{"number":1424,"text":"to the next bounded disposition, not an unbounded review loop (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1425,"text":"\n"},{"number":1426,"text":"The Executive preserves Reviewer severity, assigns priority under the selected\n"},{"number":1427,"text":"policy and hands the linked items to the lawful repair Writer. Pending review\n"},{"number":1428,"text":"alone holds no landing. An open required review holds its dependent closure,\n"},{"number":1429,"text":"and release retains all its selected conditions. Downstream use and later\n"},{"number":1430,"text":"invalidation follow EVALUATION §5; access and artifact-effect grants remain\n"},{"number":1431,"text":"unchanged (P6).\n"},{"number":1432,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1456,"heading":"EXECUTIVE_BASELINE/12. Adopting this profile for a Product is\n"},{"number":1554,"text":"the Product authority's act, recorded in its Project Reference-Frame Basis:\n"},{"number":1555,"text":"inclusion in a method cut makes the profile available, and only Product\n"},{"number":1556,"text":"authority adopts it\n"},{"number":1557,"text":"([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#7-collective-reference-frame-basis)).\n"},{"number":1558,"text":"Admitting a frame configuration, this profile's executive configuration or\n"},{"number":1559,"text":"another, for the decisions it makes follows the rule of\n"},{"number":1560,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Admission of a\n"},{"number":1561,"text":"configuration: the smallest existing authority that owns each material\n"},{"number":1562,"text":"decision admits it, and admission creates no new authority over it. Vocabulary of standing\n"},{"number":16,"text":"\n"},{"number":17,"text":"The standing of a foundational claim is what grounds it relative to the\n"},{"number":18,"text":"other foundational claims: whether the method adopts it as a premise,\n"},{"number":19,"text":"taking it without derivation, derives it from them or holds it for test\n"},{"number":20,"text":"(P6). A foundational claim is a commitment (P0 to P6, §3) or a hypothesis\n"},{"number":21,"text":"(§4 Formal fragment, §5). Each has exactly one of four standings:\n"},{"number":22,"text":"\n"},{"number":23,"text":"- recovered: an adopted premise that states as one commitment what\n"},{"number":24,"text":"  several rules of the method state in parts; those rules are named as its\n"},{"number":25,"text":"  sources, not as its proof;\n"},{"number":26,"text":"- independent: an adopted premise argued by non-entailment, that is, by a\n"},{"number":27,"text":"  case in which the other commitments hold and this one fails;\n"},{"number":28,"text":"- derived: a consequence of other commitments, with the premises it\n"},{"number":29,"text":"  follows from named;\n"},{"number":30,"text":"- hypothesis: a claim that no clause and no argument of this method\n"},{"number":31,"text":"  establishes; it is not law and is carried for falsification (§5).\n"},{"number":32,"text":"\n"},{"number":33,"text":"The recovered and independent commitments are the method's adopted\n"},{"number":34,"text":"premises, and the derived ones are consequences of them. A premise is\n"},{"number":35,"text":"never presented as derived, and a hypothesis never as law (P6). This\n"},{"number":36,"text":"standing is distinct from the standing of a result, which is what the\n"},{"number":37,"text":"result establishes about its predicate (§4 Results), and from the\n"},{"number":38,"text":"disposition a successor gives a predecessor claim\n"},{"number":39,"text":"([RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015))\n"},{"number":40,"text":"(P1, P6). Every clause names the principle (P0 to P6, §3) that requires it.\n"},{"number":41,"text":"\n"},{"number":42,"text":"Four uses of \"join\" in this corpus are distinct, and each is named where\n"},{"number":43,"text":"it is used: a categorical join is a map between categories (§4 Formal\n"},{"number":44,"text":"fragment); a composition boundary is the join between successive steps\n"},{"number":45,"text":"([ACTIVATION §1 Composition boundaries](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation));\n"},{"number":46,"text":"the join of results is the combination of closed results under one\n"},{"number":47,"text":"decision rule (§4 Conjunction of results); and a relation join is the\n"},{"number":48,"text":"equality join of participants in an enclosing relation\n"},{"number":49,"text":"([ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#complete-enclosing-relation-admission)). An\n"},{"number":50,"text":"unqualified \"join\" in a result context means the join of results (P1).\n"},{"number":51,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":72,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. exact, with inventory and bytes or semantic addresses | P3 |\n"},{"number":57,"text":"| Representation | bytes, text, a model or a program standing for a subject; equal representations do not establish equal meaning | P1 |\n"},{"number":58,"text":"| Interpretation | a declared contract from representation to meaning within a context; says which distinctions a consumer may rely on and which are residual | P1 |\n"},{"number":59,"text":"| Context | the declared scope under which an interpretation holds: subject, definitions, basis, admissible observations | P1 |\n"},{"number":60,"text":"| Outcome U | a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval; adequacy of a transformation is judged against it | P2 |\n"},{"number":61,"text":"| Object O | a subject with scoped identity (authority, kind, value), a boundary, current state and declared material relations; identity survives admissible state and encoding change | P3 |\n"},{"number":62,"text":"| Actor | whoever performs a step within a declared capability envelope (context, attention, time, capability); a role is a relation an actor occupies, not a kind of actor, and which roles exist is set by a configuration ([ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration)), not by this definition | P0, P6 |\n"},{"number":63,"text":"| Step | one bounded unit of work: intake, selected context, grant, execution, output | P0 |\n"},{"number":64,"text":"| Step-produced fact | a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable and is not one | P0, P4b |\n"},{"number":65,"text":"| Claim | an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier | P6 |\n"},{"number":66,"text":"| Evidence | the exact observations or artifacts admitted to evaluate a claim on a basis; each carries provenance, subject identity, basis and scope; evidence becomes neither semantic truth nor decision authority by being available inside a frame ([What creates no authority](#authority-kinds)) | P6 |\n"},{"number":67,"text":"| Judgment | a recorded evaluation over an unchanged subject, with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation | P6 |\n"},{"number":68,"text":"| Authority | an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope; its kinds, and what creates none, are defined under Authority kinds below | P6 |\n"},{"number":69,"text":"| Residual | a material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation that remains until an authorised disposition | P4b |\n"},{"number":70,"text":"| Basis | the exact state a step, claim, result or evaluation binds: every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration or evidence coordinate whose change can alter it; immutable, or moving with a declared way of detecting advancement and a declared condition for reevaluation; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation | P6, P3 |\n"},{"number":71,"text":"| Material | of a relation: its lawful change can change an evaluation's result, invalidate its basis, change the admissible evidence, change who may perform a material operation, or change who may decide the evaluation or a material operation; of an uncertainty or closure: likewise; materiality is evaluation-relative, so a relation material in one frame may be irrelevant in another; the relation family of ACTIVATION §2 is the material relations of a step | P2, P6 |\n"},{"number":72,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":95,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2.
