Each is defined here once; [REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md)\n"},{"number":77,"text":"states the laws over them and [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md) the step that\n"},{"number":78,"text":"activates one.\n"},{"number":79,"text":"\n"},{"number":80,"text":"| Term | Definition | Requires |\n"},{"number":81,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":82,"text":"| Evaluation | a declared question whose admissible result family, evidence basis, decision authority and, where it performs a material action, operation authority are known; it may ask for a judgment, prediction, construction, comparison, proof, refusal, classification or action recommendation | P6, P2 |\n"},{"number":83,"text":"| Evaluation family | evaluations that need the same material-relation manifold, authority basis and result algebra; similar wording does not prove that two evaluations share a family | P1, P2 |\n"},{"number":84,"text":"| Workspace | the bounded body of material reasoned over or acted upon, which may include constitutional sources, domain assets, designs, implementations, tools, runtime state, evidence, historical records, external dependencies and human decisions; broader than a repository, which is one possible carrier | P3 |\n"},{"number":85,"text":"| Material-relation manifold | the finite, jointly interpretable set of variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities, observations and exclusions an evaluation family needs; a bounded relation space whose coordinate charts may overlap; no geometric mathematics or runtime abstraction is implied | P0, P2 |\n"},{"number":86,"text":"| Coordinate | the complete local position from which a value, event, decision, observation or action is interpreted: the basis, identity, lineage, input, evidence and authority information the evaluation requires; equal names, values, shapes, locations or apparent topology positions do not establish coordinate equality, which follows a declared relation | P1, P3 |\n"},{"number":87,"text":"| Topology | the relation structure among the material entities, capabilities, authorities, lifecycle state spaces, adjacencies and seams visible to a frame at one basis; a frame need not hold the workspace's complete topology; a state-value change preserves the frame topology only when it preserves every such entity, relation, lifecycle, authority, capability, adjacency and seam, and a transition that changes any of them is a topology mutation that may invalidate the frame's coordinates | P3 |\n"},{"number":88,"text":"| Capability envelope | the competence, context capacity, tools, access, applicable evaluation- or assurance-independence conditions and configuration required to activate a frame and perform its evaluations; the same frame may be usable by one actor and unusable by another; actor capability may justify a different frame size or activation sequence and can neither waive an invariant nor widen authority | P0, P6 |\n"},{"number":89,"text":"| Reference frame | a finite specification of the attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations required to perform one declared evaluation family over a stated basis; its components are the frame tuple below | P0 |\n"},{"number":90,"text":"| Activated frame | one frame declaration bound to an exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary; a reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct | P3, P6 |\n"},{"number":91,"text":"| Frame set | the human-declared family of frames available for a governed outcome or workspace; it may intentionally hold overlaps, alternatives, specialist frames, broad exploratory frames and separately activated assurance frames; it is not required to be a partition, tree, stack or exhaustive ontology | P6 |\n"},{"number":92,"text":"| Active frame configuration | the set of frame activations and declared result relations used for one evaluation or decision; one frame, or several disjoint, overlapping or composed frames; separately activated evaluations may be disjoint or overlapping | P4a |\n"},{"number":93,"text":"| Lens | a reusable family of questions applied across a frame configuration; These may coincide in a lawful case and\n"},{"number":107,"text":"never collapse by default. A read-only evaluation declares no operation\n"},{"number":108,"text":"authority; an effectful evaluation inherits the exact operation grant from\n"},{"number":109,"text":"its existing owner, and the frame does not create that grant (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":110,"text":"\n"},{"number":111,"text":"What creates no authority. Authority of any kind exists only by an\n"},{"number":112,"text":"admitted grant or an explicit authority decision of its owner, with an\n"},{"number":113,"text":"identifiable basis. None of the following mints, widens, transfers or\n"},{"number":114,"text":"reconstructs semantic, evaluation, operation or decision authority (P6,\n"},{"number":115,"text":"P3):\n"},{"number":116,"text":"\n"},{"number":117,"text":"- actor identity, an actor's capability, its tools or its access;\n"},{"number":118,"text":"- a name, label, display label, status label, role name, capability\n"},{"number":119,"text":"  string, locator, file name or path;\n"},{"number":120,"text":"- declaring, naming, selecting, activating or executing a frame, or\n"},{"number":121,"text":"  occupying a role;\n"},{"number":122,"text":"- implementation reachability, a reachable code path or an available\n"},{"number":123,"text":"  operation;\n"},{"number":124,"text":"- the shape of evidence or of a payload, or the availability of evidence\n"},{"number":125,"text":"  inside a frame;\n"},{"number":126,"text":"- a passing check, a successful step, a completed review or a count of\n"},{"number":127,"text":"  any of them;\n"},{"number":128,"text":"- copying, interpreting, encoding, evaluating, transporting, projecting,\n"},{"number":129,"text":"  compressing, importing or acquiring material;\n"},{"number":130,"text":"- drafting, admitting or retaining a work contract, beyond what its owner\n"},{"number":131,"text":"  has admitted;\n"},{"number":132,"text":"- composition, delegation, adapters, wrappers and registries, which may\n"},{"number":133,"text":"  restrict admitted authority or carry it faithfully, and never widen its\n"},{"number":134,"text":"  scope, add a role, increase its cardinality or change its kind.\n"},{"number":135,"text":"\n"},{"number":136,"text":"Elevation, transfer, split, merge, proxy grant, revocation and retirement\n"},{"number":137,"text":"each need an explicit authority decision with an identifiable basis. A\n"},{"number":138,"text":"member that names an instance of this list for its own domain cites this\n"},{"number":139,"text":"paragraph and adds only the instance.\n"},{"number":140,"text":"\n"},{"number":141,"text":"Proxy limit. Human authority may act directly, or through an explicitly\n"},{"number":142,"text":"admitted bounded proxy where the governing identity and authority law\n"},{"number":143,"text":"permits it; proxy identity and human-authority identity stay distinct\n"},{"number":144,"text":"(P6, P3). A proxy acts only inside its existing grant. It cannot change\n"},{"number":145,"text":"the governing outcome's meaning, the requirements, the governing authority\n"},{"number":146,"text":"or the accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.\n"},{"number":147,"text":"Proxy authority does not make a constructor's self-review independent,\n"},{"number":148,"text":"confers no unrelated runtime or domain authority, and does not replace\n"},{"number":149,"text":"direct human acceptance where the governing product or release law\n"},{"number":150,"text":"requires it. The contents of a proxy grant are\n"},{"number":151,"text":"[IDENTITY §6](IDENTITY.md#6-authority-identity-and-conservation-stdo-up-004)'s,\n"},{"number":152,"text":"and the decisions a proxy may take inside a step are\n"},{"number":153,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)'s.\n"},{"number":154,"text":"\n"},{"number":155,"text":"Purpose and material relation of the list and the proxy limit: each\n"},{"number":156,"text":"member that names what cannot create authority decides the same question,\n"},{"number":157,"text":"so one list keeps the answer the same in every member, and a capability,\n"},{"number":158,"text":"a label or a passing check can never be read as a permission (P6).\n"},{"number":159,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":175,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Frame disjointness is structural:\n"},{"number":163,"text":"two frames share no material variable, coordinate, evidence or result\n"},{"number":164,"text":"dependency for the declared evaluations. Evaluation independence is\n"},{"number":165,"text":"procedural: separately activated evaluations neither consume nor influence\n"},{"number":166,"text":"one another's unclosed working results, although they may inspect the same\n"},{"number":167,"text":"subject, overlap in their manifolds and later supply closed results to one\n"},{"number":168,"text":"conjunction. Assurance independence is claim-relative: the governing\n"},{"number":169,"text":"assurance law states the non-authorship, evidence-acquisition,\n"},{"number":170,"text":"reference-exposure, actor and configuration separation a verdict needs to\n"},{"number":171,"text":"count as independent assurance (EVALUATION §3). Disjoint frames need not\n"},{"number":172,"text":"be independently evaluated; independently activated evaluations need not\n"},{"number":173,"text":"be disjoint; and the unqualified word \"independent\" establishes none of\n"},{"number":174,"text":"the three.\n"},{"number":175,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":197,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Operationally a frame is an evaluation contract that defines\n"},{"number":189,"text":"the finite attention scope one evaluation family requires. A prompt, a\n"},{"number":190,"text":"context packet, a symbolic program or any other representation is a\n"},{"number":191,"text":"projection of an activated frame, not the frame (P1). A frame is bound\n"},{"number":192,"text":"when every material coordinate above resolves to an exact source, subject,\n"},{"number":193,"text":"basis, authority, evidence route, actor envelope, result relation and\n"},{"number":194,"text":"invalidation condition; the binding may be expressed entirely in\n"},{"number":195,"text":"source-linked prose, and representation cannot create, widen or replace it\n"},{"number":196,"text":"(P3, P6).\n"},{"number":197,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":250,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Ontology/Product lineage objects","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F2.%20Ontology%2FProduct%20lineage%20objects","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"81c6db0b5228df5164798661582015e2d87042cf7c8047d1844aaa981a75c21c","start_line":198,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":198,"text":"### Product lineage objects\n"},{"number":199,"text":"\n"},{"number":200,"text":"Software is recursive and compositional: a released product may build the\n"},{"number":201,"text":"next released version of itself, a dependent product, or downstream project\n"},{"number":202,"text":"artifacts. Most taxonomy drift in recursive systems comes from collapsing\n"},{"number":203,"text":"the roles below into one overloaded word such as \"product\". Each role is an\n"},{"number":204,"text":"object with its own identity (P3). This member owns the bounded context\n"},{"number":205,"text":"`urn:stdo:bounded-context:recursive-product-taxonomy` and the concept\n"},{"number":206,"text":"identities below under the selected complete basis.\n"},{"number":207,"text":"\n"},{"number":208,"text":"| Term | Definition | Requires |\n"},{"number":209,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":210,"text":"| Substrate (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:substrate`) | a lower product or runtime used to build other products | P3 |\n"},{"number":211,"text":"| Development product (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:development-product`) | the role of one exact install of a released product while that install acts as builder substrate for a source project; the role creates no new product identity and transfers no meaning or authority from the builder to the product being authored | P3, P6 |\n"},{"number":212,"text":"| Source project (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:source-project`) | the mutable workspace building the next release cut | P3 |\n"},{"number":213,"text":"| Release cut (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:release-cut`) | one immutable annotated release-candidate boundary over a published feature set | P3 |\n"},{"number":214,"text":"| Product (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:product`) | the released immutable thing resulting when that release cut is accepted | P3 |\n"},{"number":215,"text":"| Install (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:install`) | a stamped workspace instance of that released product | P3 |\n"},{"number":216,"text":"| Artifact (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:artifact`) | any published output built by a source project or by a configured installed product | P3 |\n"},{"number":217,"text":"| Product definition (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:product-definition`) | the present-tense source-project authority surface, conventionally carried by `PRODUCT.md`; it defines the current product WHAT for decomposition and is not the released product artifact | P3, P2 |\n"},{"number":218,"text":"\n"},{"number":219,"text":"The governing rules: a mutable source workspace is not called a product;\n"},{"number":220,"text":"when a released product acts as builder substrate, the exact install is\n"},{"number":221,"text":"bound as a development product without confusing it with the product being\n"},{"number":222,"text":"authored; an immutable release cut or installed product is not confused\n"},{"number":223,"text":"with the mutable source project building the next cut; the product\n"},{"number":224,"text":"definition is the surface of a source project, not the released product\n"},{"number":225,"text":"artifact; products may depend on other products; installed products may\n"},{"number":226,"text":"build the next version of themselves or other products. The compiler\n"},{"number":227,"text":"analogy is the intended model: bootstrap source, release P0, install P0,\n"},{"number":228,"text":"use P0 to build the source for P1, release P1. The taxonomy is load-bearing:\n"},{"number":229,"text":"blurred, dependency and self-hosting errors compound quickly and are\n"},{"number":230,"text":"expensive to unwind. SPEC_METHOD §6 applies these objects to lineage and\n"},{"number":231,"text":"release.\n"},{"number":232,"text":"\n"},{"number":233,"text":"Release objects. A release cut has three neighbours that release keeps\n"},{"number":234,"text":"distinct from it and from each other (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":235,"text":"A candidate source is the mutable source-project state constructing a\n"},{"number":236,"text":"possible successor; it is non-operative for released consumers. A release\n"},{"number":237,"text":"subject is the exact declared product member set or artifact that one\n"},{"number":238,"text":"release cut binds, described by that cut's release-scoped claims; a\n"},{"number":239,"text":"carrier that holds it does not thereby make co-located material a\n"},{"number":240,"text":"member. A version-line selector is a mutable\n"},{"number":241,"text":"alias naming the highest-ordinal published release cut on one version\n"},{"number":242,"text":"line of one project; it is convenient discovery, not immutable identity,\n"},{"number":243,"text":"and not sufficient as an exact basis ([RELEASE §1](RELEASE.md#1-context-and-position)\n"},{"number":244,"text":"states which).\n"},{"number":245,"text":"Equal version text does not collapse these objects. A selector or a\n"},{"number":246,"text":"mutable carrier may move; a release cut never moves. RELEASE §2 realises\n"},{"number":247,"text":"them, with the carriers that hold them, as refs of one release source. A\n"},{"number":248,"text":"release profile need not provide a mutable selector: discovery can resolve\n"},{"number":249,"text":"an immutable cut directly without changing that cut into a selector.\n"},{"number":250,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":265,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Ontology/Work boundary","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F2.%20Ontology%2FWork%20boundary","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"72c64ed9c345607efc5331dbb204bedf720a40c1144f548b5b0bf777d381151f","start_line":251,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":251,"text":"### Work boundary\n"},{"number":252,"text":"\n"},{"number":253,"text":"The method governs the boundary around a probabilistic, agentic or\n"},{"number":254,"text":"delegated work unit; it does not absorb the worker's internal solution\n"},{"number":255,"text":"strategy into the framework (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":256,"text":"The declared boundary of such a unit is an object with six parts, which the\n"},{"number":257,"text":"live specification and design should declare: the input and output contract; the\n"},{"number":258,"text":"required context; the capability or role expectation; the admissible\n"},{"number":259,"text":"evidence and evaluator regime; the provenance obligation; and the lawful\n"},{"number":260,"text":"stop, hold, gap, continuation or completion states. The worker, tool, agent\n"},{"number":261,"text":"or domain implementation owns the internal HOW inside that boundary unless\n"},{"number":262,"text":"the product explicitly promotes part of that HOW into reusable declared\n"},{"number":263,"text":"structure. The step of ACTIVATION §1 is this unit with its intake, context\n"},{"number":264,"text":"and result algebra made exact.\n"},{"number":265,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":288,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Ontology/Accounts of a construction","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F2.%20Ontology%2FAccounts%20of%20a%20construction","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"ea757c046b9fed0d906f1874d963887cb458b09e58615b0c24be6e0ea82e729f","start_line":266,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":266,"text":"### Accounts of a construction\n"},{"number":267,"text":"\n"},{"number":268,"text":"A construction is the realisation of a selected outer contract through\n"},{"number":269,"text":"steps, as P0 states it (§3). Three accounts of a construction stay\n"},{"number":270,"text":"distinct (P1, P0):\n"},{"number":271,"text":"\n"},{"number":272,"text":"- the algorithmic description: the steps;\n"},{"number":273,"text":"- the informational interpretation: what the data means, given under an\n"},{"number":274,"text":"  Interpretation (the ontology table above);\n"},{"number":275,"text":"- the computational realisation: how people, machines or combinations of\n"},{"number":276,"text":"  them carry it out in a declared execution environment; for a build\n"},{"number":277,"text":"  tenant that environment is the one\n"},{"number":278,"text":"  [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding) defines.\n"},{"number":279,"text":"\n"},{"number":280,"text":"The distinction is kept for any construction and is independent of the\n"},{"number":281,"text":"tiers of this corpus: a construction may need all three accounts, and no\n"},{"number":282,"text":"account is a tier (P1). This section owns the distinction as an added\n"},{"number":283,"text":"choice in the sense of §3 Foundation to law, not a commitment; it has none\n"},{"number":284,"text":"of the standings of §1. Purpose and material relation: the steps, the\n"},{"number":285,"text":"meaning of the data and the means of execution can each change while the others\n"},{"number":286,"text":"hold, so a claim about one account is never taken for a claim about\n"},{"number":287,"text":"another (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":288,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":342,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/2. Ontology/Imports between members","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F2.%20Ontology%2FImports%20between%20members","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"35eee707b1af79b275a78784a01e73da437f5b55a89b04e8adbd1c6428cf4486","start_line":289,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":289,"text":"### Imports between members\n"},{"number":290,"text":"\n"},{"number":291,"text":"A member that uses a concept another member defines imports it and does\n"},{"number":292,"text":"not define it again (P1, P3). An import is\n"},{"number":293,"text":"reference-only. Source and target meanings are identical owner-qualified\n"},{"number":294,"text":"references, not new local definitions. Direction is from the named source\n"},{"number":295,"text":"to the importing context; loss is none and no translation or ownership\n"},{"number":296,"text":"transfer is asserted. An import provides no semantic, evaluation,\n"},{"number":297,"text":"operation or decision authority (P6; Authority kinds, What creates no\n"},{"number":298,"text":"authority). A use that changes, narrows or loses\n"},{"number":299,"text":"the source meaning is not an import and is never declared as one.\n"},{"number":300,"text":"\n"},{"number":301,"text":"An import declaration states, for each imported concept (P1, P3, P6):\n"},{"number":302,"text":"\n"},{"number":303,"text":"- what is imported: the concept, under the name its owner gives it;\n"},{"number":304,"text":"- its owner: the owning section of the member that defines it, which is a\n"},{"number":305,"text":"  place in the text, not a semantic authority (Authority kinds above);\n"},{"number":306,"text":"- the source context: the bounded context the owning member declares, or\n"},{"number":307,"text":"  that member itself where it declares none;\n"},{"number":308,"text":"- the target context and the member that owns it;\n"},{"number":309,"text":"- the direction and the loss, which one sentence may state for all the\n"},{"number":310,"text":"  concepts of one declaration.\n"},{"number":311,"text":"\n"},{"number":312,"text":"An import takes one of two forms. A declaration states these contents\n"},{"number":313,"text":"for each imported concept in one place; between members of this corpus,\n"},{"number":314,"text":"it is the owner-authorised relation described here (P6). A reference at the\n"},{"number":315,"text":"point of use that names the owning section is also an import: it states what is\n"},{"number":316,"text":"imported and its owner; its source context is the one the list above\n"},{"number":317,"text":"names, its target is the using member's context, and its direction, loss\n"},{"number":318,"text":"and lack of authority are those stated above. A concept another member\n"},{"number":319,"text":"defines enters a bounded context only by one of these forms, never by\n"},{"number":320,"text":"proximity or equal spelling (P1, P3).\n"},{"number":321,"text":"\n"},{"number":322,"text":"An activation binds each member's distinct coordinates in its selected\n"},{"number":323,"text":"complete governing basis; equal cut selection does not mean equal member\n"},{"number":324,"text":"coordinates. Adoption is a target's taking an imported concept into use\n"},{"number":325,"text":"under the conditions its source states, which are its adoption premises.\n"},{"number":326,"text":"Lifecycle and adoption remain source-owned. A changed member,\n"},{"number":327,"text":"selected basis, source declaration or adoption premise requires fresh\n"},{"number":328,"text":"applicability before use. An activation lacking the source meaning,\n"},{"number":329,"text":"adoption or authority binding reports that unresolved relation before\n"},{"number":330,"text":"dependent reliance rather than interpreting it from equal spelling (P3,\n"},{"number":331,"text":"P5). For an evaluation that depends on the imported concept, a missing\n"},{"number":332,"text":"source meaning, adoption or authority binding is an undeclared material\n"},{"number":333,"text":"relation, the ground of `out_of_frame` ([Results](#results), Out of frame\n"},{"number":334,"text":"or indeterminate); a changed member or basis whose applicability is not\n"},{"number":335,"text":"yet re-established is the ground of `invalid_basis` (§4 Results).\n"},{"number":336,"text":"\n"},{"number":337,"text":"Purpose and material relation of the declaration's contents, its two\n"},{"number":338,"text":"forms, a member as source context and the two grounds above: a concept\n"},{"number":339,"text":"used outside its owning section keeps one meaning and one owner, so two\n"},{"number":340,"text":"members cannot answer one question two ways, and using a concept grants\n"},{"number":341,"text":"no authority over it (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":342,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":472,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/3. Commitments","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F3.%20Commitments","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"e2532e1e4615241f8bae200880abbffac9973283fb3bc15b71e07e03f06af793","start_line":343,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":343,"text":"## 3. Commitments\n"},{"number":344,"text":"\n"},{"number":345,"text":"Each commitment has exactly one standing, in the terms §1 defines; the\n"},{"number":346,"text":"table states it, with a distinction the commitment retains. The adopted\n"},{"number":347,"text":"premises, which §1 identifies as the recovered and independent\n"},{"number":348,"text":"commitments, are commitments adopted for the domain this method governs,\n"},{"number":349,"text":"not theorems derived from finite capacity alone, that is, from the bound\n"},{"number":350,"text":"on an actor's envelope (P0). Particular method rules need these premises\n"},{"number":351,"text":"plus their stated domain and policy choices, each with its owner\n"},{"number":352,"text":"([Foundation to law](#foundation-to-law)). An argument from the premises\n"},{"number":353,"text":"preserves that distinction; it does not create authority (P6). Purpose\n"},{"number":354,"text":"and material relation of this paragraph and the standing column: each\n"},{"number":355,"text":"commitment shows what grounds it, so no premise is presented as derived\n"},{"number":356,"text":"and no consequence is taken for a premise (P6).\n"},{"number":357,"text":"\n"},{"number":358,"text":"| Commitment | Standing | Distinction retained |\n"},{"number":359,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":360,"text":"| P0 Bounded construction | recovered | the actor's internal path within a step is its own |\n"},{"number":361,"text":"| P1 Interpretation | independent | structural success never establishes fidelity |\n"},{"number":362,"text":"| P2 Purpose | independent | an obligation with no route to the outcome is unjustified |\n"},{"number":363,"text":"| P3 Identity | independent | current state, historical observation and representation identity stay separate |\n"},{"number":364,"text":"| P4a Typed composition | independent | composition retains both identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states |\n"},{"number":365,"text":"| P4b Conservation of step-produced facts | derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable | sources a later step can re-acquire are governed by sufficiency, not conservation |\n"},{"number":366,"text":"| P5 Totality | derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise | a step cannot report success on a condition outside its context |\n"},{"number":367,"text":"| P6 Justification and authority | independent | neither evidence nor authority is minted by the other |\n"},{"number":368,"text":"\n"},{"number":369,"text":"P0 Bounded construction. A finite actor realises a selected outer contract\n"},{"number":370,"text":"through steps. Each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope.\n"},{"number":371,"text":"Sources, named as sources and not as proof (§1): finite attention within a\n"},{"number":372,"text":"declared envelope ([RF-002](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-002-finite-attention)),\n"},{"number":373,"text":"material sufficiency ([RF-003](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency)),\n"},{"number":374,"text":"material closure ([AC-010](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-010-material-closure)),\n"},{"number":375,"text":"the [work boundary](#work-boundary), and the refinement of one outer\n"},{"number":376,"text":"contract into inner steps\n"},{"number":377,"text":"([ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement), Refinement).\n"},{"number":378,"text":"Premises: a selected outcome (P2); the actor of one step need not be the\n"},{"number":379,"text":"actor of the next and may re-acquire declared sources but not private\n"},{"number":380,"text":"memory; step-produced facts are not re-acquirable; the world is open; a\n"},{"number":381,"text":"step's output is a candidate until evaluated.\n"},{"number":382,"text":"\n"},{"number":383,"text":"P0's boundary commitment (the work boundary of §2): deterministic checks\n"},{"number":384,"text":"and validation are evidence surfaces; they may optimise or prove a\n"},{"number":385,"text":"domain-local path where the domain can make part of the work precise, and\n"},{"number":386,"text":"they do not authorise the method, a runtime or a framework to absorb domain\n"},{"number":387,"text":"solution strategy as constitutional law. Any unconstrained part of a\n"},{"number":388,"text":"probabilistic worker's reasoning remains hidden worker-internal activity\n"},{"number":389,"text":"and is forced back through the declared contracts, evidence, provenance and\n"},{"number":390,"text":"control truth of the boundary. A framework layer that prescribes domain\n"},{"number":391,"text":"solution strategy beyond the declared work contract and control truth has\n"},{"number":392,"text":"crossed its authority boundary (P6). A profile may bind the unit to its own\n"},{"number":393,"text":"traversal unit, in which that traversal is the admissible external space;\n"},{"number":394,"text":"PROFILES §2 keeps that binding.\n"},{"number":395,"text":"\n"},{"number":396,"text":"P1 Interpretation. Subject, representation and interpretation are distinct;\n"},{"number":397,"text":"meaning holds within a declared context through a declared contract.\n"},{"number":398,"text":"Non-entailment: let two steps fit their envelopes under one selected\n"},{"number":399,"text":"outcome, keep declared identities, compose because the first's declared\n"},{"number":400,"text":"result type, a length, meets the second's declared domain, record their\n"},{"number":401,"text":"step-produced facts, return closed results and keep evidence apart from\n"},{"number":402,"text":"authority, while the second reads the value under a contract no one\n"},{"number":403,"text":"declares, in metres where the first wrote feet; P0 and P2 to P6 hold, yet\n"},{"number":404,"text":"one representation has two meanings and no declared contract, which P1\n"},{"number":405,"text":"forbids. \"Algorithmic\" means\n"},{"number":406,"text":"explicit and structurally checkable; a semantic decision is lawful only\n"},{"number":407,"text":"under an exact decision contract.\n"},{"number":408,"text":"\n"},{"number":409,"text":"P2 Purpose. A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit\n"},{"number":410,"text":"material obligations from the transformation they serve. Non-entailment:\n"},{"number":411,"text":"let a finite actor realise a selected outer contract that names an\n"},{"number":412,"text":"outcome, through steps that fit its envelope, read under declared\n"},{"number":413,"text":"contracts, keep declared identities, compose by type, record their\n"},{"number":414,"text":"step-produced facts, return closed results and keep evidence apart from\n"},{"number":415,"text":"authority, while each interface's obligations are set by the capacity\n"},{"number":416,"text":"available and not inherited from the transformation it serves; P0, P1 and\n"},{"number":417,"text":"P3 to P6 hold, yet the same obligations count as adequate for opposite\n"},{"number":418,"text":"outcomes and an obligation with no route to the outcome stands, which P2\n"},{"number":419,"text":"forbids.\n"},{"number":420,"text":"\n"},{"number":421,"text":"P3 Identity. An object's identity is declared (authority, kind, value) and\n"},{"number":422,"text":"survives admissible change; a boundary is a claim with a proof obligation.\n"},{"number":423,"text":"Non-entailment: let steps fit their envelopes under one selected outcome,\n"},{"number":424,"text":"read under declared contracts, compose by type, record their\n"},{"number":425,"text":"step-produced facts, return closed results and keep evidence apart from\n"},{"number":426,"text":"authority, while each object's identity is taken from the place that\n"},{"number":427,"text":"stores it and no authority, kind or value is declared, so an admissible\n"},{"number":428,"text":"move makes one object two; P0 to P2 and P4a to P6 hold, yet identity is\n"},{"number":429,"text":"neither declared nor kept across admissible change, which P3 forbids.\n"},{"number":430,"text":"\n"},{"number":431,"text":"P4a Typed composition. Two steps compose only when the first's result type\n"},{"number":432,"text":"and judgment satisfy the second's exact declared domain and preconditions.\n"},{"number":433,"text":"Non-entailment: let a second step run on every output of the first, read it\n"},{"number":434,"text":"under its own declared contract and return `invalid_basis` where the output\n"},{"number":435,"text":"lies outside its declared domain, and let the composite keep only the\n"},{"number":436,"text":"step-produced facts the outer contract needs. Each step fits its envelope and serves the selected\n"},{"number":437,"text":"outcome, identities are declared and kept, the needed facts are recorded,\n"},{"number":438,"text":"every result is closed and authority stays with its owners, so P0 to P3,\n"},{"number":439,"text":"P4b, P5 and P6 hold. Yet the steps compose although the first's result type\n"},{"number":440,"text":"need not meet the second's declared domain, and the first step's other\n"},{"number":441,"text":"intermediate results and stop state are lost; P4a forbids both. The\n"},{"number":442,"text":"retention has its own route to the outcome: when the composite is later\n"},{"number":443,"text":"falsified or must be resumed, the kept intermediate results and stop state\n"},{"number":444,"text":"locate the step to repair or restart, which a record of what the outer\n"},{"number":445,"text":"contract needs does not supply (P2).\n"},{"number":446,"text":"\n"},{"number":447,"text":"P4b Conservation of step-produced facts. Judgments, residuals, observations\n"},{"number":448,"text":"and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step\n"},{"number":449,"text":"that produced them. The outer contract needs these facts (P2); the next\n"},{"number":450,"text":"actor may re-acquire declared sources but not the producing step's private\n"},{"number":451,"text":"result, because step-produced facts are not re-acquirable (P0); so only the\n"},{"number":452,"text":"producing step can record them. Its typed instances include authority,\n"},{"number":453,"text":"residuals, judgments, frame boundaries, transitions, successor claims and\n"},{"number":454,"text":"evidence by reference; each consuming member binds the applicable instance\n"},{"number":455,"text":"to its own scope.\n"},{"number":456,"text":"\n"},{"number":457,"text":"P5 Totality. A step can meet a condition outside its context (P0's\n"},{"number":458,"text":"open-world premise), and it cannot report success on one (P6). Its result\n"},{"number":459,"text":"algebra therefore carries first-class outcomes other than success for such\n"},{"number":460,"text":"a condition, and its control model names the next move. The three values\n"},{"number":461,"text":"`indeterminate`, `out_of_frame` and `invalid_basis` are a declared choice\n"},{"number":462,"text":"of [Results](#results), family F3.\n"},{"number":463,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §3](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-012-closed-results) and\n"},{"number":464,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal)\n"},{"number":465,"text":"apply the same core to their respective domains.\n"},{"number":466,"text":"\n"},{"number":467,"text":"P6 Justification and authority. Definitions, assumptions, observations,\n"},{"number":468,"text":"candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence\n"},{"number":469,"text":"supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.\n"},{"number":470,"text":"Non-entailment: a bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green\n"},{"number":471,"text":"label as acceptance.\n"},{"number":472,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":501,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/3. This is a synthesis\n"},{"number":477,"text":"of their relations, stated once so that every consumer of the construction\n"},{"number":478,"text":"relation, which [ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation), a\n"},{"number":479,"text":"tier 1 foundations member of this corpus, owns, can see which commitment grounds each part. It is derived, not a further\n"},{"number":480,"text":"commitment, and has the standing of a consequence under Foundation to law\n"},{"number":481,"text":"below (P6).\n"},{"number":482,"text":"\n"},{"number":483,"text":"| Commitment | Contribution to construction |\n"},{"number":484,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":485,"text":"| P0 Bounded construction | the outer contract is realised through steps whose contexts fit the actors' envelopes, so acquisition and work are bounded; the actor's internal path within a step is its own |\n"},{"number":486,"text":"| P1 Interpretation | the required conditions, the observed state and the predictions about an action's effects are different accounts; the meaning needed to compare them is preserved |\n"},{"number":487,"text":"| P2 Purpose | Z is selected with the criteria by which a strategy and a realised outcome are adequate; work with no route to Z is unjustified |\n"},{"number":488,"text":"| P3 Identity and state | the persistent subject, its current observations and its dependencies, from which work continues, stay distinct from any account of them |\n"},{"number":489,"text":"| P4a Typed composition | outer obligations are carried through bounded steps, refinement and the composition boundaries between them |\n"},{"number":490,"text":"| P4b Conservation of step-produced facts | what a step produced and cannot re-acquire is conserved through the loop of observation, correction and reuse |\n"},{"number":491,"text":"| P5 Totality | resource tradeoffs, recursive progress, recovery and truthful stops are accounted for, and an undecided outcome is reported as undecided |\n"},{"number":492,"text":"| P6 Justification and authority | what the results support, and who may change the model, act or accept delivery, are established and not minted |\n"},{"number":493,"text":"\n"},{"number":494,"text":"The construction relation states the obligations this synthesis places on\n"},{"number":495,"text":"construction. Finite capacity motivates bounded work; purpose, meaning,\n"},{"number":496,"text":"identity, compatibility, evidence and authority retain their own\n"},{"number":497,"text":"premises. Strategy selection and domain controls are added choices within\n"},{"number":498,"text":"those obligations, each with its owner. Feedback, a useful model and\n"},{"number":499,"text":"locally valid steps do not by themselves prove reachability, stability,\n"},{"number":500,"text":"optimality or termination (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":501,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":641,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/3. Each material family is traced in one\n"},{"number":507,"text":"family table. The table sits in the member that owns the family, at the\n"},{"number":508,"text":"section where an actor enters the family, so the actor meets the trace\n"},{"number":509,"text":"where it applies the rules (P2, P6). A family table first states its\n"},{"number":510,"text":"instance premises: the conditions of the situations the family governs,\n"},{"number":511,"text":"which the commitments do not supply. They are labelled as instance\n"},{"number":512,"text":"premises, never as commitments. The table then has one row per\n"},{"number":513,"text":"consequence, in five columns:\n"},{"number":514,"text":"\n"},{"number":515,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |\n"},{"number":516,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":517,"text":"\n"},{"number":518,"text":"- Premises, with standing: the commitments the row rests on, each with its\n"},{"number":519,"text":"  standing from the table of commitments above, and the instance premises\n"},{"number":520,"text":"  it uses. A profile's table also names the families it imports, under\n"},{"number":521,"text":"  [PROFILES §1](PROFILES.md#1-the-boundary).\n"},{"number":522,"text":"- Consequence that follows: what those premises together require of the\n"},{"number":523,"text":"  family.\n"},{"number":524,"text":"- Rule in this member that states it: the owning section or clause,\n"},{"number":525,"text":"  linked. Where a table accounts for a section of another member, this\n"},{"number":526,"text":"  column names that section, linked and marked as outside this member, or\n"},{"number":527,"text":"  a paragraph after the table names the sections of other members that\n"},{"number":528,"text":"  apply its rows; the section keeps its owner.\n"},{"number":529,"text":"- Added domain or policy choice, and its owner: what the rule decides that\n"},{"number":530,"text":"  the premises leave open, with the member, profile, adopting Product (a\n"},{"number":531,"text":"  Product that applies this method) or authority that owns it, or \"none\".\n"},{"number":532,"text":"  A row never files the whole rule as the choice: the choice is only what\n"},{"number":533,"text":"  the premises leave open.\n"},{"number":534,"text":"- Pillar: the pillar contributions the row helps account for, by number.\n"},{"number":535,"text":"  The ten contributions used in this trace are, in order: 1 specification\n"},{"number":536,"text":"  and project structure; 2 world models, identity and Markov objects; 3\n"},{"number":537,"text":"  algebraic calculus; 4 functional design; 5 outcome-driven development; 6\n"},{"number":538,"text":"  information and interpretation; 7 reference frames; 8 computational\n"},{"number":539,"text":"  calculus and execution binding; 9 evidence, correction and authority; 10\n"},{"number":540,"text":"  axiomatic calculus. A Pillar cell is a trace, like the rest of the table:\n"},{"number":541,"text":"  it is not a premise, adds no standing to the row, owns no choice, and does not\n"},{"number":542,"text":"  claim that a pillar is an axiom or follows from finite capacity.\n"},{"number":543,"text":"\n"},{"number":544,"text":"Consumers. Results of constraints, judgments, frame\n"},{"number":746,"text":"evaluations, stops, work steps and effects are stated in it or in a\n"},{"number":747,"text":"refinement mapped into it, so that results from any members combine under\n"},{"number":748,"text":"one rule ([Conjunction of results](#conjunction-of-results)). Purpose and\n"},{"number":749,"text":"material relation: no combination can report success while a failure, an\n"},{"number":750,"text":"undecided question, an unperformed evaluation or an uncertain effect\n"},{"number":751,"text":"remains, and none of these can be mistaken for another (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":752,"text":"\n"},{"number":753,"text":"Recording. A result records its core value together with the predicate\n"},{"number":754,"text":"evaluated and the original domain outcome, which is the refined value\n"},{"number":755,"text":"where a refinement produced it. A mapping into the core never owns domain\n"},{"number":756,"text":"meaning: the member, profile or adopting Product that defines the refined\n"},{"number":757,"text":"value keeps it, and a consumer that needs the domain distinction reads the\n"},{"number":758,"text":"domain outcome, never the core value alone (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":759,"text":"\n"},{"number":760,"text":"Standing. The standing of a result is what it establishes about its\n"},{"number":761,"text":"predicate; it is distinct from the standing of a commitment (§1). Only\n"},{"number":762,"text":"`satisfied` establishes the predicate. `falsified` establishes that the\n"},{"number":763,"text":"predicate fails and names the counterexample. `indeterminate`,\n"},{"number":764,"text":"`out_of_frame` and `invalid_basis` establish neither, and each names what\n"},{"number":765,"text":"would decide: the evidence, the missing relation or capability with its\n"},{"number":766,"text":"owner where the subject gives one, or the basis repair. By support for the\n"},{"number":767,"text":"predicate, `satisfied` stands above each other value, and the other four\n"},{"number":768,"text":"are not ordered among themselves.\n"},{"number":769,"text":"\n"},{"number":770,"text":"No refinement or mapping raises a result's standing (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":771,"text":"\n"},{"number":772,"text":"- a falsified or failed result never maps to a satisfied or successful one;\n"},{"number":773,"text":"- a result that admissible evidence cannot decide never maps to\n"},{"number":774,"text":"  `satisfied`;\n"},{"number":775,"text":"- an evaluation that was not performed stays distinct from one whose\n"},{"number":776,"text":"  evidence cannot decide: it has no\n"},{"number":777,"text":"  [closed result](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse), and it is never mapped\n"},{"number":778,"text":"  to `indeterminate` or to any other core value;\n"},{"number":779,"text":"- an effect whose completion is unknown never maps to no effect or to\n"},{"number":780,"text":"  completed.\n"},{"number":781,"text":"\n"},{"number":782,"text":"Not performed. An evaluation that is required or planned and was not\n"},{"number":783,"text":"performed has no closed result; an actor cannot report an evaluation it\n"},{"number":784,"text":"did not perform (P6). Nothing is coerced to success: a failed,\n"},{"number":785,"text":"indeterminate, out-of-frame, out-of-scope or invalid-basis result follows\n"},{"number":786,"text":"the declared result algebra and returns its own value under it, never\n"},{"number":787,"text":"`satisfied`, and a missing result, being no result, enters every\n"},{"number":788,"text":"conjunction over it as a gap: a planned assessment without a closed result\n"},{"number":789,"text":"where an assessment was planned, and uncovered coverage where none was.\n"},{"number":790,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §3](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-012-closed-results) states\n"},{"number":791,"text":"RF-012 as a law over frames and\n"},{"number":792,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal)\n"},{"number":793,"text":"states AC-007 as a law over constraints; each uses this core and neither\n"},{"number":794,"text":"defines it again.\n"},{"number":795,"text":"\n"},{"number":796,"text":"Refinements. A member, profile or adopting Product that needs finer\n"},{"number":797,"text":"outcomes defines a refinement. The refinement names the question it\n"},{"number":798,"text":"answers and the predicate its mapping is for, and maps every refined value\n"},{"number":799,"text":"to exactly one core value. No outcome exists outside the core; a\n"},{"number":800,"text":"refinement adds no core value and keeps the pressure of `indeterminate`,\n"},{"number":801,"text":"`out_of_frame` and `invalid_basis` explicit. Where a refined value would\n"},{"number":802,"text":"map to one of two core values according to its cause, the cause is part of\n"},{"number":803,"text":"the refined value and each resulting value maps once (P5, P1). A further\n"},{"number":804,"text":"refinement, by a member, profile, project or adopting Product, may split a\n"},{"number":805,"text":"refined value by cause. The parent-value rule governs every such split:\n"},{"number":806,"text":"each child value names its parent value and its cause and keeps its\n"},{"number":807,"text":"parent's core value; a child that needs a different core value needs a\n"},{"number":808,"text":"different parent value, which only the owner of the parent declares; and\n"},{"number":809,"text":"no child takes `satisfied` from a parent that is not `satisfied`. No\n"},{"number":810,"text":"further refinement raises a result's standing (P5, P6, P1). Purpose and\n"},{"number":811,"text":"material relation: a consumer that reads a parent value reads the same\n"},{"number":812,"text":"core value from each of its children, so a split by cause adds a domain\n"},{"number":813,"text":"distinction and never changes what the parent establishes (P5, P6). The\n"},{"number":814,"text":"refinements for admission, activation and steps are\n"},{"number":815,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition); each other\n"},{"number":816,"text":"member, profile and adopting Product states its mapping where it defines\n"},{"number":817,"text":"its values.\n"},{"number":818,"text":"\n"},{"number":819,"text":"Availability, assessment and acceptance are separate results, each with its\n"},{"number":820,"text":"own predicate: that a step produced a candidate; that the candidate meets\n"},{"number":821,"text":"its declared criteria; and that the\n"},{"number":822,"text":"[decision owner](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation) accepts it at its\n"},{"number":823,"text":"boundary. A step having produced a candidate never maps to the candidate's\n"},{"number":824,"text":"fitness or acceptance, and acceptance is never inferred from a successful\n"},{"number":825,"text":"step (P6; [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition),\n"},{"number":826,"text":"[EVALUATION §4](EVALUATION.md#4-review-results) and\n"},{"number":827,"text":"[§5](EVALUATION.md#5-acceptance)).\n"},{"number":828,"text":"\n"},{"number":829,"text":"Out of frame or indeterminate. The boundary between these values is drawn\n"},{"number":830,"text":"on what the activated frame declares and on what the step did with it (P5,\n"},{"number":831,"text":"finite capacity and graceful total handling; the material relation drawn\n"},{"number":832,"text":"is the three-way out_of_frame boundary: capability not declared, capability\n"},{"number":833,"text":"declared and exercised, capability declared and not exercised). Three cases; the first two name core values, and\n"},{"number":834,"text":"the third names none:\n"},{"number":835,"text":"\n"},{"number":836,"text":"- `out_of_frame` when the claim requires a material relation or an\n"},{"number":837,"text":"  evaluator capability that the activated frame does not declare. The\n"},{"number":838,"text":"  result names the missing relation or capability, its owner where the\n"},{"number":839,"text":"  subject gives one, and the reconfiguration pressure it creates\n"},{"number":840,"text":"  ([ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement)). A term the claim depends on and the frame\n"},{"number":841,"text":"  leaves undefined is an undeclared material relation: its meaning can\n"},{"number":842,"text":"  alter the result and it enters through no declared input (RF-003; P1). Whether the step exercised anything is\n"},{"number":843,"text":"  irrelevant to this value; the ground is the missing declaration.\n"},{"number":844,"text":"- `indeterminate` when the available admissible evidence cannot decide the\n"},{"number":845,"text":"  claim. The result names the evidence that would decide, as\n"},{"number":846,"text":"  its residual uncertainty. Where the\n"},{"number":847,"text":"  claim also depends on an undeclared relation or capability,\n"},{"number":848,"text":"  `out_of_frame` and `indeterminate` each have a lawful ground; the result\n"},{"number":849,"text":"  names the value it returns and that ground, and this boundary excludes\n"},{"number":850,"text":"  neither (P5).\n"},{"number":851,"text":"- no value of its own when the step did not exercise a declared capability\n"},{"number":852,"text":"  the evaluation requires. A result is returned wherever a sufficient\n"},{"number":853,"text":"  evaluation or an applicable judgment exists without that capability,\n"},{"number":854,"text":"  identifying its evidence, verdict and residual uncertainty like any\n"},{"number":855,"text":"  closed result:\n"},{"number":856,"text":"  a counterexample found by what was exercised, as when source inspection\n"},{"number":857,"text":"  falsifies A in a claim of A and B, returns `falsified`, and common\n"},{"number":858,"text":"  agreement cannot discard it. Where none\n"},{"number":859,"text":"  exists because the capability was not exercised, the evaluation was not\n"},{"number":860,"text":"  performed and has no result: the step's stop state carries it,\n"},{"number":861,"text":"  `incomplete` under\n"},{"number":862,"text":"  [construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability), and\n"},{"number":863,"text":"  its work state ([ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart))\n"},{"number":864,"text":"  carries the unexercised capability as a residual (P6). In either case\n"},{"number":865,"text":"  the unexercised part, B above, has no result: in every conjunction over\n"},{"number":866,"text":"  it, it is a planned assessment without a closed result, and the known\n"},{"number":867,"text":"  failure A survives with it ([Conjunction of results](#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":868,"text":"  The evaluation's result and the step's stop state answer different\n"},{"number":869,"text":"  questions, so the step's stop value never becomes the evaluation's\n"},{"number":870,"text":"  result.\n"},{"number":871,"text":"\n"},{"number":872,"text":"Foundation to law for results and their combination (family F3). Algebra/Conjunction of results","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md#FOUNDATIONS%2F4.%20Algebra%2FConjunction%20of%20results","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","sha256":"79b5437ef779d80ec48c0af13cce2ff0f43bf6c44b06e983caad2a43a38aca55","start_line":939,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/FOUNDATIONS.md","lines":[{"number":939,"text":"### Conjunction of results\n"},{"number":940,"text":"\n"},{"number":941,"text":"Conjunction combines results into one result for a composite predicate: a\n"},{"number":942,"text":"claim made of component claims, a decision over several evaluations, or\n"},{"number":943,"text":"the outer contract of composed steps. It is defined here once, over the\n"},{"number":944,"text":"core. A member or profile that combines results applies this rule and\n"},{"number":945,"text":"declares only the choices it leaves open (P4a, P4b, P5, P6). Purpose and\n"},{"number":946,"text":"material relation: failure, undecidability, non-performance and uncertain\n"},{"number":947,"text":"effects stay distinct after combination, so a composite can neither report\n"},{"number":948,"text":"success nor hide which kind of gap it has while one of them remains in\n"},{"number":949,"text":"what it requires.\n"},{"number":950,"text":"\n"},{"number":951,"text":"A conjunction takes three inputs and keeps them apart:\n"},{"number":952,"text":"\n"},{"number":953,"text":"1. the closed results returned, each a core value with its predicate and\n"},{"number":954,"text":"   domain outcome;\n"},{"number":955,"text":"2. the planned assessments that have no closed result applicable to the\n"},{"number":956,"text":"   composite: evaluations the composite requires that were not performed,\n"},{"number":957,"text":"   or whose result is absent, stale, bound to another subject or basis, or\n"},{"number":958,"text":"   incapable of establishing its claim;\n"},{"number":959,"text":"3. the required coverage that no planned assessment addresses: for a\n"},{"number":960,"text":"   required obligation set R and the coverage C that the planned\n"},{"number":961,"text":"   assessments admit, the uncovered coverage R minus C.\n"},{"number":962,"text":"\n"},{"number":963,"text":"Gaps. A conjunction with any item in the second or third input is never\n"},{"number":964,"text":"`satisfied`. Its record names which kind of gap it has, not performed,\n"},{"number":965,"text":"uncovered or both, and each item. An uncovered obligation is never\n"},{"number":966,"text":"reported as satisfied or as an omitted planned assessment; a planned\n"},{"number":967,"text":"assessment without a closed result is never reported as uncovered or as an\n"},{"number":968,"text":"`indeterminate` component.\n"},{"number":969,"text":"\n"},{"number":970,"text":"Stale results. A held result is stale for a composite when the basis it\n"},{"number":971,"text":"binds is not the basis the composite requires of that component, because\n"},{"number":972,"text":"a later state has superseded or advanced it or because it binds another\n"},{"number":973,"text":"subject or basis (§2, Basis). Two questions stay apart, so that one\n"},{"number":974,"text":"composite has one reported value (P3, P5, P6):\n"},{"number":975,"text":"\n"},{"number":976,"text":"- an evaluation performed on a subject or basis that is stale, advanced,\n"},{"number":977,"text":"  ambiguous or mismatched against the one it must bind returns\n"},{"number":978,"text":"  `invalid_basis` for its own predicate, or is reactivated on the current\n"},{"number":979,"text":"  basis; [RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)\n"},{"number":980,"text":"  states this law over frames, and a conjunction that receives that\n"},{"number":981,"text":"  `invalid_basis` holds it as a returned result;\n"},{"number":982,"text":"- a component whose only held result is stale has no closed result\n"},{"number":983,"text":"  applicable to the composite: on the basis the composite requires, its\n"},{"number":984,"text":"  evaluation was not performed. It is a planned assessment without a\n"},{"number":985,"text":"  closed result, in the second input, and a gap. Its stale value is\n"},{"number":986,"text":"  neither counted as a returned result nor relabelled `invalid_basis` for\n"},{"number":987,"text":"  the composite, and it stays in the record with its own basis;\n"},{"number":988,"text":"- the declared basis relations disagree (Reported value below) only among\n"},{"number":989,"text":"  returned results, each bound to the basis the composite requires of it,\n"},{"number":990,"text":"  whose bases the declared rule requires to agree or to join in a coherent\n"},{"number":991,"text":"  composite basis, and which do not.\n"},{"number":992,"text":"\n"},{"number":993,"text":"A stale `satisfied` never counts toward the composite. Purpose and\n"},{"number":994,"text":"material relation: answering one stale component as a gap in one place and\n"},{"number":995,"text":"as `invalid_basis` in another would give one composite two reported\n"},{"number":996,"text":"values; keeping the evaluation's own value apart from the composite's gap\n"},{"number":997,"text":"keeps the reported value unique and the stale result visible.\n"},{"number":998,"text":"\n"},{"number":999,"text":"Survival. Every known failure (a `falsified` result with its\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"counterexample), every planned assessment without a closed result and\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"every uncovered obligation is carried with the composite and survives every\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"join: combining conjunctions takes the union of known failures and of\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"planned assessments without a closed result, and recomputes uncovered\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"coverage over the combined obligations. A known failure and a gap of\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"either kind survive every join. Common agreement among contributors\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"cannot discard a constraint or a material counterexample that only one\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"contributor found. A missing, wrong-subject, conflicted or indeterminate\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"mandatory result stays unresolved under the declared rule, and aggregate\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"satisfied status cannot replace it (P4b, P5).\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"Predicates travel. Each component keeps its predicate and domain outcome\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"through every join, so an uncertain effect stays distinct from a failure\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"and from an undecided claim, and a `satisfied` for one predicate never\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"counts toward another: a step's `satisfied` for \"a candidate is available\"\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"never counts toward the candidate's fitness or acceptance.\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"Reported value. The conjunction is `satisfied` only when every mandatory\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"result is `satisfied` with valid applicable evidence, the declared basis\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"relations agree, and the second and third inputs are empty. A composite\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"with a material counterexample to a mandatory constraint or an uncovered\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"required obligation cannot project success. Where a mandatory result is\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"not `satisfied`, the conjunction\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"reports a non-satisfied value chosen by its declared rule from those\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"returned; no universal order among the non-satisfied values exists, and\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"the member or profile that applies the conjunction declares its own in\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"its declared rule. Where every mandatory returned result is `satisfied`\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"and the declared basis relations disagree, the conjunction reports\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"`invalid_basis`, because no coherent composite basis supports the\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"composite predicate (§2, Basis); any gaps stay recorded by kind. Where\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"every mandatory returned result is `satisfied`, the declared basis\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"relations agree and a gap remains, the conjunction reports\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"`indeterminate`, because the results it holds cannot decide the composite\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"predicate; that value is the conjunction's own, and the gaps stay\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"recorded by kind. A `falsified` result that is not mandatory stays in the\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"conjunction's record with its predicate and is never discarded. Where\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"every mandatory result is `satisfied`, the declared basis relations agree\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"and no gap remains, a material counterexample to a mandatory constraint\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"falsifies the conjunction whichever contributor found it, and without one\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"the conjunction's value is the one its declared rule gives over the\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"mandatory results.\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"The declared rule. A conjunction declares which results are mandatory; how\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"conflict and indeterminacy are handled; which basis relations must agree,\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"results on different bases combining only under a declared coherent\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"composite basis (§2, Basis); which decision authority owns the\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"conjunction; how results that are not mandatory count; and whether any\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"result may veto or defer the decision.\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"Conjunction does not transfer the semantic authority of a contributing\n"},{"number":1049,"text":"evaluation (P6, P4a).\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"Composition of results. The result of composed steps for the outer\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"predicate is the conjunction of the steps' results, with the outer\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"contract's obligations as the required coverage. That each step returned\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"`satisfied` supports the outer predicate only where the refinement's\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"premises hold ([ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement),\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"Refinement).\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1109,"heading":"FOUNDATIONS/4. They are the shared owner for\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"the preservation, assertion, provenance, quantified-assurance, reuse and\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"formal-representation obligations in this corpus; ACTIVATION §1, §4, §5 and §7, EVALUATION §1 and §3,\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"ASSURANCE §3, §10, §11 and §14, RELEASE §8 and §9, SPEC_METHOD §4 and\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"any a_c interpretation apply them and state no second relation (P6).\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"A tenant chooses its representation and execution within these obligations.
