The required order is: declare the outcome\n"},{"number":645,"text":"traversal over typed assets; publish the declarative GTL/ABG carrier\n"},{"number":646,"text":"structure; implement only the minimal imperative adapter code that remains\n"},{"number":647,"text":"necessary (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":648,"text":"\n"},{"number":649,"text":"An outcome traversal declares the governed movement before\n"},{"number":650,"text":"implementation: source asset type; target asset type; edge traversal or\n"},{"number":651,"text":"graph-function name; closure or evaluation obligation; lineage obligation;\n"},{"number":652,"text":"ambiguity or gap obligation; allowed `F_D`, `F_P` and `F_H` bindings. The\n"},{"number":653,"text":"declarative carrier structure is GTL graph functions, typed nodes,\n"},{"number":654,"text":"vectors, operator bindings, evaluator bindings, carrier schemas, policy\n"},{"number":655,"text":"declarations, projection declarations and lineage ledger declarations\n"},{"number":656,"text":"(P0, P3).\n"},{"number":657,"text":"\n"},{"number":658,"text":"Imperative adapter code is lawful only where it transports or persists\n"},{"number":659,"text":"facts: file or network IO; CLI or API transport; event persistence;\n"},{"number":660,"text":"runtime invocation; projection rendering; tool execution already admitted\n"},{"number":661,"text":"by a declared traversal. Imperative code must not own domain meaning,\n"},{"number":662,"text":"semantic target movement, step selection, closure semantics, lineage truth\n"},{"number":663,"text":"or constructive workflow truth. Framework behaviour implemented\n"},{"number":664,"text":"imperatively first and only later described in GTL vocabulary is\n"},{"number":665,"text":"ODD-shaped but not yet ODD-built (P6, P0).\n"},{"number":666,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":673,"heading":"ODD/11. Callers are never bound directly to hidden inner vectors (P4a,\n"},{"number":680,"text":"P3).\n"},{"number":681,"text":"\n"},{"number":682,"text":"Where a public carrier refines into inner executable structure, the live\n"},{"number":683,"text":"traversal boundaries are published explicitly through lawful GTL boundary\n"},{"number":684,"text":"surfaces such as `RefinementBoundary` or `CandidateFamily`. ABG owns continuation authority, re-entry after\n"},{"number":698,"text":"publish boundaries, the graph-call lifecycle, and step selection over the\n"},{"number":699,"text":"declared graph (P6, P0).\n"},{"number":700,"text":"\n"},{"number":701,"text":"The product may publish typed assets and evidence, execute one admitted\n"},{"number":702,"text":"bounded constructive step, publish downstream read models or domain\n"},{"number":703,"text":"overlays, and return control to ABG. The product must not own a hidden\n"},{"number":704,"text":"continuation loop; carry multi-step controller memory across publish\n"},{"number":705,"text":"boundaries; infer later steps locally instead of re-entering through ABG;\n"},{"number":706,"text":"treat public `next` and explicit graph-function continuation as rival\n"},{"number":707,"text":"authorities inside one controller; or build product-local orchestration\n"},{"number":708,"text":"that in effect replaces ABG (P6).\n"},{"number":709,"text":"\n"},{"number":710,"text":"An application that replaces ABG continuation with tenant-local control\n"},{"number":711,"text":"flow no longer behaves as an ODD application over GTL/ABG. It has drifted\n"},{"number":712,"text":"into a different architecture that only happens to publish some\n"},{"number":713,"text":"ODD-shaped artifacts (P6).\n"},{"number":714,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":774,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.5B Execution authority audit","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.5B%20Execution%20authority%20audit","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"4db12021abf1c17a65074f45a0bf2ba9d1c8cf610fc18d4f195beaf704b92347","start_line":715,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":715,"text":"### 11.5B Execution authority audit\n"},{"number":716,"text":"\n"},{"number":717,"text":"An ODD product over GTL/ABG that changes runtime, `start` or `iterate`,\n"},{"number":718,"text":"worker transport, actor invocation, process supervision, plugin dispatch,\n"},{"number":719,"text":"event projection, closure, assurance, retry or continuation semantics\n"},{"number":720,"text":"must include an execution-authority audit before activation and closure\n"},{"number":721,"text":"(P6).\n"},{"number":722,"text":"\n"},{"number":723,"text":"The audit must prove that exactly one execution authority exists for the\n"},{"number":724,"text":"affected traversal. For a consumer using the GTL and ABG roles, that\n"},{"number":725,"text":"authority is the one consumer-bound realisation of the ABG role, including\n"},{"number":726,"text":"when the realisation under change itself implements that role. A\n"},{"number":727,"text":"different realisation is lawful only under an explicitly ratified,\n"},{"number":728,"text":"non-overlapping runtime scope (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":729,"text":"\n"},{"number":730,"text":"The audit must inventory at least these surfaces (P6):\n"},{"number":731,"text":"\n"},{"number":732,"text":"| Surface | Lawful owner | Product or plugin role | Forbidden local implementation |\n"},{"number":733,"text":"| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n"},{"number":734,"text":"| Traversal selection and vector advance | ABG | Declare graph functions, vectors, assets, and domain policy inputs | Product-local runner deciding the next traversal step |\n"},{"number":735,"text":"| Actor invocation and process supervision | ABG | Provide actor bindings, prompts, payload adapters, and evidence adapters | Product-local worker `spawn`, `spawnSync`, `exec`, timeout, kill, or stdout/stderr supervision outside the ABG actor seam |\n"},{"number":736,"text":"| Retry, correction, continuation, and re-entry | ABG | Publish bounded-step outputs and return control | Product-local retry loops, carry-over controller memory, or hidden `next` authority |\n"},{"number":737,"text":"| Runtime event emission, append, replay, and projection | ABG | Map domain evidence into admitted event payloads | Direct event append, side ledger mutation, or projection reconstruction that bypasses ABG runtime truth |\n"},{"number":738,"text":"| Closure fold and assurance gate | ABG, with product policy and gain inputs | Provide domain interpretation, evaluators, gap reasons, and policy weights | Worker self-report or product postflight directly closing the runtime unit |\n"},{"number":739,"text":"\n"},{"number":740,"text":"Where these surfaces admit a consequential entity transformation, ABG's\n"},{"number":741,"text":"admission authority is the graph-native specialisation of transformation\n"},{"number":742,"text":"admission completeness, whose admission semantics\n"},{"number":743,"text":"[ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#complete-enclosing-relation-admission) owns;\n"},{"number":744,"text":"the software-design profile applies that law in\n"},{"number":745,"text":"[DESIGN_MODULE, Transformation admission completeness](DESIGN_MODULE.md#transformation-admission-completeness-up-016).\n"},{"number":746,"text":"ABG's broader execution, supervision, retry and projection authority\n"},{"number":747,"text":"continues to derive from this profile and is not thereby reclassified as\n"},{"number":748,"text":"admission authority. `F_P` and `F_H` are the ODD projections of the\n"},{"number":749,"text":"candidate-producer and human-adjudication roles, which this profile binds\n"},{"number":750,"text":"to the source concepts of SPEC_METHOD §5 in\n"},{"number":751,"text":"[§5 Probabilistic compute](#probabilistic-compute) (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":752,"text":"\n"},{"number":753,"text":"Reviewing produced artifacts alone does not satisfy the audit. It must\n"},{"number":754,"text":"include a code, call-graph or static-surface review appropriate to the\n"},{"number":755,"text":"language and tenant, and it must name the evidence used to rule out hidden\n"},{"number":756,"text":"execution authority (P6).\n"},{"number":757,"text":"\n"},{"number":758,"text":"Any of these conditions prevents closure (P6):\n"},{"number":759,"text":"\n"},{"number":760,"text":"- a downstream product contains its own `start` or `iterate` loop for an\n"},{"number":761,"text":"  ABG traversal;\n"},{"number":762,"text":"- product or plugin code supervises worker processes outside the ABG\n"},{"number":763,"text":"  actor seam;\n"},{"number":764,"text":"- product or plugin code constructs retry, continuation or re-entry state\n"},{"number":765,"text":"  outside ABG;\n"},{"number":766,"text":"- product or plugin code appends runtime events or mutates runtime ledgers\n"},{"number":767,"text":"  without ABG admission;\n"},{"number":768,"text":"- plugin output carries next-vector, closure, actor-invocation, process\n"},{"number":769,"text":"  or runtime-event authority instead of evidence or policy input;\n"},{"number":770,"text":"- two controllers can each claim authority for one traversal.\n"},{"number":771,"text":"\n"},{"number":772,"text":"When any is present, the product may be useful but is not currently\n"},{"number":773,"text":"ODD-correct over GTL/ABG (P6).\n"},{"number":774,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":795,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.5C Projection-source coherence","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.5C%20Projection-source%20coherence","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"65135a43364b47da1dbf8e163c12375488fe27a9e8609d52ceed6e2d1e5845c0","start_line":775,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":775,"text":"### 11.5C Projection-source coherence\n"},{"number":776,"text":"\n"},{"number":777,"text":"Projection and query lanes are downstream read models over admitted\n"},{"number":778,"text":"carrier, runtime, event or source truth. They may summarise, index,\n"},{"number":779,"text":"filter or render that truth; they must not reconstruct an alternate\n"},{"number":780,"text":"authority surface beside the admitted carrier (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":781,"text":"\n"},{"number":782,"text":"For an ODD product: function catalogue views must reconcile to the\n"},{"number":783,"text":"admitted GTL module or public carrier; asset ownership and start-target\n"},{"number":784,"text":"views must be derived from, or structurally compared against, the admitted\n"},{"number":785,"text":"carrier they expose; runtime status views must derive from ABG runtime\n"},{"number":786,"text":"facts, events, replay or projection truth; domain query overlays must fail\n"},{"number":787,"text":"closed when the carrier they describe is missing, stale or structurally\n"},{"number":788,"text":"divergent (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":789,"text":"\n"},{"number":790,"text":"Name equality is not enough. A same-named graph function, node, carrier,\n"},{"number":791,"text":"policy or route with different inputs, outputs, vectors, declarations,\n"},{"number":792,"text":"ownership or closure law is a different truth surface until reconciled.\n"},{"number":793,"text":"Negative proof for a projection must include structural drift, not only\n"},{"number":794,"text":"missing source truth (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":795,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1435,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.5D Constructive evaluation and yield loop","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.5D%20Constructive%20evaluation%20and%20yield%20loop","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"058d4a6e9bbca76cd53f78582f146d23677839dddc8705aa431bf260da6b6a5e","start_line":796,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":796,"text":"### 11.5D Constructive evaluation and yield loop\n"},{"number":797,"text":"\n"},{"number":798,"text":"Every ODD product over GTL/ABG must preserve one constructive evaluation\n"},{"number":799,"text":"loop running from intent lineage and model synthesis through observation\n"},{"number":800,"text":"to the next lawful action. This is the profile's homeostasis loop, and\n"},{"number":801,"text":"its constitutional surface names the operative functions directly:\n"},{"number":802,"text":"`synthesize_model`, `eval_gap`, `evaluate_next` and `evaluate_action`\n"},{"number":803,"text":"(P2, P5, P6). The loop is this profile's binding of\n"},{"number":804,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Feedback and diagnosis](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation):\n"},{"number":805,"text":"it corrects towards the required conditions as observations arrive,\n"},{"number":806,"text":"guarantees neither convergence nor the adequacy of those conditions, and\n"},{"number":807,"text":"its diagnoses distinguish the four causes named there (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":808,"text":"\n"},{"number":809,"text":"The selected Product outcome under\n"},{"number":810,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §3 Outcome conservation](SPEC_METHOD.md#3-outcome-conservation) is external\n"},{"number":811,"text":"authority for this loop. Product models, gaps, assurance, ledgers and\n"},{"number":812,"text":"projections may interpret that outcome but cannot author, select or\n"},{"number":813,"text":"enlarge it. `evaluate_next` may select material work only within that\n"},{"number":814,"text":"outcome or within an admitted bounded prerequisite or experiment. Graph or\n"},{"number":815,"text":"edge closure is evidence toward Product acceptance and is neither Product\n"},{"number":816,"text":"nor release acceptance (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":817,"text":"\n"},{"number":818,"text":"The loop selects no further material work without another admitted basis\n"},{"number":819,"text":"once the selected outcome is accepted; an admitted prerequisite is\n"},{"number":820,"text":"discharged; an admitted experiment's stated decision is resolved; another\n"},{"number":821,"text":"admitted terminal condition is reached; or its governing basis or bound\n"},{"number":822,"text":"is exhausted, rejected, withdrawn, superseded, repriced away or\n"},{"number":823,"text":"falsified. A `reprice` disposition requests lawful constitutional\n"},{"number":824,"text":"re-entry; it neither performs the reprice nor selects the successor\n"},{"number":825,"text":"outcome (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":826,"text":"\n"},{"number":827,"text":"The loop is framework-independent. Implementations may use other carrier\n"},{"number":828,"text":"names but must keep this authority shape (P6, P4a):\n"},{"number":829,"text":"\n"},{"number":830,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":831,"text":"selected Product outcome and admitted bounded-basis refs\n"},{"number":832,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":833,"text":"\n"},{"number":834,"text":"IntentLineage\n"},{"number":835,"text":"-> ProductAssetModel\n"},{"number":836,"text":"-> ObservationSnapshot\n"},{"number":837,"text":"-> GapPressureRow\n"},{"number":838,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":839,"text":"-> PriorityProjection\n"},{"number":840,"text":"-> ConstructionIntent\n"},{"number":841,"text":"-> AdmittedEvidence\n"},{"number":842,"text":"-> EdgeFulfillmentLedger\n"},{"number":843,"text":"-> EdgeClosureDecision\n"},{"number":844,"text":"-> NextActionProjection\n"},{"number":845,"text":"```\n"},{"number":846,"text":"\n"},{"number":847,"text":"The objects have these meanings (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":848,"text":"\n"},{"number":849,"text":"| Object | Definition | Authority |\n"},{"number":850,"text":"| --- | --- | --- |\n"},{"number":851,"text":"| `IntentLineage` | Admitted source intent and its lineage refs: human, imported source, prior product, intent engine, or prior synthesized construction intent. | ABG event-log truth over source intent. It seeds the product model and must not invent graph actions. |\n"},{"number":852,"text":"| `ProductAssetModel` | Desired and known typed asset model synthesized from intent lineage, prior model, and admitted product truth. | Product-owned model truth whose publication basis is carried by admitted events and product-owned projection refs. It is not runtime fact or action authority. |\n"},{"number":853,"text":"| `Worksite` | Current workspace, runtime archive, transform assets, product asset root, profile, and observed file or process state. | Observable substrate, not authority by itself. |\n"},{"number":854,"text":"| `RuntimeEventLog` | Append-only admitted runtime facts. | ABG runtime truth. |\n"},{"number":855,"text":"| `RuntimeProjection` | Replay-derived current runtime state over event log and execution basis. | ABG projection truth. |\n"},{"number":856,"text":"| `ObservationSnapshot` | Read-only view of runtime truth plus worksite facts relevant to construction. | ABG evaluator carrier with product domain rows. |\n"},{"number":857,"text":"| `GapPressureRow` | Typed pressure over missing, partial, blocked, waiting, or ambiguous assets and evidence. | Product domain meaning over admitted observation. |\n"},{"number":858,"text":"| `TargetObligationBinding` | Exact binding from gap pressure to the selected Product outcome, any admitted prerequisite or experiment basis, target assets, required roles, evidence refs, and admissible graph outcomes. | Product domain binding over GTL/ABG action authority. |\n"},{"number":859,"text":"| `ActionCatalog` | Published lawful graph actions: graph functions, vectors, targets, inputs, and eligible outcomes. | GTL/product publication consumed by ABG. |\n"},{"number":860,"text":"| `NextActionBasis` | Sum type naming why `evaluate_next` is being called: `initial_selection`, `post_yield_resume`, `post_close_graph_continuation`, `post_retry`, `post_repair`, `post_reenter`, `post_reprice`, or `post_block`. `post_reprice` records a re-entry request and carries no action-selection authority. | Dispatch basis for next-action evaluation. It is not a separate controller. |\n"},{"number":861,"text":"| `PriorityProjection` | Deterministic ranking over bound lawful actions under visible policy. | ABG evaluator kernel plus product policy. |\n"},{"number":862,"text":"| `ConstructionIntent` | Admitted selected action for one bounded graph invocation, preserving the selected outcome or admitted bounded-basis refs carried by its target binding. | ABG admission and traversal authority. |\n"},{"number":863,"text":"| `AdmittedEvidence` | Admitted worker, process, product, execution, materialization, liveness, and postflight evidence. | ABG/product admission, not worker self-closure. |\n"},{"number":864,"text":"| `EdgeFulfillmentLedger` | Evidence and convergence carrier for one edge attempt or version. | Closure evidence truth. |\n"},{"number":865,"text":"| `EdgeClosureDecision` | Sum type over the ledger: close, yield, retry, repair, re-enter, reprice, block. | Closure decision truth. |\n"},{"number":866,"text":"| `NextActionProjection` | Read model that observes `NextActionBasis` plus current truth and selects a next graph action only when lawful. | ABG next-action evaluation projection with product policy. |\n"},{"number":867,"text":"\n"},{"number":868,"text":"The loop has one model-synthesis function and three distinct evaluation\n"},{"number":869,"text":"functions. They may share underlying libraries; they must not share\n"},{"number":870,"text":"authority (P6):\n"},{"number":871,"text":"\n"},{"number":872,"text":"| Function | Inputs | Output | Boundary |\n"},{"number":873,"text":"| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n"},{"number":874,"text":"| `synthesize_model` | `IntentLineage + prior ProductAssetModel + admitted product truth` | `ProductAssetModel` | Model synthesis. It may update desired and known typed asset truth. It must not observe the worksite, select work, invoke work, or close work. |\n"},{"number":875,"text":"| `eval_gap` | `ProductAssetModel + RuntimeEventLog + RuntimeProjection + Worksite` | `ObservationSnapshot + GapPressureRow` | Read-only gap discovery. It compares desired model truth to observed reality and emits missing, partial, blocked, waiting, or ambiguous asset pressure. It does not choose work and does not close work. |\n"},{"number":876,"text":"| `evaluate_next` | `NextActionBasis + fresh eval_gap + TargetObligationBinding + ActionCatalog + Policy` | `PriorityProjection + NextActionProjection + selected_action`; for a typed no-action, also its own core result (A4) | Next-action selection. `TargetObligationBinding` carries the exact selected Product outcome and any admitted bounded-basis refs. `NextActionBasis` is either `initial_selection(IntentLineage, ProductAssetModel)` or one explicit post-action basis derived from an `EdgeClosureDecision`: `post_yield_resume`, `post_close_graph_continuation`, `post_retry`, `post_repair`, `post_reenter`, `post_reprice`, or `post_block`. Except for unresolved `post_reprice`, which returns typed no-action pending separately admitted constitutional authority, it may select only published lawful graph actions that bind to the gap and governing basis. It does not admit construction intent and does not evaluate the result of an action. |\n"},{"number":877,"text":"| `evaluate_action` | `ConstructionIntent + AdmittedEvidence + TargetObligationBinding + Policy` | `EdgeFulfillmentLedger + EdgeClosureDecision` | Action-result evaluation. It decides close, yield, retry, repair, re-enter, reprice, or block for the action just taken. It does not choose the next graph action. |\n"},{"number":878,"text":"\n"},{"number":879,"text":"The word evaluator is not sufficient by itself. A design, ticket, code\n"},{"number":880,"text":"module or proof must name which function it implements or consumes:\n"},{"number":881,"text":"`synthesize_model`, `eval_gap`, `evaluate_next` or `evaluate_action`\n"},{"number":882,"text":"(P6, P3).\n"},{"number":883,"text":"\n"},{"number":884,"text":"Intent has lineage through the loop. Bootstrap or external intent may come\n"},{"number":885,"text":"from a human, an imported source, a prior product or an intent engine;\n"},{"number":886,"text":"that intent seeds the product asset model that `eval_gap` uses. Current\n"},{"number":887,"text":"construction intent is synthesised against that model and the observed\n"},{"number":888,"text":"gap, then admitted by a distinct admission step after `evaluate_next`\n"},{"number":889,"text":"selects a published graph action. Intent does not invent unpublished\n"},{"number":890,"text":"actions: gap-derived action selection supplies the selected action basis\n"},{"number":891,"text":"for admitting current construction intent over an already-published graph\n"},{"number":892,"text":"function or vector. `ConstructionIntent` must cite the lineage, the\n"},{"number":893,"text":"selected action and the `TargetObligationBinding` that preserve the exact\n"},{"number":894,"text":"selected Product outcome and any admitted bounded-basis refs (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":895,"text":"\n"},{"number":896,"text":"The loop is governed by the axioms A0 to A16, each a labelled paragraph\n"},{"number":897,"text":"below (P6).\n"},{"number":898,"text":"\n"},{"number":899,"text":"A0 One surface. There is one authoritative computational surface for\n"},{"number":900,"text":"traversal consequence (P6, P3):\n"},{"number":901,"text":"\n"},{"number":902,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":903,"text":"IntentLineage\n"},{"number":904,"text":"-> ProductAssetModel\n"},{"number":905,"text":"-> ObservationSnapshot\n"},{"number":906,"text":"-> GapPressureRow\n"},{"number":907,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":908,"text":"-> PriorityProjection\n"},{"number":909,"text":"-> ConstructionIntent\n"},{"number":910,"text":"-> AdmittedEvidence\n"},{"number":911,"text":"-> EdgeFulfillmentLedger\n"},{"number":912,"text":"-> EdgeClosureDecision\n"},{"number":913,"text":"-> NextActionProjection\n"},{"number":914,"text":"```\n"},{"number":915,"text":"\n"},{"number":916,"text":"No CLI branch, prompt prose, postflight string, gap-dossier action list,\n"},{"number":917,"text":"query projection, service method or local operator summary may become a\n"},{"number":918,"text":"rival source of traversal truth (P6).\n"},{"number":919,"text":"\n"},{"number":920,"text":"A1 Worksite is observed, not trusted. The file system, process output,\n"},{"number":921,"text":"screen logs, worker artifacts and product files are observations. They\n"},{"number":922,"text":"become authority only after admission into typed evidence and their fold\n"},{"number":923,"text":"into ledger and decision truth (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":924,"text":"\n"},{"number":925,"text":"A1a Workspace-ledger governed work pair. The worksite or workspace and the\n"},{"number":926,"text":"ledger form the governed work pair (P3, P4b):\n"},{"number":927,"text":"\n"},{"number":928,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":929,"text":"W = mutable workspace under construction\n"},{"number":930,"text":"L = immutable governed ledger of work over W\n"},{"number":931,"text":"E = immutable event log / replay spine\n"},{"number":932,"text":"Ev = evaluator work over L\n"},{"number":933,"text":"```\n"},{"number":934,"text":"\n"},{"number":935,"text":"The workspace is where F_P construction happens. The ledger is the\n"},{"number":936,"text":"immutable governed account of closure-relevant work over that workspace;\n"},{"number":937,"text":"it is not a copy of the workspace but the admitted trace of callout basis,\n"},{"number":938,"text":"observed deltas, file refs, digests, execution evidence, obligations\n"},{"number":939,"text":"touched, claims made, evaluator inputs, evaluator outputs and admission\n"},{"number":940,"text":"status. The loop is (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":941,"text":"\n"},{"number":942,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":943,"text":"F_P acts in W.\n"},{"number":944,"text":"Admission records governed facts in L.\n"},{"number":945,"text":"E orders and anchors L entries with predecessor refs.\n"},{"number":946,"text":"Ev evaluates a declared L snapshot, not ambient W.\n"},{"number":947,"text":"Ev output is itself F_P work and is admitted back into L/E.\n"},{"number":948,"text":"L/E constrain the next lawful F_P action in W.\n"},{"number":949,"text":"```\n"},{"number":950,"text":"\n"},{"number":951,"text":"The consistency rule is (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":952,"text":"\n"},{"number":953,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":954,"text":"W can change without being true.\n"},{"number":955,"text":"L can be true without being the whole W.\n"},{"number":956,"text":"Closure can only use W through L.\n"},{"number":957,"text":"Eval can only judge W through L.\n"},{"number":958,"text":"Eval only affects traversal after its own L/E admission.\n"},{"number":959,"text":"```\n"},{"number":960,"text":"\n"},{"number":961,"text":"Every closure-relevant F_P callout that does work needs ledger admission.\n"},{"number":962,"text":"Evaluator work is not outside F_P merely because it reads ledgers: it is\n"},{"number":963,"text":"F_P work over governed ledger state, and its result must be admitted into\n"},{"number":964,"text":"the immutable ledger and event spine before it can affect closure, routing\n"},{"number":965,"text":"or traversal. Corrections append or supersede ledger and event facts; they\n"},{"number":966,"text":"do not rewrite the governed history of work (P4b, P6, P3).\n"},{"number":967,"text":"\n"},{"number":968,"text":"A1b Ledger is governed attention. A ledger is the system's governed\n"},{"number":969,"text":"attention over construction history. This is a structural analogy and not\n"},{"number":970,"text":"an implementation dependency on transformer attention: model attention\n"},{"number":971,"text":"selects from context through learned weights, while ODD ledger attention\n"},{"number":972,"text":"is typed, immutable, lineage-constrained, policy-bounded and replayable.\n"},{"number":973,"text":"An evaluator may attend only to admitted ledger rows reachable through\n"},{"number":974,"text":"declared lineage, predecessor refs, target binding, policy and the\n"},{"number":975,"text":"relevant event-log cursor. Workspace facts, worker prose, archives,\n"},{"number":976,"text":"summaries and controller memory outside that reachable ledger set lie\n"},{"number":977,"text":"outside the evaluator's lawful attention surface. Lineage is therefore\n"},{"number":978,"text":"not only provenance bookkeeping: it is the attention graph that decides\n"},{"number":979,"text":"which evidence the evaluator may see, what it must ignore, and which\n"},{"number":980,"text":"predecessor chain makes the judgment reproducible (P0, P6, P3).\n"},{"number":981,"text":"\n"},{"number":982,"text":"A2 Exact target binding. Every constructive action must bind the current\n"},{"number":983,"text":"gap to exact target assets and obligations before invocation (P2, P3):\n"},{"number":984,"text":"\n"},{"number":985,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":986,"text":"selected Product outcome ref\n"},{"number":987,"text":"+ optional admitted prerequisite or experiment basis ref\n"},{"number":988,"text":"+ gap pressure + target assets + required roles + evidence refs\n"},{"number":989,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":990,"text":"```\n"},{"number":991,"text":"\n"},{"number":992,"text":"A broad edge cannot satisfy a specific product or evidence gap unless the\n"},{"number":993,"text":"binding proves that edge is the lawful action for those exact assets\n"},{"number":994,"text":"(P2).\n"},{"number":995,"text":"\n"},{"number":996,"text":"A3 Published action law. `evaluate_next` may rank only published lawful\n"},{"number":997,"text":"actions from the action catalogue. If the desired action is unpublished,\n"},{"number":998,"text":"the lawful result is a typed no-action disposition, not a fallback to a\n"},{"number":999,"text":"broad executive graph or a local script (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"A4 `evaluate_next` totality. `evaluate_next` must be total. On\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"`initial_selection` it selects from the current model, current gap, target\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"binding, catalogue and policy. On `post_yield_resume` it resumes or yields\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"the same edge from replay-visible resume truth without classifying the\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"action as failure. On `post_close_graph_continuation` it may select the\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"next graph edge after the current edge closed, or no action when the graph\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"is complete. On `post_retry`, `post_repair`, `post_reenter` and\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"`post_block` it follows this rule (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"if higher-priority lawful action exists:\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"  select it\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"else if current graph edge remains lawful:\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"  follow the graph\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"else if authority is missing:\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"  reprice or block\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"else:\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"  block with typed no-action disposition\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"On `post_reprice`, `evaluate_next` must return a typed no-action\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"disposition while constitutional re-entry stays unresolved. The reprice\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"decision cannot authorise a replacement action; work may be evaluated\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"again only after lawful re-entry separately admits an exact selected\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"Product outcome or bounded basis and supplies it through a new\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"`initial_selection` or a basis-bearing resume. Default graph following is\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"ordinary, but it is still an `evaluate_next` decision and not hidden\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"sequential control (P5, P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"Selection and its results. `evaluate_next`'s selection of what is\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"invoked next is invocational data (A11) and is not itself a value of the\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"core result algebra of\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). A typed no-action\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"disposition, however, records a material determination: that no\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"published lawful action can be selected. Each typed no-action returns its\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"own result for the predicate \"a published lawful action can be selected\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"for the current gap on the exact basis\", refined by cause as A8 refines\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"`block`, on `initial_selection` and after a closure decision alike. A\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"closure decision it follows (`post_retry`, `post_repair`, `post_reenter`,\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"`post_block`, `post_reprice`) keeps its own value for the edge predicate\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"under A8 below and is evidence for the selection, not its result; neither\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"value counts toward the other's predicate\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"An earlier result stands for a no-action only where it decided this same\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"predicate on the current basis. In the rule above, `reprice or block` and\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"`block with typed no-action disposition` name typed no-actions of\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"`evaluate_next`, not closure decisions, which only `evaluate_action` makes\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"(A4a); on `post_reprice` the no-action is `no_action(undeclared)`, naming\n"},{"number":1049,"text":"the outcome or bound the reprice found undeclared and the re-entry that\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"would declare it (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"| Typed no-action | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"| `no_action(undeclared)` | out_of_frame | the gap needs an action that the admitted catalogue does not publish, or a relation, capability or authority that no admitted basis declares (A3); the value names what is missing and its owner, as for `block(undeclared)` |\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"| `no_action(basis)` | invalid_basis | no published action is lawful on the current bound outcome, catalogue and policy, which cannot support the gap, as for `block(basis)` |\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"The typed no-action stays beside its core value as the domain outcome,\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"and producing the next-action projection establishes availability only\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"([ACTIVATION §3 Construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability)).\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"Where the graph is complete and no action follows a closed edge, nothing\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"is refused and no selection determination is made: the empty selection is\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"invocational data, and `close` keeps its own value for the edge predicate\n"},{"number":1063,"text":"under A8.\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"A4a Evaluation function separation. `synthesize_model`, `eval_gap`,\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"`evaluate_next` and `evaluate_action` are separate authority functions.\n"},{"number":1067,"text":"`synthesize_model` may synthesise the current product asset model from\n"},{"number":1068,"text":"event-log-backed intent lineage, prior model and admitted product truth\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"only; it must not observe the worksite, admit construction intent, invoke\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"work, close work or select the next action. `eval_gap` may emit\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"observation and gap pressure only; it must not admit construction intent,\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"invoke work, close work or select the next action. `evaluate_action` may\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"fold admitted action evidence into ledger and closure decision only; it\n"},{"number":1074,"text":"must not select the next graph action. `evaluate_next` may bind target\n"},{"number":1075,"text":"obligations, rank lawful published actions and publish the next-action\n"},{"number":1076,"text":"projection; it must not admit construction intent or decide whether the\n"},{"number":1077,"text":"prior action closed, yielded, failed or needs repair except by consuming\n"},{"number":1078,"text":"the admitted `EdgeClosureDecision`. A module that lets one of these\n"},{"number":1079,"text":"functions exercise another's authority creates a rival control surface\n"},{"number":1080,"text":"and violates A0 (P6).\n"},{"number":1081,"text":"\n"},{"number":1082,"text":"A5 Bounded construction and declared authority. F_P may inspect, discover, reason, draft,\n"},{"number":1083,"text":"transform and propose within the bounded action. F_P must not close the\n"},{"number":1084,"text":"edge, emit runtime events, mutate ledgers or decide re-entry. Product admission\n"},{"number":1085,"text":"owns admission of Product facts; ABG's declared admission mechanisms own\n"},{"number":1086,"text":"admission of typed evidence and evaluator outputs into L/E (A1/A1a).\n"},{"number":1087,"text":"Closure truth is ABG's admitted `evaluate_action` fold over admitted evidence,\n"},{"number":1088,"text":"recorded as `EdgeClosureDecision` under A4a, A6 and A8. F_P evaluator outputs\n"},{"number":1089,"text":"remain proposals until their own admission; merely declaring an evaluation\n"},{"number":1090,"text":"does not establish durable evidence, closure or permission.\n"},{"number":1091,"text":"\n"},{"number":1092,"text":"These admission gates retain deterministic validation against their declared\n"},{"number":1093,"text":"criteria and their own grants; §11.7A applies that obligation to method\n"},{"number":1094,"text":"artifacts. A gate claiming common F_D additionally establishes §5's\n"},{"number":1095,"text":"total-domain eligibility. The kind's no-authority rule is\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds)'s;\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"here it preserves the separate Product and ABG admission and closure owners.\n"},{"number":1098,"text":"Each operation names its admissible evidence and permitted consequences\n"},{"number":1099,"text":"(P0, P6). An F_P\n"},{"number":1100,"text":"worker must not be given an F_D-authored semantic extraction recipe when\n"},{"number":1101,"text":"the edge requires F_P judgment (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"A6 Evidence before closure. No edge closes from raw artifact presence, a\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"raw worker report, raw process success or a CLI summary. Closure is a fold\n"},{"number":1105,"text":"over admitted evidence (P6):\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"AdmittedEvidence\n"},{"number":1109,"text":"-> EdgeFulfillmentLedger\n"},{"number":1110,"text":"-> EdgeClosureDecision\n"},{"number":1111,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1112,"text":"\n"},{"number":1113,"text":"A7 Ledger is evidence, not action selector. `EdgeFulfillmentLedger`\n"},{"number":1114,"text":"records evidence and convergence (P6, P3):\n"},{"number":1115,"text":"\n"},{"number":1116,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1117,"text":"counts\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"obligation rows\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"materialization refs\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"liveness refs\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"admission refs\n"},{"number":1122,"text":"edge_converged\n"},{"number":1123,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1124,"text":"\n"},{"number":1125,"text":"It does not select the next action. Action selection belongs to\n"},{"number":1126,"text":"`evaluate_next` over `EdgeClosureDecision` plus fresh `eval_gap` truth\n"},{"number":1127,"text":"(P6).\n"},{"number":1128,"text":"\n"},{"number":1129,"text":"A8 Closure decision is a sum type. The closure decision vocabulary is\n"},{"number":1130,"text":"closed (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1131,"text":"\n"},{"number":1132,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1133,"text":"close\n"},{"number":1134,"text":"yield\n"},{"number":1135,"text":"retry\n"},{"number":1136,"text":"repair\n"},{"number":1137,"text":"re-enter\n"},{"number":1138,"text":"reprice\n"},{"number":1139,"text":"block\n"},{"number":1140,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1141,"text":"\n"},{"number":1142,"text":"Each disposition is replay-visible and must carry basis and reason refs\n"},{"number":1143,"text":"sufficient to reproduce the decision (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1144,"text":"\n"},{"number":1145,"text":"Mapping of the closure decision to the core result algebra. Purpose: [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) states\n"},{"number":1146,"text":"every outcome in the core or in a refinement that maps each refined value\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"to exactly one core value and adds no core value. Material relation: a\n"},{"number":1148,"text":"composite over the edge joins each closure decision as one core value, so\n"},{"number":1149,"text":"a failure, an undecided closure and a needed re-entry stay distinct (P5,\n"},{"number":1150,"text":"P6). The closure decision is `evaluate_action`'s result over admitted\n"},{"number":1151,"text":"evidence, mapped for the predicate \"the edge's obligations are fulfilled\n"},{"number":1152,"text":"on the exact basis\". The bounded action it judges has its own step result\n"},{"number":1153,"text":"under [ACTIVATION §3 Construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability)\n"},{"number":1154,"text":"for \"a candidate is available\", and neither value counts toward the\n"},{"number":1155,"text":"other's predicate\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":1157,"text":"Each decision keeps its own vocabulary and its basis and reason refs\n"},{"number":1158,"text":"beside its core value (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1159,"text":"\n"},{"number":1160,"text":"Refined by cause. Where a decision would map to one of two core values\n"},{"number":1161,"text":"according to its cause, the cause is part of the refined value, written\n"},{"number":1162,"text":"in parentheses as in `re-enter(basis)`, and each refined value maps once\n"},{"number":1163,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Refinements). The cause is read from the\n"},{"number":1164,"text":"decision's basis and reason refs, which A8 requires to be sufficient to\n"},{"number":1165,"text":"reproduce it. The seven decisions of A8 stay the closed vocabulary; a\n"},{"number":1166,"text":"refined value names a decision and its cause and adds no decision (P5,\n"},{"number":1167,"text":"P6). The causes are:\n"},{"number":1168,"text":"\n"},{"number":1169,"text":"- `retry(defeated)`: admissible evidence defeats the edge for this attempt\n"},{"number":1170,"text":"  while the same action stays lawful; `retry(undecided)`: every other\n"},{"number":1171,"text":"  retry, as after a liveness interruption, which alone never gives\n"},{"number":1172,"text":"  `retry(defeated)` (A10).\n"},{"number":1173,"text":"- `repair(implementation)` and `repair(proof)`: the edge's governing\n"},{"number":1174,"text":"  relation, basis and target binding stay coherent, and a local defect,\n"},{"number":1175,"text":"  in the implementation or in its proof, keeps the edge from closing, so\n"},{"number":1176,"text":"  a repair of the same edge is the lawful next action (A11).\n"},{"number":1177,"text":"  `repair(implementation)`: admitted evidence shows the implementation\n"},{"number":1178,"text":"  failing an edge obligation; `repair(proof)`: every other repair, the\n"},{"number":1179,"text":"  defect being in the proof.\n"},{"number":1180,"text":"- `re-enter(undeclared)` and `block(undeclared)`: the cause is a relation,\n"},{"number":1181,"text":"  capability or authority that no admitted basis declares;\n"},{"number":1182,"text":"  `re-enter(basis)` and `block(basis)`: every other cause, the current\n"},{"number":1183,"text":"  basis being unable to support the edge, as when it is stale, substituted\n"},{"number":1184,"text":"  or unrepairable. A decision with both causes records both and takes the\n"},{"number":1185,"text":"  `basis` value, as\n"},{"number":1186,"text":"  [ACTIVATION §3 Construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability)\n"},{"number":1187,"text":"  decides for `re_entry_requested`.\n"},{"number":1188,"text":"\n"},{"number":1189,"text":"| Decision | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1190,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1191,"text":"| `close` | satisfied | the ledger's admitted evidence fulfils the edge's obligations on the exact basis |\n"},{"number":1192,"text":"| `yield` | indeterminate | the edge stays lawful and the admitted evidence, progress or a waiting state, does not yet decide its obligations; the replay-visible resume basis names what would decide; no failure is classified, as A9 requires |\n"},{"number":1193,"text":"| `retry(defeated)` | falsified | the evidence that defeats the edge for this attempt is the counterexample; A9 separates this failure-classified re-attempt from yield |\n"},{"number":1194,"text":"| `retry(undecided)` | indeterminate | the attempt ended without evidence that decides the edge's obligations; the decision's reason refs name the re-attempt that would decide |\n"},{"number":1195,"text":"| `repair(implementation)` | falsified | the failing obligation row is the counterexample (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":1196,"text":"| `repair(proof)` | indeterminate | the defect is in the proof, so the admitted evidence cannot decide the obligation; the decision's reason refs name the repaired proof that would decide (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":1197,"text":"| `re-enter(undeclared)` | out_of_frame | the edge cannot close on its current basis because an upstream asset or governing relation must change, and the change needs a relation, capability or authority that no admitted basis declares; the decision names it and its owner |\n"},{"number":1198,"text":"| `re-enter(basis)` | invalid_basis | the edge cannot close on its current basis because an upstream asset or governing relation must change, and that basis cannot support the edge |\n"},{"number":1199,"text":"| `reprice` | out_of_frame | further work needs a selected outcome or bound that no admitted basis declares; the decision names it, its owner and the constitutional re-entry it requests, which is the reconfiguration pressure of out_of_frame ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Out of frame or indeterminate) |\n"},{"number":1200,"text":"| `block(undeclared)` | out_of_frame | `evaluate_action` decides that the action just taken leaves the edge unable to proceed, because it needs a relation, capability or authority that no admitted basis declares |\n"},{"number":1201,"text":"| `block(basis)` | invalid_basis | `evaluate_action` decides that the action just taken leaves the edge unable to proceed on its current basis, which cannot support it |\n"},{"number":1202,"text":"\n"},{"number":1203,"text":"Closure decisions and dispositions. The closure decisions of A8 and their\n"},{"number":1204,"text":"refined values are this member's, and they answer the edge predicate\n"},{"number":1205,"text":"above. The dispositions `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter` and `reject`\n"},{"number":1206,"text":"are owned by [ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition) and\n"},{"number":1207,"text":"answer another predicate, \"the candidate is accepted at its declared\n"},{"number":1208,"text":"boundary\". A closure decision is not a disposition and is never recorded\n"},{"number":1209,"text":"as one, and no disposition is a closure decision: `repair` is not\n"},{"number":1210,"text":"`local_repair`, and `re-enter` is not `re_enter`. Edge closure is\n"},{"number":1211,"text":"evidence toward acceptance and never acceptance itself (the\n"},{"number":1212,"text":"selected-outcome paragraphs above). Their core values differ because their\n"},{"number":1213,"text":"predicates differ. `repair(proof)` is `indeterminate`, because a\n"},{"number":1214,"text":"defective proof leaves the edge's obligations undecided, while\n"},{"number":1215,"text":"`local_repair` is `falsified`, because the local defect defeats\n"},{"number":1216,"text":"acceptance of the candidate. `re-enter(undeclared)` is `out_of_frame`,\n"},{"number":1217,"text":"because the change needs a relation, capability or authority that no\n"},{"number":1218,"text":"admitted basis declares, while `re_enter` is `invalid_basis`. Neither\n"},{"number":1219,"text":"value counts toward the other's predicate\n"},{"number":1220,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":1221,"text":"In §11.5D, §16 and §19 \"disposition\" names a closure decision (the\n"},{"number":1222,"text":"selected-outcome paragraphs, A8, A11, the constitutional equation, §16\n"},{"number":1223,"text":"item 13 and §19 question 11) or, in \"typed no-action disposition\", a\n"},{"number":1224,"text":"selection of `evaluate_next` (A3, A4); there it never names a disposition\n"},{"number":1225,"text":"of ACTIVATION §3. Successor-claim dispositions are governed by\n"},{"number":1226,"text":"[RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015)\n"},{"number":1227,"text":"(P1, P5, P6). Purpose and material relation:\n"},{"number":1228,"text":"a consumer that read an edge's `repair` as `local_repair`, or `re-enter`\n"},{"number":1229,"text":"as `re_enter`, would take an undecided edge for a defeated candidate, or a\n"},{"number":1230,"text":"missing declaration for an unsupporting basis; the material relation is\n"},{"number":1231,"text":"whether a closure decision is combined as an acceptance result.\n"},{"number":1232,"text":"\n"},{"number":1233,"text":"A9 Yield is lawful iterate. `yield` is the lawful iteration boundary (P5):\n"},{"number":1234,"text":"\n"},{"number":1235,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1236,"text":"same edge or attempt remains lawful\n"},{"number":1237,"text":"progress or waiting state is admitted\n"},{"number":1238,"text":"resume basis is replay-visible\n"},{"number":1239,"text":"control returns without failure classification\n"},{"number":1240,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1241,"text":"\n"},{"number":1242,"text":"Yield is not retry, not block, not timeout and not a local CLI loop. It is\n"},{"number":1243,"text":"the pressure-release state that lets long-running, bounded or partially\n"},{"number":1244,"text":"productive work return control without losing the current edge (P5, P0).\n"},{"number":1245,"text":"\n"},{"number":1246,"text":"A10 Liveness does not close semantic truth. Liveness observes activity,\n"},{"number":1247,"text":"inactivity, process state and interruption. It can support yield or a\n"},{"number":1248,"text":"liveness interruption; it cannot by itself declare semantic failure,\n"},{"number":1249,"text":"semantic closure or requirement non-satisfaction (P6).\n"},{"number":1250,"text":"\n"},{"number":1251,"text":"A11 Re-entry is graph law. Repair and re-entry are graph actions selected\n"},{"number":1252,"text":"by `evaluate_next` from admitted closure truth and published action\n"},{"number":1253,"text":"authority, not local retry branches over strings. `evaluate_action` may\n"},{"number":1254,"text":"emit `repair` or `re-enter` as a closure disposition; `evaluate_next`\n"},{"number":1255,"text":"selects which published graph action realises that repair or re-entry.\n"},{"number":1256,"text":"Disposition is conceptual; selection is invocational (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1257,"text":"\n"},{"number":1258,"text":"A12 Public query is a read-only evaluation view. A public query or gaps\n"},{"number":1259,"text":"view may render read-only outputs of `eval_gap`, `evaluate_action` and\n"},{"number":1260,"text":"`evaluate_next`: gap pressure, closure decision and next-action\n"},{"number":1261,"text":"projection. It must not append events, invoke workers, admit intent, run\n"},{"number":1262,"text":"`evaluate_action` or choose traversal by itself (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1263,"text":"\n"},{"number":1264,"text":"A13 Replayability. Every closure decision and next-action selection must\n"},{"number":1265,"text":"be reproducible from (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":1266,"text":"\n"},{"number":1267,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1268,"text":"RuntimeEventLog\n"},{"number":1269,"text":"+ execution basis\n"},{"number":1270,"text":"+ ABG event-log-backed IntentLineage\n"},{"number":1271,"text":"+ ProductAssetModel publication basis and its event refs\n"},{"number":1272,"text":"+ selected Product outcome identity and admitted bounded-basis refs\n"},{"number":1273,"text":"+ GapPressureRow\n"},{"number":1274,"text":"+ TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":1275,"text":"+ ActionCatalog\n"},{"number":1276,"text":"+ admitted evidence\n"},{"number":1277,"text":"+ EdgeFulfillmentLedger\n"},{"number":1278,"text":"+ EdgeClosureDecision\n"},{"number":1279,"text":"+ NextActionBasis\n"},{"number":1280,"text":"+ visible policy refs\n"},{"number":1281,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1282,"text":"\n"},{"number":1283,"text":"If replay cannot reproduce the decision, the implementation has created\n"},{"number":1284,"text":"hidden state (P3).\n"},{"number":1285,"text":"\n"},{"number":1286,"text":"A13a Causal chain integrity. Each governing admitted or replay-derived\n"},{"number":1287,"text":"carrier and projection in the loop must reference its causal predecessor\n"},{"number":1288,"text":"refs (P3, P4b):\n"},{"number":1289,"text":"\n"},{"number":1290,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1291,"text":"selected Product outcome and admitted bounded-basis refs\n"},{"number":1292,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":1293,"text":"\n"},{"number":1294,"text":"IntentLineage\n"},{"number":1295,"text":"-> ProductAssetModel\n"},{"number":1296,"text":"-> GapPressureRow\n"},{"number":1297,"text":"-> TargetObligationBinding\n"},{"number":1298,"text":"-> PriorityProjection\n"},{"number":1299,"text":"-> NextActionProjection (selected_action)\n"},{"number":1300,"text":"-> ConstructionIntent\n"},{"number":1301,"text":"-> AdmittedEvidence\n"},{"number":1302,"text":"-> EdgeFulfillmentLedger\n"},{"number":1303,"text":"-> EdgeClosureDecision\n"},{"number":1304,"text":"-> NextActionBasis\n"},{"number":1305,"text":"-> NextActionProjection (next)\n"},{"number":1306,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1307,"text":"\n"},{"number":1308,"text":"The target binding must be reachable from the exact selected Product\n"},{"number":1309,"text":"outcome and any admitted bounded-basis refs. The first\n"},{"number":1310,"text":"`NextActionProjection` in the chain carries the selected action that\n"},{"number":1311,"text":"admits `ConstructionIntent`, which preserves those authority refs. The\n"},{"number":1312,"text":"second is the post-action projection produced from `NextActionBasis` plus\n"},{"number":1313,"text":"fresh `eval_gap` truth. Both must be reachable from their predecessor\n"},{"number":1314,"text":"refs. A13 requires that the decision be reproducible from the inputs;\n"},{"number":1315,"text":"A13a requires that each governing carrier or projection carry the predecessor refs\n"},{"number":1316,"text":"that make reproduction reachable without external joins. A broken\n"},{"number":1317,"text":"predecessor chain is non-replayable at the carrier level and therefore\n"},{"number":1318,"text":"fails A13 (P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":1319,"text":"\n"},{"number":1320,"text":"A14 Recursive published refinement. The homeostasis loop recurses over\n"},{"number":1321,"text":"published refinement. If a graph function refines an outer vector into\n"},{"number":1322,"text":"published inner vectors, each inner vector boundary obeys\n"},{"number":1323,"text":"`synthesize_model`, `eval_gap`, `evaluate_next` and `evaluate_action` with\n"},{"number":1324,"text":"its own visible model, gap, binding, action, evidence, ledger, closure and\n"},{"number":1325,"text":"next-action projection. An intentionally opaque inner realisation is\n"},{"number":1326,"text":"ordinary implementation inside one bounded action: it may use local\n"},{"number":1327,"text":"control flow to compute the action's internal result, but it must not\n"},{"number":1328,"text":"publish, dispatch, retry, repair, re-enter or close graph work as a hidden\n"},{"number":1329,"text":"traversal controller. Once a refinement is published as graph structure,\n"},{"number":1330,"text":"the loop governs it recursively (P4a, P0, P6).\n"},{"number":1331,"text":"\n"},{"number":1332,"text":"A15 Method ownership. ABG owns runtime truth, event replay, the graph-call\n"},{"number":1333,"text":"lifecycle, actor and process supervision, continuation, and re-entry\n"},{"number":1334,"text":"mechanics. The product owns domain asset meaning, graph-function\n"},{"number":1335,"text":"catalogue meaning, gap interpretation and priority policy. The\n"},{"number":1336,"text":"software-design profile (DESIGN_MODULE, tier 3; PROFILES §3) governs\n"},{"number":1337,"text":"realisation modules inside that split and must not fragment `eval_gap`,\n"},{"number":1338,"text":"`evaluate_next` or `evaluate_action` into module-local decision\n"},{"number":1339,"text":"authorities (P6).\n"},{"number":1340,"text":"\n"},{"number":1341,"text":"A16 Constitutional override. For any ticket, design, code module or proof\n"},{"number":1342,"text":"that touches `synthesize_model`, `eval_gap`, `evaluate_next`,\n"},{"number":1343,"text":"`evaluate_action`, traversal, gap evaluation, action selection,\n"},{"number":1344,"text":"construction intent, worker invocation, evidence admission, fulfilment,\n"},{"number":1345,"text":"liveness, closure, re-entry, public query or live proof, the causally\n"},{"number":1346,"text":"applicable members of this axiom set and the constitutional equation below\n"},{"number":1347,"text":"are the controlling acceptance constraints for the selected Product\n"},{"number":1348,"text":"outcome and the affected published boundary. Unchanged accepted relations\n"},{"number":1349,"text":"cite their accepted basis and are not proved again. The axiom family\n"},{"number":1350,"text":"authorises no horizontal realisation growth, creates no Product work and\n"},{"number":1351,"text":"does not widen the selected outcome (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1352,"text":"\n"},{"number":1353,"text":"Ticket-local closure wording, test names, source-grep checks, compact CLI\n"},{"number":1354,"text":"summaries and implementation notes cannot weaken the constitutional loop.\n"},{"number":1355,"text":"A ticket that looks complete by its local checklist but leaves a rival\n"},{"number":1356,"text":"traversal-consequence path is not constitutionally complete; the lawful\n"},{"number":1357,"text":"result is to request lawful re-entry, keep the gap as a closure blocker,\n"},{"number":1358,"text":"or admit separately bounded paydown under an independently selected\n"},{"number":1359,"text":"Product outcome or prerequisite basis (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1360,"text":"\n"},{"number":1361,"text":"These artifacts may provide evidence, diagnostics or read-model context\n"},{"number":1362,"text":"only; they must not independently close an edge, select a next action, or\n"},{"number":1363,"text":"route retry, repair or re-entry (P6):\n"},{"number":1364,"text":"\n"},{"number":1365,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1366,"text":"gap dossier\n"},{"number":1367,"text":"postflight report\n"},{"number":1368,"text":"assurance report\n"},{"number":1369,"text":"materialization manifest\n"},{"number":1370,"text":"runtime liveness projection\n"},{"number":1371,"text":"run summary\n"},{"number":1372,"text":"worker prose\n"},{"number":1373,"text":"screen or PTY transcript\n"},{"number":1374,"text":"prompt package\n"},{"number":1375,"text":"harness target argument\n"},{"number":1376,"text":"source-grep test\n"},{"number":1377,"text":"CLI branch or compact output\n"},{"number":1378,"text":"public query or gaps view\n"},{"number":1379,"text":"service method output\n"},{"number":1380,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1381,"text":"\n"},{"number":1382,"text":"If any of them conflicts with the admitted `EdgeFulfillmentLedger`,\n"},{"number":1383,"text":"`EdgeClosureDecision` or `NextActionProjection`, the ledger, decision and\n"},{"number":1384,"text":"projection chain wins. If that chain is absent, the edge has not\n"},{"number":1385,"text":"constitutionally closed and the next action has not been constitutionally\n"},{"number":1386,"text":"selected (P6).\n"},{"number":1387,"text":"\n"},{"number":1388,"text":"The constitutional equation is (P6, P4a):\n"},{"number":1389,"text":"\n"},{"number":1390,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1391,"text":"let U = (selected_product_outcome_ref, optional_admitted_bounded_basis_ref)\n"},{"number":1392,"text":"let L = project_intent_lineage_from_event_log(source_intent_refs, prior_intent_refs)\n"},{"number":1393,"text":"let M0 = synthesize_model(L, prior_model, admitted_product_truth)\n"},{"number":1394,"text":"let G0 = eval_gap(M0, RuntimeEventLog, RuntimeProjection, The same\n"},{"number":1439,"text":"ODD structural law can build many different domain products, and each\n"},{"number":1440,"text":"product defines its own asset meanings, proof lanes and query overlays.\n"},{"number":1441,"text":"Structural GTL law and product-specific semantic law are never confused\n"},{"number":1442,"text":"(P1).\n"},{"number":1443,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1473,"heading":"ODD/11. A human operator using\n"},{"number":1447,"text":"only the declared authority surfaces should be able to (P0, P6):\n"},{"number":1448,"text":"\n"},{"number":1449,"text":"1. identify the current asset state, the current typed asset or node;\n"},{"number":1450,"text":"2. identify the next lawful vector and its public graph-function carrier,\n"},{"number":1451,"text":"   the vector being the constitutional transition contract and the graph\n"},{"number":1452,"text":"   function the published constructive program that realises it (§5\n"},{"number":1453,"text":"   Vectors and Graph functions);\n"},{"number":1454,"text":"3. determine the required inputs, evaluators, output contract and carried\n"},{"number":1455,"text":"   environment;\n"},{"number":1456,"text":"4. construct or assess the next asset, a produced asset or checkpoint;\n"},{"number":1457,"text":"5. repeat until target-relative closure is reached.\n"},{"number":1458,"text":"\n"},{"number":1459,"text":"Automation may make this faster, safer or more repeatable; it may not\n"},{"number":1460,"text":"invent a different process. Automation is lawful when it renders prompts,\n"},{"number":1461,"text":"scaffolds artifacts, selects the next traversal step, runs workers,\n"},{"number":1462,"text":"collects evidence and assesses closure. Automation is unlawful when it\n"},{"number":1463,"text":"skips undeclared nodes; fabricates authority absent from the declared\n"},{"number":1464,"text":"surfaces; collapses several constitutional transitions into one opaque\n"},{"number":1465,"text":"step without declaring the refinement; depends on implementation-carrier\n"},{"number":1466,"text":"knowledge the installed product should not have; or collapses the\n"},{"number":1467,"text":"installed builder and the product under development into one authority\n"},{"number":1468,"text":"surface during self-host work (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":1469,"text":"\n"},{"number":1470,"text":"If the team cannot explain the manual traversal, the automation is not yet\n"},{"number":1471,"text":"method-safe. Automation that cannot be explained in these terms is ahead\n"},{"number":1472,"text":"of the method (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":1473,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1563,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.7A Conforming agentic development","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.7A%20Conforming%20agentic%20development","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"476e9bd3c0ddd50329f71db02af5bf7b7c91fdfe74bd0161ce6e130af72c3e85","start_line":1474,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":1474,"text":"### 11.7A Conforming agentic development\n"},{"number":1475,"text":"\n"},{"number":1476,"text":"This profile is the premise for conforming agentic development over the\n"},{"number":1477,"text":"graph-native worksite. An agentic coder produces governed work by\n"},{"number":1478,"text":"following the constitutional process over a minimal declared authority\n"},{"number":1479,"text":"packet, and admission gates the artifacts it produces. SPEC_METHOD governs\n"},{"number":1480,"text":"the general constitutional process and [TICKETS](TICKETS.md) governs\n"},{"number":1481,"text":"artifact admission; this section names the ODD specialisation and composes\n"},{"number":1482,"text":"that law without declaring it again (P6, P0).\n"},{"number":1483,"text":"\n"},{"number":1484,"text":"Conformance has two halves: an F_P walkthrough supplying evidence that the\n"},{"number":1485,"text":"process can be followed, and a declared admission gate assessing the produced\n"},{"number":1486,"text":"artifacts under its evidence contract and grant. A gate claiming F_D also\n"},{"number":1487,"text":"establishes the common kind's eligibility under §5; its kind is no authority\n"},{"number":1488,"text":"to admit (P6).\n"},{"number":1489,"text":"\n"},{"number":1490,"text":"The walkthrough is the conformance proof. §11.7 requires automation to\n"},{"number":1491,"text":"stay true for a manual walkthrough; its agentic form is a conformance test\n"},{"number":1492,"text":"of the method itself. An agentic coder executes the constitutional process\n"},{"number":1493,"text":"end to end on real work, using only the declared authority surfaces:\n"},{"number":1494,"text":"intake triage, the smallest lawful re-entry, the specification,\n"},{"number":1495,"text":"requirement, design and ticket chain, the constructive evaluation loop of\n"},{"number":1496,"text":"§11.5D, and closure proof. The agentic coder is F_P over the\n"},{"number":1497,"text":"constitutional process (P0, P6).\n"},{"number":1498,"text":"\n"},{"number":1499,"text":"The agent works from a minimal declared authority packet, not from memory\n"},{"number":1500,"text":"and not from wholesale hidden context. The general method already requires\n"},{"number":1501,"text":"declared context for any agentic work unit: input and output contract,\n"},{"number":1502,"text":"required context, role, evaluator regime and provenance (SPEC_METHOD;\n"},{"number":1503,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#1-the-step)). The ODD addition is that the\n"},{"number":1504,"text":"packet carries only the smallest declared authority sufficient to decide\n"},{"number":1505,"text":"the step, with its source refs, and that conformance is enforced by\n"},{"number":1506,"text":"admitting the produced artifact rather than by enlarging what the agent\n"},{"number":1507,"text":"must hold. Compression is prompt input and never the deciding authority\n"},{"number":1508,"text":"(P0, P6). What a derived surface may decide is owned by\n"},{"number":1509,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope),\n"},{"number":1510,"text":"Acquisition and Standalone scope; this section adds only the ODD limit\n"},{"number":1511,"text":"that follows. A derived surface or projected frame of the general method may\n"},{"number":1512,"text":"orient the agent to source precedence, lawful re-entry and traceability;\n"},{"number":1513,"text":"it must not be used to decide product-specific behaviour, which must come\n"},{"number":1514,"text":"from the current product authority packet (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1515,"text":"\n"},{"number":1516,"text":"The walkthrough proves at two levels. The work it produces must be lawful:\n"},{"number":1517,"text":"correct change class, traceable, admitted. A point where the walkthrough\n"},{"number":1518,"text":"cannot proceed is a method defect only when a competent agent, correctly\n"},{"number":1519,"text":"configured and using the declared authority, still cannot decide because\n"},{"number":1520,"text":"of ambiguity, a missing step, contradictory authority or an undecidable\n"},{"number":1521,"text":"change class in an owning surface. That defect is repriced into the owning\n"},{"number":1522,"text":"authority surface, as a failed manual traversal is a graph defect under\n"},{"number":1523,"text":"§11.7 (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1524,"text":"\n"},{"number":1525,"text":"An agent that ignored the declared authority, relied on stale memory or\n"},{"number":1526,"text":"reasoned badly has produced agent error, not a method defect. Admission\n"},{"number":1527,"text":"rejects the malformed artifact either way, so a bad agent turn neither\n"},{"number":1528,"text":"becomes law nor silently indicts the method (P6).\n"},{"number":1529,"text":"\n"},{"number":1530,"text":"This proof is independent of any automated runtime. A live lane that\n"},{"number":1531,"text":"depends on external execution conditions, such as an overloaded model API\n"},{"number":1532,"text":"or a flaky transport, cannot prove the constitutional process sound,\n"},{"number":1533,"text":"because it conflates process validity with runtime availability. The\n"},{"number":1534,"text":"walkthrough proves the process; the runtime only executes it (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1535,"text":"\n"},{"number":1536,"text":"The validator is the conformance gate. The constitutional process is an\n"},{"number":1537,"text":"interface contract, and interface conformance is enforced by validating\n"},{"number":1538,"text":"artifacts against the contract, not by the conformer holding the contract.\n"},{"number":1539,"text":"This profile does not declare the artifact rules again: tickets,\n"},{"number":1540,"text":"change-class declarations, design-module derivations and execution\n"},{"number":1541,"text":"contracts are admitted under SPEC_METHOD and TICKETS, which already require\n"},{"number":1542,"text":"a drafted classification to be admitted or rejected against deterministic\n"},{"number":1543,"text":"criteria rather than taken as automatic truth. This profile requires only\n"},{"number":1544,"text":"that agentic development pass through that admission. The agentic coder\n"},{"number":1545,"text":"produces the artifact; the declared admission gates it deterministically,\n"},{"number":1546,"text":"fail-closed and naming the violated rule, exactly as a typed asset is\n"},{"number":1547,"text":"enforced by its constructor (§11.1) (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1548,"text":"\n"},{"number":1549,"text":"This keeps the F_P and F_D split at the method layer. The agentic coder is\n"},{"number":1550,"text":"F_P: it reasons, drafts and proposes within the declared packet. Admission\n"},{"number":1551,"text":"uses F_D only when the §5 total-domain contract is established, and its own\n"},{"number":1552,"text":"contract and authority determine what artifact-conformance decision it may\n"},{"number":1553,"text":"make. An unresolved eligibility assessment stays open under the migration\n"},{"number":1554,"text":"relation; an unchanged-subject evaluator still preserves that subject. The walkthrough\n"},{"number":1555,"text":"establishes that the process can be followed; admission establishes that\n"},{"number":1556,"text":"each act of following it conforms (P6, P0).\n"},{"number":1557,"text":"\n"},{"number":1558,"text":"Conformance is not approval by usage. A passed admission and a completed\n"},{"number":1559,"text":"walkthrough are conformance evidence, not ratification. Shared method\n"},{"number":1560,"text":"change still follows §9: repeated agentic execution does not make grey\n"},{"number":1561,"text":"work constitutional. The agentic coder conforms to the method; it does not\n"},{"number":1562,"text":"amend the method by acting (P6).\n"},{"number":1563,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1593,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.7B Real authority-path negative proof (STDO-UP-010)","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.7B%20Real%20authority-path%20negative%20proof%20%28STDO-UP-010%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"366c545c40cd039db66c44cdda25c98e21653867969907f473b2a0113b2e2c2c","start_line":1564,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":1564,"text":"### 11.7B Real authority-path negative proof (STDO-UP-010)\n"},{"number":1565,"text":"\n"},{"number":1566,"text":"Negative proof for an ODD or graph-native boundary exercises the supported\n"},{"number":1567,"text":"Product authority path. It must not manufacture the refusal state, blocked\n"},{"number":1568,"text":"event, gap or verdict that the system is supposed to derive (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1569,"text":"\n"},{"number":1570,"text":"Closure-grade negative evidence identifies the supported entry and the\n"},{"number":1571,"text":"governing authority; invalidates the real authority-bearing input;\n"},{"number":1572,"text":"exercises the supported path; proves refusal before the prohibited\n"},{"number":1573,"text":"effect; and establishes that no legacy, fallback, reconstruction or\n"},{"number":1574,"text":"parallel path succeeds. Source, packaged, installed and runtime absence\n"},{"number":1575,"text":"are distinct claims (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1576,"text":"\n"},{"number":1577,"text":"Where these identities apply, the supported relation is (P6, P4a):\n"},{"number":1578,"text":"\n"},{"number":1579,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1580,"text":"public entry\n"},{"number":1581,"text":"  -> admitted GTL composition owns traversal topology\n"},{"number":1582,"text":"  -> named GraphFunction supplies the callable work contract\n"},{"number":1583,"text":"  -> implementation or plugin binding realizes only its admitted seam\n"},{"number":1584,"text":"  -> ABG owns traversal, event, continuation, and replay truth\n"},{"number":1585,"text":"  -> replay-derived projection\n"},{"number":1586,"text":"  -> typed Product outcome or continuation\n"},{"number":1587,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1588,"text":"\n"},{"number":1589,"text":"No CLI, SDK, service, adapter, plugin, fixture, query or projection may\n"},{"number":1590,"text":"become a rival traversal controller. The consumer owns the concrete test\n"},{"number":1591,"text":"and evidence mechanism; this section owns the property that mechanism\n"},{"number":1592,"text":"must prove (P6).\n"},{"number":1593,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1607,"heading":"ODD/11. Core law/11.8 Cumulative environment law is mandatory","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md#ODD%2F11.%20Core%20law%2F11.8%20Cumulative%20environment%20law%20is%20mandatory","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","sha256":"21ecd60683349e8eaa9880dbfc7e6cfd03b4299a4179dd31d3ce161e13c986d7","start_line":1594,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/ODD.md","lines":[{"number":1594,"text":"### 11.8 Cumulative environment law is mandatory\n"},{"number":1595,"text":"\n"},{"number":1596,"text":"Composition is not modelled as \"the last output feeds the next input\".\n"},{"number":1597,"text":"The ODD law is a cumulative typed environment (P4a, P4b).\n"},{"number":1598,"text":"\n"},{"number":1599,"text":"Each retained `GraphFunction` should declare `environment.requires`,\n"},{"number":1600,"text":"`environment.provides` and `environment.carries`. A later function may\n"},{"number":1601,"text":"require any typed binding available in the cumulative carried\n"},{"number":1602,"text":"environment, not only the immediately previous output (P4a, P4b).\n"},{"number":1603,"text":"\n"},{"number":1604,"text":"A product that publishes graph functions without this cumulative\n"},{"number":1605,"text":"environment law has a line that is graph-shaped but structurally wrong\n"},{"number":1606,"text":"(P4a, P6).\n"},{"number":1607,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1623,"heading":"ODD/11. When an outer public carrier is refined\n"},{"number":1611,"text":"into inner executable structure, the refined inner chain must close\n"},{"number":1612,"text":"lawfully; the enclosing coarse contract must also stay true after\n"},{"number":1613,"text":"fold-back; and zoomed and unzoomed views must agree on whether the\n"},{"number":1614,"text":"enclosing carrier is open or closed (P4a, P2).\n"},{"number":1615,"text":"\n"},{"number":1616,"text":"For current product closure, live current requirements that lack an\n"},{"number":1617,"text":"executable proof witness keep the enclosing carrier open until they are\n"},{"number":1618,"text":"realised, explicitly deferred, or explicitly repriced out of the active\n"},{"number":1619,"text":"branch. For the active software line the immediate pressure is usually a\n"},{"number":1620,"text":"realised testcase or archived test evidence, but the governing law is\n"},{"number":1621,"text":"proof-lane aware: the witness must be a governed realised proof surface\n"},{"number":1622,"text":"appropriate to the requirement class (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1623,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1637,"heading":"ODD/12.
