After publication, changing one of those bytes requires the\n"},{"number":525,"text":"applicable immutable successor: a higher RC or a new version after stable. The\n"},{"number":526,"text":"version-line selector has no content-reconciliation phase because it adds\n"},{"number":527,"text":"no new Product bytes (P3).\n"},{"number":528,"text":"\n"},{"number":529,"text":"Exact version and cut identity belong in release-scoped carriers and\n"},{"number":530,"text":"consumer basis bindings (P3). How a live constitutional surface, Product\n"},{"number":531,"text":"and requirements surfaces included, uses version labels is the\n"},{"number":532,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §2 Specification surface rule](SPEC_METHOD.md#specification-surface-rule).\n"},{"number":533,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":551,"heading":"RELEASE/6. Release-scoped assets and the Product subject/Product subject and repository carrier","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F6.%20Release-scoped%20assets%20and%20the%20Product%20subject%2FProduct%20subject%20and%20repository%20carrier","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"cda56a9957ae2b22204b8a1de126a7bf827b4eaee54b45514dd137f6ee9510ed","start_line":534,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":534,"text":"### Product subject and repository carrier\n"},{"number":535,"text":"\n"},{"number":536,"text":"Before qualification, the project declares (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":537,"text":"\n"},{"number":538,"text":"- its Project Release Namespace and exact Project Subtree root;\n"},{"number":539,"text":"- the exact Product member set or artifact constituting the release\n"},{"number":540,"text":"  subject;\n"},{"number":541,"text":"- the release-scoped claim surfaces describing that subject; and\n"},{"number":542,"text":"- co-located mutable source-project fields excluded from both.\n"},{"number":543,"text":"\n"},{"number":544,"text":"A repository commit carries those declared sets but does not make every\n"},{"number":545,"text":"co-located file or sibling Project Subtree a Product member. The exact\n"},{"number":546,"text":"Project Subtree tree and Product member inventory distinguish the subject\n"},{"number":547,"text":"from the wider carrier. Once the immutable cut is published, no post-review\n"},{"number":548,"text":"carrier delta is admitted into that cut. Publication-caused ticket or\n"},{"number":549,"text":"source-work bookkeeping is recorded afterward on the continuing source\n"},{"number":550,"text":"branch and cannot move the immutable cut tag (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":551,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":591,"heading":"RELEASE/7. Coordinated release-matched asset cohorts","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F7.%20Coordinated%20release-matched%20asset%20cohorts","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"929048e961e19bda9cda3d3101cfb4fc3f9954fe40851503d63fdeb32eecf488","start_line":552,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":552,"text":"## 7. Coordinated release-matched asset cohorts\n"},{"number":553,"text":"\n"},{"number":554,"text":"A Product authority may declare an explicit cross-Product Release-Matched\n"},{"number":555,"text":"Asset Cohort when one source corpus and its required distributed or\n"},{"number":556,"text":"derived assets need to remain usable as one versioned set. The declaring\n"},{"number":557,"text":"relation names every required Product and asset, the exact source\n"},{"number":558,"text":"dependency, its owning authorities, the qualification boundary and the\n"},{"number":559,"text":"publication transaction. Path co-location, equal version text or a common\n"},{"number":560,"text":"actor cannot infer the relation (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":561,"text":"\n"},{"number":562,"text":"For the existing RC-profile cohort, every required member uses one exact version suffix\n"},{"number":563,"text":"`<version>-rc.<n>`. Product-local cut names and refs render it as\n"},{"number":564,"text":"`v<version>-rc.<n>`; embedded asset-version fields render the same suffix\n"},{"number":565,"text":"without `v`. Qualification normalises only that leading cut-name marker\n"},{"number":566,"text":"and requires exact suffix equality. Equal versions establish release\n"},{"number":567,"text":"matching only. They do not collapse Product identities, member\n"},{"number":568,"text":"inventories, tags, acceptance judgments or release authorities (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":569,"text":"\n"},{"number":570,"text":"For a release-matched STDO stack, the closed cohort contains all of (P3,\n"},{"number":571,"text":"P4b):\n"},{"number":572,"text":"\n"},{"number":573,"text":"1. the exact STDO standards corpus cut;\n"},{"number":574,"text":"2. the distributed `spec` plugin and host assets carried by that STDO cut;\n"},{"number":575,"text":"3. the exact Axiom Indexer mechanics Product used to validate and project\n"},{"number":576,"text":"   the index;\n"},{"number":577,"text":"4. the exact STDO Representation Product; and\n"},{"number":578,"text":"5. its released `a_c.STDO` axiomatic program and logical constraint map\n"},{"number":579,"text":"   or equivalent semantic index, with the complete source-STDO member\n"},{"number":580,"text":"   inventory, member digests, member-set digest and exact cut identity\n"},{"number":581,"text":"   used to derive it.\n"},{"number":582,"text":"\n"},{"number":583,"text":"The cohort is incomplete when a required member is missing, stale,\n"},{"number":584,"text":"differently versioned, built from another source cut, or unable to\n"},{"number":585,"text":"reproduce its declared source-member and digest closure. A change to any\n"},{"number":586,"text":"source member covered by the index invalidates the old derived candidate\n"},{"number":587,"text":"for the successor cohort. The index is regenerated, mechanically\n"},{"number":588,"text":"validated, independently qualified where required, and released under the\n"},{"number":589,"text":"same new cut name. A stale index may remain immutable history; it cannot\n"},{"number":590,"text":"accompany the changed source as the current cohort (P3, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":591,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":618,"heading":"RELEASE/7. Coordinated release-matched asset cohorts/Source freeze and stable cohort construction","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F7.%20Coordinated%20release-matched%20asset%20cohorts%2FSource%20freeze%20and%20stable%20cohort%20construction","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"4019ebcf5e150268f659c9242db3976ee2256ee8c8238129c2981dec30f2a55a","start_line":592,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":592,"text":"### Source freeze and stable cohort construction\n"},{"number":593,"text":"\n"},{"number":594,"text":"A declared stable cohort may select an exact `<major>.<minor>.<patch>` suffix\n"},{"number":595,"text":"instead of the RC-profile suffix. Its contract names the complete required\n"},{"number":596,"text":"Product and component set, current-source relationships and qualification\n"},{"number":597,"text":"obligations. The historical RC-profile member set above does not limit an\n"},{"number":598,"text":"explicitly selected successor cohort. Product identity and independent\n"},{"number":599,"text":"third-party version pins remain distinct from the shared cohort version.\n"},{"number":600,"text":"\n"},{"number":601,"text":"When a native package must include its derived documentation, tools or proof\n"},{"number":602,"text":"views, construction first freezes the exact semantic source independently of\n"},{"number":603,"text":"those generated bytes. The source record inventories every authoritative\n"},{"number":604,"text":"member and native contract, classifies derived routes, and names all generated\n"},{"number":605,"text":"exclusions with their owners. No authoritative source may be excluded merely\n"},{"number":606,"text":"to make a digest agree. Derived candidates bind that source record, its exact\n"},{"number":607,"text":"member digests and the intended cut URI. Generated frames remain projections\n"},{"number":608,"text":"of their exact owners, not independent semantic authorities (P3, P5, P6).\n"},{"number":609,"text":"\n"},{"number":610,"text":"All required installed assets are built and qualified before the native cut\n"},{"number":611,"text":"is frozen. After its annotated tag and installed manifest exist, an external\n"},{"number":612,"text":"cohort record binds the source freeze, complete native cut and every derived\n"},{"number":613,"text":"Product subject without modifying embedded payload bytes. No asset must\n"},{"number":614,"text":"embed its own containing manifest's digest. Source drift invalidates affected\n"},{"number":615,"text":"derivations; generation may add only the declared auxiliary bytes. This\n"},{"number":616,"text":"source-freeze construction preserves the same exact-subject, complete-ref,\n"},{"number":617,"text":"atomic publication and public verification obligations below (P3, P4b, P5).\n"},{"number":618,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":666,"heading":"RELEASE/7. Coordinated release-matched asset cohorts/Two-commit construction and one publication transaction","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F7.%20Coordinated%20release-matched%20asset%20cohorts%2FTwo-commit%20construction%20and%20one%20publication%20transaction","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"f61dbc1f5c216030407028cc0901cf20fa6727357fd4b12baff4dd7c587d2aec","start_line":619,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":619,"text":"### Two-commit construction and one publication transaction\n"},{"number":620,"text":"\n"},{"number":621,"text":"Exact installed-manifest identity includes the annotated STDO tag object,\n"},{"number":622,"text":"so a same-commit carrier containing both that identity and derived child\n"},{"number":623,"text":"bytes would be self-referential. The original RC-profile cohort, whose\n"},{"number":624,"text":"derived assets are outside the native package, uses this bounded two-commit\n"},{"number":625,"text":"construction. A stable cohort with embedded derived assets uses the source\n"},{"number":626,"text":"freeze above and retains the same external final binding (P3, P5):\n"},{"number":627,"text":"\n"},{"number":628,"text":"1. commit A freezes the exact STDO corpus, plugin, release record and\n"},{"number":629,"text":"   their qualification bytes;\n"},{"number":630,"text":"2. the annotated STDO cut tag is created locally over commit A but is not\n"},{"number":631,"text":"   pushed;\n"},{"number":632,"text":"3. that exact local cut is installed and verified, producing the manifest\n"},{"number":633,"text":"   identity used by every derived Product and index;\n"},{"number":634,"text":"4. the Axiom Indexer, STDO Representation, semantic-index bytes and cohort\n"},{"number":635,"text":"   record are derived and frozen in commit B;\n"},{"number":636,"text":"5. prepublication qualification evaluates commit B against the exact\n"},{"number":637,"text":"   local STDO tag before child immutable tags are created;\n"},{"number":638,"text":"6. annotated child cut tags and every Product-local RC branch,\n"},{"number":639,"text":"   version-line selector and optional release branch are prepared\n"},{"number":640,"text":"   locally;\n"},{"number":641,"text":"7. a mandatory post-tag, pre-push gate re-runs qualification over every\n"},{"number":642,"text":"   local annotated tag object and peel, selector, RC and release branch,\n"},{"number":643,"text":"   normalised version mapping, target commit and the exact closed ref\n"},{"number":644,"text":"   set; it also fetches and binds the expected remote object ID or\n"},{"number":645,"text":"   required absence for every destination ref; and\n"},{"number":646,"text":"8. one transport transaction atomically publishes only that qualified\n"},{"number":647,"text":"   carrier branch and complete Product ref set.\n"},{"number":648,"text":"\n"},{"number":649,"text":"If the remote does not support atomic ref publication, publication\n"},{"number":650,"text":"refuses. The process has no sequential-push fallback. Every immutable cut\n"},{"number":651,"text":"tag is create-only and therefore requires bound remote absence. Every\n"},{"number":652,"text":"mutable carrier, RC branch, selector and release branch uses an explicit\n"},{"number":653,"text":"per-ref compare-and-swap lease, such as\n"},{"number":654,"text":"`--force-with-lease=<ref>:<expected-oid>`, in that same atomic\n"},{"number":655,"text":"transaction. A missing expected ref, unexpected existing tag or changed\n"},{"number":656,"text":"remote object ID stops publication; the operator refetches and repeats\n"},{"number":657,"text":"complete content and local-ref-graph qualification before constructing\n"},{"number":658,"text":"another push. A lease mismatch never falls back to an unguarded force, a\n"},{"number":659,"text":"partial push or an in-place expectation update (P5, P3).\n"},{"number":660,"text":"\n"},{"number":661,"text":"Remote verification fails closed when any required cohort ref is absent,\n"},{"number":662,"text":"lightweight, differently versioned, points to the wrong Product commit, or\n"},{"number":663,"text":"has a selector or release branch that does not match its immutable cut.\n"},{"number":664,"text":"Post-publication bookkeeping may use a later commit, but it cannot move\n"},{"number":665,"text":"any immutable cohort tag (P5, P3).\n"},{"number":666,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":692,"heading":"RELEASE/7. Coordinated release-matched asset cohorts/Qualification and recovery","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F7.%20Coordinated%20release-matched%20asset%20cohorts%2FQualification%20and%20recovery","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"c1fb37d4635dc260ffcd35a89fcf9d50466bab4998a713a1a49bc99c76eded1a","start_line":667,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":667,"text":"### Qualification and recovery\n"},{"number":668,"text":"\n"},{"number":669,"text":"Prepublication content qualification binds the exact commit-A STDO tag\n"},{"number":670,"text":"and manifest, commit-B source tree, all Product-local target refs, version\n"},{"number":671,"text":"markers, Product member inventories, semantic-index bytes and complete\n"},{"number":672,"text":"source-corpus digest closure. It proves that the frozen candidate can be\n"},{"number":673,"text":"tagged without changing a qualifying byte. After tag and mutable ref\n"},{"number":674,"text":"creation, local-ref-graph qualification binds their annotated objects,\n"},{"number":675,"text":"peels, target commits, exact push set, and every fetched remote expected\n"},{"number":676,"text":"object ID or required absence to that unchanged content result.\n"},{"number":677,"text":"Post-publication qualification verifies the same relation from remote refs\n"},{"number":678,"text":"and refuses a partial cohort (P6, P3, P5).\n"},{"number":679,"text":"\n"},{"number":680,"text":"A historically published source cut may be the basis of a later\n"},{"number":681,"text":"same-version backfill only when separately authorised recovery law names\n"},{"number":682,"text":"that exception. Every recovered asset still binds the exact historical cut\n"},{"number":683,"text":"and same cut name, and remote completeness remains mandatory. Recovery\n"},{"number":684,"text":"cannot move the historical tag, add bytes to its Product subject, or be\n"},{"number":685,"text":"represented as an atomic cohort that existed at the original publication.\n"},{"number":686,"text":"Normal successor publication uses the atomic cohort process above (P3,\n"},{"number":687,"text":"P6).\n"},{"number":688,"text":"\n"},{"number":689,"text":"Adding or changing this cohort law changes qualifying bytes of this\n"},{"number":690,"text":"member. It governs only an immutable successor that contains those bytes\n"},{"number":691,"text":"and cannot retroactively make an earlier cut a coordinated cohort (P3).\n"},{"number":692,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":694,"heading":"RELEASE/8. Acceptance","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F8.%20Acceptance","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"4aee02f2ea328f7a5d2c06aa75eb5a202929ec4b789de904d45515f61a0bb8b4","start_line":693,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":693,"text":"## 8. Acceptance\n"},{"number":694,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":720,"heading":"RELEASE/8. Acceptance/Acceptance criteria","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F8.%20Acceptance%2FAcceptance%20criteria","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"b7a9c6f03f56fd116593e5793c01fb90b03eed41a07df647b7a7a332ae882a19","start_line":695,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":695,"text":"### Acceptance criteria\n"},{"number":696,"text":"\n"},{"number":697,"text":"A release cut may be accepted when (P6, P3):\n"},{"number":698,"text":"\n"},{"number":699,"text":"- proportionate prepublication qualification passed for the declared subject;\n"},{"number":700,"text":"- independent exact-cut review passed where required;\n"},{"number":701,"text":"- required operator review is complete;\n"},{"number":702,"text":"- the intended release scope and successor relation are stable;\n"},{"number":703,"text":"- release-scoped assets accurately describe the exact cut;\n"},{"number":704,"text":"- all release-blocking gaps, including the findings that block promotion\n"},{"number":705,"text":"  under [EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion),\n"},{"number":706,"text":"  are closed or the claimed scope is explicitly narrowed; and\n"},{"number":707,"text":"- the human Product authority accepted the exact immutable cut identity.\n"},{"number":708,"text":"\n"},{"number":709,"text":"Each criterion is a mandatory gate in the sense of\n"},{"number":710,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse):\n"},{"number":711,"text":"it applies irrespective of any selection of checks after a change, and\n"},{"number":712,"text":"retained evidence satisfies it only under the validity conditions stated\n"},{"number":713,"text":"there (P6).\n"},{"number":714,"text":"\n"},{"number":715,"text":"Acceptance attaches to that immutable cut identity. It neither advances\n"},{"number":716,"text":"nor rolls back the version-line selector. Consumer adoption separately\n"},{"number":717,"text":"evaluates the exact latest target presented by the channel and mutates\n"},{"number":718,"text":"only after its digest-bound plan is accepted (P6, P3; EVALUATION §5 is\n"},{"number":719,"text":"the generic acceptance law).\n"},{"number":720,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":734,"heading":"RELEASE/8. Acceptance/External qualification dependencies","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F8.%20Acceptance%2FExternal%20qualification%20dependencies","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"05bf8ac51a8b9c18efe332bf458e8599e277ba1559b30654174505a868b470af","start_line":721,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":721,"text":"### External qualification dependencies\n"},{"number":722,"text":"\n"},{"number":723,"text":"Some claims depend on external backends, transports or operator-facing\n"},{"number":724,"text":"services outside the local carrier. Such a dependency may remain out of\n"},{"number":725,"text":"Product for carrier and migration classification while still blocking the\n"},{"number":726,"text":"dependent release claim (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":727,"text":"\n"},{"number":728,"text":"A clean skip caused by an unhealthy external dependency is an evaluation\n"},{"number":729,"text":"not performed, which has no result\n"},{"number":730,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Not performed). It may\n"},{"number":731,"text":"preserve correct Product classification, but it cannot establish that the\n"},{"number":732,"text":"dependent capability passed. The claim is either qualified against a\n"},{"number":733,"text":"healthy dependency or narrowed before acceptance (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":734,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":798,"heading":"RELEASE/9. Successor baseline conservation (STDO-UP-015)","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F9.%20Successor%20baseline%20conservation%20%28STDO-UP-015%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"c2aab673c962616236c63ba80ca263f36f0d9cef87262a37d75fdd23cf243007","start_line":735,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":735,"text":"## 9. Successor baseline conservation (STDO-UP-015)\n"},{"number":736,"text":"\n"},{"number":737,"text":"A successor identifies the exact predecessor immutable cut whose semantic\n"},{"number":738,"text":"claims it evolves. That origin remains immutable for the candidate. Every\n"},{"number":739,"text":"predecessor claim capable of affecting the successor receives one semantic\n"},{"number":740,"text":"disposition (P4b, P3, P6):\n"},{"number":741,"text":"\n"},{"number":742,"text":"- conserved: the successor retains the claim;\n"},{"number":743,"text":"- superseded: an accepted successor relation replaces it;\n"},{"number":744,"text":"- intentionally removed: current Product authority removes it; or\n"},{"number":745,"text":"- not applicable: it has no successor effect, with a bounded reason.\n"},{"number":746,"text":"\n"},{"number":747,"text":"Evidence for a disposition is retained or reassessed under\n"},{"number":748,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse):\n"},{"number":749,"text":"a `conserved` reading made on an earlier successor text applies to a later\n"},{"number":750,"text":"one only where the owning text and the consumer bindings that carry it\n"},{"number":751,"text":"are unchanged, or the change is shown not to affect the claim (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":752,"text":"\n"},{"number":753,"text":"An unresolved disposition blocks qualification of the affected claim.\n"},{"number":754,"text":"Conservation is semantic: patch absence does not prove loss when a\n"},{"number":755,"text":"successor-native realisation preserves behaviour, and naming or code\n"},{"number":756,"text":"similarity does not prove conservation without relevant evidence (P6,\n"},{"number":757,"text":"P1). The comparison that decides `conserved` is made on the same material\n"},{"number":758,"text":"case, scope and authority: what must happen, what may happen, what is\n"},{"number":759,"text":"prohibited, and what follows when a trigger, exception or required\n"},{"number":760,"text":"premise is absent, in the owning text and in the consumer bindings that\n"},{"number":761,"text":"apply it, with the counterexamples that would expose a changed decision.\n"},{"number":762,"text":"Modal wording is judged by that meaning: indicative wording can state a\n"},{"number":763,"text":"binding law, and rewriting \"must\" or \"shall\" is neither conservation nor\n"},{"number":764,"text":"supersession by itself; an obligation stays obligatory, a preference\n"},{"number":765,"text":"stays a preference, and every permitted exception and scope condition\n"},{"number":766,"text":"survives, or the claim is not conserved. A statement that a whole\n"},{"number":767,"text":"package's wording is equivalent establishes none of this for any claim\n"},{"number":768,"text":"(P6, P1). A `conserved` disposition recorded\n"},{"number":769,"text":"before this test applied is re-evaluated under it before the affected\n"},{"number":770,"text":"claim qualifies; until then its standing is `unresolved`.\n"},{"number":771,"text":"\n"},{"number":772,"text":"Each disposition is a claim the successor makes about one predecessor\n"},{"number":773,"text":"claim ([EVALUATION §1](EVALUATION.md#1-claims)), not a result value; its\n"},{"number":774,"text":"predicate is its value's wording above. It is distinct from the decision\n"},{"number":775,"text":"owner's disposition of an assessed candidate\n"},{"number":776,"text":"([ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition)), which is an\n"},{"number":777,"text":"acceptance result. Qualification evaluates each\n"},{"number":778,"text":"disposition on evidence and records a value of the core result algebra\n"},{"number":779,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results)) with that predicate.\n"},{"number":780,"text":"An unresolved disposition states no claim and so has no result: in the\n"},{"number":781,"text":"qualification of the affected claim it is a planned assessment without a\n"},{"number":782,"text":"closed result, which is why it blocks that qualification\n"},{"number":783,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results),\n"},{"number":784,"text":"Gaps). Purpose and material relation: a recorded disposition establishes\n"},{"number":785,"text":"nothing until it is evaluated, so no disposition stands as a result (P6,\n"},{"number":786,"text":"P5).\n"},{"number":787,"text":"\n"},{"number":788,"text":"Where a maintenance or support line may affect retained claims, the\n"},{"number":789,"text":"release basis identifies the watched source, observation boundary,\n"},{"number":790,"text":"inclusion policy and successor candidate. Relevant changes receive\n"},{"number":791,"text":"semantic disposition at material integration and exact-cut qualification.\n"},{"number":792,"text":"The consumer owns its record, branch strategy, comparison and proof\n"},{"number":793,"text":"mechanism (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":794,"text":"\n"},{"number":795,"text":"[EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#5-acceptance) states what acceptance\n"},{"number":796,"text":"requires of the disposition record; it applies this section and is not\n"},{"number":797,"text":"part of it (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":798,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":849,"heading":"RELEASE/9. Successor baseline conservation (STDO-UP-015)/Deterministic-kind migration","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F9.%20Successor%20baseline%20conservation%20%28STDO-UP-015%29%2FDeterministic-kind%20migration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","sha256":"be7dce9eb21e0a1d9ecc481f2b6be849519face98d1dea4d97f00f1ae37e9e65","start_line":799,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/RELEASE.md","lines":[{"number":799,"text":"### Deterministic-kind migration\n"},{"number":800,"text":"\n"},{"number":801,"text":"A successor that adopts the total deterministic kind of\n"},{"number":802,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds)\n"},{"number":803,"text":"preserves each existing evaluation operation's unchanged subject, admissible\n"},{"number":804,"text":"reads, witness/log outputs, permitted writes, stops/results, authority and\n"},{"number":805,"text":"invalidation conditions. That profile alone does not\n"},{"number":806,"text":"establish the new kind's totality, closed dependencies or declared outcomes.\n"},{"number":807,"text":"The old deterministic evaluation/proof definition supplies no general\n"},{"number":808,"text":"termination argument. Assess each proposed use against this relation (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":809,"text":"\n"},{"number":810,"text":"| Evidence and declared migration status | Successor disposition |\n"},{"number":811,"text":"|---|---|\n"},{"number":812,"text":"| Establishes the new totality, closed-dependency and outcome contract | Map to common F_D plus the unchanged operation profile and exact traversal binding. Preserve the evidence and grants. |\n"},{"number":813,"text":"| New-kind eligibility is unestablished, and the owner has identified the missing evidence or a separately declared bounded successor and its remediation obligation | Keep that identified migration pending. The legacy operation retains only its lawful standing on its exact old basis while it remains applicable; it gains no successor F_D standing. A narrower domain or fuel-bounded implementation has its own contract, identity, exhaustion outcomes and affected preservation evidence; it does not retrospectively prove the old operation total or preserve every old continuation. |\n"},{"number":814,"text":"| New-kind eligibility is unestablished and no supported remediation or successor classification has been selected | Retain the exact legacy meaning and evidence with an explicit unresolved successor-classification obligation until its owner disposes it. The legacy operation retains only its lawful standing on its exact old basis while applicable. Grant neither new F_D standing nor an automatic F_P label; the affected successor claim stays open. |\n"},{"number":815,"text":"\n"},{"number":816,"text":"An old deterministic evaluator with unestablished termination or an\n"},{"number":817,"text":"undeclared material dependency takes the second or third row, even if it\n"},{"number":818,"text":"preserves the judged subject: the second row requires an identified evidence\n"},{"number":819,"text":"gap/remediation or selected bounded successor; absent that, the third records\n"},{"number":820,"text":"the unresolved classification. Evidence alone need not choose the owner's\n"},{"number":821,"text":"remediation. This relation imposes no general decision procedure for totality.\n"},{"number":822,"text":"These eligibility/remediation cases are not additional semantic dispositions\n"},{"number":823,"text":"under this section. Generic role descriptions and schematic traversal contracts are not concrete\n"},{"number":824,"text":"operations with an implementation to qualify; their use still binds the\n"},{"number":825,"text":"kind and operation contracts when instantiated.\n"},{"number":826,"text":"\n"},{"number":827,"text":"ODD admission and closure retain their named operation owners under\n"},{"number":828,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5's authority boundary](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds).\n"},{"number":829,"text":"Exhaustion\n"},{"number":830,"text":"retains the evaluated predicate and its signature/traversal stop mapping,\n"},{"number":831,"text":"as [the conformance examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish.\n"},{"number":832,"text":"\n"},{"number":833,"text":"Immutable consumers keep their selected edition's meaning. New consumers\n"},{"number":834,"text":"explicitly select the complete successor and operation profiles. A stable\n"},{"number":835,"text":"concept URN is not its immutable calculus edition\n"},{"number":836,"text":"([AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §8](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#8-calculus-identity)). Migration\n"},{"number":837,"text":"records the old release, manifest, member and clauses and the applicable row\n"},{"number":838,"text":"above. Current URN lookup never reinterprets history. A versioned import or\n"},{"number":839,"text":"alias records its justified supersession and grants no broader permission.\n"},{"number":840,"text":"Disposition and qualification retain the separate obligations of this\n"},{"number":841,"text":"section; unresolved mappings block the affected successor claim.\n"},{"number":842,"text":"\n"},{"number":843,"text":"Broadening operation purpose while strengthening totality, dependency and\n"},{"number":844,"text":"evidence requirements is a substantive semantic change. A patch-shaped\n"},{"number":845,"text":"version label by itself promises no compatibility. The release's version\n"},{"number":846,"text":"assessment identifies the selected predecessor, affected consumer mappings\n"},{"number":847,"text":"and remaining obligations. This relation settles no general version-line\n"},{"number":848,"text":"policy and waives no acceptance gate.\n"},{"number":849,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":856,"heading":"RELEASE/10. Open questions\n"},{"number":851,"text":"\n"},{"number":852,"text":"These questions remain open (P2):\n"},{"number":853,"text":"\n"},{"number":854,"text":"- What exact qualification bundle is mandatory for each Product class?\n"},{"number":855,"text":"- What version-line compatibility rule requires a new `<version>` rather\n"},{"number":856,"text":"  than a higher RC ordinal?\n"}]},{"end_line":22,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"8edcfc9506aa79b959ec9db0f2dc2064df45c5f2eb29bf19c7ec7f47fe62f8f3","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# SPEC_METHOD\n"},{"number":2,"text":"\n"},{"number":3,"text":"Tier 2. Owns the particular method: the position and identity of the\n"},{"number":4,"text":"method, the constitutional chain and its surfaces, the manifesto and the\n"},{"number":5,"text":"litmus tests, requirement and design law, trace closure, live-surface law,\n"},{"number":6,"text":"outcome conservation, change management with intake triage and computed\n"},{"number":7,"text":"classification, the consistency gate, the sprint boundary, ambiguity\n"},{"number":8,"text":"governance, lifecycle sufficiency, lineage and the release version boundary,\n"},{"number":9,"text":"migration law, the method's procedures, the design-record conventions and\n"},{"number":10,"text":"the general law of build-tenant binding (§11). Its two families of rules\n"},{"number":11,"text":"are laid out from premises to law at §2 and §4.\n"},{"number":12,"text":"It is realised from [FOUNDATIONS](FOUNDATIONS.md),\n"},{"number":13,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md), [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md) and\n"},{"number":14,"text":"[EVALUATION](EVALUATION.md): nothing here is foundational, every clause\n"},{"number":15,"text":"names the principle that requires it (P0 to P6, FOUNDATIONS §3), and each\n"},{"number":16,"text":"mechanism could be realised differently under the same principles. The\n"},{"number":17,"text":"tier's other members carry what this one points to:\n"},{"number":18,"text":"[PRODUCT_DEFINITION](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md) (how one project binds to the\n"},{"number":19,"text":"method), [ASSURANCE](ASSURANCE.md) (testing law),\n"},{"number":20,"text":"[TICKETS](TICKETS.md) (work carriers) and [RELEASE](RELEASE.md) (release\n"},{"number":21,"text":"mechanics).\n"},{"number":22,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":24,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/1. Its point is to make software\n"},{"number":29,"text":"re-derivable, auditable and correctable under explicit authority. Its\n"},{"number":30,"text":"overriding bias is declarative rather than imperative: the system should\n"},{"number":31,"text":"primarily declare truths, structures, interfaces, constraints and evidence\n"},{"number":32,"text":"surfaces, and let lawful processing derive and realise work from that\n"},{"number":33,"text":"declared surface.\n"},{"number":34,"text":"Imperative procedure still exists and is subordinate to declared authority\n"},{"number":35,"text":"(P6, P1).\n"},{"number":36,"text":"\n"},{"number":37,"text":"Constitutional examples use neutral capability and authority identities:\n"},{"number":38,"text":"they demonstrate enabled capabilities rather than cite a consumer as\n"},{"number":39,"text":"precedent, whose particulars cannot become method law\n"},{"number":40,"text":"([PROFILES §1](PROFILES.md#1-the-boundary)) (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":41,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":83,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/1. Position and identity/Process constitution","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F1.%20Position%20and%20identity%2FProcess%20constitution","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"29d6caa0e9d8dfd38aeac216b15f610c34217faf5ed860c36f947944a0762be0","start_line":42,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":42,"text":"### Process constitution\n"},{"number":43,"text":"\n"},{"number":44,"text":"This method is the process constitution for building projects by\n"},{"number":45,"text":"spec-driven development, not a local operating note for one implementation.\n"},{"number":46,"text":"Its role is meta-constitutional: it defines how goals, intent, product,\n"},{"number":47,"text":"requirements, design, code, evidence and repricing relate; what counts as\n"},{"number":48,"text":"specification sufficiency; what kinds of requirement truth exist; and how\n"},{"number":49,"text":"authority flows during iterative delivery. If a project's implementation\n"},{"number":50,"text":"disappears, the method should still be sufficient to bootstrap a new\n"},{"number":51,"text":"spec-driven project process from scratch; the method plus the surviving domain specification\n"},{"number":52,"text":"can reconstruct the project (P2, P0).\n"},{"number":53,"text":"\n"},{"number":54,"text":"The boundary between surfaces is this: this member defines the process\n"},{"number":55,"text":"constitution; a goals surface, conventionally `GOALS.md`, names the current\n"},{"number":56,"text":"overriding concerns for the active body of work; an intent surface,\n"},{"number":57,"text":"conventionally `INTENT.md`, names domain direction; a product-definition\n"},{"number":58,"text":"surface, conventionally `PRODUCT.md`, names the current product definition\n"},{"number":59,"text":"of the mutable source project; a requirement surface, conventionally\n"},{"number":60,"text":"`specification/requirements/`, is the live requirement surface derived from\n"},{"number":61,"text":"the product definition; a shared design surface plus any tenant-local design\n"},{"number":62,"text":"surfaces choose the concrete mechanism. The product's definition binds the\n"},{"number":63,"text":"actual authority locations\n"},{"number":64,"text":"([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §1](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#1-overlay-and-layout-independence)); the conventional names\n"},{"number":65,"text":"require no existing project to move or duplicate its files, and the\n"},{"number":66,"text":"definition's tenant registry entries locate the project-owned realisations\n"},{"number":67,"text":"beneath one shared specification\n"},{"number":68,"text":"([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers)).\n"},{"number":69,"text":"\n"},{"number":70,"text":"The authoritative split is strict: the surfaces bound as WHAT define WHAT;\n"},{"number":71,"text":"design and realisation surfaces define HOW; no build tenant, design, code,\n"},{"number":72,"text":"definition overlay or derived surface becomes co-equal constitutional\n"},{"number":73,"text":"authority with the bound WHAT (P6).\n"},{"number":74,"text":"\n"},{"number":75,"text":"In the default scaffold `requirements/` is a folder under `specification/`.\n"},{"number":76,"text":"Requirements may instead be stored at any location the product definition\n"},{"number":77,"text":"binds, as individual files or grouped into requirement families. The default\n"},{"number":78,"text":"shape exists to avoid collapsing the constitutional surface into one\n"},{"number":79,"text":"monolithic requirements document, not to make folder placement\n"},{"number":80,"text":"constitutional. This is one expression of the declarative bias: declaring\n"},{"number":81,"text":"requirement structure and family boundaries is preferred over maintaining\n"},{"number":82,"text":"one imperative catch-all document (P2).\n"},{"number":83,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":99,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/1. Within that context STDO is the\n"},{"number":89,"text":"shorthand for the method's four named areas. Its\n"},{"number":149,"text":"instance premises, which the commitments do not supply, are named in the\n"},{"number":150,"text":"rows as follows: owned layers, a product has a selected outcome and an\n"},{"number":151,"text":"owning authority for each layer of its specification; layered surfaces,\n"},{"number":152,"text":"its specification is written as layered surfaces that actors interpret;\n"},{"number":153,"text":"several realisations, one specification may have several realisations,\n"},{"number":154,"text":"which change over time; immutable releases, a release is an immutable\n"},{"number":155,"text":"identity. Standing of the commitments cited (FOUNDATIONS §3): P0\n"},{"number":156,"text":"recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and\n"},{"number":157,"text":"P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable; P5\n"},{"number":158,"text":"derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise.\n"},{"number":159,"text":"\n"},{"number":160,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |\n"},{"number":161,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":162,"text":"| P6 independent; P1 independent; instance: owned layers, several realisations | By P6 authority exists only where it is declared and admitted, and by P1 a realisation's form carries no meaning of its own, so the declared specification governs: a build tenant, a design, code, a definition overlay or a derived view realises, locates or projects it and never becomes co-equal authority. | [Process constitution](#process-constitution); [Manifesto](#manifesto); [Constitutional chain](#constitutional-chain) | the declarative bias and the neutral constitutional examples of [Position](#position): policy choices of this member | 1, 9 |\n"},{"number":163,"text":"| P2 independent; P6 independent; instance: owned layers, layered surfaces | By P2 every obligation serves the selected outcome, so each live requirement has an owning design decision and downstream closure or explicit deferment. By P6 behaviour has authority only through what authorises it, so it traces back to the requirement and design that authorise it, and a break in that trace is drift. | [Trace closure and anti-drift](#trace-closure-and-anti-drift); [Spec-drivenness litmus](#spec-drivenness-litmus) items 6 to 8; [Requirement categories and classification](#requirement-categories-and-classification), the status axis; [§10](#10-design-records), `Implements:` | the four categories, the four statuses, the legacy classifications and the `Status` and `Category` fields; the ADR fields, ADRs per decision boundary, their storage defaults, their append-only lifecycle and the move of a narrowed shared ADR: domain choices of this member (§2, §10) | 1, 4, 9 |\n"},{"number":164,"text":"| P1 independent; P2 independent; instance: layered surfaces, several realisations | By P2 a layer exists so that the next can be derived from it, so a layer is sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from it, and a failure to derive is a defect of the upper layer. By P1 one meaning admits several representations, so several conformant realisations may satisfy one layer; the generic law is [EVALUATION §6](EVALUATION.md#6-conformance-of-realisations), Layered sufficiency. A realisation choice that no upper layer constrains belongs to design. | [Reconstruction litmus](#reconstruction-litmus); [Spec-drivenness litmus](#spec-drivenness-litmus) items 1 to 5; [Specification surface rule](#specification-surface-rule); [Design rule](#design-rule); [Requirement categories and classification](#requirement-categories-and-classification), the category axis | the layers of the chain and their order, and the conventional surface names: domain choices of this member ([Constitutional chain](#constitutional-chain), [Process constitution](#process-constitution)); where each surface lives: the product definition ([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §1](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#1-overlay-and-layout-independence)) | 1, 4, 6 |\n"},{"number":165,"text":"| P3 independent; instance: layered surfaces, immutable releases | By P3 a result binds the exact surface it read, so a live constitutional surface that changed in place would silently change what earlier results bound; it therefore changes by supersession or withdrawal, never in place, and is versioned history. For the same reason a version label binds an identity: an explicit one is reserved for an immutable release fact, a selector binding, or clearly historical or superseded material, never recency, and current truth is stated in the present tense. | [Live surface immutability](#live-surface-immutability); [Specification surface rule](#specification-surface-rule); [§6](#6-lineage-and-release), the release version boundary; [Spec-drivenness litmus](#spec-drivenness-litmus) item 9 | the exact tag `v<version>-rc.<n>` and the selector tag `v<version>`: a domain choice of this member, with release mechanics at [RELEASE](RELEASE.md#2-release-identities) | 1, 9 |\n"},{"number":166,"text":"| P2 independent; P5 derived; instance: layered surfaces | By P2 the specification serves an outcome that use keeps testing, so use exposes conditions the current specification cannot express. By P5 an unexpressed condition is an open gap, not a satisfied one, so a constitutional gap reprices the surface that cannot express it, or is carried as recorded, governed debt, and an unanswered lifecycle phase is a recorded gap, never a silent absence. | [Renewal path](#renewal-path); [Operational lifecycle sufficiency](#operational-lifecycle-sufficiency); [Spec-drivenness litmus](#spec-drivenness-litmus) items 11 and 13 | the phases of the operational lifecycle and the `Gap:` and `Unanswered:` markers: domain choices of this member | 1, 5 |\n"},{"number":167,"text":"| P2 independent; P6 independent; instance: owned layers | By P2 progress is movement toward one selected outcome, so product progress is judged against it. Only an obligation's owner can weaken it (P6), so a change that needs a weaker obligation is a change to the WHAT at its owning layer. | [§11](#11-build-tenant-binding), rules 1, 2, 4 and 6, and Application in this method | the division of a binding into requirements calculus, computational calculus and execution environment: a domain choice of this member; each tenant's calculus and environment: that tenant's design | 4, 8 |\n"},{"number":173,"text":"| P0 recovered; P1 independent; P2 independent; P4a independent; P6 independent; P5 derived; instance: several realisations | By P0 and P5 a binding's results must be evaluable by a finite actor, so a binding identifies its operations, their outcome values mapped into the core, and resource measures with units and boundaries. By P4a a calculus composes by its declared laws, so it may serve wherever its laws hold, whoever executes it. By P6 a project's mechanics for developing several tenants are that project's own law. | [§11](#11-build-tenant-binding), rules 3 and 5, and Development of several tenants | which resources are measured, the limits on them, and their units and boundaries: each tenant's binding, as its obligations require, under the resource-limit law of [ACTIVATION §6 Resource limits](ACTIVATION.md#resource-limits); the development mechanics: the project's product definition or the tenant's design | 3, 8 |\n"},{"number":174,"text":"| P1 independent; P0 recovered; P4a independent; P6 independent; instance: several realisations | By P1 and P4a the steps of a construction, what its data means and how it is carried out are separately declared, so they stay three separate accounts across the binding. A mapping from one account to another is a transformation, so it states and discharges its preservation under the law of [ACTIVATION §4 Refinement](ACTIVATION.md#refinement) and, where it is recorded in a_c, of [AC-013](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-013-transformation). | [§11](#11-build-tenant-binding), rule 7 | which accounts a mapping joins, and the evidence that discharges its preservation in the environment: each tenant's binding; the three accounts of a construction: an added choice owned by [FOUNDATIONS §2 Accounts of a construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#accounts-of-a-construction) | 6, 8 |\n"},{"number":175,"text":"\n"},{"number":176,"text":"The standing of these consequences is stated in\n"},{"number":177,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).\n"},{"number":178,"text":"The table accounts for §1 to §3, §6 and §9 to §11. §1 Canonical statement\n"},{"number":179,"text":"decides nothing of its own: each clause names its owning section. §8\n"},{"number":180,"text":"binds the step of ACTIVATION to this method's terms;
