The chain/Constitutional chain","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FConstitutional%20chain","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"3b3b67d4159a87bfbaff2860a9b82916350bd5da5ff5db33f40eea5c70eaae06","start_line":207,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":207,"text":"### Constitutional chain\n"},{"number":208,"text":"\n"},{"number":209,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":210,"text":"Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Code\n"},{"number":211,"text":"  → Events → Projection → Delta → Scenarios → Gap analysis\n"},{"number":212,"text":"  → Repricing at the layer its change class names\n"},{"number":213,"text":"```\n"},{"number":214,"text":"\n"},{"number":215,"text":"Goals define the current overriding concerns for the active body of work.\n"},{"number":216,"text":"Intent defines purpose and direction. Product Definition defines the current\n"},{"number":217,"text":"product realisation of the mutable source project, its key terms and its\n"},{"number":218,"text":"end-state shape in terms that can be decomposed into requirements.\n"},{"number":219,"text":"Requirements define invariant truths the system must satisfy. Design\n"},{"number":220,"text":"defines the structural decisions, interfaces, carrier surfaces and delivery\n"},{"number":221,"text":"topology that make those truths achievable; ADRs are one durable form of\n"},{"number":222,"text":"design record, not a second constitutional layer above design. Code\n"},{"number":223,"text":"realises those decisions where the selected execution environment is\n"},{"number":224,"text":"software; a performed human procedure realises them where it is a human\n"},{"number":225,"text":"process, and both where it is mixed (§11). Events are the retained\n"},{"number":226,"text":"record of what happened, in the carrier the binding selects: an event\n"},{"number":227,"text":"stream, a ledger, a signed record or an observation log. Projection\n"},{"number":228,"text":"reconstructs current truth from that retained record where the record is\n"},{"number":229,"text":"sufficient for the product's obligations; it need not replay a complete\n"},{"number":230,"text":"event stream. Delta reveals drift\n"},{"number":231,"text":"between intended truth and realised state. Scenarios test operational\n"},{"number":232,"text":"meaning: whether the system can do what the words describe. Gap analysis\n"},{"number":233,"text":"identifies where real use cases hit the current model and reveal\n"},{"number":234,"text":"insufficiency. Repricing updates goals, intent, product, requirements,\n"},{"number":235,"text":"design or code when the system no longer harmonises; when gap analysis\n"},{"number":236,"text":"reveals constitutional insufficiency, repricing re-enters at the layer its\n"},{"number":237,"text":"[change class](#change-classes) names and generates new goals or intent\n"},{"number":238,"text":"where the work wave, direction or scope changes (P2, P1).\n"},{"number":239,"text":"\n"},{"number":240,"text":"This is the homeostatic loop. Every link is load-bearing. A break at any\n"},{"number":241,"text":"link, goals with no downstream repricing path, an unowned requirement, an\n"},{"number":242,"text":"ungrounded design record, code without a design decision, creates\n"},{"number":243,"text":"accidental law (P6). Load-bearing means owned, not software: the links\n"},{"number":244,"text":"Code, Events and Projection name responsibilities every realisation\n"},{"number":245,"text":"carries in the carrier its binding selects (§11), and no product owes a\n"},{"number":246,"text":"code base or an event store that its binding does not select (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":247,"text":"\n"},{"number":248,"text":"The goals surface is the bounded work-wave surface: it captures the current\n"},{"number":249,"text":"overriding concerns for the next body of work, keeps temporary focus out of\n"},{"number":250,"text":"deeper constitutional layers until it is intentionally repriced there, and\n"},{"number":251,"text":"is more immediate than intent while remaining higher-level than product\n"},{"number":252,"text":"definition and requirements. The product-definition surface is the bridge\n"},{"number":253,"text":"between direction and obligation: it states the current product definition\n"},{"number":254,"text":"of the mutable source project in present-tense terms, names the product\n"},{"number":255,"text":"terms and boundaries that downstream layers rely on, and provides the\n"},{"number":256,"text":"surface that requirements decompose. It is not the immutable release cut\n"},{"number":257,"text":"and not the installed product; those are the lineage objects of FOUNDATIONS\n"},{"number":258,"text":"§2 (P3).\n"},{"number":259,"text":"\n"},{"number":260,"text":"Requirements are the constitutional what of the project. They are not\n"},{"number":261,"text":"limited to user-visible features: the live requirement surface may include\n"},{"number":262,"text":"capabilities, invariants, constraints, governance and verification\n"},{"number":263,"text":"obligations; what matters is that each requirement states something the\n"},{"number":264,"text":"project must make true. Design is the structural how: it chooses the\n"},{"number":265,"text":"concrete realisation that satisfies requirement truth, interfaces, topology,\n"},{"number":266,"text":"file placement, carrier documents, entry and control surfaces, runtime\n"},{"number":267,"text":"wiring and lawful tenant boundaries. Requirements may require such surfaces\n"},{"number":268,"text":"to exist and be delivered; design chooses where and how they are realised\n"},{"number":269,"text":"unless the path itself is constitutional (P2, P1).\n"},{"number":270,"text":"\n"},{"number":271,"text":"The relation between the WHAT and the build tenants that realise it is\n"},{"number":272,"text":"[§11](#11-build-tenant-binding) (P2).\n"},{"number":273,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":300,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Manifesto","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FManifesto","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"ccc62bd0e9c758aeddcfaa97c1f822700ff507bb6b91975bfd961514f657b4b5","start_line":274,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":274,"text":"### Manifesto\n"},{"number":275,"text":"\n"},{"number":276,"text":"The method commits to these (P2, P6). It defines the\n"},{"number":277,"text":"current goals for the active body of work before repricing deeper\n"},{"number":278,"text":"constitutional layers. It works from intent before implementation. It\n"},{"number":279,"text":"defines the current product definition in explicit present-tense terms\n"},{"number":280,"text":"before decomposing it into detailed requirements. It defines the full\n"},{"number":281,"text":"constitutional what in requirements, not merely a feature list. It prefers\n"},{"number":282,"text":"declaring desired truth and lawful boundaries over prescribing step-by-step\n"},{"number":283,"text":"imperative procedure. It makes design the explicit structural bridge\n"},{"number":284,"text":"between requirements and code. It requires code to be derivable from\n"},{"number":285,"text":"requirements and design, not defended as accidental precedent. It treats\n"},{"number":286,"text":"spec-driven development as a disambiguation pipeline: each major gate\n"},{"number":287,"text":"reduces the space of lawful interpretations before downstream realisation\n"},{"number":288,"text":"proceeds. It demands evidence for claims through scenarios, tests, events,\n"},{"number":289,"text":"projection and delta. It treats repricing as part of correctness: when\n"},{"number":290,"text":"reality exposes a constitutional gap, the specification changes. It keeps\n"},{"number":291,"text":"authority directional while iterating: goals govern intent, intent governs\n"},{"number":292,"text":"product definition, product definition governs requirements, requirements\n"},{"number":293,"text":"govern design, and requirements plus design govern code. It keeps the live\n"},{"number":294,"text":"operative surface in the present tense only: once a new current reality is\n"},{"number":295,"text":"established, transitional paths are erased from the live product unless\n"},{"number":296,"text":"explicitly retained as compatibility features. It treats derived artifacts,\n"},{"number":297,"text":"indexes, trace matrices, reports, automation and generated views, as read\n"},{"number":298,"text":"models, never as constitutional truth. If these claims do not hold, the\n"},{"number":299,"text":"work is not spec-driven.\n"},{"number":300,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":330,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Spec-drivenness litmus","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FSpec-drivenness%20litmus","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"383ae41c8d382c36894f0b67d1f404fb71de15a997c24e3e0dc4efa4a117f66e","start_line":301,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":301,"text":"### Spec-drivenness litmus\n"},{"number":302,"text":"\n"},{"number":303,"text":"The work is not spec-driven if any of these holds (P2, P6):\n"},{"number":304,"text":"\n"},{"number":305,"text":"1. Given goals, a competent team cannot derive a conformant intent surface.\n"},{"number":306,"text":"2. Given intent, a competent team cannot derive a conformant\n"},{"number":307,"text":"   product-definition surface.\n"},{"number":308,"text":"3. Given product definition, a competent team cannot derive conformant\n"},{"number":309,"text":"   requirements.\n"},{"number":310,"text":"4. Given requirements, a competent team cannot derive a conformant design.\n"},{"number":311,"text":"5. Given requirements and design, a competent team cannot derive conformant\n"},{"number":312,"text":"   code.\n"},{"number":313,"text":"6. A live requirement has no explicit status, category or owning design\n"},{"number":314,"text":"   decision.\n"},{"number":315,"text":"7. A live requirement has no downstream realisation or explicit deferment\n"},{"number":316,"text":"   surface.\n"},{"number":317,"text":"8. Code behaviour exists without requirement and design authority.\n"},{"number":318,"text":"9. A live domain artifact is rewritten in place after becoming part of the\n"},{"number":319,"text":"   live constitutional surface.\n"},{"number":320,"text":"10. A capability claim has no operational evidence.\n"},{"number":321,"text":"11. Drift is discovered, [Universal intake triage](#universal-intake-triage)\n"},{"number":322,"text":"    locates its cause in the constitutional source, and that source is not\n"},{"number":323,"text":"    repriced.\n"},{"number":324,"text":"12. A major ambiguity at a constitutional or realisation boundary is neither\n"},{"number":325,"text":"    recorded nor explicitly governed.\n"},{"number":326,"text":"13. A material product, module, function, application, runtime surface or\n"},{"number":327,"text":"    capability has no declared operational lifecycle signal and no recorded\n"},{"number":328,"text":"    gap for unanswered release, deployment, live-use, telemetry or\n"},{"number":329,"text":"    retirement questions.\n"},{"number":330,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":372,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Reconstruction litmus","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FReconstruction%20litmus","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"3f0f348cbda89c5455a918ab7d17c96ed68f563dde48439d26ddf215cc23c90f","start_line":331,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":331,"text":"### Reconstruction litmus\n"},{"number":332,"text":"\n"},{"number":333,"text":"The generic law, that a layered specification is sufficient when a competent\n"},{"number":334,"text":"actor can derive each layer from the one above, that sufficiency is not\n"},{"number":335,"text":"determinism, that a boundary crossed only by hiding a major ambiguity is not\n"},{"number":336,"text":"sufficient, and that an accepted relation may be reused on its exact basis\n"},{"number":337,"text":"after checking applicability and invalidation, is EVALUATION §6. Applied to\n"},{"number":338,"text":"this chain (P2, P1), the method is\n"},{"number":339,"text":"specification-driven only if the layers are reconstructable in order: given\n"},{"number":340,"text":"goals, a competent team should be able to derive a conformant intent\n"},{"number":341,"text":"surface; given\n"},{"number":342,"text":"intent, a conformant product definition; given product, conformant\n"},{"number":343,"text":"requirements; given requirements, a conformant design; given requirements\n"},{"number":344,"text":"plus design, conformant code. Different designs may satisfy the same\n"},{"number":345,"text":"requirements and different codebases the same design.\n"},{"number":346,"text":"\n"},{"number":347,"text":"A failure at any boundary is a specification defect of the upper layer. If\n"},{"number":348,"text":"intent cannot be derived from goals, the goals surface is unclear,\n"},{"number":349,"text":"contradictory or not concrete enough to orient the next bounded wave of\n"},{"number":350,"text":"work. If product cannot be derived from intent, the intent surface is too\n"},{"number":351,"text":"vague, contradictory or not concrete enough to guide realisation. If\n"},{"number":352,"text":"requirements cannot be derived from product, the product surface is\n"},{"number":353,"text":"underspecified, contradictory or not decomposable enough to govern\n"},{"number":354,"text":"implementation. If design cannot be derived from requirements, the\n"},{"number":355,"text":"requirement surface is underspecified, contradictory or polluted with\n"},{"number":356,"text":"accidental implementation detail. If code cannot be derived from\n"},{"number":357,"text":"requirements plus design, the design surface is incomplete, ambiguous or\n"},{"number":358,"text":"not operational enough. ADRs and design documents are therefore not\n"},{"number":359,"text":"decorative explanation; they are the load-bearing bridge between\n"},{"number":360,"text":"constitutional truth and executable realisation.\n"},{"number":361,"text":"\n"},{"number":362,"text":"Reconstruction sufficiency depends on ambiguity governance (§5). The\n"},{"number":363,"text":"hidden-ambiguity limit, reuse of an accepted relation's evidence, what\n"},{"number":364,"text":"reconstructability requires and grants, and the reconstruction span are\n"},{"number":365,"text":"stated once at\n"},{"number":366,"text":"[EVALUATION §6 Layered sufficiency](EVALUATION.md#6-conformance-of-realisations);\n"},{"number":367,"text":"this litmus applies them to the method's own chain, where the span of a\n"},{"number":368,"text":"local selected function excludes recreating the whole product. The design\n"},{"number":369,"text":"profile owns design-view coverage, its material-change gate and\n"},{"number":370,"text":"unchanged-boundary reuse; this litmus neither waives that gate nor requires\n"},{"number":371,"text":"recreating unchanged accepted views ([DESIGN_MODULE](DESIGN_MODULE.md)).\n"},{"number":372,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":403,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Renewal path","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FRenewal%20path","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"a847c8a57484bab91b0f8735bdf4fa3779056b0971571bc4dfb80e17c633e0d5","start_line":373,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":373,"text":"### Renewal path\n"},{"number":374,"text":"\n"},{"number":375,"text":"Intent is not only top-down. The full homeostatic cycle includes a reverse\n"},{"number":376,"text":"path, from real use cases back into the chain, that generates new goals or\n"},{"number":377,"text":"intent where a use case changes the work wave, direction or scope (P2):\n"},{"number":378,"text":"\n"},{"number":379,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":380,"text":"current specification → real-world use case → gap analysis → re-entry at the layer its change class names\n"},{"number":381,"text":"```\n"},{"number":382,"text":"\n"},{"number":383,"text":"The generative rule: a real use case (scenario, deployment, external review)\n"},{"number":384,"text":"hits the current model; gap analysis identifies what the constitution cannot\n"},{"number":385,"text":"express; if the gap is constitutional, not merely a missing implementation,\n"},{"number":386,"text":"it re-enters at the layer its [change class](#change-classes) names, and\n"},{"number":387,"text":"new goals or intent are written where it changes the work wave, direction\n"},{"number":388,"text":"or scope; the repriced surface then flows forward through the layers that\n"},{"number":389,"text":"class lists. New intents emerge from repeated, real use-case pressure\n"},{"number":390,"text":"against the current model, not from abstract speculation; a gap becomes\n"},{"number":391,"text":"intent only once it is concrete. Ad hoc coding pressure does not generate\n"},{"number":392,"text":"intent; explicit gap analysis does. This is how the system stays alive\n"},{"number":393,"text":"instead of becoming a frozen constitution.\n"},{"number":394,"text":"\n"},{"number":395,"text":"The flow is not a one-pass waterfall computation; it is cumulative\n"},{"number":396,"text":"iteration: requirements and design are refined over time; code is\n"},{"number":397,"text":"repeatedly re-derived against the current constitutional surface; gaps\n"},{"number":398,"text":"discovered during implementation, testing, replay or scenario work feed\n"},{"number":399,"text":"back into repricing. What stays stable is the full direction of authority:\n"},{"number":400,"text":"goals govern intent, intent governs product, product governs requirements,\n"},{"number":401,"text":"requirements govern design, and requirements plus design govern code,\n"},{"number":402,"text":"through every iteration.\n"},{"number":403,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":442,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Specification surface rule","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FSpecification%20surface%20rule","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"b3d07d9d084d25ef1750b67c280d9d8e3622bf036953cc4f293243f0e0cb7b1a","start_line":404,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":404,"text":"### Specification surface rule\n"},{"number":405,"text":"\n"},{"number":406,"text":"The active specification layers have distinct constitutional roles (P2, P1). Goals orient the current bounded work\n"},{"number":407,"text":"wave and are not a substitute requirement surface. Intent states why the\n"},{"number":408,"text":"system exists and what directional change is in or out of scope; it carries\n"},{"number":409,"text":"no optional realisation detail unless that detail is itself constitutional.\n"},{"number":410,"text":"Product states the current concrete product definition and bridges intent\n"},{"number":411,"text":"to requirements; it is not a release-note surface; it carries enough\n"},{"number":412,"text":"operational lifecycle signal for downstream requirements and design to\n"},{"number":413,"text":"understand intended use, release and install posture, live-use posture,\n"},{"number":414,"text":"observability posture, and retirement or supersession posture where those\n"},{"number":415,"text":"materially affect product meaning. Requirements state stable obligations\n"},{"number":416,"text":"that must be true; they carry explicit acceptance criteria and remain\n"},{"number":417,"text":"sufficient for downstream design derivation, including lifecycle\n"},{"number":418,"text":"obligations or named lifecycle ambiguity gaps where build, assurance,\n"},{"number":419,"text":"release, deployment, live usage, telemetry or retirement materially affect\n"},{"number":420,"text":"the obligation. Design states how requirement truth is realised; it is\n"},{"number":421,"text":"downstream of requirements and may choose structure, interfaces, carriers,\n"},{"number":422,"text":"packaging and tenant boundaries. ADRs are durable design memory, not a\n"},{"number":423,"text":"second requirement surface.\n"},{"number":424,"text":"\n"},{"number":425,"text":"Constitutional specification is current-surface law and is written in the\n"},{"number":426,"text":"present tense. Dead law does not remain in active constitutional artifacts\n"},{"number":427,"text":"for historical comfort: what is no longer live is deleted, superseded or\n"},{"number":428,"text":"moved to commentary, and a migration wave does not justify preserving stale\n"},{"number":429,"text":"constitutional wording inside the live surface (P3). During a change wave\n"},{"number":430,"text":"the live constitutional surface is written in terms of the current truth\n"},{"number":431,"text":"and the declared affected boundary; version-line branding such as `2.0` or\n"},{"number":432,"text":"`3.0` is not used merely to indicate recency, and explicit version labels\n"},{"number":433,"text":"are reserved for immutable release facts, selector bindings, or clearly\n"},{"number":434,"text":"historical or superseded material (§6).\n"},{"number":435,"text":"\n"},{"number":436,"text":"Before a downstream specification artifact is treated as complete, the\n"},{"number":437,"text":"whole affected span is checked: is the change class clear; is the re-entry\n"},{"number":438,"text":"point lawful for that class; can each downstream layer still be derived\n"},{"number":439,"text":"from the upstream layer; do the active intent, product, requirements,\n"},{"number":440,"text":"design and qualification surfaces still say the same thing in the affected\n"},{"number":441,"text":"scope. If not, the gate is not closed (§4, consistency gate).\n"},{"number":442,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":460,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Design rule","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FDesign%20rule","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"321b155dbfe652814989c522a46b9a6c1528b1c8720e3669eaa2de65861ce3c9","start_line":443,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":443,"text":"### Design rule\n"},{"number":444,"text":"\n"},{"number":445,"text":"Requirements state what control or delivery surfaces must exist; design\n"},{"number":446,"text":"decides the concrete mechanism that realises them. If a technology stack,\n"},{"number":447,"text":"carrier or runtime is not already constrained by an upstream constitutional\n"},{"number":448,"text":"surface, choosing it is part of design, not a separate upstream authority\n"},{"number":449,"text":"(P2, P1). A tenant's choice of stack, human process or\n"},{"number":450,"text":"combination is its execution binding, declared in that design under §11.\n"},{"number":451,"text":"The boundary matters especially for\n"},{"number":452,"text":"agent-facing bootstrap and control surfaces: requirements may say that\n"},{"number":453,"text":"authoritative bootstrap or control surfaces must be present, carry bare\n"},{"number":454,"text":"axioms and route to the canonical method; design decides whether those\n"},{"number":455,"text":"surfaces are entry documents, embedded blocks, standalone compiled\n"},{"number":456,"text":"artifacts or another lawful topology (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §12). If\n"},{"number":457,"text":"filenames and placement are hardcoded in requirements without\n"},{"number":458,"text":"constitutional necessity, the requirement surface has absorbed design\n"},{"number":459,"text":"detail and made re-derivation harder.\n"},{"number":460,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":480,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Realisation shape","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FRealisation%20shape","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"9a602118a8eb970fb44b777d7b1abd84b21f33062d36f46a6bf10360c7ad98c6","start_line":461,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":461,"text":"### Realisation shape\n"},{"number":462,"text":"\n"},{"number":463,"text":"For a realisation boundary that the design profile governs (DESIGN_MODULE,\n"},{"number":464,"text":"tier 3, adopted under its own adoption rule), the core rule is: semantic\n"},{"number":465,"text":"steps should read as transforms over admitted truth; effects should be\n"},{"number":466,"text":"explicit and pushed to the edge. If a reader has to inspect orchestration\n"},{"number":467,"text":"code, mutable workspace state, service methods or fallback defaults to\n"},{"number":468,"text":"determine what the system means, the design is too imperative and too\n"},{"number":469,"text":"coupled (P1, P6).\n"},{"number":470,"text":"\n"},{"number":471,"text":"Non-goals of that profile (P1, P4a): it does not require one specific programming language,\n"},{"number":472,"text":"elimination of all imperative code, monadic or category-theory vocabulary,\n"},{"number":473,"text":"or replacing every exception with a custom algebraic type. It does require\n"},{"number":474,"text":"that the implementation shape remain readable, modular and honest about\n"},{"number":475,"text":"where meaning lives and where effects happen. Where a boundary composes\n"},{"number":476,"text":"higher-order functions or effectful computation, it does require an\n"},{"number":477,"text":"explicit composition and effect algebra with its applicable identity,\n"},{"number":478,"text":"closure, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws (FOUNDATIONS\n"},{"number":479,"text":"§4 Composition). The vocabulary is optional; the law is not.\n"},{"number":480,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":561,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Requirement categories and classification","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FRequirement%20categories%20and%20classification","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"822d078f249debcebeb2978a6dccc8730fa900a885ecfe48d84f9b4e9d6dc492","start_line":481,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":481,"text":"### Requirement categories and classification\n"},{"number":482,"text":"\n"},{"number":483,"text":"Every live requirement family is categorised by the kind of truth it\n"},{"number":484,"text":"asserts, so that the requirement surface is not treated as a feature list\n"},{"number":485,"text":"(P1, P2):\n"},{"number":486,"text":"\n"},{"number":487,"text":"| Category | Meaning | Typical question |\n"},{"number":488,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":489,"text":"| Capability | a behaviour, function or surface the system must provide | what can the system do |\n"},{"number":490,"text":"| Constraint / Guarantee | an invariant, law, safety property, portability rule or semantic guarantee that bounds how the system may behave | what must always remain true |\n"},{"number":491,"text":"| Governance | a policy or control rule over lifecycle, authority, visibility, release or operator action | what governs use and change |\n"},{"number":492,"text":"| Verification | a requirement on tests, evidence, traceability, qualification or forensic surfaces | how do we know the claim is true |\n"},{"number":493,"text":"\n"},{"number":494,"text":"Requirements remain part of the constitutional layer in all four cases. A\n"},{"number":495,"text":"category is not a priority label and not a claim that the requirement is\n"},{"number":496,"text":"user-facing; it states what kind of project truth the requirement owns.\n"},{"number":497,"text":"Requirements describe the full constitutional what; design describes the\n"},{"number":498,"text":"structural how, with ADRs one durable design form; scenarios validate the\n"},{"number":499,"text":"operational meaning of capability claims. Not every requirement should be\n"},{"number":500,"text":"translated into a marketed feature; some are better expressed as\n"},{"number":501,"text":"guarantees, constraints, governance rules or verification obligations.\n"},{"number":502,"text":"Requirements should also avoid freezing concrete realisation choices\n"},{"number":503,"text":"prematurely:\n"},{"number":504,"text":"unless a path, filename or packaging rule is itself constitutional, it\n"},{"number":505,"text":"belongs to design.\n"},{"number":506,"text":"\n"},{"number":507,"text":"Every live requirement family is classified on two independent axes (P3,\n"},{"number":508,"text":"P1): lifecycle status (Active,\n"},{"number":509,"text":"Deferred, Superseded, Orphaned) and requirement category (the four above).\n"},{"number":510,"text":"The axes answer different questions: status says whether the requirement\n"},{"number":511,"text":"still belongs in the constitution and whether it is operative or explicitly\n"},{"number":512,"text":"deferred; category says what kind of truth it asserts. A live requirement\n"},{"number":513,"text":"is incomplete if either axis is missing. In project documents the\n"},{"number":514,"text":"classification is explicit in the requirement's header metadata: `Status`\n"},{"number":515,"text":"carries lifecycle status and `Category` carries the kind.\n"},{"number":516,"text":"\n"},{"number":517,"text":"Every inherited or legacy requirement is classified as one of these, and\n"},{"number":518,"text":"nothing live remains unclassified (P3):\n"},{"number":519,"text":"\n"},{"number":520,"text":"| Classification | Meaning | Action |\n"},{"number":521,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":522,"text":"| Deferred | retained in the live surface as an explicit not-yet-operative or not-yet-realised obligation | keep with an honest deferment surface; do not present as current closure |\n"},{"number":523,"text":"| Superseded | ownership has moved to a newer constitutional surface or design decision | add Implements and Supersedes to the governing design record |\n"},{"number":524,"text":"| Active | remains live constitutional law in the current surface | has an owning design decision; write or update one |\n"},{"number":525,"text":"| Orphaned | no longer part of the intended system | remove or explicitly supersede |\n"},{"number":526,"text":"\n"},{"number":527,"text":"The lifecycle statuses (Active, Deferred, Superseded, Orphaned), the\n"},{"number":528,"text":"categories and the legacy classifications are declared states of a\n"},{"number":529,"text":"requirement, not results, and map to no core value. So are the other\n"},{"number":530,"text":"declared classes of this member: the kinds of evidence of §3 (material\n"},{"number":531,"text":"advance, prerequisite readiness, preservation, regression), the old-path\n"},{"number":532,"text":"classes of §7 Required migration protocol, the inherited-material\n"},{"number":533,"text":"classes adopted, superseded, deferred and orphaned and the\n"},{"number":534,"text":"implementation classifications `carry_across`, `redundant` and `rewrite`\n"},{"number":535,"text":"of §7 Fundamental migration, and the ADR `Status:` values of §10; the change\n"},{"number":536,"text":"classes are declared states under §4 Change classes. Each records\n"},{"number":537,"text":"a declared classification of its subject, not the answer to a predicate\n"},{"number":538,"text":"that an evaluation decides. An evaluation that reads them returns its own\n"},{"number":539,"text":"core value with its predicate under\n"},{"number":540,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). Purpose and material\n"},{"number":541,"text":"relation: a declared state is never combined as an evaluation result, so\n"},{"number":542,"text":"a requirement marked Active, or evidence classed as material advance,\n"},{"number":543,"text":"cannot stand in for a `satisfied` result, and a requirement marked\n"},{"number":544,"text":"Deferred or Orphaned cannot stand in for a `falsified` one (P5, P1).\n"},{"number":545,"text":"\n"},{"number":546,"text":"The legacy classification answers one question: what standing an\n"},{"number":547,"text":"inherited requirement holds in the project's own live requirement\n"},{"number":548,"text":"surface. The disposition of a predecessor claim under\n"},{"number":549,"text":"[RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015)\n"},{"number":550,"text":"answers another: what a successor release does with a claim of the\n"},{"number":551,"text":"released predecessor it evolves, a claim that qualification evaluates.\n"},{"number":552,"text":"Where a project's work is also such a successor, each predecessor claim\n"},{"number":553,"text":"takes its RELEASE §9 disposition by that section's predicates, and no\n"},{"number":554,"text":"lifecycle status or legacy classification supplies or replaces it: a\n"},{"number":555,"text":"requirement marked Active may still be `superseded` where its meaning\n"},{"number":556,"text":"changed, Superseded names no accepted successor relation, and Orphaned\n"},{"number":557,"text":"is not an intentional removal. Purpose and material relation: two\n"},{"number":558,"text":"vocabularies with overlapping words would otherwise let a project-level\n"},{"number":559,"text":"record stand in for a successor disposition that its owner has not made\n"},{"number":560,"text":"(P6, P3).\n"},{"number":561,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":602,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Trace closure and anti-drift","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FTrace%20closure%20and%20anti-drift","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"73f9d087688cad52803bf8933e4d274e545b1e1070f13831f86be3a3ab368b1b","start_line":562,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":562,"text":"### Trace closure and anti-drift\n"},{"number":563,"text":"\n"},{"number":564,"text":"Spec-driven development requires constitutional trace closure: the rule\n"},{"number":565,"text":"that closes the constitution over realised behaviour, stricter than\n"},{"number":566,"text":"documentation completeness (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":567,"text":"\n"},{"number":568,"text":"Ownership: every live requirement family maps to one or more owning design\n"},{"number":569,"text":"decisions; every ADR or other design record grounds itself in requirements\n"},{"number":570,"text":"through an explicit `Implements:` line.\n"},{"number":571,"text":"\n"},{"number":572,"text":"Downstream closure: no live requirement remains a free-floating statement\n"},{"number":573,"text":"of intent; if it is live it is realised through the downstream chain or\n"},{"number":574,"text":"explicitly deferred with an honest surface that records the deferment, so\n"},{"number":575,"text":"every live requirement family has downstream closure, realised in design,\n"},{"number":576,"text":"code and tests or explicitly deferred. No shipping code or tests exist as\n"},{"number":577,"text":"ungoverned behaviour: behaviour that exists traces back to live\n"},{"number":578,"text":"requirements and the design decisions that authorise it. No hidden product\n"},{"number":579,"text":"surface is allowed; behaviour without trace authority is accidental law\n"},{"number":580,"text":"even if it works.\n"},{"number":581,"text":"\n"},{"number":582,"text":"Drift signals: unowned requirements, ungrounded\n"},{"number":583,"text":"design records, deferred requirements without explicit deferment, and code\n"},{"number":584,"text":"without trace authority are design drift. An ADR or other design artifact\n"},{"number":585,"text":"with no requirement grounding is design without constitutional authority.\n"},{"number":586,"text":"Code behaviour with no design owner means the design has already drifted.\n"},{"number":587,"text":"Shipping code or tests that cannot trace back out to live requirement and\n"},{"number":588,"text":"design authority are ungoverned product surface. Tests that validate\n"},{"number":589,"text":"implementation habit rather than requirement truth lock in drift. Events\n"},{"number":590,"text":"and projection that reveal persistent delta signal drift whose cause\n"},{"number":591,"text":"[Universal intake triage](#universal-intake-triage) diagnoses: the code, the\n"},{"number":592,"text":"requirement and design stack, the predictive model or the observation. A\n"},{"number":593,"text":"capability with requirements and design but no scenario has unverified\n"},{"number":594,"text":"operational meaning.\n"},{"number":595,"text":"A requirement treated as a product feature when it is a guarantee,\n"},{"number":596,"text":"governance rule or verification obligation is misclassified. A live\n"},{"number":597,"text":"constitutional artifact corrected by in-place mutation rather than\n"},{"number":598,"text":"supersession or withdrawal has corrupted constitutional history. A real use\n"},{"number":599,"text":"case that reveals a gap not expressible in current requirements needs\n"},{"number":600,"text":"re-entry at the layer its [change class](#change-classes) names,\n"},{"number":601,"text":"Requirements or upstream, not a code hack.\n"},{"number":602,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":619,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Live surface immutability","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FLive%20surface%20immutability","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"dfcabe06ab3ba2c33c2d8bc3acc05ba2cdd81561fe4fb4c9193d2e1d724fdd86","start_line":603,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":603,"text":"### Live surface immutability\n"},{"number":604,"text":"\n"},{"number":605,"text":"A project may accumulate multiple live domain surfaces over time. A live\n"},{"number":606,"text":"surface is versioned constitutional history, not scratch space (P3). Engine code, design documents, tests and\n"},{"number":607,"text":"tooling may be refactored aggressively while they remain mutable\n"},{"number":608,"text":"implementation surfaces. Live domain artifacts, once published as live\n"},{"number":609,"text":"constitutional surfaces, are immutable in place; if one is wrong, the valid\n"},{"number":610,"text":"actions are to supersede it with a new version or to withdraw or delete it\n"},{"number":611,"text":"from the live surface. Transitional implementation paths, migration\n"},{"number":612,"text":"scaffolds and fallback behaviours have no permanent authority in the live\n"},{"number":613,"text":"surface: once superseded they are retired, and any retained responsibility\n"},{"number":614,"text":"satisfies the retention relation of §7 (closure criterion). The past is\n"},{"number":615,"text":"preserved by version control, operational event history where present and\n"},{"number":616,"text":"superseded constitutional artifacts. The method does not require shipping\n"},{"number":617,"text":"compatibility shims forever, and it does not allow silent mutation of live\n"},{"number":618,"text":"constitutional history.\n"},{"number":619,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":664,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/2. The chain/Operational lifecycle sufficiency","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F2.%20The%20chain%2FOperational%20lifecycle%20sufficiency","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"41623a868cddedba916174ad6df1395940dca75a55cb0f1093726f3a2b5dd40c","start_line":620,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":620,"text":"### Operational lifecycle sufficiency\n"},{"number":621,"text":"\n"},{"number":622,"text":"Constitutional specification treats a designed thing as more than its build\n"},{"number":623,"text":"shape (P2). Any material\n"},{"number":624,"text":"product, application, module, function, runtime surface, plugin\n"},{"number":625,"text":"surface, public interface, data surface or capability has an operational\n"},{"number":626,"text":"lifecycle, whose canonical chain is intent, requirement, build, assurance,\n"},{"number":627,"text":"release, deployment, live usage, observed telemetry, retirement. The\n"},{"number":628,"text":"product definition and the requirement surface need not prescribe the\n"},{"number":629,"text":"implementation mechanism for every phase; they provide enough\n"},{"number":630,"text":"constitutional signal for downstream design to derive the intended\n"},{"number":631,"text":"lifecycle, or explicitly record the unresolved ambiguity.\n"},{"number":632,"text":"\n"},{"number":633,"text":"For product definition this means naming the current product boundary,\n"},{"number":634,"text":"intended use context, release and install posture, live-use posture,\n"},{"number":635,"text":"observability posture, and retirement or supersession posture where those\n"},{"number":636,"text":"materially affect the product's meaning. For requirements it means stating\n"},{"number":637,"text":"any invariant obligation that governs build, assurance, release,\n"},{"number":638,"text":"deployment, live usage, telemetry, retirement, ownership, source truth,\n"},{"number":639,"text":"authority boundary or downstream interpretation; a requirement may defer a\n"},{"number":640,"text":"phase only by naming the deferment and the surface that will own its later\n"},{"number":641,"text":"resolution.\n"},{"number":642,"text":"\n"},{"number":643,"text":"The rule is an ambiguity detector, not a demand that every requirement\n"},{"number":644,"text":"become a release plan. Each phase has one of three answers, and this\n"},{"number":645,"text":"section owns them: the phase is answered by the surface; if a phase is\n"},{"number":646,"text":"not applicable, the surface says why; if it is unknown, a named gap such\n"},{"number":647,"text":"as `Gap:` or `Unanswered:` is recorded.\n"},{"number":648,"text":"Silent absence is not a valid lifecycle answer.\n"},{"number":649,"text":"[ASSURANCE §16](ASSURANCE.md#16-module-lifecycle-confirmation) applies\n"},{"number":650,"text":"the three answers to the design evidence of a governed boundary. When the lifecycle signal is\n"},{"number":651,"text":"missing, downstream design may not fill the gap by local convention,\n"},{"number":652,"text":"implementation precedent, prompt prose or test fixture; it reprices the\n"},{"number":653,"text":"appropriate constitutional surface or carries the ambiguity as explicit,\n"},{"number":654,"text":"governed debt (§5).\n"},{"number":655,"text":"\n"},{"number":656,"text":"A phase answered, a phase declared not applicable with its reason, and a\n"},{"number":657,"text":"named `Gap:` or `Unanswered:` marker are declared states of the surface\n"},{"number":658,"text":"for that phase, not results, and map to no core value. An evaluation that\n"},{"number":659,"text":"reads them returns its own core value with its predicate under\n"},{"number":660,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). Purpose and material\n"},{"number":661,"text":"relation: a declared state is never combined as an evaluation result, so\n"},{"number":662,"text":"a phase marked answered or not applicable cannot stand in for a\n"},{"number":663,"text":"`satisfied` result (P5, P1).\n"},{"number":664,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":753,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/3. Outcome conservation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F3.%20Outcome%20conservation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"25d09cefb3754e106d993c903b27ad6f8cfc333e00f0a06e52717d116cd5b800","start_line":665,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":665,"text":"## 3. Outcome conservation\n"},{"number":666,"text":"\n"},{"number":667,"text":"Every product-outcome-bearing work wave identifies one explicitly selected,\n"},{"number":668,"text":"unresolved, directly verifiable product-defined outcome and declares the\n"},{"number":669,"text":"acceptance interval for that instance. Product-progress claims and\n"},{"number":670,"text":"promotion onto the supported product path are judged against that same\n"},{"number":671,"text":"outcome (P2; FOUNDATIONS §2\n"},{"number":672,"text":"Outcome U is the generic object).\n"},{"number":673,"text":"\n"},{"number":674,"text":"Evidence distinguishes material advance, prerequisite readiness,\n"},{"number":675,"text":"preservation and regression. The four refine the progress\n"},{"number":676,"text":"categories of [ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart)\n"},{"number":677,"text":"(Progress) for a product outcome: material advance is progress there,\n"},{"number":678,"text":"accepted material movement toward the selected product outcome, and only\n"},{"number":679,"text":"material advance projects product progress; prerequisite readiness is\n"},{"number":680,"text":"its prerequisite work, which names the product obligation it enables and\n"},{"number":681,"text":"here also remains bounded; preservation is its preservation and repeated\n"},{"number":682,"text":"proof, useful evidence, not progress; regression maps to evidence that\n"},{"number":683,"text":"is not new progress, and this member adds one need to it: the promotion\n"},{"number":684,"text":"block in the last paragraph of this section. Churn and the revision of the forecast are\n"},{"number":685,"text":"ACTIVATION §5's, unchanged here.\n"},{"number":686,"text":"\n"},{"number":687,"text":"The exact bound outcome instance stops selecting later product-progress\n"},{"number":688,"text":"work when the owning authority accepts it; its witnesses remain regression\n"},{"number":689,"text":"and preservation evidence. Acceptance exhausts only that instance and its\n"},{"number":690,"text":"declared acceptance interval; it does not discharge an enduring guarantee,\n"},{"number":691,"text":"a recurring obligation or a broader product family beyond the accepted\n"},{"number":692,"text":"instance. Further work against the accepted instance is preservation, a\n"},{"number":693,"text":"named bounded prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new change\n"},{"number":694,"text":"requiring lawful repricing; it is not additional progress against the\n"},{"number":695,"text":"accepted instance (EVALUATION §5).\n"},{"number":696,"text":"\n"},{"number":697,"text":"Selecting the next unresolved outcome already defined by the product is a\n"},{"number":698,"text":"goals and work-sequencing decision. Changing an outcome's meaning or scope,\n"},{"number":699,"text":"or introducing a new product outcome, requires lawful re-entry at the\n"},{"number":700,"text":"product (§4).\n"},{"number":701,"text":"\n"},{"number":702,"text":"Evidence evaluates and constrains its bound product claim. Completion of a\n"},{"number":703,"text":"proof surface, matrix, coverage ledger, inventory, design-method artifact,\n"},{"number":704,"text":"test suite or other evidence surface cannot by itself select, enlarge or\n"},{"number":705,"text":"replace the product outcome. If an assurance capability is explicitly\n"},{"number":706,"text":"defined as product behaviour, delivery of that capability is judged as\n"},{"number":707,"text":"product progress; its evidence still does not author the claim. The same\n"},{"number":708,"text":"artifact may be product output for one claim and evidence for another only\n"},{"number":709,"text":"when those roles are declared separately (P6).\n"},{"number":710,"text":"\n"},{"number":711,"text":"Within a product-outcome-bearing work wave, material realisation growth\n"},{"number":712,"text":"derives its authority from the selected unresolved product outcome, an\n"},{"number":713,"text":"admitted named bounded prerequisite to it, or an admitted named bounded\n"},{"number":714,"text":"experiment whose stated observation discriminates a stated decision for it.\n"},{"number":715,"text":"A prerequisite or experiment authorises only its declared provisional\n"},{"number":716,"text":"bound; it does not select or enlarge the product outcome, authorise\n"},{"number":717,"text":"downstream work, confer promotion or closure, or waive applicable design,\n"},{"number":718,"text":"safety, authority or release law, including the prime law of a design\n"},{"number":719,"text":"profile where one applies.\n"},{"number":720,"text":"\n"},{"number":721,"text":"Admission or renewal of a prerequisite or experiment belongs to the\n"},{"number":722,"text":"authority owning the selected work wave, or its explicitly bounded proxy,\n"},{"number":723,"text":"and is recorded in the existing durable goals or ticket authority. The\n"},{"number":724,"text":"admitted basis states its provisional bound and its exhaustion or\n"},{"number":725,"text":"falsification condition. Satisfaction of an experiment's stated\n"},{"number":726,"text":"decision-discriminating observation exhausts that experiment. Drafting or\n"},{"number":727,"text":"validating a ticket or execution contract, retaining active status, or\n"},{"number":728,"text":"holding a prior admission cannot create, extend or renew the basis\n"},{"number":729,"text":"(ACTIVATION §1, Admission).\n"},{"number":730,"text":"\n"},{"number":731,"text":"Acceptance of the selected outcome, discharge of an admitted prerequisite,\n"},{"number":732,"text":"or resolution of an admitted experiment's stated decision exhausts that\n"},{"number":733,"text":"basis. A basis or bound also ends when another admitted terminal condition\n"},{"number":734,"text":"is reached or it is rejected, withdrawn, superseded, repriced away or\n"},{"number":735,"text":"falsified by evidence. Change management\n"},{"number":755,"text":"\n"},{"number":756,"text":"For an arriving report, start at [Universal intake triage](#universal-intake-triage).\n"},{"number":757,"text":"[Change classes](#change-classes) locates the owning layer;\n"},{"number":758,"text":"[Computed classification and treatment](#computed-classification-and-treatment)\n"},{"number":759,"text":"separates what rules decide from judgment and owner decisions;\n"},{"number":760,"text":"[Consistency gate](#consistency-gate) decides closure over the affected span.\n"},{"number":761,"text":"The family table traces those rules and creates no second decision path.\n"},{"number":762,"text":"\n"},{"number":763,"text":"Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared\n"},{"number":764,"text":"change intent and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain\n"},{"number":765,"text":"(P4b, P2).\n"},{"number":766,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":818,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/4. Its instance premises, which the commitments do not supply, are\n"},{"number":774,"text":"named in the rows as follows: changing specification, the specification\n"},{"number":775,"text":"changes while work proceeds; one front door, reports of every kind arrive\n"},{"number":776,"text":"at one product; shared interfaces, a shared interface has several\n"},{"number":777,"text":"producers and consumers; reserved decisions, a decision may be taken\n"},{"number":778,"text":"under declared policy or be reserved to a human authority. Standing of\n"},{"number":779,"text":"the commitments cited (FOUNDATIONS §3): P0 recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and\n"},{"number":780,"text":"P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that\n"},{"number":781,"text":"step-produced facts are not re-acquirable; P5 derived from P0 and P6,\n"},{"number":782,"text":"with P0's open-world premise.\n"},{"number":783,"text":"\n"},{"number":784,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |\n"},{"number":785,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":786,"text":"| P6 independent; P2 independent; instance: changing specification, one front door | By P6 a governing relation is accepted only by its owner, so a change re-enters at the layer that owns what it changes and is accepted there. By P6 fact, judgment and ruling are distinct authorities, so they stay apart, and candidate behaviour cannot author its own target law. | [Computed classification and treatment](#computed-classification-and-treatment) | the C, J and O annotations, the order of the four steps and the material inputs of C named as instances of the reuse rule's: domain choices of this member; reuse and invalidation: [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse); continuity of recorded judgments and rulings: [TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity) | 3, 9 |\n"},{"number":789,"text":"| P5 derived; instance: changing specification | By P5 an unknown is not a value, so an unknown relation, delta or effect stays unknown: it withholds the reliance and promotion that depend on it, not unrelated authorised work, and an effect of uncertain completion is never treated as no effect. | [Computed classification and treatment](#computed-classification-and-treatment), its last paragraphs | none | 3, 9 |\n"},{"number":790,"text":"| P6 independent; P4b derived; P5 derived; instance: changing specification | By P5 inconsistent surfaces cannot all be satisfied, so no gate closes while the affected surfaces are inconsistent. By P6 and P4b closure is decided only by recorded evidence for the declared obligations, so closure is their conjunction with valid evidence; an event, an aggregate or a status does not replace it, and implementation behaviour is evidence, not authority. | [Consistency gate](#consistency-gate) | none; the closure condition, which the gate applies to its change span: [TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse); reuse: [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse) | 3, 9 |\n"},{"number":791,"text":"| P2 independent; P0 recovered; instance: changing specification | By P2 proof serves the outcome, and by P0 an actor can carry only bounded deferred work, so proof cost may be deferred inside a batch only while the deferred cost stays local, visible, bounded and repayable. A sprint batches work and admits none, so it is not an authority layer, and a carrier is chosen for the lifetime the work needs. | [Sprint execution boundary](#sprint-execution-boundary); [Carriers](#carriers) | the sprint with its required statements and close triggers: a policy choice of this member, its mechanics at [TICKETS §3](TICKETS.md#3-sprint-rules); whether escrow suits a domain: the profile that adopts it | 1, 5 |\n"},{"number":792,"text":"| P5 derived; P6 independent; P2 independent; instance: reserved decisions | By P5 an ambiguity left unrecorded would be read as resolved, so major ambiguity at a boundary is detected and recorded with its outcome, and no dependent claim rests on an ambiguity that is carried, escalated or blocked as if it were resolved. By P2 whether it blocks depends on the risk the outcome bears, so it is policy, and by P6 a hard stop holds whatever the policy. | [§5](#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle); [Spec-drivenness litmus](#spec-drivenness-litmus) item 12 | the risk appetite, which sets the threshold between probabilistic decision and human adjudication: the project's declared policy; the order of narrowing, the major and micro split and the two concept identities: domain choices of this member; the hard-stop classes: [ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement) | 6, 9 |\n"},{"number":793,"text":"| P3 independent; P6 independent; instance: shared interfaces | By P3 each identity and state binds one authority, and by P6 two authorities on one acceptance path compete, so one authority governs each request, fact, identity, state and projection on an acceptance path. By P6 and P4b a break is shown by evidence that persists, so each break shows that its severed seam is rejected, and a retained mechanism identifies its own supported obligation and owner. | [Inside-out first sequencing](#inside-out-first-sequencing); [Hard-break discipline](#hard-break-discipline); [Proof-last rule](#proof-last-rule); [Closure criterion](#closure-criterion) | the inside-out order, from the source carrier outward: a policy choice of this member | 4, 9 |\n"},{"number":795,"text":"| P3 independent; P6 independent; instance: changing specification | By P6 inherited material has no authority in a new line unless that line adopts it, and by P3 adoption binds the new line's own surfaces, so in a fundamental migration nothing carries forward by default: inherited material has no authority in the new line until it is explicitly re-adopted and classified. | [Fundamental migration](#fundamental-migration) | the classes `carry_across`, `redundant` and `rewrite`: domain choices of this member | 1, 9 |\n"},{"number":796,"text":"\n"},{"number":797,"text":"The standing of these consequences is stated in\n"},{"number":798,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).\n"},{"number":799,"text":"The table accounts for §4, §5 and §7.\n"},{"number":800,"text":"\n"},{"number":801,"text":"Consumers of these rows, where an actor enters them (FOUNDATIONS §3\n"},{"number":802,"text":"Foundation to law, Consumers), one list per row, each consumer linked to\n"},{"number":803,"text":"its own locus:\n"},{"number":804,"text":"\n"},{"number":805,"text":"- Row 1, re-entry at the owning layer and the change classes: [§2 Constitutional chain](#constitutional-chain) and [Renewal path](#renewal-path), where a constitutional gap re-enters at the layer its change class names; The intake label does not\n"},{"number":822,"text":"determine the process class: a reported bug, feature request, issue,\n"},{"number":823,"text":"regression, operator finding, release blocker or scenario failure all enter\n"},{"number":824,"text":"through the same intake triage (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":825,"text":"\n"},{"number":826,"text":"Intake triage determines six things: whether the report represents a\n"},{"number":827,"text":"substantive change at all; the affected product boundary and intended\n"},{"number":828,"text":"scope; the lawful change class; the lawful re-entry point into the\n"},{"number":829,"text":"constitutional chain; the downstream surfaces and evidence that must be\n"},{"number":830,"text":"repriced, re-derived or re-proved, a determination whose evidence part is\n"},{"number":831,"text":"the selection `S_Δ` over the impact cover `I(Δ)` of the affected surfaces\n"},{"number":832,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse));\n"},{"number":833,"text":"and whether the work remains within the\n"},{"number":834,"text":"currently declared release scope or requires repricing of that release\n"},{"number":835,"text":"plan. No bug, feature, issue or other intake bypasses this triage by going\n"},{"number":836,"text":"straight to code, tests or release handling. The purpose is not a separate\n"},{"number":837,"text":"tracking bureaucracy; it is to classify impact correctly so the change\n"},{"number":838,"text":"enters the method at the right constitutional boundary.\n"},{"number":839,"text":"\n"},{"number":840,"text":"Triage diagnoses among the four causes of\n"},{"number":841,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Feedback and diagnosis](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation),\n"},{"number":842,"text":"a defective realisation, an inadequate governing requirement or design, an\n"},{"number":843,"text":"inaccurate predictive model, and insufficient observation, and routes each\n"},{"number":844,"text":"supported repair to the owner of its cause rather than inferring it from\n"},{"number":845,"text":"the intake label; severity and priority follow the policies that\n"},{"number":846,"text":"[TICKETS](TICKETS.md) owns; a bug list projects existing work state. This\n"},{"number":847,"text":"paragraph applies ACTIVATION §1 Feedback and diagnosis and states no\n"},{"number":848,"text":"second relation (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":849,"text":"\n"},{"number":850,"text":"Triage triangulates a failure across the applicable reference frames over\n"},{"number":851,"text":"the same subject and basis. Each frame tests candidate diagnoses against\n"},{"number":852,"text":"its material workspace variables, governing relations and evidence; their\n"},{"number":853,"text":"combined results constrain the supported cause, preserve unresolved\n"},{"number":854,"text":"alternatives and uncertainty, and identify the smallest sufficient lawful\n"},{"number":855,"text":"scope of repair. The frame that exposes a failure need not contain its\n"},{"number":856,"text":"cause. Repeating the same analysis under different frame names supplies no\n"},{"number":857,"text":"additional causal evidence. The smallest sufficient applicable frame\n"},{"number":858,"text":"configuration is used, under frame applicability and frames in conjunction\n"},{"number":859,"text":"(REFERENCE_FRAME §5 and §6). The frames' results combine under the one\n"},{"number":860,"text":"[conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results): each\n"},{"number":861,"text":"keeps the diagnosis it evaluated as its predicate, a counterexample that\n"},{"number":862,"text":"one frame finds survives the join, and a frame planned and not applied\n"},{"number":863,"text":"leaves its diagnosis open, never ruled out. Counterexample localisation\n"},{"number":864,"text":"applies where required (ASSURANCE). This prescribes no reviewer count and no new\n"},{"number":865,"text":"review round; required independence stays intact. A diagnosis grants no\n"},{"number":866,"text":"repair effects and does not establish that governing meaning must change: a\n"},{"number":867,"text":"candidate may instead need correction under sufficient existing law (P6).\n"},{"number":868,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":902,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/4. classes","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F4.%20Change%20management%2FChange%20classes","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"73ada264eedd52f976c5150c442b98aeb507843c496b4134696a0a49650007bb","start_line":869,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":869,"text":"### Change classes\n"},{"number":870,"text":"\n"},{"number":871,"text":"The minimum lawful change classes, each with its re-entry point and the\n"},{"number":872,"text":"layers its repricing flows through (P4b, P2):\n"},{"number":873,"text":"\n"},{"number":874,"text":"| Class | Change | Re-enters at | Flows through |\n"},{"number":875,"text":"|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":876,"text":"| `goal_reprice` | current bounded work-wave focus changes | Goals | Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence where that focus changes deeper constitutional truth |\n"},{"number":877,"text":"| `intent_reprice` | directional or scope change | Intent | Product, Requirements, Design, Code, Evidence |\n"},{"number":878,"text":"| `product_reprice` | current product realisation changes while directional intent stays stable | Product | Requirements, Design, Code, Evidence |\n"},{"number":879,"text":"| `requirement_reprice` | constitutional truth changes while project direction stays stable | Requirements | Design, Code, Evidence |\n"},{"number":880,"text":"| `design_reframe` | realisation structure changes while active intent and requirement truth stay stable | Design | Code, Evidence |\n"},{"number":881,"text":"| `realization_refactor` | local code, configuration or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change | the realised surface only | nothing upstream; it must prove no upstream drift |\n"},{"number":882,"text":"\n"},{"number":883,"text":"Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert\n"},{"number":884,"text":"that no upstream constitutional surface is changing. The absence of a\n"},{"number":885,"text":"declared change class is process drift. A changed governing relation is\n"},{"number":886,"text":"accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a\n"},{"number":887,"text":"violation whatever the size of the delta (ACTIVATION §1).\n"},{"number":888,"text":"Triage records the change intent, the class, the re-entry point and when\n"},{"number":889,"text":"triage occurred, wherever substantive work begins.\n"},{"number":890,"text":"[TICKETS §4](TICKETS.md#change-class) records the class on the carrier.\n"},{"number":891,"text":"\n"},{"number":892,"text":"The change classes are declared states of a change that intake triage\n"},{"number":893,"text":"records, not results, and map to no core value. An evaluation that reads\n"},{"number":894,"text":"a declared class returns its own core value with its predicate under\n"},{"number":895,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). A close classification\n"},{"number":896,"text":"of [TICKETS §3](TICKETS.md#close-review) that names a layer, such as\n"},{"number":897,"text":"`design_reframe`, is a result for its own predicate, mapped there, and\n"},{"number":898,"text":"carries the class at which the work re-enters as its domain outcome.\n"},{"number":899,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a declared class is never combined as an\n"},{"number":900,"text":"evaluation result, so a change classed `realization_refactor` cannot stand\n"},{"number":901,"text":"in for a `satisfied` result that no upstream drift occurred (P5, P1).\n"},{"number":902,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1009,"heading":"SPEC_METHOD/4. Change management/Computed classification and treatment","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#SPEC_METHOD%2F4.%20Change%20management%2FComputed%20classification%20and%20treatment","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","sha256":"1f58255b88c6279030839a4c8ecdb0f6fd3bb39eb493c0d119fec08ca2e8f09e","start_line":903,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md","lines":[{"number":903,"text":"### Computed classification and treatment\n"},{"number":904,"text":"\n"},{"number":905,"text":"Intake supplies one reusable classification result rather than requiring\n"},{"number":906,"text":"each role to reconstruct the same facts (P4b, P6, P1). Three annotations keep the kinds\n"},{"number":907,"text":"of determination apart: C denotes reproducible facts and declared rule\n"},{"number":908,"text":"application; J denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; O denotes\n"},{"number":909,"text":"a ruling reserved to its actual owner. The annotations grant no authority,\n"},{"number":910,"text":"an instance of\n"},{"number":911,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What\n"},{"number":912,"text":"creates no authority, and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface or mandatory\n"},{"number":913,"text":"document.\n"},{"number":914,"text":"\n"},{"number":915,"text":"The explicitly selected source, worksite or qualification capability\n"},{"number":916,"text":"produces C over the exact request and desired outcome, the known targets\n"},{"number":917,"text":"and effects, the operation grant and work lifetime, the product definition\n"},{"number":918,"text":"and governing basis, the baseline and the available candidate, the declared\n"},{"number":919,"text":"relations, the accepted design and trace bindings, the evidence and the\n"},{"number":920,"text":"applicable rules. Its output identifies the producer and procedure\n"},{"number":921,"text":"revision, the inputs, the result, the scope, the source routes, the\n"},{"number":922,"text":"reproduction relation, the unknowns and the invalidators. A missing\n"},{"number":923,"text":"candidate or missing evidence is an input state, not a claim that nothing\n"},{"number":924,"text":"changed.\n"},{"number":925,"text":"\n"},{"number":926,"text":"The computed result exposes four things, in this order:\n"},{"number":927,"text":"\n"},{"number":928,"text":"1. Authority traversal. Follow the explicit source, ownership, dependency,\n"},{"number":929,"text":"   composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and\n"},{"number":930,"text":"   effects. Identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and its\n"},{"number":931,"text":"   changed, unchanged or unknown relation, the traversed edges and the\n"},{"number":932,"text":"   unresolved frontier. Include root, authority and grant changes even when\n"},{"number":933,"text":"   public bytes are equal. An absent edge does not prove irrelevance;\n"},{"number":934,"text":"   undeclared or semantically uncertain materiality remains J.\n"},{"number":935,"text":"2. Public delta. Enumerate the complete relevant serialised member universe\n"},{"number":936,"text":"   under its owning declaration and applicable projection, including helper\n"},{"number":937,"text":"   and generated dependencies. Report added and removed identities and\n"},{"number":938,"text":"   every retained member with changed typed value or bytes, with exact\n"},{"number":939,"text":"   before and after values. A rename is removal plus addition unless its\n"},{"number":940,"text":"   owner supplies an identity-preserving relation. A missing candidate,\n"},{"number":941,"text":"   incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity or unavailable projection\n"},{"number":942,"text":"   leaves the affected delta unknown; membership equality alone proves no\n"},{"number":943,"text":"   value equality (P3).\n"},{"number":944,"text":"3. Accepted-design coverage. Join changed bytes and relations to explicit\n"},{"number":945,"text":"   accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence. Distinguish covered,\n"},{"number":946,"text":"   missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope evidence. A filename, listed\n"},{"number":947,"text":"   artifact or digest alone establishes no accepted coverage. Current trace\n"},{"number":948,"text":"   coverage is a computed fact; residual semantic sufficiency remains J.\n"},{"number":949,"text":"4. Rule-determined treatment. Apply only declared rules with sufficient\n"},{"number":950,"text":"   input facts, recording their owners, matched predicates and\n"},{"number":951,"text":"   consequences. Expose the smallest lawful re-entry, the next action, the\n"},{"number":952,"text":"   applicable evidence or assessment, the reserved ruling and the carrier\n"},{"number":953,"text":"   lifetime, with any conflict or missing premise still unresolved. A label\n"},{"number":954,"text":"   or filename cannot select the route. When rules settle the question, no\n"},{"number":955,"text":"   residual judgment is invented.\n"},{"number":956,"text":"\n"},{"number":957,"text":"The values these steps assign, a relation changed, unchanged or unknown,\n"},{"number":958,"text":"an identity added, removed or retained with a changed value, and evidence\n"},{"number":959,"text":"covered, missing, stale, ambiguous or outside scope, are facts of the\n"},{"number":960,"text":"computed result. They are not results of an evaluation and map to no core\n"},{"number":961,"text":"value. An evaluation that consumes them returns its own core value with\n"},{"number":962,"text":"its predicate under [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), and\n"},{"number":963,"text":"an unknown it consumes stays unknown. Purpose and material relation: a\n"},{"number":964,"text":"classification fact is never combined as an evaluation result, so\n"},{"number":965,"text":"evidence classified covered, or a relation classified unchanged, cannot\n"},{"number":966,"text":"stand in for a `satisfied` result (P5, P1).\n"},{"number":967,"text":"\n"},{"number":968,"text":"A public delta or other nonconformance does not itself require changing\n"},{"number":969,"text":"the governing contract. If that contract remains sufficient for the\n"},{"number":970,"text":"authorised outcome, the candidate is rejected or locally repaired within\n"},{"number":971,"text":"its grant. The actual governing owner is re-entered when the explicitly\n"},{"number":972,"text":"selected desired outcome requires changed meaning or an applicable\n"},{"number":973,"text":"assessment establishes governing insufficiency. C determines that\n"},{"number":974,"text":"consequence only from sufficient declared premises; unresolved intended\n"},{"number":975,"text":"meaning or necessity is J, and any reserved decision remains O. Candidate\n"},{"number":976,"text":"behaviour cannot author its own target law (P6).\n"},{"number":977,"text":"\n"},{"number":978,"text":"Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated\n"},{"number":979,"text":"authorised work. An existing bounded construction or evidence grant may\n"},{"number":980,"text":"permit the cheapest useful discriminator, including obtaining the first\n"},{"number":981,"text":"candidate, without asserting that the candidate is conformant; it carries\n"},{"number":982,"text":"its own exact subject, territory, operations and stop conditions. The\n"},{"number":983,"text":"affected C result is updated before dependent effects or promotion rely on\n"},{"number":984,"text":"newly available evidence. A mistaken route is corrected at its smallest\n"},{"number":985,"text":"affected owner, preserving the original cause, the attempted subject, the\n"},{"number":986,"text":"observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires the applicable\n"},{"number":987,"text":"outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions; an effect of uncertain\n"},{"number":988,"text":"completion (`completion_unknown`, or `not_effected` with its end not\n"},{"number":989,"text":"established, under [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects)) cannot\n"},{"number":990,"text":"be silently treated\n"},{"number":991,"text":"as no effect, and is reconciled as ACTIVATION §5 states before any retry\n"},{"number":992,"text":"or dependent action (P5).\n"},{"number":993,"text":"\n"},{"number":994,"text":"A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact\n"},{"number":995,"text":"applicability; reuse and invalidation are\n"},{"number":996,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse), which this\n"},{"number":997,"text":"paragraph applies to C. The material inputs of C, whose change is that\n"},{"number":998,"text":"rule's material input change and invalidates the affected claims of C\n"},{"number":999,"text":"before reliance, are by name: the request, the candidate, an owner or\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"root relation, a projection, a design trace or acceptance, a rule\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"applied, the configuration and the material evidence. A changed basis\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"and a declared revising observation, that rule's other two\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"invalidators, invalidate likewise.
