Both\n"},{"number":802,"text":"are part of the ticket authority, not optional commentary.\n"},{"number":803,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#7-migration) defines the migration law;\n"},{"number":804,"text":"this category defines the minimum ticket-local declaration and checklist\n"},{"number":805,"text":"that a reviewer can check before accepting a closure claim on one concrete\n"},{"number":806,"text":"work item, and is the local enforcement surface for the inside-out\n"},{"number":807,"text":"migration law of SPEC_METHOD §7 (P6, P4b, P3).\n"},{"number":808,"text":"\n"},{"number":809,"text":"The declaration states: the migration strategy used for this work item; the\n"},{"number":810,"text":"exact affected migration scope; every explicitly excluded or disjoint\n"},{"number":811,"text":"product or compatibility scope with its deterministic routing relation; the\n"},{"number":812,"text":"old truth path or superseded contract; the new truth path or authoritative\n"},{"number":813,"text":"contract; the producer set for the old and the new path; the consumer set\n"},{"number":814,"text":"for the old and the new path; every projection, report, status surface and\n"},{"number":815,"text":"proof surface derived from that contract family; and the closure law for\n"},{"number":816,"text":"the migration.\n"},{"number":817,"text":"\n"},{"number":818,"text":"The ticket carries at least this checklist in live markdown form:\n"},{"number":819,"text":"\n"},{"number":820,"text":"```md\n"},{"number":821,"text":"## Migration Checklist\n"},{"number":822,"text":"\n"},{"number":823,"text":"- [ ] exact affected migration scope is named\n"},{"number":824,"text":"- [ ] excluded or disjoint Product and compatibility scopes are named with deterministic routing\n"},{"number":825,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is named explicitly\n"},{"number":826,"text":"- [ ] new truth path is named explicitly\n"},{"number":827,"text":"- [ ] producer set for the new truth is listed\n"},{"number":828,"text":"- [ ] consumer set for the new truth is listed\n"},{"number":829,"text":"- [ ] projection/read-model surfaces are listed\n"},{"number":830,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is removed or explicitly demoted from authority within the affected scope\n"},{"number":831,"text":"- [ ] mixed-state behavior is no longer accepted as closure evidence\n"},{"number":832,"text":"- [ ] tests proving mixed old/new behavior are removed or repriced\n"},{"number":833,"text":"- [ ] recurring realization patterns are checked against existing library/commonization surfaces\n"},{"number":834,"text":"- [ ] ticket declares library usage and names the governing library or rationale\n"},{"number":835,"text":"- [ ] if the work exists in more than one build tenant, this backlog/active ticket carries only one tenant lifecycle and any sibling tenant work lives on its own suffixed ticket\n"},{"number":836,"text":"- [ ] ticket wording, product wording, and proof claims are reconciled before closure\n"},{"number":837,"text":"```\n"},{"number":838,"text":"\n"},{"number":839,"text":"Where no excluded or disjoint scope exists, the second item is satisfied by\n"},{"number":840,"text":"declaring that absence explicitly, as the migration example of §8 writes\n"},{"number":841,"text":"it; silence does not satisfy it (P6).\n"},{"number":842,"text":"\n"},{"number":843,"text":"The required fields are `migration_strategy`, with the values\n"},{"number":844,"text":"`inside_out_hard_break` and `fundamental_re_adoption`, and\n"},{"number":845,"text":"`library_usage`, with the values `none`, `consume` and `extend`. When\n"},{"number":846,"text":"`library_usage` is `consume` or `extend`, the ticket names the governing\n"},{"number":847,"text":"reusable library or commonisation surface in `governing_library`. When it\n"},{"number":848,"text":"is `none`, the ticket explains in `library_rationale` that no existing\n"},{"number":849,"text":"reusable surface applies, or that the pattern is still boundary-specific,\n"},{"number":850,"text":"or that it is not yet a lawful recurrence or commonisation candidate (P3,\n"},{"number":851,"text":"P2).\n"},{"number":852,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":882,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Closure of a migration ticket","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FClosure%20of%20a%20migration%20ticket","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"e6a577464f0594fc8b5c9bea5a81a01ee3e4bb6a01d817e0110571c5152ba4b2","start_line":853,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":853,"text":"### Closure of a migration ticket\n"},{"number":854,"text":"\n"},{"number":855,"text":"Closure is blocked while the old authoritative interface still passes in\n"},{"number":856,"text":"normal execution within the declared affected scope, unless the ticket\n"},{"number":857,"text":"explicitly declares a retained compatibility feature. A deterministically\n"},{"number":858,"text":"routed, non-overlapping product scope outside the declared affected scope\n"},{"number":859,"text":"remains governed by its own current authority (P6, P3). Accordingly: the\n"},{"number":860,"text":"old path may not remain silently authoritative within the affected scope;\n"},{"number":861,"text":"mixed old and new green tests do not count as migration completion; any\n"},{"number":862,"text":"retained old path within the affected scope is named as compatibility\n"},{"number":863,"text":"rather than current native truth; retained compatibility is justified in\n"},{"number":864,"text":"the ticket itself, never inferred from surviving code; proxy or partial\n"},{"number":865,"text":"implementations do not satisfy migration closure; and if a ticket was\n"},{"number":866,"text":"marked `completed` and later review shows checked closure items are false\n"},{"number":867,"text":"on the current tree, the ticket is reopened or an explicitly linked\n"},{"number":868,"text":"successor ticket is created, because a false closure claim is a\n"},{"number":869,"text":"ticket-method defect, not only a code defect (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":870,"text":"\n"},{"number":871,"text":"An intermediate product-slice milestone inside an open migration ticket may\n"},{"number":872,"text":"be accepted under the path-relative promotion rule of SPEC_METHOD §7, which\n"},{"number":873,"text":"also states how the slice's identity and acceptance criteria derive and\n"},{"number":874,"text":"that ticket wording cannot narrow that authority away. The ticket-local\n"},{"number":875,"text":"consequence: the ticket remains active and does not claim migration\n"},{"number":876,"text":"closure until the migration checklist and the final closure law are\n"},{"number":877,"text":"satisfied; its `active` status renews none of the accepted slice's\n"},{"number":878,"text":"exhausted growth authority; and removal, demotion and closure-proof work\n"},{"number":879,"text":"may continue within the bound SPEC_METHOD §7 states, further material\n"},{"number":880,"text":"producer or consumer growth requiring another basis admitted under\n"},{"number":881,"text":"SPEC_METHOD §3 (P2, P6; §1, Milestones).\n"},{"number":882,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":902,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Strategy requirements","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FStrategy%20requirements","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"c87eb3e9fe69382146ec81eaaa9ce022b7eebe80a48e321bcd0ba79bb25c3988","start_line":883,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":883,"text":"### Strategy requirements\n"},{"number":884,"text":"\n"},{"number":885,"text":"When `migration_strategy: inside_out_hard_break`, the ticket carries a full\n"},{"number":886,"text":"best-guess interface inventory for the migrating contract family; the\n"},{"number":887,"text":"ordered break sequence from the deepest source truth outward; the old seam\n"},{"number":888,"text":"each break intentionally severs; and the negative proof expected for each\n"},{"number":889,"text":"break (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":890,"text":"\n"},{"number":891,"text":"When `migration_strategy: fundamental_re_adoption`, the ticket carries the\n"},{"number":892,"text":"explicit selection of fundamental re-adoption by the human product\n"},{"number":893,"text":"authority; the comparison with bounded evolution across product value,\n"},{"number":894,"text":"feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained\n"},{"number":895,"text":"predecessor semantics; the bounded abort or re-entry condition; the\n"},{"number":896,"text":"sideways reference line or prior implementation boundary treated as source\n"},{"number":897,"text":"material; the module and interface adjudication surface; and explicit\n"},{"number":898,"text":"classifications for inherited modules, interfaces, carriers, projections\n"},{"number":899,"text":"and proof surfaces, each `carry_across`, `redundant` or `rewrite`\n"},{"number":900,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#fundamental-migration) defines the three).\n"},{"number":901,"text":"Unclassified inherited implementation blocks closure (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":902,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":933,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Recurring realisation and library declaration","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FRecurring%20realisation%20and%20library%20declaration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"2a030f06afc7b69555d7aedaeeb4eea4585e3cfc29c26bd7fa773860f3f38a7a","start_line":903,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":903,"text":"### Recurring realisation and library declaration\n"},{"number":904,"text":"\n"},{"number":905,"text":"An implementation migration ticket declares whether the active boundary is\n"},{"number":906,"text":"rebuilding a pattern locally, consuming an existing reusable library or\n"},{"number":907,"text":"commonisation surface, or extending that surface before the local\n"},{"number":908,"text":"implementation lands; `library_usage` records which (P2, P4a).\n"},{"number":909,"text":"\n"},{"number":910,"text":"The recurrence rule is ticket law for every implementation migration\n"},{"number":911,"text":"ticket, whichever profiles the Product adopts (P2, P4a): the second\n"},{"number":912,"text":"credible recurrence forces an explicit\n"},{"number":913,"text":"library or commonisation review; the third local rebuild is not acceptable\n"},{"number":914,"text":"by default. If review shows the same realisation pattern already exists in\n"},{"number":915,"text":"two module boundaries or tickets, a third local rebuild blocks\n"},{"number":916,"text":"implementation unless the ticket declares `library_usage: consume`,\n"},{"number":917,"text":"declares `library_usage: extend`, or links an explicit do-not-commonise\n"},{"number":918,"text":"design decision in `library_rationale`. The preferred order is\n"},{"number":919,"text":"boundary-local cleanup, then a tenant-local reusable library or\n"},{"number":920,"text":"commonisation surface, then shared or common propagation only through\n"},{"number":921,"text":"separate design re-entry (P2, P3). A Product that adopts DESIGN_MODULE\n"},{"number":922,"text":"also applies its refinement,\n"},{"number":923,"text":"[§10 Recurrence extraction](DESIGN_MODULE.md#recurrence-extraction),\n"},{"number":924,"text":"which makes the same rule a design-review obligation and states what\n"},{"number":925,"text":"counts as a commonisation candidate; it adds no rival threshold.\n"},{"number":926,"text":"\n"},{"number":927,"text":"A reusable pattern discovered during the active ticket remains under the\n"},{"number":928,"text":"second- and third-recurrence rules. Outside those rules and the current\n"},{"number":929,"text":"claim's applicable hard stops it is repricing input: it does not block the\n"},{"number":930,"text":"bounded claim or require a follow-up ticket unless the owning authority\n"},{"number":931,"text":"admits that follow-up (P2; §7, Execution and verification authority\n"},{"number":932,"text":"separation).\n"},{"number":933,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":944,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Multi-build-tenant review","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FMulti-build-tenant%20review","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"c7cdb336b375244fe6b8e445d1d84abe8ea1633860ec59c454e9e183530bc8e9","start_line":934,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":934,"text":"### Multi-build-tenant review\n"},{"number":935,"text":"\n"},{"number":936,"text":"When the same work item is processed across several build tenants, review\n"},{"number":937,"text":"of backlog and active tickets checks that each tenant has its own suffixed\n"},{"number":938,"text":"ticket; each ticket names its `build_tenant`; each tenant ticket has its\n"},{"number":939,"text":"own proof surface and closure law; one tenant's green proof does not stand\n"},{"number":940,"text":"in for another tenant's closure; and reopening, repricing and successor\n"},{"number":941,"text":"work remain tenant-local unless the upstream source, product or design\n"},{"number":942,"text":"ticket itself must change (P3, P6;\n"},{"number":943,"text":"§4, Multi-build-tenant independence).\n"},{"number":944,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":984,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Review disambiguation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FReview%20disambiguation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"290bd8c07e9d6da416d59ec8b7b6729bac8b4008372ed3822b8008ba8fb99843","start_line":945,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":945,"text":"### Review disambiguation\n"},{"number":946,"text":"\n"},{"number":947,"text":"An implementation migration ticket makes the review problem concrete enough\n"},{"number":948,"text":"that an implementor cannot land a rename, adapter, wrapper or happy-path\n"},{"number":949,"text":"proof and claim source-truth migration (P6, P1). For a core-interface or\n"},{"number":950,"text":"carrier migration the ticket should include a `Functional Review Criteria`\n"},{"number":951,"text":"section, specific to the ticket, such that a reviewer should be able to\n"},{"number":952,"text":"answer these generic questions:\n"},{"number":953,"text":"\n"},{"number":954,"text":"1. Did the change replace control-flow-owned meaning with carrier-owned,\n"},{"number":955,"text":"   algebra-owned, event-owned or otherwise admitted source truth?\n"},{"number":956,"text":"2. Did the change reduce or remove a semantic centre, or only rename and\n"},{"number":957,"text":"   relocate it behind helpers?\n"},{"number":958,"text":"3. Is the new law expressed as a typed or closed carrier, contract or\n"},{"number":959,"text":"   transition family rather than an open dict, string protocol or\n"},{"number":960,"text":"   config-shaped surface?\n"},{"number":961,"text":"4. Is the main step readable as a pure transform over admitted truth, or\n"},{"number":962,"text":"   does it still contain orchestration that decides the law procedurally?\n"},{"number":963,"text":"5. Are effects pushed to the edge, such as event emission, manifest\n"},{"number":964,"text":"   publication, file or output publication, or operator delivery, instead\n"},{"number":965,"text":"   of being mixed into source-truth interpretation?\n"},{"number":966,"text":"6. Do downstream consumers pattern-match or otherwise consume the admitted\n"},{"number":967,"text":"   carrier directly, or do they reconstruct truth from payloads,\n"},{"number":968,"text":"   `.get(...)`, fallback defaults, raw text or legacy files?\n"},{"number":969,"text":"7. Are projections and reports derived from event or source truth, or can\n"},{"number":970,"text":"   they still close independently as a second authority surface?\n"},{"number":971,"text":"8. If deterministic gates, validation or other deterministic checks exist,\n"},{"number":972,"text":"   do they inform the current state without structurally blocking the\n"},{"number":973,"text":"   lawful constructive or probabilistic path that the admitted contract\n"},{"number":974,"text":"   permits?\n"},{"number":975,"text":"9. If the same realisation pattern already exists elsewhere, does the\n"},{"number":976,"text":"   ticket explicitly consume or extend a reusable library or commonisation\n"},{"number":977,"text":"   surface rather than rebuild it locally again?\n"},{"number":978,"text":"\n"},{"number":979,"text":"Passing tests do not satisfy this section by themselves. A slice that keeps\n"},{"number":980,"text":"the same semantic centre alive behind typed wrappers, adapter-local policy,\n"},{"number":981,"text":"old lists beside new algebra, fallback config or rehydrated dict payloads\n"},{"number":982,"text":"still fails migration review even when public behaviour remains green\n"},{"number":983,"text":"(P6).\n"},{"number":984,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1019,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Impacted interface review checklist","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FImpacted%20interface%20review%20checklist","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"ade687d10055180012dea257e3350d7fb04f214fd02f09d61c7974f4bff360ed","start_line":985,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":985,"text":"### Impacted interface review checklist\n"},{"number":986,"text":"\n"},{"number":987,"text":"For a core-interface, carrier or authoritative-contract migration, the\n"},{"number":988,"text":"ticket includes an `Impacted Interface Review Checklist` before tests can be\n"},{"number":989,"text":"used as closure evidence. The checklist is a named walk of every live\n"},{"number":990,"text":"interface that can still bypass, reinterpret, replay or project the\n"},{"number":991,"text":"migrating truth path (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":992,"text":"At minimum it should enumerate, where they exist: the source-carrier builder;\n"},{"number":993,"text":"closure, register and projection builders; the deepest semantic kernel and\n"},{"number":994,"text":"adapter boundaries; public wrappers and the bootstrap, replay, ingest,\n"},{"number":995,"text":"resume and query entrypoints; prompt, report, projection and read-model\n"},{"number":996,"text":"surfaces; constructor and materialisation paths; proof lanes and\n"},{"number":997,"text":"negative-proof fixtures.\n"},{"number":998,"text":"\n"},{"number":999,"text":"Each checklist item states what counts as closure for that interface, for\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"example:\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"- \"`<conformance-module>::consume_projection` consumes the admitted carrier\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"  or projection and does not import raw helper authority\"\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"- \"`<query-module>::project_domain` exposes a read model only and does not\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"  silently rebuild the carrier when publication is absent\"\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"- \"`<gap-module>::build_canonical_gap` does not aggregate open payload rows\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"  into an independent closure decision\"\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"Review rules (P6): a checked box asserts truth on the current tree, not\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"intended direction; if review shows a checked interface item is false, the\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"ticket is not closure-ready; an intentionally deferred interface either\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"names its successor ticket or stays unchecked; compatibility shims do not\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"satisfy the checklist unless explicitly justified as retained\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"compatibility; for `inside_out_hard_break` the checklist describes the\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"seam inventory before tests are used as closure evidence; for\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"`fundamental_re_adoption` the checklist covers the inherited modules and\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"interfaces being carried, dropped or rewritten, and implicit carry-forward\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"does not count.\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1048,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Break order and break-to-closure map","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FBreak%20order%20and%20break-to-closure%20map","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"3837ee8264b1eb9ff96205f05a6ccbd217370445687ea32aff2f0a9c33310845","start_line":1020,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1020,"text":"### Break order and break-to-closure map\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"An implementation migration ticket that touches a core interface includes\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"a `Required Break Order` or an equivalent ordered execution section. The\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"order starts at the authoritative source carrier and moves outward\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"(P4b, P6;\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#hard-break-discipline)):\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"1. discover the full best-guess interface family;\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"2. publish or admit the new source carrier;\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"3. deliberately sever one old authoritative seam and keep it broken;\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"4. rebind the deepest semantic kernel to that carrier;\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"5. remove or demote old producers;\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"6. rebind old consumers;\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"7. reprice projections, reports, prompts, delivery bindings and tests.\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"When the migration has several old interfaces, the ticket also includes a\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"`Break-To-Closure Map` stating which break closes which closure-law clause;\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"without it a partial landing can look like a full landing (P6).\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"Reviewers treat these as explicit defects: a typed wrapper that still\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"carries old semantic authority; a new carrier added beside the old\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"authoritative read model; a proxy or partial implementation that keeps the\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"old interface alive behind a new name; constructor, replay, ingest, resume,\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"bootstrap or public-wrapper paths that bypass admission; a projection or\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"test that can pass without the new carrier; a fallback path that invents\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"missing policy, identity, target or closure truth; a downstream proof that\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"passes while upstream source-carrier work remains open (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1077,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Mixed-state negative proof","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FMixed-state%20negative%20proof","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"f1b4016c40a4d7522030fe43d8c1d25ca418ebe5e67c27b321cc50c3b961f091","start_line":1049,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1049,"text":"### Mixed-state negative proof\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"For a migration ticket, positive behaviour proof is not enough. The proof\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"surface should include at least one negative or structural proof that\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"the old path can no longer satisfy the closure law (P6, P5). Examples: the severed seam in the current\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"break is rejected before downstream repair is accepted as progress;\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"removing the new carrier makes advancement, closure, prompt assembly or\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"projection fail closed rather than silently fall back; a legacy payload\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"without the admitted carrier is rejected instead of rehydrated into current\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"truth; old and new truth intentionally disagree in a fixture and the new\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"truth wins or the run fails closed; a same-name carrier, published\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"function, route, policy or projection source with different structure fails\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"closed instead of being accepted as equivalent; required closure proof\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"does not depend on undeclared local fixtures or mutable sibling workspaces.\n"},{"number":1063,"text":"\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"If the old path still works in normal execution within the declared\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"affected scope, or remains reachable on the claimed acceptance path, the\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"ticket remains open unless that path is explicitly specified as retained\n"},{"number":1067,"text":"compatibility. A deterministically routed, non-overlapping product scope\n"},{"number":1068,"text":"outside the declared affected scope remains governed by its own current\n"},{"number":1069,"text":"authority and does not block the migration merely because its path still\n"},{"number":1070,"text":"works (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1071,"text":"\n"},{"number":1072,"text":"For a ticket with an `Impacted Interface Review Checklist`, the negative\n"},{"number":1073,"text":"proof exercises the named public consumers that matter for closure. Proving\n"},{"number":1074,"text":"that one legacy shim is bypassed is not sufficient when the live authority\n"},{"number":1075,"text":"path already bypasses that shim through other helpers, loaders or rebuild\n"},{"number":1076,"text":"paths (P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":1077,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1087,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"02ecd3b5b8cbf7fa38d06e7b9c8ab5cf0abf185a5fbb669510e34fe0d6330ea9","start_line":1078,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1078,"text":"## 7. Authority, judgment, closure and state\n"},{"number":1079,"text":"\n"},{"number":1080,"text":"The generic law is tier 1: a constructor's self-review is construction\n"},{"number":1081,"text":"output and the independent-assessment protocol is\n"},{"number":1082,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment); acceptance as the\n"},{"number":1083,"text":"decision owner's disposition, and closure by stated condition rather than\n"},{"number":1084,"text":"by reviewer approval, is [EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#5-acceptance); reuse\n"},{"number":1085,"text":"of a closed result is [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse).\n"},{"number":1086,"text":"This section states what those laws require of work carriers.\n"},{"number":1087,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1145,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FExecution%20and%20verification%20authority%20separation%20%28UP-007%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"1c3a94a3c83e769658d633172e58ff43d9e2f5f8738549726fe3e1f38e9b0376","start_line":1088,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1088,"text":"### Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)\n"},{"number":1089,"text":"\n"},{"number":1090,"text":"Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to\n"},{"number":1091,"text":"verify it. What counts as independent, including that the reviewer is\n"},{"number":1092,"text":"not the author of the reviewed subject, and the protocol an independent\n"},{"number":1093,"text":"assessment follows are\n"},{"number":1094,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment). Where\n"},{"number":1095,"text":"independent review is required, the reviewer identifies the exact\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"findings (P6). Review\n"},{"number":1098,"text":"findings must cite current authority and the code or proof paths they\n"},{"number":1099,"text":"rest on, not only historical commentary (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1100,"text":"\n"},{"number":1101,"text":"Self-review remains useful authoring evidence and cannot be relabelled as\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"independent. Human authority may accept or reject the claim; it does not\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"make implementer self-review independent. The boundaries at which this\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"method requires independent assessment are this member's policy, which\n"},{"number":1105,"text":"EVALUATION §3 names; a governing basis may add others, as that section\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"states. Independent review is required at\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"product, qualification, release and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries that\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"claim it, not for every local implementation step (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1109,"text":"\n"},{"number":1110,"text":"A claimed independent review may support promotion or closure only when its\n"},{"number":1111,"text":"exact subject and verdict are durably traceable through an existing ticket,\n"},{"number":1112,"text":"commentary, qualification or release-evidence carrier. A statement that\n"},{"number":1113,"text":"review occurred, an unbound conversation summary or an unavailable draft is\n"},{"number":1114,"text":"not the review verdict. This rule requires no separate receipt, carrier or\n"},{"number":1115,"text":"review round (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":1116,"text":"\n"},{"number":1117,"text":"A ticket's review verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and its\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"applicable hard stops. When a finding blocks current promotion, and what a\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"valid observation outside that boundary does, are stated once at\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion);\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"this carrier applies that section to a ticket's review and adds no\n"},{"number":1122,"text":"trigger (P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1123,"text":"\n"},{"number":1124,"text":"A direct or lawfully proxied human ruling receives a durable disposition\n"},{"number":1125,"text":"before the next affected acceptance boundary. Its source wording stays\n"},{"number":1126,"text":"distinct from agent interpretation. Opening a ticket records the\n"},{"number":1127,"text":"obligation and does not satisfy it, and an agent cannot widen the ruling\n"},{"number":1128,"text":"while recording it (P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":1129,"text":"\n"},{"number":1130,"text":"Where the agentic construction relation applies (ACTIVATION §1, bound to\n"},{"number":1131,"text":"this method by [SPEC_METHOD §8](SPEC_METHOD.md#8-bounded-execution-in-this-method)),\n"},{"number":1132,"text":"the active work item identifies the selected execution basis, the bounded\n"},{"number":1133,"text":"affected relation set, the delegated construction and assessment authority,\n"},{"number":1134,"text":"and the re-entry conditions. It may point to accepted design and existing\n"},{"number":1135,"text":"evidence carriers rather than restate them. Ticket state, ticket prose or\n"},{"number":1136,"text":"an admitted execution contract cannot widen that basis or substitute for\n"},{"number":1137,"text":"the live-surface assessment the relation requires (P6, P0).\n"},{"number":1138,"text":"\n"},{"number":1139,"text":"The reviewable transition (ACTIVATION §7, Transition evidence) may be\n"},{"number":1140,"text":"carried by an existing ticket, commentary, commit, qualification or\n"},{"number":1141,"text":"release-evidence surface. No new ticket state, document type, review round\n"},{"number":1142,"text":"or approval ceremony is required. This member carries selection and\n"},{"number":1143,"text":"traceability; ACTIVATION §1 and SPEC_METHOD §8 own the execution semantics\n"},{"number":1144,"text":"(P2, P6).\n"},{"number":1145,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1233,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FRecorded%20judgment%20and%20owner-ruling%20continuity","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a4d9b8e04f0ca62538f6450df06f54b15ec2047f6442d9a765f484fe934d8617","start_line":1146,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1146,"text":"### Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"\n"},{"number":1148,"text":"A residual judgment that another activation needs is recorded once, with\n"},{"number":1149,"text":"its owning work, in the existing carrier selected under §5. The record\n"},{"number":1150,"text":"identifies the question; the exact subject and governing basis; the\n"},{"number":1151,"text":"supporting computed facts and evidence; the responsible actor and its\n"},{"number":1152,"text":"authority; the conclusion and its scope; the uncertainty; and a concrete\n"},{"number":1153,"text":"revising observation that lets a consumer determine whether the conclusion\n"},{"number":1154,"text":"still applies. A question settled by rule needs no invented J record (P4b,\n"},{"number":1155,"text":"P6; C, J and O are\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"the annotations of [SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment)).\n"},{"number":1157,"text":"\n"},{"number":1158,"text":"Later roles and resumed runs recover the result and check its\n"},{"number":1159,"text":"applicability rather than re-author unchanged judgment. Reuse and\n"},{"number":1160,"text":"invalidation are\n"},{"number":1161,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse): changed material\n"},{"number":1162,"text":"inputs, a declared revising observation or a changed basis invalidate\n"},{"number":1163,"text":"the affected result, preserving the original result and its successor\n"},{"number":1164,"text":"relation and keeping only demonstrably independent results, and a new\n"},{"number":1165,"text":"role or conversation alone invalidates nothing. For a recorded judgment\n"},{"number":1166,"text":"the material inputs include its supporting computed facts and evidence,\n"},{"number":1167,"text":"and its declared revising observation is the one the record states;\n"},{"number":1168,"text":"reassessment covers what the change affects. The result may reference\n"},{"number":1169,"text":"current C outputs; reuse cannot silently turn unknown facts into\n"},{"number":1170,"text":"established premises (P4b, P5). Required independent assessment may consume valid C, but\n"},{"number":1171,"text":"its assessor acquires sufficient exact evidence and supplies its own\n"},{"number":1172,"text":"judgment under the actual independence condition; reusing the author's J\n"},{"number":1173,"text":"cannot satisfy that condition (P6; EVALUATION §3).\n"},{"number":1174,"text":"\n"},{"number":1175,"text":"A direct or lawfully proxied owner ruling is recorded in its original\n"},{"number":1176,"text":"wording, with its owner, exact subject and basis, permitted scope and\n"},{"number":1177,"text":"effects, conditions and source, separately from agent interpretation. Later\n"},{"number":1178,"text":"work consumes that same ruling while it applies; it neither widens the\n"},{"number":1179,"text":"ruling nor requests unchanged authority again. New ambiguity or a\n"},{"number":1180,"text":"materially changed decision returns only the affected question to its\n"},{"number":1181,"text":"owner. J is not O, and recording either cannot create admission,\n"},{"number":1182,"text":"acceptance, effects or continuation beyond the original grant (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1183,"text":"\n"},{"number":1184,"text":"These results follow the lifetime of the existing run, sprint or durable\n"},{"number":1185,"text":"ticket and its named result and evidence surface. They require no separate\n"},{"number":1186,"text":"judgment registry, no ticket per judgment and no additional approval\n"},{"number":1187,"text":"ceremony (P2).\n"},{"number":1188,"text":"\n"},{"number":1189,"text":"Repricing gives each affected obligation a disposition in that same\n"},{"number":1190,"text":"carrier: retained, superseded, deferred or withdrawn, with its owning\n"},{"number":1191,"text":"authority and applicable evidence links. Surviving work is preserved and\n"},{"number":1192,"text":"changed dependencies are explained; unaffected history is not copied into\n"},{"number":1193,"text":"a parallel ledger. An owner decision is presented as the short consequence\n"},{"number":1194,"text":"delta needed to decide it, with the original ruling preserved separately.\n"},{"number":1195,"text":"A general instruction to continue does not accept an undisclosed\n"},{"number":1196,"text":"architectural or scope change (P4b, P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1197,"text":"\n"},{"number":1198,"text":"The four repricing dispositions are lifecycle states of an obligation,\n"},{"number":1199,"text":"set by its owning authority. A state label is not an evaluation result and\n"},{"number":1200,"text":"has no automatic core mapping. A material repricing decision is the separate\n"},{"number":1201,"text":"owner decision that establishes one such state for an exact obligation,\n"},{"number":1202,"text":"subject and basis. Its record names the chosen disposition, the decision\n"},{"number":1203,"text":"owner and grant, the governing conditions, evidence, affected dependencies,\n"},{"number":1204,"text":"remaining obligations and any conditions for revisiting the decision (P3,\n"},{"number":1205,"text":"P4b, P6).\n"},{"number":1206,"text":"\n"},{"number":1207,"text":"A performed evaluation of that decision answers the predicate: **the named\n"},{"number":1208,"text":"owner lawfully establishes the recorded disposition for this exact\n"},{"number":1209,"text":"obligation, subject and basis, with every applicable condition satisfied\n"},{"number":1210,"text":"and every surviving obligation preserved.** This is the repricing predicate\n"},{"number":1211,"text":"owned here; it is not candidate acceptance under\n"},{"number":1212,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition), and it does not claim\n"},{"number":1213,"text":"that the underlying work was delivered. The result retains the decision,\n"},{"number":1214,"text":"its chosen state and its evidence, and refines the core values of\n"},{"number":1215,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) as follows:\n"},{"number":1216,"text":"\n"},{"number":1217,"text":"| Repricing result | Core value | Meaning for the repricing predicate |\n"},{"number":1218,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1219,"text":"| `repricing_established` | satisfied | the exact applicable owner decision, authority, evidence and preservation of surviving obligations establish the predicate |\n"},{"number":1220,"text":"| `repricing_falsified` | falsified | a counterexample defeats the predicate, including a disposition outside the actor's grant or contrary to an applicable obligation |\n"},{"number":1221,"text":"| `repricing_indeterminate` | indeterminate | admissible evidence cannot decide whether the decision meets an applicable condition; the undecided condition and needed evidence remain explicit |\n"},{"number":1222,"text":"| `repricing_out_of_frame` | out_of_frame | a material relation or capability needed to evaluate the decision is undeclared in the frame; the missing relation or capability remains explicit |\n"},{"number":1223,"text":"| `repricing_invalid_basis` | invalid_basis | the decision is evaluated on an absent, stale, ambiguous or mismatched required basis that cannot support the predicate |\n"},{"number":1224,"text":"\n"},{"number":1225,"text":"An evaluation that was not performed has no result. The evaluation records\n"},{"number":1226,"text":"all applicable failure grounds and supplies no decision authority; the\n"},{"number":1227,"text":"state changes only through the owner's authorised act. A lawful deferral\n"},{"number":1228,"text":"may therefore yield `repricing_established` while the delivery claim remains\n"},{"number":1229,"text":"failed or outstanding. An unauthorised `withdrawn` label cannot close an\n"},{"number":1230,"text":"obligation. Neither retention nor a satisfied repricing predicate establishes\n"},{"number":1231,"text":"delivery, and a superseded, deferred or withdrawn state cannot erase\n"},{"number":1232,"text":"unresolved obligations or evidence (P5, P1, P6).\n"},{"number":1233,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1276,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Condition-based closure and reuse","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FCondition-based%20closure%20and%20reuse","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"0a2cce28b1ba79c864157e0c98ccb38caee7f37f297a2dd4940a71964fc36987","start_line":1234,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1234,"text":"### Condition-based closure and reuse\n"},{"number":1235,"text":"\n"},{"number":1236,"text":"A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is\n"},{"number":1237,"text":"satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope; every\n"},{"number":1238,"text":"required judgment and owner ruling is present and applicable; and no active\n"},{"number":1239,"text":"non-closure condition remains. A mandatory obligation whose applicability is\n"},{"number":1240,"text":"unknown, or whose evidence is insufficient, withholds the dependent claim;\n"},{"number":1241,"text":"evidence presence alone is not satisfaction. The existing owner decides any\n"},{"number":1242,"text":"reserved acceptance (P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1243,"text":"This condition is the\n"},{"number":1244,"text":"[conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results) with the\n"},{"number":1245,"text":"declared obligations as required coverage. This section owns the\n"},{"number":1246,"text":"closure condition of a work claim;\n"},{"number":1247,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4 Consistency gate](SPEC_METHOD.md#consistency-gate)\n"},{"number":1248,"text":"applies it as the gate over a declared change span.\n"},{"number":1249,"text":"\n"},{"number":1250,"text":"Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.\n"},{"number":1251,"text":"Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved\n"},{"number":1252,"text":"acceptance, a work claim is recorded as\n"},{"number":1253,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)\n"},{"number":1254,"text":"states in Recording a result without review, with the ticket as the\n"},{"number":1255,"text":"existing carrier. The conditions that still apply include sprint-close\n"},{"number":1256,"text":"law (§3) and the design profile's law (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1257,"text":"\n"},{"number":1258,"text":"An unchanged obligation reuses valid applicable evidence and recorded J\n"},{"number":1259,"text":"and O under the reuse rule of\n"},{"number":1260,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse). For a work\n"},{"number":1261,"text":"claim, the changed material inputs and revising observations that rule\n"},{"number":1262,"text":"names include a material counterexample, changed evidence and a stated\n"},{"number":1263,"text":"revising observation of a recorded J; with a changed basis, each\n"},{"number":1264,"text":"invalidates the affected claim and its dependent results before further\n"},{"number":1265,"text":"reliance. An unrelated observation is retained as bounded repricing input;\n"},{"number":1266,"text":"it does not reopen a satisfied claim or expand the work automatically.\n"},{"number":1267,"text":"Closure recording preserves the exact evaluated scope, the satisfied\n"},{"number":1268,"text":"conditions, the evidence and the remaining residuals (P4b, P2).\n"},{"number":1269,"text":"\n"},{"number":1270,"text":"Landing a candidate and releasing it are distinct from this condition; apply\n"},{"number":1271,"text":"[EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#landing-closure-and-release) and any explicitly\n"},{"number":1272,"text":"declared Product acceptance gate. An open required review withholds the work\n"},{"number":1273,"text":"claim that depends on its complete coverage, not an independently authorized\n"},{"number":1274,"text":"landing merely because review is open. Keep the linked Bug items and their\n"},{"number":1275,"text":"verification provenance current; a report's existence closes none of them.\n"},{"number":1276,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1322,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Test case authority","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FTest%20case%20authority","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"b27ac901dd5b38dd7c610b0f8620ff080feaeee5a494e03ef84e7b883246d741","start_line":1277,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1277,"text":"### Test case authority\n"},{"number":1278,"text":"\n"},{"number":1279,"text":"Tests are proof projections from admitted work authority. Every\n"},{"number":1280,"text":"substantive test case should derive along this chain (P6, P2):\n"},{"number":1281,"text":"\n"},{"number":1282,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1283,"text":"ticket -> intake triage -> lawful re-entry point -> governing requirement,\n"},{"number":1284,"text":"design, module, published function, carrier, or closure surface -> test expectation\n"},{"number":1285,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1286,"text":"\n"},{"number":1287,"text":"Tests do not derive authority from the current implementation. An\n"},{"number":1288,"text":"acceptance predicate also needs an applicable supported entry or state and\n"},{"number":1289,"text":"an obligation under the governing operating or threat model. Existing test\n"},{"number":1290,"text":"presence cannot authorise an excluded threat or retain a superseded guard.\n"},{"number":1291,"text":"When that responsibility changes, the affected predicates are audited, and\n"},{"number":1292,"text":"unsupported expectations are retired under the owning basis without\n"},{"number":1293,"text":"inventing a replacement guard. An actual conflict in live authority\n"},{"number":1294,"text":"requires re-entry, not a test-only waiver (P6, P2).\n"},{"number":1295,"text":"\n"},{"number":1296,"text":"Implementation behaviour is evidence. The code is never the arbiter of a\n"},{"number":1297,"text":"test's expected result when code and test disagree (P6). When a ticket is\n"},{"number":1298,"text":"fixed and a mismatch appears between implementation behaviour and test\n"},{"number":1299,"text":"expectation, review reconciles the mismatch in this order:\n"},{"number":1300,"text":"\n"},{"number":1301,"text":"1. the ticket's `change_intent`, `change_class`, `re_entry_point`,\n"},{"number":1302,"text":"   `target_truth`, `superseded_truth`, `closure_law`,\n"},{"number":1303,"text":"   `evaluation_criteria` and `non_closure_conditions`;\n"},{"number":1304,"text":"2. the ticket's intake triage and lawful owning re-entry;\n"},{"number":1305,"text":"3. the governing requirement, design, module, published-function, carrier\n"},{"number":1306,"text":"   or other cited authority surface;\n"},{"number":1307,"text":"4. the test case expectation;\n"},{"number":1308,"text":"5. the implementation.\n"},{"number":1309,"text":"\n"},{"number":1310,"text":"The implementation may show that a test is stale, incomplete or too\n"},{"number":1311,"text":"narrow; it cannot by itself authorise changing the expected result.\n"},{"number":1312,"text":"Changing a test only because the current code behaves differently is a\n"},{"number":1313,"text":"ticket-method defect. A test that predates a lawful ticket repricing is\n"},{"number":1314,"text":"updated or removed only after naming the governing ticket and the authority\n"},{"number":1315,"text":"change that superseded the old expectation. If the ticket is stale,\n"},{"number":1316,"text":"ambiguous or missing the authority needed to decide the expectation, the\n"},{"number":1317,"text":"work re-enters triage (§4) before either the code or the test is treated as\n"},{"number":1318,"text":"correct. A passing test is closure evidence only when its expectation\n"},{"number":1319,"text":"traces back to the admitted ticket and its governing authority chain (P6,\n"},{"number":1320,"text":"P4b). The general test authority law is ASSURANCE §3; this clause is its\n"},{"number":1321,"text":"ticket-local rule.\n"},{"number":1322,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1336,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Comments,\n"},{"number":1328,"text":"dashboards, registers, indexes and generated summaries are projections\n"},{"number":1329,"text":"(P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1330,"text":"\n"},{"number":1331,"text":"Recency, visibility or repetition does not turn a projection into truth.\n"},{"number":1332,"text":"Contradiction between the owning ticket, its required milestones, the\n"},{"number":1333,"text":"current goals or the cited acceptance evidence blocks closure. Superseded\n"},{"number":1334,"text":"evidence remains history and cannot be projected as current acceptance\n"},{"number":1335,"text":"(P6, P4b).\n"},{"number":1336,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1491,"heading":"TICKETS/8. Recommended shapes","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F8.%20Recommended%20shapes","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a96542d5b5013b9716760128b49bdd910b1bcff4355af6ba8a38803b8561baee","start_line":1337,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1337,"text":"## 8.
