indeterminate retains `hold` plus a declared residual; refused yields `refusal` |\n"},{"number":801,"text":"| `frontier_projection` | `Projection` | `admitted`, `hold`, `gap`, `refused`, `invalid_basis` | exact projection/frontier ids and digests, complete members, basis, precedence law, boundary, and residuals | stale frontier retains `hold` plus `stale_frontier`; unresolved lineage retains `gap`; re-enter with a new projection |\n"},{"number":802,"text":"\n"},{"number":803,"text":"Each is an inherited `Judgment` and so carries the unchanged subject id\n"},{"number":804,"text":"and digest, evaluator, authority, evidence, provenance and decision\n"},{"number":805,"text":"coordinate. The judgment kind defines the applicable stops and residuals;\n"},{"number":806,"text":"none is inferred from prose (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":807,"text":"\n"},{"number":808,"text":"The closed constraint domains are (P5):\n"},{"number":809,"text":"\n"},{"number":810,"text":"| Constraint kind | Subject | Deciding judgment | `falsified` mapping | `indeterminate` mapping |\n"},{"number":811,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":812,"text":"| `identity_dependency_acyclic` | `OccurrenceModelSubject` | `model_validation` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_cause` |\n"},{"number":813,"text":"| `occurrence_causation_acyclic` | `OccurrenceModelSubject` | `model_validation` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_cause` |\n"},{"number":814,"text":"| `event_causation_acyclic` | `OccurrenceModelSubject` | `model_validation` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_cause` |\n"},{"number":815,"text":"| `occurrence_seed_complete` | `Occurrence` | `occurrence_admission` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_cause` |\n"},{"number":816,"text":"| `relation_claim_admissible` | `RelationClaim` | `claim_admission` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_cause` or `stale_frontier` |\n"},{"number":817,"text":"| `semantic_cut_complete` | `SemanticAdmissionCut` | `semantic_cut_admission` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `stale_frontier` |\n"},{"number":818,"text":"| `pre_effect_current` | `EffectSubject` | `effect_readiness` | `stale` plus `hold` and `stale_currentness` | `hold` plus `stale_currentness` |\n"},{"number":819,"text":"| `operation_grant_contains_effect` | `EffectSubject` | `effect_readiness` | `unauthorized` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unobserved_subject_state` |\n"},{"number":820,"text":"| `event_scope_compatible` | `FrameworkEvent` | `event_admission` | `out_of_scope` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `unresolved_scope` |\n"},{"number":821,"text":"| `frontier_complete` | `Projection` | `frontier_projection` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `hold` plus `stale_frontier` |\n"},{"number":822,"text":"| `transition_subject_complete` | `TransitionSubject` | `transition_evaluation` | `refused` plus `refusal` | `indeterminate` plus `unobserved_subject_state` |\n"},{"number":823,"text":"\n"},{"number":824,"text":"Each constraint declares zero latitude unless its exact record names a\n"},{"number":825,"text":"`latitude_ref`; silence is not latitude. The residual kind fixes re-entry\n"},{"number":826,"text":"(P5, P4b):\n"},{"number":827,"text":"\n"},{"number":828,"text":"| Residual kind | Subject | Required re-entry |\n"},{"number":829,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":830,"text":"| `unobserved_subject_state` | `SubjectBinding` | acquire a bounded observation or retain hold |\n"},{"number":831,"text":"| `partial_effect` | `EffectInvocation` | acquire post-observation and explicit disposition |\n"},{"number":832,"text":"| `unresolved_cause` | claim or event | acquire authority and evidence or retain unresolved |\n"},{"number":833,"text":"| `unresolved_scope` | `FrameworkEvent` | declare lawful scope or refuse admission |\n"},{"number":834,"text":"| `competing_lineage` | `EventFrontier` | apply an authorized `frontier_projection` judgment |\n"},{"number":835,"text":"| `stale_frontier` | `Projection` | construct a new exact frontier and projection |\n"},{"number":836,"text":"| `stale_currentness` | `EffectSubject` | re-observe and re-judge before effect |\n"},{"number":837,"text":"| `unobserved_external_mutation` | `SubjectBinding` | observe or retain an explicit material unknown |\n"},{"number":838,"text":"\n"},{"number":839,"text":"Mapping to the core result algebra. Purpose:\n"},{"number":840,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) states every outcome in\n"},{"number":841,"text":"the core or in a refinement that maps each refined value to exactly one\n"},{"number":842,"text":"core value, and\n"},{"number":843,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds)\n"},{"number":844,"text":"requires a traversal's stop algebra to map totally to that core (P5).\n"},{"number":845,"text":"Material relation: a consumer that joins an occurrence's results with\n"},{"number":846,"text":"other results reads each decision, stop and effect disposition as one\n"},{"number":847,"text":"core value with its predicate, so a refusal, a held judgment or a partial\n"},{"number":848,"text":"effect is neither read as success nor mistaken for another case (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":849,"text":"The profile states three refinements, each with the predicate its mapping\n"},{"number":850,"text":"is for:\n"},{"number":851,"text":"\n"},{"number":852,"text":"| Refinement | Predicate of the mapping | Stated in |\n"},{"number":853,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":854,"text":"| judgment decisions | the first decision the judgment kind lists holds for the unchanged subject on the exact basis | this section |\n"},{"number":855,"text":"| stop kinds | the traversal application can reach its declared result on the exact basis | this section |\n"},{"number":856,"text":"| effect dispositions | the intended effect occurred ([ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects)) | [Mutable-subject effect relation](#mutable-subject-effect-relation) |\n"},{"number":857,"text":"\n"},{"number":858,"text":"A judgment decision is the evaluation's result and a stop is the step's.\n"},{"number":859,"text":"Where values emitted together map to different core values, as `stale`\n"},{"number":860,"text":"with `hold` does, each answers its own predicate. The stop's predicate is\n"},{"number":861,"text":"not the predicate of\n"},{"number":862,"text":"[construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability), \"a\n"},{"number":863,"text":"candidate is available\", and no value counts toward another predicate\n"},{"number":864,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).\n"},{"number":865,"text":"Each value keeps its own vocabulary, residual and re-entry law beside its\n"},{"number":866,"text":"core value (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Recording) (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":867,"text":"\n"},{"number":868,"text":"Refined by cause. Where a stop or decision would map to one of two core\n"},{"number":869,"text":"values according to its cause, the cause is part of the refined value,\n"},{"number":870,"text":"written in parentheses as in `refusal(basis)`, and each refined value maps\n"},{"number":871,"text":"once (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Refinements). The cause is read from what\n"},{"number":872,"text":"the record already carries: for a refusal, the conditions it names; for a\n"},{"number":873,"text":"`partial_effect` or `partial`, the effect evidence and the bounded\n"},{"number":874,"text":"post-observation, read against the intended outcome under its outcome\n"},{"number":875,"text":"contract and comparison basis (`IntendedOutcome`).\n"},{"number":876,"text":"A refusal's cause is the one that the operation-outcome\n"},{"number":877,"text":"rows `refusal(constraint)` and `refusal(basis)` of\n"},{"number":878,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS AC-007](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal)\n"},{"number":879,"text":"state for the conditions the refusal names: `constraint` where it names a\n"},{"number":880,"text":"demonstrated violation by the record, model, carrier, transformation or\n"},{"number":881,"text":"application under judgment, whatever condition of the basis it also names,\n"},{"number":882,"text":"and `basis` where it names only conditions of the basis, a violation\n"},{"number":883,"text":"inside an input that the operation acts on as its basis included. AC-007\n"},{"number":884,"text":"gives each cause its core value and reports a basis condition named beside\n"},{"number":885,"text":"a violation as its own invalid_basis result. Where a relation qualifier\n"},{"number":886,"text":"records the cause, it records it and does not choose it, so this profile\n"},{"number":887,"text":"and AC-007 give one refusal one value. The closed populations above are\n"},{"number":888,"text":"unchanged; a refined value names a kind and its cause and adds no kind\n"},{"number":889,"text":"(P5, P3). The causes are:\n"},{"number":890,"text":"\n"},{"number":891,"text":"- `refusal(basis)`: the refusal names one or more conditions of the basis\n"},{"number":892,"text":"  the operation acts on, as AC-007 lists for that value, and no\n"},{"number":893,"text":"  demonstrated violation by what is under judgment; where a relation\n"},{"number":894,"text":"  qualifier records its cause, it carries `refuse_invalid_basis`, which\n"},{"number":895,"text":"  records a condition of the basis and no other cause. A basis mismatch\n"},{"number":896,"text":"  inside the model or a record is the mixed bases that AC-007 lists for\n"},{"number":897,"text":"  this value, a condition of the basis, so a refusal that names only such\n"},{"number":898,"text":"  a mismatch has this cause: a coordinate and basis mismatch or a\n"},{"number":899,"text":"  basis-relation mismatch refused at model validation\n"},{"number":900,"text":"  ([Finite reference-domain table](#finite-reference-domain-table)), a\n"},{"number":901,"text":"  qualifier basis mismatch refused at structural admission\n"},{"number":902,"text":"  ([Closed relation families](#closed-relation-families)) and a\n"},{"number":903,"text":"  cross-basis required edge that refuses a semantic admission cut\n"},{"number":904,"text":"  ([Candidate, judgment, event and relation separation](#candidate-judgment-event-and-relation-separation)).\n"},{"number":905,"text":"  None is the counterexample of a structural constraint. A refusal emitted\n"},{"number":906,"text":"  with an `invalid_basis` decision, as `model_validation`'s \"refusal or\n"},{"number":907,"text":"  invalid basis\" allows, has this cause where it names no demonstrated\n"},{"number":908,"text":"  violation, because that decision names a condition of the basis and its\n"},{"number":909,"text":"  repair. Where the refusal also names a demonstrated violation by what is\n"},{"number":910,"text":"  under judgment, it has cause `constraint` below, as AC-007 rules, and\n"},{"number":911,"text":"  the co-emitted `invalid_basis` decision is the basis condition's own\n"},{"number":912,"text":"  result: it keeps invalid_basis for its own predicate, because the\n"},{"number":913,"text":"  constraint rule above maps `invalid_basis` only to that core value and\n"},{"number":914,"text":"  the judgment table keeps `refused` and `invalid_basis` distinct.\n"},{"number":915,"text":"- `refusal(constraint)`: every other refusal, that is, every refusal that\n"},{"number":916,"text":"  names a demonstrated violation by what is under judgment, whatever\n"},{"number":917,"text":"  condition of the basis it also names, or names no condition that AC-007\n"},{"number":918,"text":"  lists for `refusal(basis)`. The record, model, carrier, transformation\n"},{"number":919,"text":"  or application under judgment violates a constraint of the occurrence\n"},{"number":920,"text":"  signature, as AC-007 states for this value, and a basis condition the\n"},{"number":921,"text":"  refusal also names is recorded with it and reported as its own\n"},{"number":922,"text":"  invalid_basis result. It follows a falsified constraint, and the defect\n"},{"number":923,"text":"  it names is the counterexample; where a relation qualifier records its\n"},{"number":924,"text":"  cause, it carries `refuse_missing`, `refuse_duplicate`,\n"},{"number":925,"text":"  `refuse_wrong_type` or `refuse_out_of_scope`. The falsified constraint\n"},{"number":926,"text":"  is one of three: a row of the constraint table, which maps `falsified`\n"},{"number":927,"text":"  to `refused` plus `refusal`; a structural constraint, named below; or\n"},{"number":928,"text":"  the requirement that an admitted event carry a lawful declared scope. A\n"},{"number":929,"text":"  refusal of admission under the `unresolved_scope` re-entry is a\n"},{"number":930,"text":"  judgment-level refusal, which no relation qualifier records, and it takes\n"},{"number":931,"text":"  this cause from the condition it names under AC-007, as every refusal\n"},{"number":932,"text":"  does: `event_admission` requires the event's scope authority as evidence\n"},{"number":933,"text":"  and the re-entry names the lawful scope declaration as what must be\n"},{"number":934,"text":"  supplied, so the event candidate still lacking it when the re-entry\n"},{"number":935,"text":"  closes is a demonstrated violation by the event under judgment and the\n"},{"number":936,"text":"  counterexample. The `unresolved_scope` residual is retained, naming the\n"},{"number":937,"text":"  undeclared scope, and re-entry is a new event\n"},{"number":938,"text":"  candidate with a lawful declared scope. A seed that falsifies\n"},{"number":939,"text":"  `occurrence_seed_complete`, an event scope missing when that re-entry\n"},{"number":940,"text":"  closes or incompatible with the admitting authority, and a duplicate,\n"},{"number":941,"text":"  missing, extra, reversed or mismatched edge are each a defect of the\n"},{"number":942,"text":"  occurrence or event under judgment that violates a constraint of the\n"},{"number":943,"text":"  signature. None is the seed set, scope or required-edge semantics of the\n"},{"number":944,"text":"  basis the operation acts on, which AC-007 lists for `refusal(basis)`, so\n"},{"number":945,"text":"  a refusal for any of them has this cause there. The same defect can bear\n"},{"number":946,"text":"  on the predicate of another operation that acts on that record as its\n"},{"number":947,"text":"  basis, as AC-007 rules (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":948,"text":"- `refused(basis)` and `refused(constraint)`: decision `refused` of any\n"},{"number":949,"text":"  judgment, by the cause of the refusal it yields, which the conditions\n"},{"number":950,"text":"  that refusal names decide under AC-007 as above: `refused(basis)` when\n"},{"number":951,"text":"  that refusal is `refusal(basis)`, otherwise `refused(constraint)`.\n"},{"number":952,"text":"- `partial_effect(not_attained)`: the admitted evidence establishes that\n"},{"number":953,"text":"  the intended outcome is not met and that no later completion of the\n"},{"number":954,"text":"  effect can meet it. The effect evidence and the bounded\n"},{"number":955,"text":"  post-observation, read under the outcome contract, show the intended\n"},{"number":956,"text":"  outcome not met where nothing left of the effect can meet it, for\n"},{"number":957,"text":"  example where the effect has ended short, or an interval that the\n"},{"number":958,"text":"  outcome contract bounds has closed with only part reached, or the part\n"},{"number":959,"text":"  already done has itself defeated the outcome, such as an effect that\n"},{"number":960,"text":"  has already deleted a record the outcome requires, which no later\n"},{"number":961,"text":"  completion of the effect restores. The evidence\n"},{"number":962,"text":"  of non-attainment, such as the unreached part, is the counterexample.\n"},{"number":963,"text":"  Whether the effect has ended is not part of this cause: where the\n"},{"number":964,"text":"  evidence does not establish the end, the `partial_effect`\n"},{"number":965,"text":"  residual records it beside the value, as\n"},{"number":966,"text":"  [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects) states.\n"},{"number":967,"text":"- `partial_effect(undecided)`: every other `partial_effect`, that is,\n"},{"number":968,"text":"  one whose admitted evidence does not establish non-attainment. The\n"},{"number":969,"text":"  admitted evidence cannot decide whether the intended outcome is or will be met:\n"},{"number":970,"text":"  the bounded post-observation that the\n"},{"number":971,"text":"  [effect law](#mutable-subject-effect-relation) requires is not yet\n"},{"number":972,"text":"  acquired, or it shows part reached while a later completion of the\n"},{"number":973,"text":"  effect could still meet the outcome, or it shows the outcome met while\n"},{"number":974,"text":"  the effect may still be acting, so whether the outcome is met once the\n"},{"number":975,"text":"  effect settles is undecided, or a response was lost and no\n"},{"number":976,"text":"  counterexample is observed. A lost response, an absent record or an\n"},{"number":977,"text":"  actor's context holding no trace of the effect is no evidence about the\n"},{"number":978,"text":"  subject, so it establishes neither non-attainment nor the end of the\n"},{"number":979,"text":"  effect ([ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects)).\n"},{"number":980,"text":"- `partial(not_attained)` and `partial(undecided)`: decision `partial` of\n"},{"number":981,"text":"  `transition_evaluation`, by the cause of the stop `partial_effect` it\n"},{"number":982,"text":"  yields.\n"},{"number":983,"text":"\n"},{"number":984,"text":"| Value | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":985,"text":"|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":986,"text":"| stop `hold` | indeterminate | the step stops with the deciding evidence not yet admitted (missing seed, unresolved cause or scope, stale frontier or currentness, unobserved state), so the admissible evidence cannot decide whether the application can reach its declared result ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results); RF-012); its residual names the evidence that would decide |\n"},{"number":987,"text":"| stop `gap` | invalid_basis | a reference or lineage member the judgment requires is unresolved, its resolution still open as AC-007 defines for `gap`, so the closure it rests on is undefined on this basis (AC-003, AC-010) and the basis cannot support the judgment until repaired |\n"},{"number":988,"text":"| stop `refusal(constraint)` | falsified | the falsified constraint's defect is the counterexample, as construction availability maps `refused` to falsified (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":989,"text":"| stop `refusal(basis)` | invalid_basis | the basis cannot support the judgment; the constraint rule above maps `invalid_basis` only to that core value |\n"},{"number":990,"text":"| stop `invalid_basis` | invalid_basis | the same core value; the constraint rule above maps `invalid_basis` only to it |\n"},{"number":991,"text":"| stop `out_of_scope` | falsified | it is emitted only with `refusal`, when `event_scope_compatible` is falsified by a declared scope that conflicts with the admitting authority; an event scope not yet declared is `hold` plus `unresolved_scope` while the signature declares the scope relation, so the ground of out_of_frame, a missing declaration in the frame, is absent, and the spelling is not the core's out_of_frame; a refusal of admission once that re-entry closes without the declaration is stop `refusal(constraint)`, its cause taken from AC-007's condition as for every refusal, not this stop (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":992,"text":"| stop `partial_effect(not_attained)` | falsified | the unreached part of the intended outcome, which no later completion of the effect can reach, defeats the declared result; an end of the effect that the evidence does not establish takes no part in the value and is recorded in the `partial_effect` residual, which stays with the value with explicit re-entry before any further effect (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":993,"text":"| stop `partial_effect(undecided)` | indeterminate | an effect that has begun and whose evidence cannot decide whether the intended outcome is or will be met supplies no counterexample ([Mutable-subject effect relation](#mutable-subject-effect-relation)), so the admissible evidence cannot decide; the `partial_effect` residual names the post-observation and explicit disposition that would decide (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":994,"text":"| decision `partial(not_attained)` | falsified | the post-observation, read under the outcome contract, shows part of the intended outcome not reached and not reachable by any later completion of the effect, which defeats the transition's positive decision whether or not the effect has ended (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":995,"text":"| decision `partial(undecided)` | indeterminate | the admissible evidence cannot decide whether the transition reaches the intended outcome; the decision's required evidence includes the post-observation, and a missing one is `indeterminate` plus `unobserved_subject_state` under `transition_subject_complete`; the `partial_effect` residual names the explicit disposition that would decide (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":996,"text":"| decision `refused(constraint)` | falsified | the image of a falsified constraint under the constraint table, or of a falsified structural constraint named below (P5, P6) |\n"},{"number":997,"text":"| decision `refused(basis)` | invalid_basis | as stop `refusal(basis)` (P5) |\n"},{"number":998,"text":"\n"},{"number":999,"text":"The remaining judgment decisions follow the constraint rule above: the\n"},{"number":1000,"text":"first decision each judgment lists maps to satisfied; `out_of_scope`,\n"},{"number":1001,"text":"`unauthorized` and `stale`, which the constraint table makes the images\n"},{"number":1002,"text":"of a falsified constraint, map to falsified; `hold`, the image of an\n"},{"number":1003,"text":"indeterminate constraint, maps to indeterminate; `gap` maps to\n"},{"number":1004,"text":"invalid_basis on the ground of the stop so named; and `invalid_basis` and\n"},{"number":1005,"text":"the `falsified` and `indeterminate` of `transition_evaluation` map to the\n"},{"number":1006,"text":"core values so named (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1007,"text":"\n"},{"number":1008,"text":"This mapping holds for every traversal under this profile's signature; a\n"},{"number":1009,"text":"traversal does not re-map it. `hold`, `gap`, `refusal(constraint)` and\n"},{"number":1010,"text":"`refusal(basis)` have the meanings and core values that\n"},{"number":1011,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS AC-007](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal)\n"},{"number":1012,"text":"gives them, as the table above states. A traversal record's `stop_states`\n"},{"number":1013,"text":"may refine those four values by cause for that traversal, by a binding\n"},{"number":1014,"text":"declared in the shape of [PROFILES §1](PROFILES.md#1-the-boundary): its\n"},{"number":1015,"text":"direction, preserved meaning, narrowed scope and invalidation. A refined\n"},{"number":1016,"text":"value adds no kind and takes its core value under the parent-value rule\n"},{"number":1017,"text":"of [AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds),\n"},{"number":1018,"text":"which this profile applies and does not restate. The other stops and\n"},{"number":1019,"text":"every judgment decision keep the mapping above unrefined, and a record\n"},{"number":1020,"text":"that declares no binding takes it unrefined (P5, P3, P1).\n"},{"number":1021,"text":"\n"},{"number":1022,"text":"A structural refusal is one whose source is this profile's closed\n"},{"number":1023,"text":"structure rather than a row of the constraint table: an unknown or missing\n"},{"number":1024,"text":"required field under the closed value contract\n"},{"number":1025,"text":"([Closed semantic-object sorts](#closed-semantic-object-sorts)); a\n"},{"number":1026,"text":"missing population, hidden record, ambiguous ref, unknown record kind or\n"},{"number":1027,"text":"undeclared field domain\n"},{"number":1028,"text":"([Imported calculus boundary](#imported-calculus-boundary)); a missing\n"},{"number":1029,"text":"row, target outside its row, wrong population or sort, unresolved\n"},{"number":1030,"text":"external target, cardinality violation or nested coordinate or witness\n"},{"number":1031,"text":"defect refused at model validation\n"},{"number":1032,"text":"([Finite reference-domain table](#finite-reference-domain-table)); an\n"},{"number":1033,"text":"unknown event kind, wrong payload sort, mismatched payload digest or\n"},{"number":1034,"text":"forbidden claim or occurrence field refused at event admission\n"},{"number":1035,"text":"([Closed event-kind population](#closed-event-kind-population)); and a\n"},{"number":1036,"text":"qualifier-record defect refused at structural admission, a ref outside\n"},{"number":1037,"text":"the closed `ProfileRecordRef` union, resolved under a wrong population or\n"},{"number":1038,"text":"sort or absent from its declared external domain, and a duplicate,\n"},{"number":1039,"text":"missing, extra, reversed or mismatched edge refused at occurrence\n"},{"number":1040,"text":"admission ([Closed relation families](#closed-relation-families)). Each\n"},{"number":1041,"text":"is the refusal of a falsified structural constraint: the closed structure\n"},{"number":1042,"text":"is the declared predicate, and the unknown kind, unknown or missing\n"},{"number":1043,"text":"field, wrong type or mismatched edge is the counterexample that defeats\n"},{"number":1044,"text":"it (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results). A basis mismatch at any of these sources\n"},{"number":1045,"text":"is not among them: it is the mixed bases of AC-007, a condition of the\n"},{"number":1046,"text":"basis, so a refusal that names only such a mismatch takes\n"},{"number":1047,"text":"`refusal(basis)`, as stated for that value above. A stop `refusal` or\n"},{"number":1048,"text":"decision `refused` from such a source therefore takes\n"},{"number":1049,"text":"`refusal(constraint)` or `refused(constraint)`, and takes\n"},{"number":1050,"text":"`refusal(basis)` or `refused(basis)` only under the cause stated for\n"},{"number":1051,"text":"those values, as every refusal does: a source in the closed structure\n"},{"number":1052,"text":"does not make a refusal an invalid basis (P5, P6). A required reference\n"},{"number":1053,"text":"that `model_validation` leaves unresolved, its resolution still open as\n"},{"number":1054,"text":"AC-007 defines for `gap`, is not refused: it retains `gap` until repaired\n"},{"number":1055,"text":"and maps to invalid_basis by that stop's row. A reference evaluated to no\n"},{"number":1056,"text":"target, a local reference with no record in the closed populations\n"},{"number":1057,"text":"included, is dangling and refuses under\n"},{"number":1058,"text":"[AC-003](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-003-reference-closure) (P5). Where a\n"},{"number":1059,"text":"relation qualifier records the cause of a refusal, the qualifier, not\n"},{"number":1060,"text":"the core value, records whether the defect is a missing, duplicate,\n"},{"number":1061,"text":"wrong-typed or out-of-scope input or an invalid basis; the stop keeps it\n"},{"number":1062,"text":"in its own vocabulary, so the mapping drops none of the distinctions the\n"},{"number":1063,"text":"qualifier draws (P5, P4b).\n"},{"number":1064,"text":"\n"},{"number":1065,"text":"Neither core value to which the `partial` and `partial_effect` values map\n"},{"number":1066,"text":"records that the subject changed or whether the effect has ended. (P3):\n"},{"number":1094,"text":"\n"},{"number":1095,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1096,"text":"id(o_n) binds (\n"},{"number":1097,"text":"  exact traversal-occurrence-profile subject-binding identity,\n"},{"number":1102,"text":"  intended-outcome identity,\n"},{"number":1103,"text":"  declared lineage inputs,\n"},{"number":1104,"text":"  declared identity-dependency inputs\n"},{"number":1105,"text":")\n"},{"number":1106,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1107,"text":"\n"},{"number":1108,"text":"Post-effect observations, effect evidence, judgments, admitted The relation records are minted only after the occurrence identity\n"},{"number":1118,"text":"exists, so they do not enter the seed; their endpoints must reproduce it\n"},{"number":1119,"text":"exactly (P3).\n"},{"number":1120,"text":"\n"},{"number":1121,"text":"Two applications of one traversal over one subject are two occurrences. seed\n"},{"number":1139,"text":"(P3).\n"},{"number":1140,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1238,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Candidate, judgment, event and relation Candidate, judgment, event and relation separation\n"},{"number":1142,"text":"\n"},{"number":1143,"text":"The admission relation is (P6, P3):\n"},{"number":1144,"text":"\n"},{"number":1145,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1146,"text":"RelationClaim c\n"},{"number":1147,"text":"  -> Judgment j_c over unchanged c\n"},{"number":1148,"text":" materialized from (c, j_c, e, j_e, basis)\n"},{"number":1151,"text":"  -> successor frontier F_k_plus_1\n"},{"number":1152,"text":"  -> SemanticAdmissionCut a = (c, j_c, e, j_e, r, F_k, F_k_plus_1)\n"},{"number":1153,"text":"  -> Judgment j_a over unchanged a\n"},{"number":1154,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1155,"text":"\n"},{"number":1156,"text":"Only `j_c.decision = admitted`, `j_e.decision = admitted` and\n"},{"number":1157,"text":"`j_a.decision = admitted` together admit the complete semantic cut. `c`,\n"},{"number":1158,"text":"`j_c`, `e`, `j_e`, `r`, `a` and `j_a` have distinct identities and\n"},{"number":1159,"text":"authority. Constructing `c` does not admit it. A judgment does not rewrite\n"},{"number":1160,"text":"its subject. An event does not inherit the candidate's authority.\n"},{"number":1161,"text":"Materialisation cannot change the relation kind, endpoints, qualifiers or\n"},{"number":1162,"text":"basis that `j_c` accepted (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1163,"text":"\n"},{"number":1164,"text":"The three judgments are exact inherited `Judgment` records (P6):\n"},{"number":1165,"text":"\n"},{"number":1166,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1167,"text":"j_c.kind = claim_admission\n"},{"number":1168,"text":"j_c.subject = c.id\n"},{"number":1169,"text":"j_c.subject_digest = sha256(canonical bytes of c)\n"},{"number":1170,"text":"\n"},{"number":1171,"text":"j_e.kind = event_admission\n"},{"number":1172,"text":"j_e.subject = e.id\n"},{"number":1173,"text":"j_e.subject_digest = sha256(canonical bytes of e)\n"},{"number":1174,"text":"\n"},{"number":1175,"text":"j_a.kind = semantic_cut_admission\n"},{"number":1176,"text":"j_a.subject = a.id\n"},{"number":1177,"text":"j_a.subject_digest = sha256(canonical bytes of a)\n"},{"number":1178,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1179,"text":"\n"},{"number":1180,"text":"Each judgment has the complete inherited context, owner, scope, basis,\n"},{"number":1181,"text":"evaluator, authority, decision, evidence, provenance and decision-time\n"},{"number":1182,"text":"fields. A missing cut judgment, a decision other than `admitted`, a wrong\n"},{"number":1183,"text":"subject or digest, or a judgment across bases refuses the semantic cut\n"},{"number":1184,"text":"(P6, P5).\n"},{"number":1185,"text":"\n"},{"number":1186,"text":"An admission event's identity binds its event kind, payload digest,\n"},{"number":1187,"text":"scope, optional occurrence, exact claim, claim judgment, source frontier,\n"},{"number":1188,"text":"owner, scope and basis. The materialised relation's identity binds the\n"},{"number":1189,"text":"unchanged claim, claim judgment, event, event judgment and profile basis.\n"},{"number":1190,"text":"`frontier_contains(F, e)` holds exactly when `e` appears once in\n"},{"number":1191,"text":"`F.value.member_event_refs`; neither representation may hold an extra or a\n"},{"number":1192,"text":"missing event (P3).\n"},{"number":1193,"text":"\n"},{"number":1194,"text":"For claim admission, `e.value.event_kind_ref` is exactly\n"},{"number":1195,"text":"`urn:stdo:traversal-occurrence:event-kind:claim-admission`, and these refs\n"},{"number":1196,"text":"are identical, not merely equivalent or adjacent (P3):\n"},{"number":1197,"text":"\n"},{"number":1198,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1199,"text":"c.value.source_frontier_ref\n"},{"number":1200,"text":"  = e.value.source_frontier_ref\n"},{"number":1201,"text":"  = a.value.source_frontier_ref\n"},{"number":1202,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1203,"text":"\n"},{"number":1204,"text":"`a.value.successor_frontier_ref` resolves a frontier whose exact member\n"},{"number":1205,"text":"set is the source frontier's member set plus `e.id` once. The cut's claim,\n"},{"number":1206,"text":"claim judgment, event, event judgment, relation, source frontier and\n"},{"number":1207,"text":"successor frontier refs each resolve the unchanged record judged or\n"},{"number":1208,"text":"materialised (P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":1209,"text":"\n"},{"number":1210,"text":"All seven cut subjects, all three judgments and the three required\n"},{"number":1211,"text":"relation records share the exact profile basis. The source and successor\n"},{"number":1212,"text":"frontiers also share `projection_basis_ref` and `precedence_law_ref`, and\n"},{"number":1213,"text":"the only permitted difference in frontier content is the addition of\n"},{"number":1214,"text":"`e.id` once. The cut includes exactly (P3, P4b):\n"},{"number":1215,"text":"\n"},{"number":1216,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1217,"text":"admits_claim(e, c)\n"},{"number":1218,"text":"materializes_relation(e, r)\n"},{"number":1219,"text":"frontier_contains(F_k_plus_1, e)\n"},{"number":1220,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1221,"text":"\n"},{"number":1222,"text":"Each edge has the exact inherited relation shape and\n"},{"number":1223,"text":"`OccurrenceRelationQualifiers`. Missing, extra, reversed, duplicate or\n"},{"number":1224,"text":"cross-basis required edges refuse the cut. The source frontier must not\n"},{"number":1225,"text":"already contain `e`, and duplicate frontier members refuse before any set\n"},{"number":1226,"text":"comparison (P3, P5).\n"},{"number":1227,"text":"\n"},{"number":1228,"text":"A first event needs no fictional predecessor. A correction\n"},{"number":1254,"text":"changes later projection through an explicit selection law; it does not\n"},{"number":1255,"text":"delete, rewrite or retrospectively re-identify the corrected fact (P3,\n"},{"number":1256,"text":"P4b).\n"},{"number":1257,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1277,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Causality and typed lineage","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FCausality%20and%20typed%20lineage","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"176e8c0d104b91aa307aa40b065378180c3ad7d1ac6e9a3ba5705e419a0b9faf","start_line":1258,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1258,"text":"## Causality and typed lineage\n"},{"number":1259,"text":"\n"},{"number":1260,"text":"Three graph families stay distinct (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":1261,"text":"\n"},{"number":1262,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1263,"text":"G_id          identity-dependency DAG\n"},{"number":1264,"text":"G_occ_cause   declared occurrence-causation DAG\n"},{"number":1265,"text":"G_evt_cause   declared event-causation DAG\n"},{"number":1266,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1267,"text":"\n"},{"number":1268,"text":"Each is acyclic under its own typed relation. Cause is established only by\n"},{"number":1269,"text":"an admitted causal claim under competent authority and evidence.\n"},{"number":1270,"text":"Timestamp, ordinal, adjacency, containment, a common subject, a shared\n"},{"number":1271,"text":"actor, correlation and arrival order do not create cause (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1272,"text":"\n"},{"number":1273,"text":"The wider typed-lineage graph may lawfully contain opposing edges of\n"},{"number":1274,"text":"different kinds: one event may support another while the second corrects\n"},{"number":1275,"text":"the first. A cycle in the untyped union is not a causal cycle unless one\n"},{"number":1276,"text":"declared causal subgraph itself cycles (P3).\n"},{"number":1277,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1284,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Causality and typed lineage/OP-004 Precedence is not authority","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FCausality%20and%20typed%20lineage%2FOP-004%20Precedence%20is%20not%20authority","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"efc52e2ae8b45c104d8eb2dbe9874a6b43a665d07ab6a523145d0c5726d8094e","start_line":1278,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1278,"text":"### OP-004 Precedence is not authority\n"},{"number":1279,"text":"\n"},{"number":1280,"text":"A projection may use a declared precedence coordinate to select current\n"},{"number":1281,"text":"truth. The coordinate, its comparison law, its basis and its admitting\n"},{"number":1282,"text":"authority are explicit. The coordinate orders eligible facts; it gains no\n"},{"number":1283,"text":"semantic, admission, causal or decision authority (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1284,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1405,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Mutable-subject effect relation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FMutable-subject%20effect%20relation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"a6b0da22ff7fd3f8d94ee52416ce5ff79f3c9b20f527a4813d1eb7f8dc77f66c","start_line":1285,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1285,"text":"## Mutable-subject effect relation\n"},{"number":1286,"text":"\n"},{"number":1287,"text":"Let `W` be an externally mutable subject bound by the stable\n"},{"number":1288,"text":"`SubjectBinding b_W`. For occurrence `o_n` (P3, P6):\n"},{"number":1289,"text":"\n"},{"number":1290,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1291,"text":"observe(W_n, b_W) -> q_n\n"},{"number":1292,"text":"\n"},{"number":1293,"text":"F_K[v_n] classifies one traversal application.\n"},{"number":1294,"text":"op_n is a separately identified domain operation.\n"},{"number":1295,"text":"g_n is the exact owner-issued grant for op_n over b_W.\n"},{"number":1296,"text":"inv_n = EffectInvocation(o_n, op_n, executor_n, actor_n, g_n, territory_n, inputs_n)\n"},{"number":1297,"text":"s_n = EffectSubject(o_n, b_W, q_n, inv_n, op_n, g_n, territory_n, invalidation_n)\n"},{"number":1298,"text":"j_ready = judge_effect_readiness(s_n)\n"},{"number":1299,"text":"\n"},{"number":1300,"text":"j_ready.decision = ready\n"},{"number":1301,"text":"  -> dispatch(inv_n, W_n, b_W)\n"},{"number":1302,"text":"       -> (W_n_plus_1, disposition_n)\n"},{"number":1303,"text":"\n"},{"number":1304,"text":"observe(W_n_plus_1, b_W) -> q_n_plus_1\n"},{"number":1305,"text":"judge(TransitionSubject(o_n, q_n, q_n_plus_1, disposition_n, ...)) -> Judgment\n"},{"number":1306,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1307,"text":"\n"},{"number":1308,"text":"Functor kind, traversal, domain operation, executor, actor, grant and\n"},{"number":1309,"text":"effect invocation are different coordinates. An `F_P`, `F_D` or `F_H`\n"},{"number":1310,"text":"classification does not by itself identify, authorise or execute `op_n`\n"},{"number":1311,"text":"(P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1312,"text":"\n"},{"number":1313,"text":"No operation is lawful without a matching grant that names the subject\n"},{"number":1314,"text":"binding, the operation kind and the effect territory. Profile construction\n"},{"number":1315,"text":"and occurrence admission mint no grant (P6).\n"},{"number":1316,"text":"\n"},{"number":1317,"text":"For invocation `inv_n`, operation instance `op_n`, grant `g_n` and\n"},{"number":1318,"text":"occurrence `o_n`, every operation binding is exact (P6, P3):\n"},{"number":1319,"text":"\n"},{"number":1320,"text":"```text\n"},{"number":1321,"text":"inv_n.value.operation_ref = op_n.id\n"},{"number":1322,"text":"target(operation_of_kind(op_n)) = op_n.value.operation_kind_ref\n"},{"number":1323,"text":"target(targets_subject(op_n)) = op_n.value.subject_binding_ref\n"},{"number":1324,"text":"target(authorized_by(inv_n)) = inv_n.value.operation_grant_ref = g_n.id\n"},{"number":1325,"text":"op_n.value.subject_binding_ref = g_n.value.subject_binding_ref\n"},{"number":1326,"text":"                             = o_n.value.subject_binding_ref\n"},{"number":1327,"text":"op_n.value.operation_kind_ref in g_n.value.allowed_operation_kind_refs\n"},{"number":1328,"text":"op_n.value.operation_contract_ref\n"},{"number":1329,"text":"  = object(op_n.value.operation_kind_ref).value.operation_contract_ref\n"},{"number":1330,"text":"op_n.value.effect_territory_ref = inv_n.value.effect_territory_ref\n"},{"number":1331,"text":"                               = g_n.value.allowed_effect_territory_ref\n"},{"number":1332,"text":"```\n"},{"number":1333,"text":"\n"},{"number":1334,"text":"The exact `OperationKind` object therefore closes the grant over both kind\n"},{"number":1335,"text":"and contract. A grant cannot authorise an operation instance that carries\n"},{"number":1336,"text":"the same label with a different contract, target sort, invalidated kind or\n"},{"number":1337,"text":"unresolved kind ref (P6, P3).\n"},{"number":1338,"text":"\n"},{"number":1339,"text":"An adopting Product may replace exact territory equality only through an\n"},{"number":1340,"text":"explicit, authority-owned containment relation in its compatible\n"},{"number":1341,"text":"signature. Nominal kind equality, a role label, executor access or broad\n"},{"number":1342,"text":"workspace access does not satisfy the grant (P6, P1).\n"},{"number":1343,"text":"\n"},{"number":1344,"text":"The disposition law is closed (P5, P6):\n"},{"number":1345,"text":"\n"},{"number":1346,"text":"- `no_effect` has no dispatched invocation and records that no domain\n"},{"number":1347,"text":"  effect was attempted;\n"},{"number":1348,"text":"- `completed_effect` binds one dispatched invocation, a bounded\n"},{"number":1349,"text":"  post-observation and sufficient effect evidence;\n"},{"number":1350,"text":"- `partial_effect` binds one dispatched invocation, a bounded\n"},{"number":1351,"text":"  post-observation, bounded evidence, the `partial_effect` residual and\n"},{"number":1352,"text":"  stop, and explicit re-entry before any further effect; and\n"},{"number":1353,"text":"- `refused_effect` binds the refused invocation attempt and the `refusal`\n"},{"number":1354,"text":"  stop, with evidence that no mutation began within the material effect\n"},{"number":1355,"text":"  boundary.\n"},{"number":1356,"text":"\n"},{"number":1357,"text":"A refusal records a decision about authority; it does not by itself\n"},{"number":1358,"text":"establish the absence of a mutation. Where an unauthorised mutation\n"},{"number":1359,"text":"occurred or remains possible within the material effect boundary, retain\n"},{"number":1360,"text":"the actual invocation, observations and uncertainty. Such a case does not\n"},{"number":1361,"text":"satisfy the evidence condition for `refused_effect`; its effect result\n"},{"number":1362,"text":"and recovery follow [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects) and\n"},{"number":1363,"text":"[ACTIVATION §5 Recovery](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart). `not_effected` means that\n"},{"number":1364,"text":"the intended outcome was not attained, not that no effects occurred\n"},{"number":1365,"text":"(P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1366,"text":"\n"},{"number":1367,"text":"`invokes_effect` exists if and only if a concrete invocation was\n"},{"number":1368,"text":"dispatched; `unauthorized` or `stale` readiness never dispatches it. The\n"},{"number":1369,"text":"immutable `EffectInvocation` contains no future disposition, and\n"},{"number":1370,"text":"`EffectDisposition` records the later outcome without rewriting the\n"},{"number":1371,"text":"invocation (P3, P6).\n"},{"number":1372,"text":"\n"},{"number":1373,"text":"Mapping of the dispositions to the core. Purpose:\n"},{"number":1374,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) places the results of\n"},{"number":1375,"text":"effects in the core. Material relation: whether an occurrence's effect\n"},{"number":1376,"text":"may be repeated or relied on, which is the material relation of\n"},{"number":1377,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects) (P5, P6). An occurrence\n"},{"number":1378,"text":"intends an effect when an `EffectInvocation` names it. For such an\n"},{"number":1379,"text":"occurrence the disposition refines ACTIVATION §3 Effects and maps for its\n"},{"number":1380,"text":"predicate, \"the intended effect occurred\"; the causes of the two\n"},{"number":1381,"text":"`partial_effect` values are those stated under\n"},{"number":1382,"text":"[Closed constraint, judgment, residual and stop kinds](#closed-constraint-judgment-residual-and-stop-kinds):\n"},{"number":1383,"text":"\n"},{"number":1384,"text":"| Disposition | Effects value | Core value | Ground |\n"},{"number":1385,"text":"|---|---|---|---|\n"},{"number":1386,"text":"| `completed_effect` | `completed` | satisfied | the bounded post-observation and sufficient effect evidence establish that the intended effect occurred and that the effect has ended |\n"},{"number":1387,"text":"| `partial_effect(not_attained)` | `not_effected` | falsified | the admitted evidence establishes that the intended outcome is not attained and that no later completion of the effect can attain it; the part that did occur is named with the value, and an end of the effect that the evidence does not establish is recorded beside it, not in it |\n"},{"number":1388,"text":"| `partial_effect(undecided)` | `completion_unknown` | indeterminate | the evidence cannot decide whether the intended outcome is or will be reached |\n"},{"number":1389,"text":"| `refused_effect` | `not_effected` | falsified | the evidence shows that no mutation began within the material effect boundary |\n"},{"number":1390,"text":"| `no_effect` | `not_effected` | falsified | the admitted disposition records that no invocation was dispatched, and the record is exact because `invokes_effect` exists if and only if one was; so the occurrence effected nothing on the subject |\n"},{"number":1391,"text":"\n"},{"number":1392,"text":"An occurrence that no `EffectInvocation` names intends no effect.\n"},{"number":1393,"text":"ACTIVATION §3 Effects poses no predicate for it, and its `no_effect`\n"},{"number":1394,"text":"records only that no domain effect was attempted: it is a record, not an\n"},{"number":1395,"text":"effect result (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1396,"text":"\n"},{"number":1397,"text":"`j_ready` judges the unchanged `EffectSubject` immediately before effect\n"},{"number":1398,"text":"dispatch under the application's declared currentness and invalidation\n"},{"number":1399,"text":"law. If the pre-observation or the grant has become stale, the effect does\n"},{"number":1400,"text":"not start; the application re-observes and issues a new readiness subject\n"},{"number":1401,"text":"and judgment, or stops. If an effect has begun and cannot establish a\n"},{"number":1402,"text":"complete disposition, `partial_effect` stays explicit and a bounded\n"},{"number":1403,"text":"post-effect observation is required. This law requires no lock or\n"},{"number":1404,"text":"transaction implementation (P5, P6).\n"},{"number":1405,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1416,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Mutable-subject effect relation/OP-005 Mutable reality conservation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FMutable-subject%20effect%20relation%2FOP-005%20Mutable%20reality%20conservation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"b91c230c6b2253bd47749c867422bae23a371f663c5feb38ad72b480e95c5efe","start_line":1406,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1406,"text":"### OP-005 Mutable reality conservation\n"},{"number":1407,"text":"\n"},{"number":1408,"text":"`W` remains the carrier of mutable reality. Observation, evidence, result,\n"},{"number":1409,"text":"checkpoint, event, projection, cache or model content may describe `W`;\n"},{"number":1410,"text":"none replaces it. A later traversal application observes the then-current\n"},{"number":1411,"text":"`W` under the stable binding when authority is unchanged (P3, P0).\n"},{"number":1412,"text":"\n"},{"number":1413,"text":"Snapshotting or rollback may be supplied by a separately authorised\n"},{"number":1414,"text":"application. This profile neither requires nor forbids it and does not\n"},{"number":1415,"text":"infer rollback from a new occurrence (P6).\n"},{"number":1416,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1423,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Mutable-subject effect relation/OP-006 Immutable iteration history","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FMutable-subject%20effect%20relation%2FOP-006%20Immutable%20iteration%20history","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"1f030c71e6ac9bd40ae01b0c2c908f7654531be25a3a4132f47c95ff7e487e6f","start_line":1417,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1417,"text":"### OP-006 Immutable iteration history\n"},{"number":1418,"text":"\n"},{"number":1419,"text":"Iteration does not mutate an earlier occurrence. Each traversal\n"},{"number":1420,"text":"reapplication mints a fresh immutable occurrence over the evolving\n"},{"number":1421,"text":"subject, so the admitted occurrence and event history is append-only even\n"},{"number":1422,"text":"when the external subject changes repeatedly (P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":1423,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1444,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Event frontier and projection","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FEvent%20frontier%20and%20projection","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"89ff715ce2c071d3ff75a992ba3a6eb3dcf170b1fd1ef7e8ccfc906bde80b6a9","start_line":1424,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1424,"text":"## Event frontier and projection\n"},{"number":1425,"text":"\n"},{"number":1426,"text":"An `EventFrontier` binds the complete member set of events evaluated, its\n"},{"number":1427,"text":"exact basis and its declared precedence law. A projection judgment points\n"},{"number":1428,"text":"to one unchanged `Projection` identity and digest, and that projection\n"},{"number":1429,"text":"binds exactly one unchanged frontier (P3).\n"},{"number":1430,"text":"\n"},{"number":1431,"text":"For profile basis `b`, scope `s` and precedence law `p` there is one empty\n"},{"number":1432,"text":"frontier `F_0(b,s,p)`. Admitting event `e_k_plus_1` constructs a successor\n"},{"number":1433,"text":"whose member set is exactly `members(F_k) union {e_k_plus_1}`. Frontier\n"},{"number":1434,"text":"identity binds the profile basis, scope, precedence law, sorted event\n"},{"number":1435,"text":"identities and event content digests. Projection identity binds the exact\n"},{"number":1436,"text":"frontier, the projection rule, and the selected relation, boundary and\n"},{"number":1437,"text":"residual ids (P3, P4b).\n"},{"number":1438,"text":"\n"},{"number":1439,"text":"New events create a new frontier, and a prior projection does not silently\n"},{"number":1440,"text":"advance. Latest-only summaries do not prove frontier completeness.\n"},{"number":1441,"text":"Competing corrections, unresolved scope, missing causal inputs or a stale\n"},{"number":1442,"text":"basis remain residuals or stops according to the selected projection law\n"},{"number":1443,"text":"(P3, P5).\n"},{"number":1444,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1451,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Event frontier and projection/OP-007 Scope conservation","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FEvent%20frontier%20and%20projection%2FOP-007%20Scope%20conservation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"5275a749fa28004bc44d4d55ce7748c68d74941e63c21c5bbe7f76c0f313cdfd","start_line":1445,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1445,"text":"### OP-007 Scope conservation\n"},{"number":1446,"text":"\n"},{"number":1447,"text":"Every event carries its declared scope class. `event_for` is present only\n"},{"number":1448,"text":"when the scope law names one exact occurrence. Facts that are\n"},{"number":1449,"text":"subject-wide, publication-wide or otherwise independent of any occurrence\n"},{"number":1450,"text":"stay independent (P3).\n"},{"number":1451,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1477,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Authority and adoption","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FAuthority%20and%20adoption","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"a6eb5d5d9596caf28e0728df4bbe81a0c2d5e8c5dd5acbae7edad5b9eae1f217","start_line":1452,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1452,"text":"## Authority and adoption\n"},{"number":1453,"text":"\n"},{"number":1454,"text":"This profile owns only the application-neutral record, relation, identity,\n"},{"number":1455,"text":"causal, effect-boundary, frontier and refusal laws above. It grants no\n"},{"number":1456,"text":"semantic, operation, evaluation, admission, decision, correction,\n"},{"number":1457,"text":"continuation or closure authority. Every material operation and judgment\n"},{"number":1458,"text":"resolves an existing owner-issued grant. Copying a profile record or\n"},{"number":1459,"text":"adopting the profile transfers no authority (P6).\n"},{"number":1460,"text":"\n"},{"number":1461,"text":"Only Product authority adopts the profile, as\n"},{"number":1462,"text":"[PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#7-collective-reference-frame-basis)\n"},{"number":1463,"text":"states for every available profile; this section adds no adopter. For\n"},{"number":1464,"text":"this profile, a Product adoption declares at least (P6, P1):\n"},{"number":1465,"text":"\n"},{"number":1466,"text":"- the exact traversal-occurrence-profile basis;\n"},{"number":1467,"text":"- the exact subject and subject-binding interpretation;\n"},{"number":1468,"text":"- mappings from Product concepts to profile sorts and relation kinds;\n"},{"number":1469,"text":"- operation, actor, executor, admission, projection and decision\n"},{"number":1470,"text":"  authorities;\n"},{"number":1471,"text":"- event scope and frontier laws;\n"},{"number":1472,"text":"- invalidation and re-entry conditions; and\n"},{"number":1473,"text":"- qualification evidence proving that no Product distinction was lost.\n"},{"number":1474,"text":"\n"},{"number":1475,"text":"An absent or incomplete adoption means the profile is available but\n"},{"number":1476,"text":"inactive for that Product (P6).\n"},{"number":1477,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":1483,"heading":"TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE/Exact profile identity","id":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE%2FExact%20profile%20identity","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","sha256":"0fcd09c3375872e99986bf7b2e38c91455c1456651b670145f24b6a542dd5dc4","start_line":1478,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/run-coherent-003/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5/source/standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md","lines":[{"number":1478,"text":"## Exact profile identity\n"},{"number":1479,"text":"\n"},{"number":1480,"text":"The stable concept identity does not identify one immutable profile\n"},{"number":1481,"text":"edition. Position\n"},{"number":51,"text":"\n"},{"number":52,"text":"This profile exists to make one instruction precise: \"using the UX\n"},{"number":53,"text":"profile, build this UI surface\" (P2). It adopts the Elm\n"},{"number":54,"text":"Architecture (TEA) as its constitutional process model: the view is a\n"},{"number":55,"text":"pure projection of typed state; state transitions are pure reductions\n"},{"number":56,"text":"over typed messages; side effects are values the reducer describes and a\n"},{"number":57,"text":"declared effect membrane interprets; the runtime owns lifecycle and the\n"},{"number":58,"text":"view does not own continuation (P0, P1). Product truth and admitted carriers\n"},{"number":213,"text":"\n"},{"number":214,"text":"UX surfaces are projection and control surfaces: they render admitted\n"},{"number":215,"text":"truth and emit typed messages (P6, P0). A UX-local Msg\n"},{"number":216,"text":"may govern view-local concerns such as expansion state, sort order,\n"},{"number":217,"text":"filter text, focus movement or draft input. A Msg that changes product\n"},{"number":218,"text":"truth is not merely a UX concern. Product-truth changes include:\n"},{"number":219,"text":"\n"},{"number":220,"text":"- writing, creating, moving or deleting assets;\n"},{"number":221,"text":"- changing Context, selection authority, pinning or global product state;\n"},{"number":222,"text":"- spawning, attaching or resuming sessions;\n"},{"number":223,"text":"- dispatching agents, jobs, workorders, graph calls or runtime commands;\n"},{"number":224,"text":"- changing closure, approval, continuation, lineage, provenance or\n"},{"number":225,"text":"  evidence;\n"},{"number":226,"text":"- publishing, accepting, rejecting or superseding product records.\n"},{"number":227,"text":"\n"},{"number":228,"text":"Such a message maps to one admitted product carrier (P6, P4a):\n"},{"number":229,"text":"\n"},{"number":230,"text":"- an AssetSurface action;\n"},{"number":231,"text":"- a published graph function or lawful graph-function composition;\n"},{"number":232,"text":"- a workorder, job or runtime command admitted by the product's design;\n"},{"number":233,"text":"- an ABG event or command boundary where ABG is the runtime authority;\n"},{"number":234,"text":"- another typed product contract named by the design module.\n"},{"number":235,"text":"\n"},{"number":236,"text":"The UX layer does not become the hidden constructive carrier. If no\n"},{"number":237,"text":"admitted carrier exists for a product-truth-changing message, the UX\n"},{"number":238,"text":"surface is blocked until the carrier is authored or the requirement is\n"},{"number":239,"text":"repriced (P6, P5; §15 states the result).\n"},{"number":240,"text":"\n"}]},{"end_line":262,"heading":"UX/4.
